10.1002/hec.70014.abstractZh: 在英国国家医疗服务体系中，大多数患者可以通过在线平台向诊所发送书面请求，同时也可以选择亲自前往诊所。然而，人们担心在线渠道的可用性可能会对老年或低社会经济地位群体的医疗服务产生不利影响。为了探讨这些担忧，我们研究了2019年和2020年间289家诊所在线渠道实施的差异，这些诊所服务的患者总数超过250万，主要分布在伦敦西北部地区。我们发现，在线渠道的使用并未对初级医疗中的年龄和社会经济不平等现象产生显著影响，但所有类型的互动都有所增加，在某些情况下，非计划性住院治疗的次数略有减少（最坏情况下，没有变化）。这些发现表明，提供在线渠道可以提升医疗服务水平，而不会对老年或低社会经济地位群体的患者造成不利影响。

abstract.text: Appearance-based bullying is common among teenagers and may inflict substantial psychological harm on its victims. Overweight and obese students are both more likely to be bullied at school and more likely to engage in suicidal behaviors than their healthy-weight counterparts. This study is the first to explore how anti-bullying laws (ABLs) affect disparities in suicidality between overweight and obese U.S. high school students compared to their and healthy-weight counterparts. Using data from the National and State Youth Risk Behavior Surveys and a difference-in-differences approach, we find that ABL adoption is associated with a 6-19 percent reduction in suicidal behaviors among overweight or obese teens; estimates for healthy-weight teens are considerably smaller in magnitude and statistically insignificant. Weight-based disparities in suicidal behaviors are reduced most by ABLs among obese teenage girls. An exploration of mechanisms suggests that improvements in the quality of peer interactions in school-rather than ABL-induced changes in body weight (sample selection) or students' own-weight perception-generate disparate mental health gains for at-risk youth. We conclude that curbing targeted bullying based on appearance yields important health benefits.

10.1002/hec.70015.abstractZh: 基于外貌的欺凌在青少年中很常见，可能会对受害者造成严重的心理伤害。超重和肥胖的学生比体重正常的学生更容易在学校受到欺凌，也更容易出现自杀行为。本研究首次探讨了反欺凌法律如何影响美国超重和肥胖高中生与体重正常学生之间的自杀风险差异。通过全国和州级青少年风险行为调查的数据以及差异-差异分析法，我们发现实施反欺凌法律可使超重或肥胖青少年的自杀行为减少6%至19%；而体重正常青少年的自杀行为减少幅度则相对较小，且统计上不显著。在肥胖青少年中，基于体重的自杀行为差异通过反欺凌法律得到最大程度的减少。机制分析表明，学校中同伴互动质量的改善，而非反欺凌法律导致的体重变化或学生对自己体重的认知变化，才是导致高风险青少年心理健康差异的主要原因。我们得出结论，针对外貌的针对性欺凌行为控制能够带来重要的健康益处。

abstract.text: This paper investigates behavioral adaptation to local improvements in environmental quality. Using exogenous variation in village sanitation coverage generated by the randomised allocation of financial incentives to latrine construction in Lao PDR, we find that the generalized adoption of improved sanitation led to significant reductions in the practice of boiling water for drinking. Our analysis suggests that this change is likely a behavioral response to a reduction in the health benefits associated with treating water, which decline and eventually become negligible as local adoption of improved sanitation increases. Estimates of the value of time savings associated with the reduction in water boiling suggest that this adaptation is an additional important benefit of sanitation investments, most of which likely accrues to girls and women.

10.1002/hec.70016.abstractZh: 本文研究了人们对当地环境质量改善的行为适应。通过随机分配财政激励以推动老挝农村厕所建设，我们观察到，对改善后的卫生设施的普遍采用显著减少了人们煮水饮用的行为。分析表明，这种改变可能是对水处理带来的健康效益下降的一种行为反应——随着当地对改善卫生设施的采用增加，这种效益会逐渐降低，最终变得微不足道。关于减少煮水时间所带来的时间节省价值的估算表明，这种适应是卫生设施投资的重要额外收益，而这些收益大多惠及女孩和妇女。

abstract.text: Parents of children with disabilities may face higher labor-market penalties given the extra care and support required. Using Swedish administrative data, we focus on first-born children with Cerebral Palsy (CP) to estimate impacts on parental labor-market outcomes. We apply an event study approach to identify effects up to 10 years after the birth of the child. Our results show that employment and earnings of mothers decrease in the short run and increase in the long run whereas for fathers, a marginal decrease is observed in the short run. The effects differ by severity of the disability, with mothers of children with severe impairments driving the increases in the long run, whilst mothers of children with mild impairments appear to experience a penalty. Further, transfers and benefits from the Swedish social insurance system compensate parents for some of the potential costs associated with caring for a child with CP.

10.1002/hec.70017.abstractZh: 有残疾孩子的父母可能需要承担更高的劳动力市场成本，因为他们需要额外的照顾和支持。我们利用瑞典的行政数据，重点关注患有脑瘫的初生子女，以评估其对父母劳动力市场结果的影响。我们采用事件研究法，在孩子出生后的10年内进行研究。研究结果显示，母亲的就业率和收入在短期内下降，而在长期内有所上升；而父亲的就业率则在短期内略有下降。不同残疾程度的父母所受到的影响也有所不同：有严重残疾孩子的母亲在长期内能够带来就业率的提升，而有轻度残疾孩子的母亲则似乎面临一定的成本负担。此外，瑞典社会保障体系提供的转移支付和福利可以弥补父母在照顾脑瘫孩子过程中可能承担的一些成本。

abstract.text: Ban the Box (BTB) laws delay criminal background checks until the later stages of the hiring process. This study provides new evidence that BTB laws that apply to both private and public employers have negative spillover effects beyond labor market outcomes. Drawing on data from the National Vital Statistics System (NVSS), I investigate the impact of BTB laws on drug-related mortality. Two years after adoption, BTB laws are associated with more than a 35 percent increase in drug-related mortality among Black and Hispanic men. The main mechanism appears to be diminished labor opportunities. BTB adoption reduces wages and the probability of employment among Black and Hispanic men.

10.1002/hec.70018.abstractZh: “禁盒”法律将犯罪背景调查推迟到招聘过程的后期阶段。本研究提供了新的证据，表明适用于私营和公共雇主的“禁盒”法律对劳动力市场结果产生了负面影响。基于国家生命统计系统的数据，我研究了“禁盒”法律对药物相关死亡率的影响。在法案实施两年后，“禁盒”法律导致黑人和西班牙裔男性中药物相关死亡率增加了35%以上。主要机制似乎是减少了就业机会。采用“禁盒”法律会降低黑人和西班牙裔男性的工资和就业机会。

abstract.text: The value-based payment reform prompted by the Affordable Care Act has stimulated vertical integrations of healthcare providers and insurers. The consequences of these integrations may vary significantly depending on the markets and entities involved. This article points out the limitations of familiar binary classifications for provider-insurer integrations in prior studies. To address these limitations, we propose a framework and taxonomy that include four key aspects for examining variations in provider-insurer integrations. The first is from the care delivery perspective; it sheds light on levels of care services owned by an integrated system and their variation across regions within the system. The second is from the insurance markets' perspective; it pertains to insurance markets in which an integrated system competes. The third is from the organizational perspective; it points out that whether the insurer or the provider is dominant in an integrated system may affect the system's priorities-care delivery reform or cost containment. The last highlights the dynamics of integrated systems that can involve the other three. We offer these insights and their possible applications hoping to sharpen discussion and research on provider-insurer integrations, and to assist antitrust agencies in evaluating relevant legal cases under the 2023 Merger Guidelines.

10.1002/hec.70019.abstractZh: 《平价医疗法案》推动的基于价值的支付改革，促进了医疗服务提供者与保险公司之间的垂直整合。这些整合的后果可能因市场及参与实体的不同而存在显著差异。本文指出，以往研究中用于描述医疗服务提供者与保险公司整合的二元分类方式存在局限性。为克服这些局限性，我们提出了一个框架和分类体系，该体系包含四个关键方面，用于分析医疗服务提供者与保险公司整合的多样性。第一个方面是从医疗服务提供角度来考察；它揭示了整合系统所拥有的医疗服务水平及其在系统内部不同地区的差异。第二个方面是从保险市场角度来考察；它涉及整合系统所竞争的保险市场。第三个方面是从组织层面来考察；它指出，在整合系统中，保险公司或医疗服务提供者处于主导地位，这可能会影响系统的优先事项——无论是医疗服务改革还是成本控制。最后一个方面则强调了整合系统的动态性，这一动态可能涉及上述三个方面。我们提供这些见解及其可能的应用，旨在促进关于医疗服务提供者与保险公司整合的讨论和研究，并帮助反垄断机构根据2023年合并指南评估相关法律案件。

abstract.text: This study experimentally tests the impact of providing information about vaccine safety and efficacy delivered by Black health care professionals. We find that providing general information increases vaccination rates after 5 months by 8 percentage points (17%), driven by a 9.8 pp (24%) increase among white participants. Political affiliation emerges as a key moderator to explain this discordant effect. Across race, general information is more effective for politically moderate and conservative respondents, most of whom are white. Among this most vaccine-hesitant group, the information effectively addresses concerns about both side effects and unknown long-run effects due to the fast approval of the vaccine, increasing vaccination rates by 14 pp.

10.1002/hec.70020.abstractZh: 本研究通过实验测试了由黑人医疗专业人员提供关于疫苗安全性和有效性信息的效果。我们发现，提供一般信息在5个月后使疫苗接种率提高了8个百分点（17%），其中白人参与者这一比例上升了9.8个百分点（24%）。政治立场成为解释这一不一致效应的关键因素。在不同种族群体中，一般信息对政治立场较为温和和保守的受访者更为有效，这些受访者大多属于白人。在这一对疫苗持犹豫态度的人群中，这些信息有效地解决了他们对疫苗副作用以及由于疫苗快速批准而导致的未知长期影响的担忧，使疫苗接种率提高了14个百分点。

abstract.text: This paper examines the role of insurer size in price negotiations between commercial health insurers and hospitals in the United States. The empirical analysis focuses on a dominant insurer in the Arkansas individual health insurance market that experienced a size increase due to a policy change. Under the Affordable Care Act (ACA), Arkansas expanded its Medicaid program, but unlike other expansion states, it used individual plans-a private insurance option generally not designed for Medicaid-to provide coverage to newly insured beneficiaries. This unique policy nearly doubled the insurer's individual plan enrollment after the ACA was implemented. Admission-level regression analysis reveals that the insurer's hospital inpatient prices for individual plans decreased by 16.7% following the expansion. Consistent with the predictions from bargaining models, the findings suggest that the insurer's increased bargaining leverage due to its larger size is the primary mechanism behind the price reduction.

10.1002/hec.70022.abstractZh: 本文探讨了保险公司在美国商业健康保险公司与医院之间的价格谈判中的角色。实证分析聚焦于阿肯色州个人健康保险市场中的一家主导保险公司，该公司在政策变更后规模有所扩大。根据《平价医疗法案》的规定，阿肯色州扩大了其医疗补助计划，但与其他扩展州不同，它采用了个人计划——一种通常不用于医疗补助的私人保险选项——为新参保的受益人提供保险。这一独特政策使得该保险公司的个人计划注册量在《平价医疗法案》实施后几乎翻了一番。 admissions-level回归分析显示，在政策扩展后，该保险公司提供个人计划的医院住院费用下降了16.7%。与谈判模型的预测一致，研究结果表明，由于公司规模扩大，其议价能力增强是价格下降的主要机制。

abstract.text: Policymakers increasingly implement pay-for-performance schemes to incentivize quality of care. A key design issue when incentivizing several process measures of quality relates to whether the payment should be linked to the performance on each measure or whether the payment should be conditional on all of the process measures of quality being provided, which we refer to as "care bundling". After developing a theoretical framework of provider incentives under care bundling, we employ a difference-in-difference analysis to evaluate the Best Practice Tariff for fragility hip fracture, introduced in England in 2010, which rewards providers based on a care bundle of nine process measures that need to be jointly achieved. The design of the processes was evidence-based and the size of the bonus was significant, up to 20% of the baseline tariff. The results suggest that the policy was successful in increasing the proportion of patients for whom all of the criteria are met by 52.5 percentage points in the first 5 years after its introduction. Temporal ordering of processes might matter under care bundling, but we do not find evidence that English providers exerted less effort to meet process measures if they already failed to meet an earlier one. Overall, we find that a scheme based on care bundle, which is evidence based and uses a sizable bonus, can be effective in improving hospital performance.

10.1002/hec.70024.abstractZh: 政策制定者越来越多地实施绩效付费机制，以激励医疗服务的质量。在激励多个质量过程指标时，一个关键的设计问题是，支付应是否与每个指标的绩效挂钩，还是支付应基于所有质量过程指标的满足情况，我们将其称为“医疗捆绑”。在建立了关于医疗捆绑下提供者激励的理论框架后，我们采用差异分析方法来评估2010年在英格兰引入的最佳实践收费制度，该制度根据九个需要共同达到的过程指标来奖励提供者。这些过程的设计基于证据，奖金的幅度相当大，可达基准收费的20%。结果表明，该政策在引入后的头5年内，成功将满足所有标准的患者比例提高了52.5个百分点。在医疗捆绑下，过程的时间顺序可能很重要，但我们没有发现证据表明，如果提供者已经未能满足某个早期指标，他们就会减少努力来满足后续指标。总体而言，我们发现基于医疗捆绑、基于证据且使用较大奖金的激励机制，可以有效提高医院绩效。

abstract.text: The association between unemployment and health is well documented, but causality remains unclear. This paper investigates how pre-existing health conditions amplify the effects of adverse labor market shocks. Using variation in local unemployment generated by a shock in the petroleum prices that hit the geographic center of the petroleum industry in Norway, but left other regions more or less unaffected, our study reveals that workers with compromised health face a higher likelihood of unemployment during downturns. Heterogeneity analysis reveals differences in susceptibility based on gender, age, education, and job type. Females exhibit greater sensitivity to health, and the youngest age group is most affected. Furthermore, higher education and white-collar jobs correlate with amplified health-related unemployment effects. Conversely, poor health in combination with high age, low education, and blue-collar jobs increases the uptake of social insurance during the economic downturn, pointing toward the substitutability between unemployment benefits and health-related benefits.

10.1002/hec.70025.abstractZh: 失业与健康之间的关联已有充分文献记载，但因果关系仍不明确。本文研究现有健康状况如何加剧不利劳动力市场冲击的影响。通过模拟石油价格冲击对挪威石油产业中心地区的影响，而其他地区则受到不同程度的影响，我们发现健康状况较差的劳动者在经济衰退期间面临更高的失业风险。异质性分析显示，基于性别、年龄、教育和职业类型的不同，人们的健康敏感度存在差异。女性对健康更为敏感，且最年轻的年龄组受影响最大。此外，较高的教育水平和白领职业与加剧的健康相关失业效应相关。相反，健康状况不佳加上高龄、低教育水平和蓝领职业则会在经济衰退期间增加社会保险的领取意愿，这表明失业救济金与健康相关福利之间存在替代性。

abstract.text: Long-term care (LTC) provides essential support to service users and informal carers to improve their quality of life. By improving quality of life, LTC can potentially impact economic growth, for example, it may enable service users of working age and their carers to spend more time in paid employment. This study investigates the effect of publicly-funded LTC expenditure on a measure of paid production across local authorities in England. We analyze yearly data from 2014/15 to 2019/20 using a dynamic panel model estimated by the Arellano-Bond estimator. We find that a £1000 increase in LTC expenditure per client increases paid production per capita by £216 in the short run and by £670 in the long run. These findings may inform policy makers interested in assessing the financial sustainability of LTC policies.

10.1002/hec.70026.abstractZh: 长期护理服务为服务用户和非正式护理人员提供重要的支持，以提升他们的生活质量。通过改善生活质量，长期护理服务有可能对经济增长产生积极影响，例如，它可以使工作年龄的服务用户及其护理人员有更多时间从事有偿工作。本研究调查了英格兰各地方政府在公共资助的长期护理支出对有偿生产的影响。我们使用动态面板模型分析了2014/15至2019/20年的年度数据，该模型通过Arellano-Bond估计方法进行估计。研究发现，每名客户在长期护理服务上的支出增加1000英镑，短期内可使人均有偿生产增加216英镑，长期则增加670英镑。这些发现可能为关注评估长期护理政策财务可持续性的政策制定者提供参考。

abstract.text: This article examines the Online Elicitation of Personal Utility Functions (OPUF) method as a novel approach for health state valuation. While OPUF offers a structured, modular alternative to traditional methods, it also presents notable challenges. Chief among these is its reliance on compositional trade-offs between health dimensions (e.g., pain, mobility, anxiety), which may inadequately reflect how individuals experience health holistically. Additionally, OPUF's use of numerical rating scales does not guarantee that resulting utility values exhibit interval properties-a requirement for robust interpretation in economic evaluations. To contextualize OPUF within the broader landscape of valuation methods, this article introduces a classification scheme outlining alternative approaches and their respective trade-offs in terms of precision, cognitive burden, and feasibility.

10.1002/hec.70027.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在线个人效用函数提取（OPUF）方法作为健康状态评估的一种新颖方法。虽然OPUF提供了一种结构化的、模块化的替代传统方法的方式，但它也面临着一些显著的挑战。其中最主要的问题是，该方法依赖于健康维度之间的组合权衡（例如疼痛、活动能力、焦虑等），这可能无法充分反映个体整体健康状况。此外，OPUF使用数值评分量表的方式并不能保证得到的效用值具有区间特性——这是经济评估中稳健解释的要求。为了将OPUF置于更广泛的评估方法框架中，本文引入了一种分类方案，概述了不同方法在精确度、认知负担和可行性方面的优缺点。

abstract.text: This paper studies how ecological fiscal transfers (EFT) can affect child health by exploiting a county-level panel dataset, using variation across counties and over time in the implementation of EFT policy in China. Our estimates indicate that EFT leads to a significant decline of 0.121 in the under-five mortality rates. Notably, EFT can increase three types of public expenditures, environmental protection, social security and healthcare, due to the flypaper effect. It results in reducing air pollution, increasing rural residents' income and improving the supply of health care service, and causes the decrease of mortality rates. The health effect of EFT is more significant in counties with steep slope, high fiscal pressure and weak clan culture.

10.1002/hec.70028.abstractZh: 本文通过利用一个县级面板数据集，研究生态财政转移如何影响儿童健康，重点关注中国不同县之间以及随时间推移在财政转移政策实施上的差异。我们的估计结果显示，生态财政转移显著降低了五岁以下儿童死亡率0.121个百分点。值得注意的是，由于“飞纸效应”，生态财政转移能够增加三类公共支出：环境保护、社会保障和医疗保健。这些措施有助于减少空气污染、提高农村居民收入并改善医疗服务供应，从而降低死亡率。在坡度陡峭、财政压力较大且宗族文化较弱的县中，生态财政转移对健康的积极影响更为显著。

abstract.text: Competition between firms selling similar drugs is often fostered by policymakers as a means to curb pharmaceutical spending. While firms may compete within these specific drug markets, they also repeatedly encounter rival firms in different markets. This may shape competitive dynamics within and between markets. Yet, multimarket contacts, particularly relevant for multiproduct firms such as pharmaceutical companies, are often overlooked by pricing regulations. This paper investigates how multimarket contacts influence competition between pharmaceutical firms in off-patent markets. Using detailed product-level information on all retail pharmacy sales of generic statin drugs, we quantify the universe of multimarket contacts between firms in these off-patent markets, in Portugal, between 2015 and 2017. We then assess how multimarket contacts affect price competition. To do so, we explore the strict price regulation in Portuguese generic drug markets. Specifically, the Portuguese Internal Reference Pricing System (RPS) defines a price cap for each generic drug. Rather than examining absolute drug prices, we quantify the degree of price competition as the ratio between a firm's drug price and its regulatory price cap (price-to-cap ratio). We find that firms with more multimarket interactions set prices closer to price caps, consistent with the mutual forbearance hypothesis. This effect persists after controlling for brand status, lagged market share, and is not explained by common ownership. Our main results are consistent across alternative model specifications. However, due to limited within-firm variation over time, the effect is not significant in system generalized method of moment instrumental variable estimates. These results suggest that price caps may act as coordination anchors, thus lowering price competition between firms. Policymakers should consider targeted price cap adjustments as safeguards to preserve competition in off-patent drug markets.

10.1002/hec.70029.abstractZh: 制药公司在销售类似药品时，常常受到政策制定者的鼓励，以此作为抑制医药支出的一项手段。虽然这些制药公司可能在这些特定药品市场上进行竞争，但它们也经常在不同市场上遇到竞争对手。这可能会影响市场内部及市场之间的竞争动态。然而，对于像制药公司这样的多产品企业来说，多市场联系往往被定价法规所忽视。本文研究了多市场联系如何影响非专利市场上的制药公司之间的竞争。我们利用关于仿制他汀类药物所有零售药房销售的详细产品级信息，量化了2015年至2017年间葡萄牙非专利市场上制药公司之间的多市场联系。然后，我们评估了多市场联系如何影响价格竞争。为此，我们研究了葡萄牙仿制药品市场的严格价格监管。具体来说，葡萄牙内部参考定价系统为每种仿制药品设定了价格上限。我们不是考察绝对药品价格，而是将价格竞争程度定义为企业药品价格与其监管价格上限之间的比率。我们发现，具有更多多市场互动的企业会将其价格设定得更接近价格上限，这与相互克制假说一致。在控制品牌地位、滞后市场份额后，这种效应仍然存在，并且无法用共同所有权来解释。我们的主要结果在不同模型设定下都是一致的。然而，由于企业内部随时间的变化有限，这种效应在系统广义矩估计的 instrumental variable 中并不显著。这些结果表明，价格上限可能起到协调作用，从而降低企业之间的价格竞争。政策制定者应考虑进行有针对性的价格上限调整，以维护非专利药物市场的竞争。

abstract.text: The vast majority of youth e-cigarette users consume flavored e-cigarettes, raising concerns from public health advocates that flavors may drive youth initiation and continued use of e-cigarettes. Flavors drew further notice from the public health community following the sudden outbreak of lung injury among vapers in 2019, prompting several states to enact sweeping bans on flavored e-cigarettes. In this study, we examine the effects of these comprehensive bans on e-cigarette use and potential spillovers into other tobacco use by youth, young adults, and adults. We utilize both standard difference-in-differences (DID) and synthetic DID methods, in conjunction with four national data sets. We find evidence that young adults decrease their use of e-cigarettes by about two to three percentage points, while increasing cigarette use. For youth, there is some suggestive evidence of increasing cigarette use, though these results are undermined by pre-trend differences between treatment and control units. The bans have no effect on e-cigarette and smoking participation among adults 25 and over. Our findings suggest that statewide comprehensive flavor bans may have generated an unintended consequence by encouraging substitution toward traditional smoking in some populations.

10.1002/hec.70030.abstractZh: 绝大多数青少年电子香烟使用者使用有香味的电子香烟，这引发了公共卫生倡导者的担忧，他们认为香味可能会促使青少年开始使用并持续使用电子香烟。2019年，电子香烟使用者突然出现肺部损伤事件后，香味问题再次引起了公共卫生界的关注，促使多个州实施了全面禁止有香味电子香烟的禁令。在这项研究中，我们探讨了这些全面禁令对电子香烟使用的影响，以及可能对其他烟草使用行为的影响，包括青少年、年轻人和成年人的使用情况。我们采用了标准差异-差异方法（DID）和合成DID方法，并结合了四个全国性的数据集进行分析。研究发现，年轻人的电子香烟使用率下降了约2%到3%，而香烟的使用率则有所上升。对于青少年来说，有迹象表明香烟的使用率有所上升，但这些结果受到处理组和对照组之间趋势差异的削弱。对于25岁及以上的成年人来说，这些禁令对电子香烟和吸烟的参与率没有影响。我们的研究结果表明，全州范围内的全面禁止香味禁令可能在某些人群中产生了意想不到的后果，即促使人们转向传统吸烟方式。

abstract.text: This paper demonstrates how optimal policy learning can inform the targeted allocation of Indonesia's two subsidized health insurance programmes. Using national survey data, we develop policy rules aimed at minimizing "catastrophic health expenditure" among enrollees of APBD or APBN, the two government-funded schemes. Employing a super learner ensemble approach, we use regression and machine learning methods of varying complexity to estimate conditional average treatment effects and construct policy rules to optimize program benefits, both with and without budget constraints. We find that the financial impact of APBD enrollment over APBN differs with household characteristics, particularly demographic composition, socioeconomic status, and geography. Households assigned to APBD under the policy rule are typically urban-based with better facilities, whereas rural households with less accessible healthcare are assigned to APBN-a pattern intensified under budget constraints. Both constrained and unconstrained optimal policy assignments show lower expected catastrophic expenditure risk than the current assignment strategy. This study contributes to the literature on heterogeneous treatment effects, optimal policy leaning, and health financing in developing countries, showcasing data-driven solutions for more equitable resource allocation in public health insurance contexts.

10.1002/hec.70031.abstractZh: 本文探讨了如何通过最优政策学习来指导印度尼西亚两项政府资助的医疗保险计划的分配。利用全国调查数据，我们制定了旨在最小化APBD和APBN参保者“灾难性医疗支出”的政策规则。采用超级学习器集成方法，我们运用不同复杂度的回归和机器学习技术来估计条件平均处理效应，并制定政策规则以优化项目效益，无论是否存在预算限制。研究发现，根据家庭特征，如人口构成、社会经济地位和地理位置，APBD参保与APBN参保的财务影响存在差异。按照政策规则，城市家庭通常会被分配到APBD，因为这些家庭拥有更好的医疗设施；而农村家庭由于医疗条件较差，会被分配到APBN。在预算限制下，这种差异会更加明显。无论是受预算限制还是不受限制的最优政策分配，都比当前的分配策略能降低灾难性医疗支出的风险。本研究为关于异质性处理效应、最优政策学习和发展中国家医疗融资的文献做出了贡献，为公共卫生保险领域的公平资源配置提供了数据驱动的解决方案。

abstract.text: Noneconomic damage caps are controversial because they seek to balance uncertain benefits through reductions in physician precautionary costs, against uncertain harms to patient welfare. Opposing policy actions at the state-level reflect this controversy as some states have enacted noneconomic damage caps over the past few decades while others repealed their caps. Our difference-in-differences analyses suggest that repeals increase premiums. These increases are larger after State Supreme Court decisions, affecting all cases in a state, compared with State Circuit Court decisions affecting only specific cases. Magnitudes differ by physician specialty, with larger effects observed in obstetrics/gynecology and general surgery, compared with internal medicine. Our estimates of these repeals are larger than estimates on enactments reported in the literature, suggesting a potential asymmetry between enacting and repealing damage caps.

10.1002/hec.70032.abstractZh: 非经济损害上限存在争议，因为它们试图通过降低医生的预防成本来平衡不确定的收益，同时避免对患者福利造成不确定的损害。各州在政策上的不同做法反映了这一争议——过去几十年里，一些州实施了非经济损害上限，而另一些州则废除了这些上限。我们的差异比较分析表明，废除这些上限会导致保费上升。这种上升幅度在州最高法院的裁决之后更为明显，这种裁决会影响该州的所有案件；而州巡回法院的裁决仅影响特定案件。不同医生专业领域的影响程度也有所不同，妇产科和普通外科领域的影响更为显著，而内科领域的影响则相对较小。我们对这些废除上限的估计值高于文献中报道的关于实施上限的估计值，这表明在实施和废除损害上限之间可能存在不对称现象。

abstract.text: This study investigates the impact of transportation infrastructure financed by Chinese aid on child health in 11 sub-Saharan African countries using Demographic and Health Survey data matched with the precise geospatial features of transportation infrastructure. We find that an additional year of exposure to transportation infrastructure significantly increases children's height-for-age z-scores by 0.041 standard deviations and reduces the likelihood of stunting by 1.6 percentage points among urban households without migration experience, relative to children in the control group. Our analysis, which employs mother fixed-effects specifications, yields consistent results. Notably, we find that the positive effects of transportation infrastructure are primarily attributable to exposure during the construction phase of aid projects. The increased likelihood of mothers securing paid employment during this period may serve as a critical mechanism driving the observed effects of exposure to transportation infrastructure.

10.1002/hec.70035.abstractZh: 本研究利用与交通基础设施的精确地理空间特征相匹配的《人口与健康调查》数据，探讨了由中国援助资助的交通基础设施对11个撒哈拉以南非洲国家儿童健康的影响。研究发现，与对照组儿童相比，城市家庭中未经历过迁移的儿童的身高年龄z分数因接触交通基础设施增加了0.041个标准差，发育迟缓的可能性降低了1.6个百分点。我们的分析采用了母亲固定效应模型，得出了一致的结果。值得注意的是，交通基础设施的积极影响主要归因于援助项目建设阶段的接触。在此期间，母亲获得有偿就业的可能性增加，这可能是推动交通基础设施接触效应的重要因素。

abstract.text: We study the effect of framing informational campaigns scientifically or emotionally on the vaccination uptake of recipients with different educational backgrounds. 7616 Swedish mothers stratified by education received a leaflet on their children's upcoming HPV vaccination opportunity. The leaflet's framing was randomized between emotional and scientific, whereas the content remained uniform; control units received an uninformative reminder of the same length. We find substantial heterogeneity by educational background. Mothers with compulsory schooling exposed to scientific framing increased their uptake by 5.7 percentage points (7.25%). The effect was driven by less skeptical mothers with little previous HPV knowledge and higher engagement with the materials. Emotional framing decreased uptake by 4.8 percentage points (5.41%) among high school-educated mothers who read more superficially and were more hesitant at baseline.

10.1002/hec.70036.abstractZh: 我们研究了信息宣传的框架方式（科学或情感导向）对不同教育背景的受种者疫苗接种接受度的影响。7616名瑞典母亲根据教育背景被分为不同组，她们收到了关于子女即将接种HPV疫苗的宣传资料。这些宣传资料的框架方式被随机分配为情感导向和科学导向，而内容则保持一致；对照组则收到了同样长度的、信息含量较低的提醒材料。我们发现不同教育背景之间存在显著的差异。接受科学导向宣传的母亲，其疫苗接种接受度增加了5.7个百分点（7.25%）。这一效应主要出现在那些对HPV疫苗了解较少、且前期参与度较高的母亲身上。而情感导向的宣传则使高中教育背景的母亲疫苗接种接受度降低了4.8个百分点（5.41%）。这些母亲对宣传材料的阅读较为肤浅，且前期态度较为犹豫。

abstract.text: This paper studies the impact of stronger employer responsibilities for facilitating work resumption of sick or disabled workers on employers' workplace accommodation efforts during sick leave. We exploit a reform in the Netherlands that altered experience rating-that is, shifting the costs of sick leave and disability insurance to the firm-both for permanent and non-permanent employees. Using unique Dutch survey data on workplace accommodation of long-term sick-listed workers, we show that experience rating has no significant impact on accommodation efforts. Moreover, we provide evidence that the reform led to more firms opting for self-arranging both the sick leave benefits and the reintegration process of sick non-permanent workers, instead of using the public insurance scheme.

10.1002/hec.70038.abstractZh: 本文研究了雇主在协助患病或残疾员工恢复工作方面的更强责任感对雇主在病假期间工作场所安排措施的影响。我们利用了荷兰的一项改革，该改革改变了经验评级机制——即将病假和残疾保险的成本转移给企业，适用于永久性和非永久性员工。通过利用荷兰关于长期病假员工工作场所安排的独特调查数据，我们发现经验评级对工作场所安排措施没有显著影响。此外，我们有证据表明，这一改革促使更多企业选择自行安排病假福利和残疾员工的重新融入过程，而不是依赖公共保险计划。

abstract.text: The cover image is based on the article Long-Term Care at Advanced Ages: The Effect of Spousal Bereavement on Institutional Care Needs by Chantal Schouwenaar et al., https://doi.org/10.1002/hec.70043.

10.1002/hec.70069.abstractZh: 封面图片基于Chantal Schouwenaar等人撰写的论文《高龄期的长期护理：配偶丧亲对机构护理需求的影响》，DOI：https://doi.org/10.1002/hec.70043。

abstract.text: This paper studies the effects of quality oversight in the context of assessing kidney transplantation-related outcomes and possible unintended consequences (e.g., cherry-picking of organs and selection of healthier transplant candidates). In this context, we propose a stochastic economic model that identifies socially optimal kidney transplant choices given the inherent trade-off between the expected wait time and the quality of the received donor kidney for a given patient. Socially optimal decisions seek to maximize the utilitarian welfare function defined as the sum of all patients' post-transplant expected utilities. To determine the social loss, we compare the socially optimal decisions to those taken by a transplant program that maximizes its utility. We derive the optimal quality oversight policy that minimizes social loss and examine how decisions are impacted due to the changes introduced by the new Kidney Allocation System. Our empirical analysis using data from the Scientific Registry of Transplant Recipients and United States Renal Data System indicates that current quality oversight imposed through Conditions of Participation results in inefficient transplant decisions for 56% of recipients, and the performance is inconsistent across different regions and parameters. We propose that the risk-adjusted post-transplant performance assessment policy considers the factors impacting demand-supply parameters such as organ availability in the 11 US transplant regions, candidates' blood type, and the newly introduced Kidney Allocation System. Policymakers and providers can utilize insights from our findings to design effective oversight mechanisms and make informed decisions regarding transplant and waitlist management that yield desired outcomes.

10.1007/s10729-025-09713-x.abstractZh: 本文研究了质量监管对肾脏移植相关结果评估的影响，以及可能产生的意外后果（例如，器官的选择性获取和更健康的移植候选人的筛选）。在此背景下，我们提出了一个随机经济模型，该模型在预期等待时间和接受捐赠肾脏的质量之间固有的权衡下，确定了社会最优的肾脏移植选择。社会最优决策旨在最大化所有患者移植后的预期效用总和。为了确定社会损失，我们将社会最优决策与最大化自身效用的移植计划所做出的决策进行了比较。我们推导出最优的质量监管政策，以最小化社会损失，并研究了由于新的肾脏分配系统引入的变化而导致的决策变化。我们使用来自移植受赠者科学登记处和美国肾脏数据系统的数据进行的实证分析表明，目前通过参与条件实施的质量监管导致56%的受赠者做出低效的移植决策，且不同地区和参数下的表现并不一致。我们提出，风险调整后的移植后性能评估政策应考虑影响供需参数的因素，如11个美国移植地区的器官可用性、候选者的血型以及新引入的肾脏分配系统。政策制定者和提供者可以利用我们的研究结果来设计有效的监管机制，并做出关于移植和等待名单管理的明智决策，以实现预期的结果。

abstract.text: How performance pay affects physicians' medical service provision and the quality of care is relevant for researchers and policy-makers alike. This paper systematically studies how performance pay, complementing either fee-for-service or capitation, affects physicians' medical service provision and the quality of care for heterogeneous patients. Using a series of controlled behavioral experiments with physicians and students, we test the incentive effect of performance pay at a within-subject level. We consider a performance pay scheme which grants a discrete bonus if a quality threshold is reached, which varies with the patients' severity of illness. We find that performance pay significantly reduces non-optimal service provision and enhances the quality of care. Effect sizes depend on the patients' severity of illness and whether performance pay is blended with fee-for-service or capitation. Health policy implications, including a cost benefit analysis of introducing performance pay, are discussed.

10.1007/s10754-025-09390-x.abstractZh: 绩效薪酬如何影响医生的医疗服务提供以及护理质量，这一问题对研究人员和政策制定者都具有重要的意义。本文系统研究了绩效薪酬在补充常规收费或按人次付费机制时，对医生医疗服务提供及异质患者护理质量的影响。通过一系列针对医生和学生的控制性实验，我们在个体层面测试了绩效薪酬的激励效应。我们采用一种绩效薪酬方案，该方案在达到一定的服务质量标准时给予一次性奖励，且奖励金额随患者病情的严重程度而变化。研究发现，绩效薪酬显著减少了非最优的服务提供，并提升了护理质量。效应大小取决于患者病情的严重程度以及绩效薪酬是结合常规收费还是按人次付费机制使用的。文章还讨论了政策层面的意义，包括引入绩效薪酬的成本效益分析。

abstract.text: Based on the belief that fee-for-service reimbursement contributes to the overuse of costly medical procedures, policymakers have sought to cut payments for low-value services. Using a difference-in-differences model and Medicare claims linked with cancer registry records, we evaluate the impact of a large payment reduction for an imaging procedure commonly used in prostate cancer patients. We find that the payment cut did not affect imaging use, even in low-risk patients for whom imaging is not recommended. Our results suggest that supply may be relatively insensitive to fee levels when decisions about the use of a service are made exclusively by referring physicians, not the physicians who deliver and receive payment for it.

10.1007/s10754-025-09398-3.abstractZh: 基于“按服务收费”的报销方式会导致昂贵医疗程序的过度使用这一观点，政策制定者试图削减低价值服务的支付金额。我们通过使用差异-差异模型，并结合医疗保险报销记录与癌症登记数据，评估了对前列腺癌患者常用的一种影像检查项目进行大幅支付削减的影响。研究发现，即使对于不推荐进行影像检查的低风险患者，支付削减也没有影响影像检查的使用。我们的结果表明，当关于服务使用的决策完全由转诊医生做出，而不是由提供和接收报酬的医生做出时，服务的供应可能对费用水平相对不敏感。

abstract.text: The assumptions that distinguish bargaining models from one another are rarely observed, but can predetermine their predictions. In this paper, we map various popular bargaining models into vertical merger predictions across two competitive landscapes that consist of either one upstream firm and two downstream firms, or vice-versa. The models’ assumptions vary with respect to: (i) How parties bargain (Derived Demand versus Nash-in-Nash versus Nash-in-Shapley); and (ii) Over what (linear wholesale prices versus two-part prices versus quantity). The paper and accompanying online vertical merger simulator are designed to help economists and enforcers select the bargaining model that best characterizes observed pre-merger competition, and the loss of such competition following a vertical merger, in a given setting. The paper is designed to supplement the horizontal and vertical merger simulators that have been developed by economists who have served at the Federal Trade Commission and Justice Department.

10.1007/s11151-025-10009-1.abstractZh: 区分不同谈判模型的假设往往不易观察到，但它们确实可以预先决定模型的预测结果。在本文中，我们将各种常见的谈判模型映射到两种竞争环境下的垂直合并预测上：一种是上游一家公司和两家下游公司，另一种则是相反的情况。这些模型的假设在以下几个方面有所不同：(i) 各方如何进行谈判（派生需求模型、纳什-纳什模型、纳什-沙普利模型）；以及(ii) 价格结构（线性批发价格、两部分价格、数量）。本文及配套的在线垂直合并模拟器旨在帮助经济学家和执行者选择最能描述观察到的合并前竞争状况的谈判模型，以及合并后这种竞争如何丧失的模型。本文旨在补充那些曾在联邦贸易委员会和司法部工作的经济学家所开发的水平和垂直合并模拟器。

abstract.text: Quantifying individual latent health has potential value in healthcare policy. This paper constructs an individual-level health index using detailed population-wide registers for individuals at advanced ages. In the methodology, we use traditional and machine learning techniques. We provide importance rankings of health variables and evaluate their ability to form an accurate stratification of health states. The high dimensionality of our data allows us to derive a small subset of health measures that enables similar analysis in settings where individual health registers may not be available. Finally, we use our indices to forecast individual-level mortality.

10.1007/s13385-025-00417-8.abstractZh: 量化个体潜在健康状况在医疗政策中具有潜在价值。本文利用详细的人口登记数据，为高龄个体构建了一个个体健康指数。在研究方法上，我们结合了传统方法和机器学习技术。我们为健康变量进行了重要性排序，并评估了它们用于准确划分健康状态的能力。由于数据的高维度性，我们能够提取出一组简化的健康指标，这些指标可以在缺乏个体健康登记数据的情况下进行类似的分析。最后，我们利用这些指数来预测个体层面的死亡率。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Given that Korea lacks measures to promote cost-effective prescribing, this study investigated the efficiency of prescribers' decision-making when faced with the choice of 398 products containing 15 proton pump inhibitors (PPI). OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to explore PPI prescribing patterns in ambulatory care over 10 years and elucidate prescribers' practices. Further analysis was conducted to estimate the achievable potential savings, assuming that the recommendation of first-choice drugs is based on the rational use of medicines. METHODS: Retrospective PPI prescribing data from the ambulatory sector pertaining to medical services provided to the entire South Korean population from 2013 to 2022 were extracted from the Korean National Health Information Database; the data were analyzed to identify annual trends in PPI spending and utilization volume according to defined daily doses (DDDs). Unit price per DDD was calculated, and a preferred cost-effective choice with identical efficacy and safety profile was selected among PPIs. The potential savings were then simulated using Dirichlet distribution. RESULTS: In ambulatory care, PPI drug costs increased by 13.0% per annum over 10 years. The preferred substances were esomeprazole (31.6%), rabeprazole (23.2%), and tegoprazan (16.5%), which are among the most expensive PPIs. However, the most cost-effective substance was dexlansoprazole (South Korean won [KRW] 522.7; standard deviation [SD] = 72.2; and median = 583). If dexlansoprazole is recommended as the first-choice PPI in the Korean context, the estimated cost savings would be 404.24 billion KRW, equivalent to 47.0% of the current PPI spending in ambulatory care. CONCLUSIONS: This study identified opportunities for substantial cost savings related to PPI prescribing. Guided decision-making toward cost-effective PPI prescribing would increase the efficiency of prescribing and the sustainability of the healthcare system.

10.1007/s41669-025-00563-5.abstractZh: 背景：鉴于韩国缺乏促进成本效益性用药的措施，本研究调查了在面临398种含有15种质子泵抑制剂（PPI）的产品选择时，医生决策的效率。目的：本研究旨在探讨10年间门诊护理中PPI的用药模式，并揭示医生的用药实践。进一步分析旨在估算在假设首选药物的推荐基于合理用药的情况下，可实现的潜在节省金额。方法：从韩国国家健康信息数据库中提取了2013年至2022年间针对整个韩国人口的门诊部门PPI用药数据；对数据进行分析，以识别按每日剂量（DDD）划分的PPI支出和使用量的年度趋势。计算了每DDD的单位价格，并在PPI中选择了具有相同疗效和安全性的最佳成本效益选择。然后使用狄利克雷分布模拟潜在的节省金额。结果：在门诊护理中，10年间PPI药物的成本每年增加13.0%。首选药物为埃索美拉唑（31.6%）、雷贝拉唑（23.2%）和特格波拉唑（16.5%），这些药物属于价格较高的PPI。然而，最具成本效益的药物是德克索索拉唑（韩国元522.7；标准差=72.2；中位数=583）。如果德克索索拉唑被推荐为韩国环境中的首选PPI，预计节省的成本为4042.4亿韩国元，相当于当前门诊护理中PPI支出金额的47.0%。结论：本研究发现了与PPI用药相关的显著节省成本的机会。引导性决策以成本效益高的PPI处方方式，能够提高处方的效率，并增强医疗系统的可持续性。

abstract.text: Amid hospitals’ efforts to enhance operational efficiency and slash costs, addressing inventory inaccuracies in hospital pharmaceutical supply chain has gained urgency. Although radio frequency identification (RFID) technology effectively reduces such inaccuracies, its introduction in vendor-managed inventory (VMI) remains debatable for vendors given the impact of competitive inter-hospital environment and corresponding implementation costs. This study develops a three-level Stackelberg game model to analyze the vendor’s strategy regarding RFID adoption within the pharmaceutical supply chain, taking into account different types of competition between hospitals (i.e., public vs. public and public vs. private). We find that the vendor’s RFID adoption strategy under both forms of competition is counter-intuitive, with RFID being adopted even when the intensity of RFID in reducing inventory inaccuracy is low, provided the reimbursement rate for public hospital is high. Furthermore, homogeneous competition increases the vendor’s need for higher RFID intensity, while heterogeneous competition heightens the requirement for a favorable reimbursement rate. Finally, both homogeneous and heterogeneous competition can facilitate RFID adoption, with the preference depending on diagnosis cost, reimbursement rate and RFID intensity. This study offers fresh perspectives on the intricacies of vendors’ decision-making processes for RFID adoption in healthcare, emphasizing the significance of competitive dynamics and strategic management of medical consumables.

10.1016/j.cie.2025.111201.abstractZh: 在医院努力提升运营效率并削减成本的同时，解决医院药品供应链中的库存不准确问题变得尤为紧迫。尽管射频识别技术能够有效减少此类不准确现象，但鉴于医院间竞争环境的影响以及相应的实施成本，供应商在采用射频识别技术进行库存管理方面仍存在争议。本研究构建了一个三层斯塔克伯格博弈模型，以分析供应商在药品供应链中采用射频识别技术的策略，同时考虑了医院之间的不同类型竞争（即公立医院与公立医院之间的竞争，以及公立医院与私立医院之间的竞争）。研究发现，在两种竞争形式下，供应商采用射频识别技术的策略都是反直觉的，即使射频识别技术在减少库存不准确方面的效果较低，只要公立医院的报销率较高，供应商仍会采用该技术。此外，同质竞争会增加供应商对更高射频识别技术强度的需求，而异质竞争则要求供应商获得有利的报销率。最后，无论是同质竞争还是异质竞争，都可以促进射频识别技术的采用，而选择哪种方式取决于诊断成本、报销率和射频识别技术的强度。本研究为供应商在医疗保健领域采用射频识别技术的决策过程提供了新的视角，强调了竞争动态和医疗耗材战略管理的重要性。

abstract.text: We examine the relationship between firms' markups and the economic value of their innovation, including both the private value captured by the innovating firm and the knowledge spillovers that benefit other firms. Using a sample of over 14,500 EU firms and 2,400 US firms granted patents between 2005 and 2014, we find that innovation by high-markup firms is more valuable privately and also creates more external value. These associations are robust to controlling for the stock of past innovation and to estimating innovation value in various ways.

10.1016/j.ijindorg.2025.103186.abstractZh: 我们研究了企业加价与其创新经济价值之间的关系，包括创新企业获得的私人价值以及对其他企业有益的知识溢出效应。通过对2005年至2014年间获得专利的14,500多家欧盟企业和2,400家美国企业样本进行分析，我们发现加价较高的企业创新在私人层面更具价值，并且创造了更多的外部价值。这些关联在控制过去创新存量以及采用不同方法估算创新价值的情况下依然成立。

abstract.text: Solar technologies have been associated with private and social returns, but their technological potential often remains unachieved because of persistently low demand for high-quality products. In a randomized field experiment in Senegal , we assess the potential of three types of quality signaling to increase demand for high-quality solar lamps. We find no effect on demand when consumers are offered a money-back guarantee but increased demand with a third-party certification or warranty, consistent with the notion that consumers are uncertain about product durability rather than their utility. However, despite the higher willingness to pay , the prices they would pay are still well below market prices for the average household, suggesting that reducing information asymmetries alone is insufficient to encourage wider adoption. Surprisingly, we also find that the effective quality signals in our setting stimulate demand for low-quality products by creating product-class effects among those least familiar with the product.

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2025.103514.abstractZh: 太阳能技术通常与私人和社会收益相关，但由于对高质量产品的需求持续低迷，其技术潜力往往未能实现。在塞内加尔的随机实地实验中，我们评估了三种质量信号类型对提高对高质量太阳能灯具需求的潜在影响。我们发现，当消费者获得退款保证时，需求没有变化；而通过第三方认证或保修来增加需求则能带来积极影响，这与消费者更担心产品的耐用性而非实用性这一观点一致。然而，尽管消费者愿意支付更高的价格，但他们实际支付的价格仍远低于普通家庭的市场价格，这表明仅减少信息不对称性不足以促进更广泛的应用。令人惊讶的是，我们还发现，在我们的研究环境中，有效的质量信号会通过在那些对产品不太熟悉的人群中产生产品类别效应，从而刺激对低质量产品的需求。

abstract.text: I analyze the impact of air pollution on manufacturing productivity in India, examining how technology and adaptation influence the damages. Using firm panel and satellite-derived pollution data, I estimate the effect of pollution on productivity, with wind velocity serving as an instrument for air pollution. While sensitivity is detected among labor-intensive industries, no meaningful average effect is found. To explain these patterns, I present a model showing that firms adapt by lowering output to mitigate pollution damages and that industries’ production technology contributes to heterogeneity. Applying the model, I estimate that a one standard deviation increase in the labor intensity of production technology results in a 0.6 percentage point greater negative impact of pollution on productivity. The findings imply that the damages of pollution to profits are twice as high among adversely affected industries than the average and four times higher when inputs remain fixed relative to when they adapt.

10.1016/j.jdeveco.2025.103597.abstractZh: 我分析了空气污染对印度制造业生产力的影响，研究了技术和适应性如何对损害产生影响。通过企业面板数据和衍生出的污染数据，我估计了污染对生产力的影响，并将风速作为空气污染的工具变量。虽然发现劳动密集型行业存在敏感性，但没有发现显著的平均效应。为了解释这些现象，我提出了一个模型，表明企业通过降低产量来减轻污染损害，并且行业的生产技术也导致了差异性的产生。应用该模型，我估计，生产技术的劳动强度增加一个标准差，会导致污染对生产力产生的负面影响增加0.6个百分点。这些发现表明，污染对利润的损害在受影响的行业中比平均水平高出两倍，而在投入保持不变的情况下，其损害是适应情况下的四倍。

abstract.text: Long waiting times are a major health policy issue across many OECD countries, and have been exacerbated by the COVID-19 pandemic. For urgent care, such as for cardiovascular conditions, a major concern for patients is that health may deteriorate while waiting and waiting times could affect health outcomes. This study investigates the effect of waiting times on health outcomes and resource use for two common procedures for patients with coronary heart disease: coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) and percutaneous transluminal coronary angioplasty (PTCA). In addition to controlling for a range of patient characteristics and hospital characteristics (through hospital fixed effects), we pursue an instrumental variable approach. For each patient, we instrument the referral-to-treatment waiting time with a measure of provider congestion, which is calculated as the average waiting time of patients admitted to the same hospital and referred to the outpatient services in the 30 days preceding the referral of a given patient. We conduct separate analyses before (2015–2019) and after COVID-19 (up to 2021/22). Our IV results suggest that longer waiting times do not lead to higher mortality, readmission rates or longer hospital length of stay for either CABG or PTCA during the pre-pandemic period. Instead, we find that during the pandemic, when waiting times increased substantially, an increase in waiting time by two months for patients undergoing CABG leads to a 0.5 and 0.8 percentage points increase in 30-day and 1-year mortality respectively, and extends hospital length of stay by 0.2 days. These effects are particularly evident among older, more complex, and more deprived patients. There is no statistically significant relationship between waiting times and outcomes for the PTCA sample in the pandemic period.

10.1016/j.jebo.2025.107150.abstractZh: 漫长的等待时间在许多经合组织国家都是重要的卫生政策问题，而COVID-19疫情进一步加剧了这一问题。对于需要紧急治疗的疾病，如心血管疾病，患者的一个主要担忧是等待期间健康状况可能会恶化，等待时间也可能影响健康结果。本研究调查了等待时间对冠状动脉疾病患者两种常见手术的健康结果和医疗资源使用的影响：冠状动脉旁路移植术（CABG）和经皮腔内冠状动脉成形术（PTCA）。在控制了一系列患者特征和医院特征（通过医院固定效应）的基础上，我们采用了工具变量方法。对于每位患者，我们用医疗服务提供者拥堵程度来衡量治疗转诊的等待时间，该指标计算为在转诊前30天内，同一医院收治的患者转至门诊服务的平均等待时间。我们在COVID-19疫情前（2015-2019年）和疫情后（直至2021/22年）分别进行了分析。我们的工具变量结果显示，在疫情前的时期，较长的等待时间并不会导致CABG或PTCA的死亡率、再入院率或住院时间延长。相反，我们发现在疫情期间，当等待时间显著增加时，CABG患者的等待时间延长两个月，会导致30天和1年死亡率分别增加0.5和0.8个百分点，住院时间延长0.2天。这些效应在年龄较大、病情更复杂且经济条件较差的患者中尤为明显。在疫情期间的PTCA样本中，等待时间与结果之间没有统计学上的显著关系。

abstract.text: We examine whether ridesharing provides a meaningful transportation alternative for those who require ongoing healthcare. Specifically, we combine variation in UberX entry across the U.S. with the Treatment Episode Data Set to estimate the effect of ridesharing on admissions to substance use disorder treatment. People needing such treatment report transportation as a barrier to receiving care. We find that UberX entry into a Core Based Statistical Area has no effect on the overall number of treatment admissions. However, we find a decline in non-intensive outpatient treatment which is fully offset by an increase in intensive outpatient treatment. Given the required relative frequency of non-intensive and intensive outpatient treatment in terms of visits per week, our findings indicate that UberX helps to reduce transportation barriers to accessing healthcare. Event-studies show parallel trends in outcomes before UberX entry and results are robust to numerous sensitivity checks.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102941.abstractZh: 我们研究拼车服务是否为需要持续医疗护理的人群提供了有意义的交通选择。具体来说，我们将美国各地UberX服务的使用情况与治疗病例数据集相结合，以评估拼车服务对物质使用障碍治疗入院率的影响。需要此类治疗的人表示，交通问题是他们接受护理的障碍之一。我们发现，UberX服务进入核心统计区域并不会影响整体治疗入院数量。然而，我们发现非密集型门诊治疗的数量有所下降，这一下降被密集型门诊治疗的增加所抵消。考虑到每周就诊次数对非密集型和密集型门诊治疗的需求，我们的研究结果表明，UberX服务有助于减少获取医疗护理的交通障碍。事件研究显示，在UberX服务出现之前，治疗效果存在类似的趋势，且研究结果在多次敏感性检验中均保持稳定。

abstract.text: Policies that increase contraceptive access for young women and their partners are a potentially low-cost way of reducing unintended pregnancies and improving later life outcomes. Several states have recently implemented laws that allow pharmacists to prescribe contraceptives to women without the need to see a physician. We study the effect of these state laws on fertility rates. Using US Natality files for 2014-2020, we employ a difference-in-differences strategy using the 13 states that had enacted a law until the first quarter of 2020 as the treated group, and the 15 policy-implementing states post-2020 quarter 1 as the control group. We find approximately 0.5 fewer births per 1000 women aged 15-49 per quarter occur post law implementation, compared to control states. The effect of the policy appears to be focused among women aged 25-34 and 40-44 and women with a high school education or less.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102942.abstractZh: 为年轻女性及其伴侣增加避孕途径的政策，是一种可能低成本的方式，可以减少意外怀孕并改善其后期生活状况。最近，一些州实施了法律，允许药剂师为女性开具避孕药具，而无需看医生。我们研究了这些州法律对生育率的影响。利用2014-2020年的美国出生数据，我们采用了差异-差异策略，将2020年第一季度之前已实施该法律的13个州作为实验组，而将2020年第一季度之后实施该法律的15个州作为对照组。研究发现，与对照组相比，法律实施后，15-49岁女性每1000人中的出生数量减少了约0.5个。该政策的影响似乎主要集中在25-34岁和40-44岁的女性，以及受教育程度为高中或以下的人群中。

abstract.text: Employing more than 2 million emergency department (ED) records, we combine machine learning and regression discontinuity to document novel distortions in triage nurses' assessments of patients' conditions and investigate the short- and medium-term consequences for patients. We show that triage nurses progressively become more lenient during their shifts, and identical ED patients arriving just after a shift change are thus assigned a lower priority. We show that these patients receive lower levels of care and require additional emergency care afterward. We conclude that distortions in nurses' initial assessments of urgency bias' medical staff's perceptions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102944.abstractZh: 我们利用了超过200万份急诊科记录，结合机器学习和回归不连续分析，揭示了护士对病人病情评估中的新型扭曲现象，并研究了这些扭曲对患者产生的短期和中期影响。研究发现，护士在轮班期间逐渐变得更为宽松，因此，在轮班结束后到达的相同急诊病人会被赋予较低的优先级。这些病人得到的护理水平较低，之后还需要额外的紧急护理。我们得出结论，护士对紧急程度的初步评估偏差，影响了医疗人员的认知。

abstract.text: Traffic fatalities are the leading cause of mortality in the United States despite being preventable. While several policies have been introduced to improve traffic safety and their effects have been well documented, the role of transitory health shocks or situational factors at explaining variations in fatal traffic accidents has been understudied. Exploring daily variation in city-specific pollen counts, this study finds novel evidence that traffic fatalities increase on days in which the local pollen count is particularly high. We find that the effects are present in accidents involving private vehicles and occur most frequently on the weekends, suggesting potentially the missed opportunity to avoid these fatalities. We do not find similar effects for fleet vehicles. These findings remain robust to alternative specifications and alternative definitions of high pollen count. Taken together, this study finds evidence that a prevalent and transitory exogenous health-shock, namely pollen allergies, increases traffic fatalities. Given our lack of evidence of avoidance, these effects are not mechanical and are likely driven by cognitive impairments that arise as a result of seasonal allergies.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102945.abstractZh: 尽管交通事故是可以预防的，但死亡事故仍然是美国的主要死因之一。虽然已经采取了一些政策来改善交通安全，并且这些政策的效果已经得到了充分的记录，但暂时性健康冲击或情境因素在解释致命交通事故的变异方面的作用却尚未得到充分研究。本研究通过探讨城市特定地区的花粉浓度日变化，发现了新的证据：在花粉浓度特别高的日子里，交通事故的发生率会上升。我们发现，这种效应在涉及私人车辆的事故中尤为明显，并且最常发生在周末，这表明可能错过了避免这些死亡事故的机会。对于车队车辆来说，并未发现类似的效应。这些发现对于不同的花粉浓度定义和不同的模型设定仍然具有稳健性。综合来看，本研究证明了一种普遍存在的暂时性外部健康冲击——花粉过敏，会增加交通事故的死亡率。鉴于我们缺乏避免这种影响的证据，这些效应并非机械性的，而是可能由季节性过敏引起的认知障碍所驱动。

abstract.text: This study examines the causal effects of sunlight exposure on suicide rates. Leveraging county-month-year data on solar insolation and suicide rates in the U.S. from 1979 to 2004, we provide first robust evidence that insufficient sunlight increases suicide rates. We also find that insufficient sunlight increases Google searches containing depressive language, suggesting a potential adverse impact on mental well-being. Importantly, our findings favor a biological pathway over alternative mechanisms. The estimated effect of sunlight on suicide, often exceeding other interventions in magnitude, sheds new light on sunlight as a significant risk factor in suicide incidence.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102947.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了阳光照射对自杀率的影响。利用1979年至2004年美国各县的日照时间和自杀率数据，我们首次提供了强有力的证据，证明阳光不足会增加自杀率。我们还发现，阳光不足会增加包含抑郁相关词汇的谷歌搜索量，这表明阳光不足可能对心理健康产生负面影响。重要的是，我们的研究结果更倾向于从生物学角度解释这一现象，而非其他机制。阳光对自杀率的估计影响通常比其他干预措施更为显著，这为阳光作为自杀发生的重要风险因素提供了新的见解。

abstract.text: We analyse a model of optimal risk adjustment in competitive health-insurance markets which suffer from both ex-ante adverse selection and ex-post moral hazard. We find, firstly, that, unlike in an adverse-selection-only market, in an environment where also moral hazard is important, removing insurers' selection incentives requires risk-adjustment payments that do not fully equalize costs among consumer types. Current practice of attempting to correct for all predictable cost differences among consumers is then misguided. Secondly, if the sponsor of the risk-adjustment system is not only concerned with eliminating selection distortions, but also wants to redistribute towards high-risk consumers, the required higher risk-adjustment payments will introduce selection distortions in high-risk consumers' contracts. This leads to excessive equilibrium provision of care for those suffering severe health shocks. Finally, insurer market power creates countervailing incentives, helping the risk adjuster to combat selection distortions but working against a risk-adjustment regulation that also cares about redistribution.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102955.abstractZh: 我们分析了一个在竞争性健康保险市场中进行最优风险调整的模式，该市场同时面临事前逆向选择和事后道德风险问题。研究发现，与仅有逆向选择问题的市场不同，在道德风险同样重要的环境下，消除保险公司的选择激励需要的风险调整支付并不足以完全均衡不同消费者类型之间的成本。因此，目前试图纠正所有可预测成本差异的做法是误导性的。其次，如果风险调整系统的发起者不仅关注消除选择扭曲，还希望向高风险消费者进行再分配，那么所需更高的风险调整支付会在高风险消费者的合同中引入选择扭曲。这会导致那些遭受严重健康冲击的消费者获得过多的医疗服务。最后，保险公司的市场力量会创造相应的激励，帮助风险调整者对抗选择扭曲，但这也会对同时关注再分配的风险调整监管产生不利影响。

abstract.text: We explore the role of epigenetic biological age in predicting subsequent health care utilisation. We use longitudinal data from the UK Understanding Society panel, capitalising on the availability of baseline epigenetic biological age measures along with data on general practitioner (GP) consultations, outpatient (OP) visits, and hospital inpatient (IP) care collected 5-12 years from baseline. Using least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) regression analyses and accounting for participants' pre-existing health conditions, baseline biological underlying health, and socio-economic predictors we find that biological age is selected as a predictor of future GP consultations and IP care, while chronological rather than biological age is selected for future OP visits. Post-selection prediction analysis and Shapley-Shorrocks decompositions, comparing our preferred prediction models to models that replace biological age with chronological age, suggest that biological ageing has a stronger role in the models predicting future IP care as opposed to "gatekeeping" GP consultations.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102956.abstractZh: 我们探讨了表观遗传生物年龄在预测后续医疗利用中的作用。我们使用了来自英国Understanding Society研究组的纵向数据，利用现有的表观遗传生物年龄测量数据，以及5至12年间收集到的全科医生咨询、门诊就诊和住院护理数据。通过最小绝对收缩与选择算子（LASSO）回归分析，并考虑参与者原有的健康状况、基础生物健康状况以及社会经济预测因素，我们发现生物年龄被选为未来全科医生咨询和住院护理的预测因子，而时间年龄而非生物年龄则被选为未来门诊就诊的预测因子。后验预测分析和Shapley-Shorrocks分解表明，与用时间年龄替代生物年龄的模型相比，生物年龄在预测未来住院护理方面起着更重要的作用，而不是“限制”全科医生咨询。

abstract.text: We conduct a randomized experiment (n = 600) to evaluate a Supported Employment (SE) program that, through intensive job coaching and follow-along support, aims to increase work activity of Belgian Disability Insurance (DI) recipients with mental health conditions. The control group gets regular vocational rehabilitation. After a 30-month follow-up period, we find that SE increases the probability of working while claiming DI by 7.5 percentage points and reduces the amount of DI benefit received by 110 euros per month (-9.5 percent).

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2024.102958.abstractZh: 我们开展了一项随机实验（样本量600人），旨在评估一项支持性就业计划。该计划通过密集的就业辅导和后续支持，旨在提高患有心理健康问题的比利时残疾保险受助者的工作活跃度。对照组则接受常规的职业康复服务。经过30个月的跟踪调查后，我们发现该计划使受助者在领取残疾保险时工作的概率增加了7.5个百分点，同时每月的残疾保险福利支出减少了110欧元，降幅为9.5%。

abstract.text: Over 2005-2019, the number of neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) grew by 10%, and the number of NICU beds increased by 30%. This expansion in intensive care has raised concerns over unwarranted intensive care admissions. In this study, we examine whether the greater supply of NICUs causally raises admission rates. Our event-study results show that an additional NICU opening in a county raises the share of newborns admitted to the NICU by 8%. The majority of new NICU admissions come from healthier newborns (2,500 grams and over) rather than very premature newborns (<1,500 grams). Admission for the smallest newborns (those under 1,500 grams) only increases in counties with limited NICU access. In these areas, greater NICU supply also reduces mortality, but only for very small newborns (<1,500 grams). Together, our findings suggest a tradeoff, where higher NICU supply reduces neonatal mortality for the most vulnerable infants while also raising admission for healthier newborns.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.102967.abstractZh: 在2005年至2019年间，新生儿重症监护病房的数量增加了10%，而重症监护病床的数量则增加了30%。这种重症监护服务的扩张引发了对不必要重症监护入院情况的担忧。本研究旨在探讨重症监护病房数量的增加是否会导致入院率上升。我们的事件研究结果显示，一个县新增一个重症监护病房会使新生儿入住该病房的比例增加8%。大多数新入院的新生儿都是健康状况较好的（体重达到2,500克及以上），而非极早出生的新生儿（体重低于1,500克）。对于体重最轻的新生儿（体重低于1,500克），只有在重症监护病房资源有限的地区，他们的入院率才会上升。在这些地区，虽然更多的重症监护病房数量有助于降低死亡率，但这一效果仅适用于体重极小的新生儿（体重低于1,500克）。总的来说，我们的研究结果表明，在提高重症监护病房数量的同时，也会对最脆弱的婴儿降低死亡率，但同时也会使健康状况较好的新生儿更容易被收治入院。

abstract.text: We investigate whether increased racial diversity of clinical trial principal investigators could increase the enrollment of Black patients, which currently lags population and disease-burden. We conducted a survey experiment in which respondents were shown a photo of a current NIH investigator in which race (Black/White) was randomized. Sex was also randomized as a relevant benchmark. Black respondents reported 0.35 standard deviation units higher interest in participating in a clinical study led by a race concordant investigator (a 12.6% increase). Sex concordance had no effect. Further analyses indicate that perceived trustworthiness and attractiveness are the most important factors explaining these results.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.102968.abstractZh: 我们研究了临床试验主要研究人员的种族多样性增加是否能够提高黑人患者的入组人数，目前黑人的入组人数相对于人口和疾病负担来说仍然偏低。我们进行了一项调查实验，实验中向受访者展示了一位当前在NIH工作的研究人员的照片，其中种族（黑人/白人）是随机分配的。性别也作为相关的基准进行了随机分配。黑人受访者表示，参与由种族一致的研究人员领导的临床研究的热情高出0.35个标准差单位（即增加了12.6%）。性别一致性对结果没有影响。进一步的分析表明，感知到的可信度和吸引力是解释这些结果的最重要因素。

abstract.text: One in nine Americans smokes cigarettes, and a disproportionate share of smokers suffer from mental illness. Despite this correlation, there exists little rigorous evidence on the effects of smoking cessation on mental health. We re-use data from a randomized trial of a smoking cessation treatment to estimate short and long-term impacts on previously un-analyzed measures of mental distress. We find that smoking cessation increases short-run mental distress, while reducing milder forms of long-run distress. We provide suggestive evidence on mechanisms including physical health, marriage, employment and substance use. Our results suggest that cessation efforts and mental health supports are complementary interventions in the short run and provide new evidence of welfare gains from cessation in the long run.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.102969.abstractZh: 每九个美国人中就有一个吸烟，而吸烟者中患有精神疾病的人数比例较高。尽管存在这种关联，但关于戒烟对心理健康影响的严格证据却很少。我们重新利用了一项戒烟治疗随机试验的数据，来估算戒烟对先前未分析的心理健康指标的长期和短期影响。我们发现，戒烟会在短期内增加心理健康问题，但在长期上则能减轻一些较轻形式的心理健康问题。我们的研究结果提供了一些关于戒烟机制的建议性证据，包括身体健康、婚姻状况、就业状况以及物质使用等方面。我们的结果表明，戒烟努力和心理健康支持是短期内互补的干预措施，并且提供了关于长期戒烟带来的福利增益的新证据。

abstract.text: Studies indicate that mortality increases after income receipt. To explore whether this is due to increased economic activity around the period of receiving income, we examine within-month patterns in ambulance transport incidents, focusing on location and timing. Using Japan's National Pension payments made every two months, we compare the number of ambulance transport incidents on the day of pension payment and on surrounding days in payment months with those in non-payment months. The results show a 4.5% increase in ambulance transport incidents on the day of pension payment, linked to increased activities such as gambling, shopping, and dining out. We show suggestive evidence that income receipt boosts economic activities by the mechanism of easing liquidity constraints. These findings have implications for healthcare system preparedness and the optimal design of public benefit payment.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.102970.abstractZh: 研究表明，收入获得后死亡率会增加。为了探讨这一现象是否是由于收入获得期间经济活动增加所致，我们研究了当月内救护车运输事件的分布情况，重点关注事件发生的地点和时间。利用日本每两个月发放一次的国民养老金数据，我们比较了养老金发放日及其前后几天与非发放月份中的救护车运输事件数量。结果显示，养老金发放日救护车运输事件数量增加了4.5%，这与赌博、购物和外出就餐等活动的增加有关。我们有证据表明，收入获得通过缓解流动性约束的方式促进了经济活动。这些发现对医疗系统的准备程度以及公共福利支付的最佳设计具有启示意义。

abstract.text: The 340B Drug Pricing Program incentivizes healthcare providers to increase medication use. It does this by allowing certain safety-net hospitals and clinics to purchase outpatient drugs at considerable discounts from manufacturers but be reimbursed at full price by payers. Yet, previous literature has left largely unstudied how the 340B program influences physician prescribing behavior. In this paper, I provide evidence of physician agency among 340B providers in the treatment of breast cancer. I leverage the staggered diffusion of the program to identify the impact of 340B participation on prescribing behavior and patient outcomes. Physicians who join the 340B program increase the share of patients who receive pharmaceutical treatments and increase the intensity of per-patient prescribing. I also find significant increases in prescribing medications that are not included in clinical treatment recommendations and medications to treat side effects. Despite more intensive treatment use, I find no statistically significant change in survival.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.102971.abstractZh: 340B药品定价计划激励医疗提供者增加药物使用。该计划允许某些医疗保障体系下的医院和诊所以大幅折扣从制造商处购买门诊药品，但由支付方全额报销。然而，现有文献对340B计划如何影响医生处方行为的研究相对较少。本文提供了关于340B参与者在乳腺癌治疗中的医生处方行为的证据。我利用该计划的分阶段实施方式，分析了340B参与对处方行为及患者治疗效果的影响。加入340B计划的医生增加了接受药物治疗的患者比例，并提高了每患者的处方强度。我还发现，医生处方了那些未包含在临床治疗建议中的药物以及用于治疗副作用的药物。尽管治疗强度有所增加，但我并未发现患者的生存状况有统计学上的显著变化。

abstract.text: This paper examines the long-term impacts of growth and development monitoring in early childhood. For this purpose, we evaluate a public health program, the Systematic Management of Children (SMC), which offers growth and development monitoring through routine health checkups for all young children (0-6 years) in China. Using data on the program's county-by-county rollout, we find that full exposure to the SMC from birth increases adult income by 5%. We further provide evidence that the introduction to the SMC leads to improved physical and mental health, better educational outcomes, increased cognitive skills, and sustained use of routine health checkups among adolescents.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.102972.abstractZh: 本文探讨了早期儿童成长与发展监测的长期影响。为此，我们评估了一项公共卫生项目——儿童系统管理计划（SMC），该项目通过为所有0-6岁的儿童进行常规健康检查，提供成长与发展监测服务。基于该项目在各省实施的数据，我们发现，从出生起就接受SMC服务的儿童，其成年收入增加了5%。此外，研究还表明，引入SMC计划有助于改善儿童的身心健康、提升教育成果、增强认知能力，并促使青少年持续使用常规健康检查服务。

abstract.text: Theories of minority stress suggest recent legislation limiting LGBT rights can reduce the health of LGBT individuals and their families. We investigate how the creation of LGBT-free zones across Poland during 2019 and 2020 affected mental health and mortality. We find that annual suicide attempts increased by 16.5 %, or 5 attempts per 100k, deaths from external causes, including automobile accidents, suicides and other accidents and injuries increased 10.6 %, or 5.6 deaths per 100k, and suicide deaths increased 17.0 % (p = 0.108), or 1.9 deaths per 100k, in LGBT-free zones. The rise in suicide attempts was concentrated among individuals aged 13-18 and 45-49 and coincided with an 8.8 % increase in sales of prescription drugs for addictive disorders. However, there was no change in the use of psychotropic medications used to treat mental health conditions, indicative of limited access to mental health care.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.102973.abstractZh: 关于少数群体压力的理论表明，近期限制LGBT权利的立法可能会降低LGBT个体及其家庭的健康状况。我们研究了2019年和2020年间波兰各地建立LGBT自由区对心理健康和死亡率的影响。研究发现，年度自杀企图增加了16.5%，即每10万人口中有5次自杀企图；由外部原因导致的死亡人数增加了10.6%，即每10万人口中有5.6人死亡；而自杀死亡人数则增加了17.0%（p=0.108），即每10万人口中有1.9人死亡。自杀企图的增加主要集中在13-18岁和45-49岁的个体中，并且与成瘾疾病处方药物销售额增加了8.8%的时间相吻合。然而，用于治疗心理健康问题的精神药物的使用情况没有变化，这表明心理健康服务的获取受到限制。

abstract.text: We investigate the impacts on education and employment of a reduction in measles stemming from a nationwide immunization program in Mexico. The program lead to significant improvements in childhood health as measles causes "immune amnesia", leaving individuals susceptible to illness from other diseases. We find the measles vaccine led to large increases in educational attainment for both men and women, with the effects being concentrated in lower secondary school for women and split between lower and upper secondary school for men. Labor market outcomes also improved with women experiencing large increases in employment and men seeing significant gains in income.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.102974.abstractZh: 我们研究了墨西哥全国免疫计划减少麻疹对教育和就业的影响。该计划显著改善了儿童健康，因为麻疹会导致“免疫遗忘”，使个体容易感染其他疾病。我们发现，麻疹疫苗显著提高了男女的教育水平，其中女性的教育水平在初中阶段得到提升，男性的教育水平则分布在初中和高中两个阶段。劳动力市场状况也有所改善，女性的就业率大幅增加，男性的收入也有显著增长。

abstract.text: Public finance constraints following the 2008 financial crisis in Europe often affected the hospital sector. This paper investigates i) the causal health impacts of reduced hospital supply, and ii) possible mechanisms to explain these. Using a staggered difference-in-differences framework, we study the effects of hospital closures on outcomes of all heart attack patients admitted to an Italian hospital between 2008 and 2015. Results show that closures increased in-hospital mortality by 10 % and length-of-stay by 0.3 days, but had no impact on readmissions. We explore potential mechanisms using different estimation approaches, and show that increased travel time following closures explains most of the mortality effect.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.102975.abstractZh: 2008年欧洲金融危机后，公共财政的约束常常影响医院行业。本文研究了以下两个问题：一是医院供应减少对健康的因果影响，二是解释这些影响的潜在机制。我们采用分阶段差异-差异框架，研究了医院关闭对2008年至2015年间意大利某医院收治的所有心脏病患者的结果影响。研究结果显示，医院关闭使住院死亡率增加了10%，住院时间延长了0.3天，但对再住院率没有影响。我们通过不同的估计方法探讨了潜在机制，并发现关闭后患者出行时间的增加解释了大部分死亡率的增加。

abstract.text: We study the competitive effects of combination therapies in pharmaceutical markets, which crucially hinge on the additional therapeutic value of combinatory use of drugs and the therapeutic substitutability with the most relevant monotherapy. If the therapeutic value is sufficiently large, the introduction of combination therapies leads to higher prices and, somewhat paradoxically, may reduce the health plan's surplus, defined as total health benefits net of drug expenditures. If the firms are allowed to coordinate their price setting, this will lead to higher prices under uniform pricing but lower prices under indication-based pricing. Allowing for the latter type of pricing scheme might increase allocational efficiency, but only at the expense of higher drug expenditures.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.102976.abstractZh: 我们研究了药物市场中组合疗法的竞争效应，这一研究的关键在于药物组合使用的额外治疗价值以及与最相关的单一疗法之间的治疗替代性。如果治疗价值足够大，组合疗法的引入会导致价格上升，而且有些矛盾的是，这可能会降低健康计划的盈余，即总健康收益减去药物支出后的数值。如果允许企业协调定价策略，那么在统一定价下价格会更高，而在基于适应症定价的模式下价格则会更低。采用后一种定价方式可能会提高资源配置效率，但代价是药物支出会增加。

abstract.text: We analyze the short- and long-term effects of the U.S. Vietnam-era military service on veterans' health outcomes using a restricted version of the National Health Interview Survey 1974-2013 and employing the draft lotteries as an instrumental variable. We conduct inference on the health effects of military service for individuals who comply with the draft-lotteries assignment (the "compliers"), as well as for those who volunteer for enlistment (the "always takers"). The causal analysis for volunteers, who represent over 70% of veterans, is novel in this literature that typically focuses on the compliers. Since the effect for volunteers is not point-identified, we employ sharp nonparametric bounds that rely on a mild mean weak monotonicity assumption. We examine a large array of health outcomes and behaviors, including mortality, up to 38 years after the end of the Vietnam War. We do not find consistent statistical evidence of detrimental health effects on compliers, in line with prior literature. For volunteers, however, we document that their estimated bounds show statistically significant detrimental health effects that appear around 10 years after the end of the conflict. As a group, veterans experience similar statistically significant detrimental health effects from military service. These findings have implications for policies regarding compensation and health care of veterans after service.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.102984.abstractZh: 我们使用1974-2013年国民健康访谈调查的受限版本，并通过征兵抽签作为工具变量，来分析美国越南战争时期的兵役对退伍军人健康结果的短期和长期影响。我们对符合征兵抽签分配条件的个体（“应征者”）以及自愿入伍的个体（“自愿入伍者”）的兵役健康影响进行了分析。对于占退伍军人总数70%以上的自愿入伍者，这种因果分析在通常聚焦于应征者的文献中是新颖的。由于志愿入伍者的数据并非点识别数据，我们采用了基于温和的平均弱单调性假设的尖锐非参数界限方法。我们考察了包括死亡率在内的大量健康结果和行为，时间跨度长达38年，直至越南战争结束之后。我们没有发现与先前文献一致的、对应征者产生不利健康影响的统计证据。然而，对于自愿入伍者，我们发现他们的估计界限显示出在冲突结束约10年后出现统计学上显著的不利健康影响。总体而言，退伍军人从兵役中遭受的统计学上显著的不利健康影响是相似的。这些发现对于关于退伍军人服役后补偿和医疗保健的政策制定具有重要意义。

abstract.text: We provide new evidence on the returns to more targeted disability insurance (DI) programs in terms of labor force participation, program spillovers, and worker health. To do so, we analyze Austrian workers after a workplace injury that experience differential levels of application screening. We find that when workers face stricter screening, they are more likely to remain in the labor force. However, we estimate no statistical differences in any physical or mental health outcomes, and can rule out large effects on overall healthcare utilization. Our findings imply that imposing stricter DI screening can yield large fiscal benefits, on the margin.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.102986.abstractZh: 我们提供了关于更有针对性的残疾保险项目的收益的新证据，这些收益体现在劳动力参与率、项目溢出效应以及工人健康方面。为此，我们分析了奥地利工人在工作受伤后所经历的不同的申请筛选情况。我们发现，当工人面临更严格的筛选时，他们更有可能继续留在劳动力市场中。然而，我们并未发现任何身体或心理健康方面的统计差异，并且可以排除对整体医疗利用产生重大影响的因素。我们的研究结果表明，实施更严格的残疾保险筛选可以在财政上带来显著的好处。

abstract.text: This study evaluates Norway's Primary Healthcare Teams (PHT) pilot program, which introduced team-based care in general practice clinics to improve care for patients with complex conditions. Practices hired nurses and chose between an activity-based or block funding model. This analysis examines the activity-based funding model, which incorporated fee-for-service (FFS) for nurses. Using a difference-in-differences (DID) approach, the study assesses the program's impact on quality-related primary care services, out-of-hours care, hospitalizations, general practitioners' (GPs') working hours, and patient list length. The findings show that PHTs increased quality-related services for target groups (primarily provided by nurses) without affecting GP working hours or list length, suggesting that added nurse capacity was used to enhance care for target patients, not expand primary care access. There is little evidence of changes in healthcare utilization outside primary care, except a possible reduction in hospitalizations for type 2 diabetes patients with ambulatory care-sensitive conditions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.102987.abstractZh: 本研究评估了挪威的初级医疗团队试点项目，该项目在全科诊所中引入团队式护理，以改善对复杂病情患者的护理。诊所雇佣了护士，并选择了基于活动的模式或基于块的资助模式。本研究分析了基于活动的资助模式，该模式为护士提供了按服务收费的报酬。采用差异-差异法，研究评估了该项目对与质量相关的初级医疗服务、非工作时间护理、住院率、全科医生的工作时间以及患者名单长度的影响。研究结果表明，初级医疗团队提高了目标群体的服务质量（主要由护士提供），而并未影响全科医生的工作时间或患者名单长度，这表明增加的护士能力用于提升目标患者的护理质量，而非扩大初级医疗服务的可及性。除了2型糖尿病患者在具有门诊护理敏感性的情况下住院率可能有所下降外，几乎没有证据表明初级医疗之外的医疗服务利用情况发生了变化。

abstract.text: A strong regularity of human life is Gompertz's law, which predicts a near-perfect exponential increase in mortality with age. In this paper, we take into account that chronological age is not a cause of death and decompose Gompertz's law into two equally strong laws: (i) an exponential increase in health deficits as measured by the frailty index, and (ii) a power law association between the frailty index and the mortality rate. We show how the increase in the frailty index can be derived from the feature of self-productivity of health deficits. We explore the robustness of the Gompertz decomposition across countries, sex, and over time and show how information about mortality rates can be used to infer the state of health of an age-structured population. Finally, we use this method to infer the biological ages of past populations, such as Australians in 1940 and Swedes in 1770.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.102988.abstractZh: 人类生命中一个显著的规律是戈珀茨定律，该定律预测了死亡率随年龄呈近乎完美的指数增长。在本文中，我们考虑了年龄并非死亡的直接原因这一事实，并将戈珀茨定律分解为两个同样具有影响力的规律：(i) 健康缺陷的指数增长，这一增长可以通过脆弱性指数来衡量；(ii) 脆弱性指数与死亡率之间的幂律关系。我们展示了如何从健康缺陷的自生特性中推导出脆弱性指数的增长。我们还探讨了戈珀茨分解方法在不同国家、性别以及时间上的稳健性，并展示了如何利用死亡率信息来推断年龄结构人口的健康状况。最后，我们利用这一方法推断出过去人口的生物年龄，例如1940年的澳大利亚人和1770年的瑞典人。

abstract.text: During the COVID-19 pandemic, the federal government issued stimulus checks and expanded the child tax credit. These payments varied by marital status and the number of children in the household. We exploit this plausibly exogenous variation in income during pregnancy to obtain estimates of the effect of income on infant health. Data are from birth certificates and the sample focuses on mothers with high school or less education. The main estimates indicate that pandemic cash payments had virtually no statistically significant, or clinically or economically meaningful effects on infant health (birth weight, gestational age, and fetal growth outcomes), at least for the range of payments received by most mothers.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.102989.abstractZh: 在COVID-19疫情期间，联邦政府发放了刺激支票，并扩大了儿童税收抵免政策。这些补贴的发放情况因婚姻状况和家庭子女数量而异。我们利用这一在孕期可能出现的收入差异，来估算收入对婴儿健康的影响。数据来源于出生证明，样本主要集中在受教育程度为高中或以下水平的母亲群体。主要估计结果显示，疫情期间发放的现金补贴对婴儿健康几乎没有统计学上的显著影响，无论是在临床还是经济层面，至少对于大多数母亲所收到的补贴范围而言是如此。

abstract.text: We present the first survey-based evidence on infant mortality in a developing country during the COVID-19 pandemic. Employing high-quality, nationally representative data from India, our analyses document a significant rise in mortality rates among infants during a six month period in 2020 covering the pandemic and the ensuing lockdown. The difference-in-differences estimates show that mortality among infants at ages 1, 3, and 6 months increased by about 9, 13, and 16 deaths per 1000 births, corresponding to an increase of 30, 42, and 44 percent, respectively. Since COVID-19 had minimal direct impact on infant mortality, our estimates likely capture some of the indirect effects on infant mortality through income shocks, reduced healthcare access, and behavioral changes such as avoidance of hospitals for maternal care during this period.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.102991.abstractZh: 我们首次基于调查数据，对发展中国家在COVID-19疫情期间婴儿死亡率的变化进行了研究。利用来自印度的高质量、具有全国代表性的数据，我们的分析显示，在2020年疫情期间及随后的封锁期间，1个月、3个月和6个月大的婴儿死亡率显著上升。差异估计结果显示，这些年龄段的婴儿死亡率分别增加了约9例、13例和16例，对应的百分比增幅分别为30%、42%和44%。由于COVID-19对婴儿死亡率的直接影响较小，我们的估计可能反映了通过收入冲击、医疗服务的减少以及行为变化（如在此期间避免前往医院接受母亲护理）对婴儿死亡率的间接影响。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the impact of severe health shocks on labor supply decisions and domestic production within German households. We draw from the German Socio-Economic Panel (SOEP), focusing on individuals aged 25 to 55 at the time of their first observed health shock. After the health shock, we find that affected individuals suffer a persistent loss in annual gross labor income of around 4,000 euros. This effect results mostly from adjustments at the extensive margin, with labor market participation declining by about 16%. We observe a reduction in full-time employment, but no significant effect on part-time employment. At the household level, a combination of public transfers and added worker effect effectively compensates for the income loss. Finally, individuals experiencing a health shock, particularly women, spend more time on domestic production.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.102992.abstractZh: 本文研究了严重的健康冲击对德国家庭劳动力供给决策和国内生产的影响。我们基于德国社会经济面板数据，重点关注在首次遭遇健康冲击时年龄在25至55岁之间的个体。研究发现，受冲击影响的个体在年度总劳动收入方面遭受了约4000欧元的持续损失。这一影响主要源于广泛边际的调整，导致劳动力市场的参与率下降了约16%。我们观察到全职就业人数减少，但兼职就业情况并未出现显著变化。在家庭层面，公共转移支付和新增劳动力效应共同弥补了收入损失。最后，经历健康冲击的个体，尤其是女性，在从事国内生产方面花费的时间更多。

abstract.text: Temporal risk aversion can justify a social genetic insurance scheme, even in the absence of reclassification risk. I model individuals who take a genetic test in period 0 and may become ill in period 2. I show that redistributing from low-risk to high-risk individuals in period 1 can increase social welfare, even when the high-risk are not financially penalized. Temporally risk-averse individuals value reductions in the risk to their lifetime utility brought by illness, such as increased morbidity and mortality. A social insurance can achieve this by taxing the low-risk and subsidizing the high-risk. I calibrate a multi-period life-cycle model for breast cancer and Huntington's disease and quantify the optimal redistribution. For these two conditions, which are rare, substantial transfers to the high-risk can be achieved with minimal taxation on the low-risk. Thus, the welfare of the high-risk is substantially improved with little impact on the low-risk.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.102994.abstractZh: 时间风险厌恶可以证明，即使在没有重新分类风险的情况下，社会遗传保险计划也是合理的。我模拟了在时期0进行遗传检测的个体，这些个体可能在时期2生病。我表明，在时期1将资源从低风险个体重新分配到高风险个体，可以提高社会福利，即使高风险个体不会受到经济上的惩罚。时间风险厌恶的个体更重视因疾病带来的终身效用减少，比如发病率和死亡率的增加。社会保险可以通过对低风险个体征税并对高风险个体提供补贴来实现这一点。我为一个针对乳腺癌和亨廷顿病的多周期生命周期模型进行了校准，并量化了最优的重新分配方案。对于这两种罕见的情况，可以通过对低风险个体进行最小的税收负担，实现对高风险个体的大量转移。因此，高风险个体的福利得到了显著改善，而低风险个体的影响则很小。

abstract.text: Advances in evidence-based neonatal care have led to large improvements in the survival rates of high-risk newborns. Yet studies have documented wide variation in the care of more prevalent moderate-risk infants, who comprise a much larger proportion of admissions to neonatal care. In this study, we build on a small literature which uses quasi-experimental design to understand the impact of neonatal care, and for the first time, examine this moderate-risk cohort of infants. We use individual-level data on the full population of births in the state of New South Wales, Australia to examine the impact of neonatal care on the healthcare use of moderate-risk infants in the first two years of life. We implement a regression discontinuity design exploiting admission protocols based on birthweight among neonatal units of three different and explicit levels of capability. Unlike previous studies, which examine differences in outcomes across the high-risk cut-off at 1500 g, our study examines differences for moderate-risk infants born near birthweight cut-offs closer to normal birth weight (2500 g). While admission to the neonatal unit jumps across the cut-off, we find modest impacts on downstream healthcare use, including both in-hospital and out-of-hospital care. However, we identify heterogeneous effects across varying capability levels. Moderate risk infants admitted to lower capability neonatal units received more cost-intensive care, resulting in reduced healthcare use following discharge from hospital, while the same was not observed for those admitted to the highest capability units. We suggest that this is due to more aggressive clinical management at lower capability units, and leave this as a priority for future research.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.102995.abstractZh: 基于证据的新生儿护理技术的进步显著提高了高风险新生儿的存活率。然而，研究也显示，在更为常见的中等风险婴儿的护理方面存在较大差异，而中等风险婴儿占新生儿护理住院人数的比例要更高。本研究基于少量使用准实验设计的研究文献，首次对中等风险婴儿群体进行了研究。我们利用了澳大利亚新南威尔士州全州出生数据的个体级数据，来探讨新生儿护理对中等风险婴儿在生命头两年中医疗使用的影响。我们采用了回归不连续设计，依据出生体重将新生儿病房划分为三个不同能力等级，并分析了这种划分对医疗使用的影响。与以往研究仅关注1500克这一高风险分界点不同，本研究关注了接近正常出生体重（2500克）分界点的中等风险婴儿的差异。结果显示，进入低能力新生儿病房的婴儿在出院后医疗使用量有所减少，而进入高能力新生儿病房的婴儿则没有这种现象。我们认为，这是由于低能力新生儿病房采取了更积极的治疗措施，这一问题值得未来进一步研究。

abstract.text: International procurement institutions play an important role in drug supply. We study price, delivery, and procurement lead time of drug products for major infectious diseases (antiretrovirals, antimalarials, antituberculosis, and antibiotics) in 106 developing countries from 2007-2017 across procurement institution types. We find that pooled procurement lowers prices: pooling internationally is most effective for small buyers and concentrated markets, while pooling within-country is most effective for large buyers and unconcentrated markets. Pooling can reduce delays, but at the cost of longer anticipated procurement lead times.
