Increases in age at first marriage and first birth, which may have led to improved health-related decisions around the time of birth, appear to be the main drivers of the mortality reductions documented.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.103075.abstractZh: 我们基于17个国家的数据，研究了禁止童婚对下一代儿童死亡率的影响。我们分析了不同国家中母亲在多个队列中受到禁止童婚政策影响的程度，以及基于地区层面童婚普及率和禁止童婚政策实施前的结婚年龄计算出的“实施强度”。研究发现，禁止童婚政策降低了5岁以下儿童死亡率，其效果相当于实施强度增加一个标准差。首次结婚和首次生育的年龄推迟，可能有助于在出生时的健康决策更加合理，这些似乎是导致死亡率下降的主要因素。

abstract.text: This paper uses original panel data from Senegal to evaluate the effect of elderly household members' deaths on the educational attainment of female children. Using a triple-difference strategy with child fixed-effects, I show that the death of a co-resident aged 60 or older is associated with 20% additional education completed over a period of 4 years by affected girls. I present evidence that changes in demand for informal caregiving among adolescent girls within the household are one of the mechanisms at play. These results highlight the central role of female teenagers in caregiving activities and suggest that policies that increase the availability of formal care for the elderly could reduce gender inequalities in education in contexts similar to Senegal.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.103076.abstractZh: 本文利用塞内加尔的原始面板数据，评估了老年家庭成员的死亡对女性儿童教育成就的影响。采用包含儿童固定效应的三重差分策略，我们发现，60岁或以上的共同居住者的死亡会导致受影响女孩在4年内的教育完成程度增加20%。研究指出，家庭内青少年女孩对非正式照顾需求的变化是其中的一个机制。这些结果凸显了女性青少年在照顾活动中的核心作用，并表明，在类似塞内加尔的情况下，增加老年人正式照顾服务的政策可以减少教育领域的性别不平等。

abstract.text: This paper examines the long-term impact of West German television exposure on smoking behavior in East Germany, with a focus on gender-specific responses. Using data from 1989 and 2002 and leveraging quasi-random variation in West German TV signal availability across East German regions, we find that TV exposure led to a substantial increase in smoking among women - by 9.5 percentage points in smoking probability and 68% in cigarette consumption - while having no measurable effect on men. This asymmetric effect reflects divergent pre-reunification norms: under socialism, female smoking was heavily stigmatized, and exposure to Western media relaxed these social constraints. The behavioral shift persisted over time, with exposed women reporting worse physical and mental health and higher healthcare utilization in 2002. Back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest a sizable increase in smoking-related mortality and healthcare costs. Our findings highlight how cultural integration through media can alter health behaviors and generate significant public health externalities in transitional societies.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.103077.abstractZh: 本文探讨了西德电视对东德吸烟行为的长期影响，重点关注性别差异。通过1989年和2002年的数据，并利用西德电视信号在东德各地区的分布差异，我们发现电视接触使女性的吸烟概率增加了9.5个百分点，香烟消费量增加了68%，而对男性的影响则不明显。这种不对称效应反映了统一前不同的社会规范：在社会主义时期，女性吸烟受到严重歧视，而西方媒体的接触则削弱了这些社会约束。这种行为变化持续了很长时间，2002年接触电视的女性报告称其身体和心理健康状况较差，医疗支出也较高。初步计算表明，吸烟相关的死亡率和医疗成本都有显著上升。我们的研究结果强调了通过媒体实现文化融合如何改变健康行为，并在转型社会中产生重大的公共卫生影响。

abstract.text: Many European countries have raised the minimum legal drinking age (MLDA) from 16 to 18 over the past decades. These policies often comprise a bundle of reforms including restrictions on alcohol sales to minors, venue access limitations, and advertising controls. We provide novel evidence of the impact of MLDA changes on educational outcomes by exploiting their staggered timing across Spanish regions. Alcohol consumption among adolescents aged 14-17 decreased by 7 to 17% and exam performance improved by 4% of a standard deviation. We also observe a 10% decrease in the use of anxiolytics and hypnosedatives, suggesting improved mental health. There are no significant changes in the use of other substances, leisure habits or study effort. These findings are consistent with neurobiological evidence that alcohol directly impairs cognitive development and increases anxiety-related behaviours. Reducing teenage alcohol consumption represents a substantial opportunity to improve educational outcomes in Europe, where youth drinking rates remain notably high.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.103078.abstractZh: 在过去的几十年里，许多欧洲国家将法定最低饮酒年龄从16岁提高至18岁。这些政策通常包括一系列改革措施，如限制向未成年人销售酒精饮料、限制场所准入以及广告管控等。我们通过分析西班牙不同地区的政策实施时间，发现了MLDA变更对教育成果的影响。结果显示，14-17岁青少年的酒精消费减少了7%至17%，考试成绩提高了4个标准差。此外，焦虑缓解剂和催眠抑制剂的使用量减少了10%，这表明青少年的心理健康状况有所改善。其他物质的使用、休闲习惯以及学习努力方面均未出现显著变化。这些发现与神经生物学证据一致，即酒精会直接损害认知发展并增加与焦虑相关的行为。减少青少年的酒精消费为改善欧洲的教育成果提供了重要机会，因为该地区的青少年饮酒率仍然较高。

abstract.text: We consider how a physical disability alters patterns of time use. A disability may raise the time cost of some activities, making them differentially less worth doing; or it may make switching activities more costly. Both possibilities predict that fewer activities will be undertaken, with more time spent on each. These explanations describe our correlational findings based on non-working ATUS 2008-22 respondents ages 70+, 32 % of whom self-assess a disability. Data from the 2013 Polish Time Use Survey, where disability is medically certified, show similar results and demonstrate the same loss of variety over multiple days. Remarkably similar basic results are found using homogenized British, Canadian, French, Italian, and Spanish time diaries. Evidence from a "sesqui-difference" test on the ATUS data hints that the relationship is causal. Overall, a mobility/physical disability leads an otherwise identical person to engage in over 10 % fewer activities on a typical day. The lost variety represents extra costs equivalent in data from six countries to over twice the average annual income of older individuals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.103079.abstractZh: 我们研究了身体残疾如何改变人们的时间使用模式。残疾可能会提高某些活动的成本，使其变得不那么值得进行；或者它可能会使转换活动变得更加昂贵。这两种情况都表明，人们会进行更少的活动，并且每项活动所花费的时间也会更多。这些解释基于非工作人口的关联研究结果，这些受访者年龄在70岁以上，其中32%的人自我评估有残疾。2013年波兰时间使用调查的数据表明，残疾情况通过医学认证，结果类似，并且显示出在多个日子里活动种类的减少。使用英国、加拿大、法国、意大利和西班牙的均质化时间日记数据也发现了非常相似的基本结果。对ATUS数据进行的“三差异”测试表明，这种关系具有因果关系。总体而言，身体残疾会导致一个原本相同的人在典型的一天中进行超过10%的活动减少。这种活动种类的减少所带来的额外成本，在六个国家的数据中相当于老年人年均收入的两倍以上。

abstract.text: To limit price variation across consumers in the Health Insurance Marketplaces, the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act (ACA) mandates that insurance plans be uniformly priced across multiple counties within the same geographic rating area. However, the ACA does not require insurers to offer plans in every county, creating the potential for partial rating area offering. Using data from the federally-facilitated Marketplaces, we find that selective participation is both prevalent and persistent throughout the 2016-2022 period. We investigate whether this selective offering reflects anticompetitive market segmentation. In six of the seven years, the evidence is inconsistent with collusive motives. Only in 2018, a year characterized by a particularly low number of insurers with extensive multimarket contact, do we find evidence suggesting anticompetitive motives were among the drivers of selective participation within rating areas.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.103080.abstractZh: 为了限制健康保险市场中各消费者之间的价格差异，《患者保护与平价医疗法案》要求保险计划在同一地理评级区域内各县的定价必须统一。然而，该法案并未要求保险公司在所有县提供保险计划，这就导致了部分评级区域可能只提供部分保险计划的情况。通过联邦推动的市场数据，我们发现从2016年到2022年期间，选择性参与现象普遍存在且持续存在。我们调查了这种选择性提供是否反映了反竞争的市场分割行为。在七年中的六年里，证据并不支持勾结动机。只有在2018年，由于当时有较少的保险公司拥有广泛的跨市场业务，我们发现了反竞争动机可能是选择性参与评级区域内的驱动因素的证据。

abstract.text: This paper documents an important unintended consequence of expanding contraceptive access; it reduces the rates of adverse infant health outcomes. I study a large family planning initiative in the St. Louis metropolitan area that provided thousands of long-acting reversible contraceptives (LARCs) to reproductive-age women at no cost. Using a synthetic difference-in-differences design, I find that the program led to substantial improvements in infant health, reducing extremely preterm births by 2.18 and infant deaths by 1.74 per 1,000 live births, reductions of approximately 20% for each outcome. I find meaningful reductions for both Black and White mothers, though the effects on Black mothers are less precisely estimated and are smaller as a percentage of the baseline rates, particularly for extremely preterm births.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.103081.abstractZh: 本文记录了扩大避孕措施普及度所带来的一个重要意外后果：它降低了婴儿健康不良的发生率。我研究了一个位于圣路易斯大都会区的重大计划生育项目，该项目为育龄妇女免费提供了数千种长效可逆避孕措施。通过合成差异-差异设计，我发现该项目显著改善了婴儿健康状况，使极早早产儿数量减少了2.18%，婴儿死亡率减少了1.74%，每1000名活产婴儿中分别减少了约20%。我发现黑人和白人母亲的婴儿健康状况都有所改善，不过黑人母亲的改善效果估计较为不准确，且相对于基线水平而言，其改善幅度较小，尤其是在极早早产儿方面。

abstract.text: In light of growing concerns over escalating natural disaster risks and persistently low fertility rates, this paper quantifies the causal impacts of tropical cyclones and identifies the pathways through which they influence childbearing decisions among Australians of reproductive age. Using an individual fixed effects model and exogenous variation in cyclone exposure, we find a robust and substantial decline in fertility, occurring only after the most severe category 5 cyclones, with the effect weakening as distance from the cyclone's eye increases. We find no evidence of delayed cyclone effects, indicating that the fertility loss attributable to these most severe cyclones is permanent. Our findings are robust to extensive validity checks, including a falsification test and various randomization tests. The fertility decline is most pronounced among younger adults, individuals with lower educational attainment, those childless at baseline, and those lacking prior private health or residential insurance. While physical health, financial constraints, and migration appear unlikely to drive the effect, the evidence points to reduced family formation, increased marital breakdown, child mortality, cyclone-induced home damage, elevated psychological stress, and heightened risk perceptions as plausible mechanisms.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.103083.abstractZh: 鉴于对自然灾害风险加剧以及持续低生育率的担忧日益增加，本文量化了热带气旋的因果影响，并确定了它们影响澳大利亚育龄人群生育决策的途径。通过个体固定效应模型以及气旋暴露的外生变化，我们发现只有在最严重的5级气旋发生后，生育率才会出现显著下降，且随着距离气旋中心的距离增加，这种影响会减弱。我们没有发现气旋影响的延迟现象，这表明由这些最严重气旋导致的生育率下降是永久性的。我们的研究结果经过广泛的有效性检验，包括伪造测试和各种随机化测试，仍然保持稳定。生育率的下降在较年轻的人群、教育程度较低的人群、基线时没有子女的人群以及缺乏私人健康或住房保险的人群中最为明显。虽然身体健康状况、经济限制和迁移不太可能是导致这种影响的因素，但证据表明，家庭形成减少、婚姻破裂增加、儿童死亡率上升、气旋造成的房屋损坏、心理压力加剧以及风险感知增强可能是合理的机制。

abstract.text: Mental health stigma hinders access to healthcare by distorting belief formation and decision-making. Stigmatized individuals often underestimate their risk of mental illness and avoid diagnostic information. This study develops a decision-theoretic model that formalizes how stigma reinforces identity-congruent actions, driving belief distortion and information avoidance. By integrating insights from information preference theory and identity utility, the model explains why individuals with strong stigma-driven identity concerns are prone to optimistic bias and resist diagnostic tests to protect their self-concept. The study contributes to the literature in three key ways. First, it conceptually extends economic theory by endogenizing belief distortion, identity-congruent action, and information avoidance within a unified decision-making structure. By introducing stigma as a formally modeled individual-specific parameter - previously underexplored in economics - the framework improves our ability to capture heterogeneity in health-related decision-making and strengthens the theoretical bridge between economic modeling and clinical mental health research. Second, it provides a theoretical framework linking clinical phenomena such as denial, delayed treatment-seeking, and treatment discontinuation within a formal decision-theoretic model. Third, it offers a structured foundation for experimental and empirical research by demonstrating how stigma, a quantifiable construct, systematically influences decision-making through identity-driven actions and belief distortion.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.103084.abstractZh: 心理健康污名通过扭曲信念形成和决策过程，阻碍人们获得医疗服务。被污名化的个体往往低估自己患精神疾病的风险，并避免了解诊断信息。本研究提出了一个决策理论模型，该模型阐述了污名如何强化与身份一致的行动，导致信念扭曲和信息回避。通过整合信息偏好理论和身份效用的见解，该模型解释了为何那些因污名而存在强烈身份担忧的个体容易产生乐观偏差，并抗拒诊断测试以保护自己的自我概念。该研究在三个关键方面为相关文献做出了贡献。首先，它通过将信念扭曲、与身份一致的行动和信息回避内生化到统一的决策结构中，扩展了经济理论的概念框架。通过将污名作为正式建模的个体特定参数引入模型——这在经济学中之前未被充分探讨——该框架提高了我们捕捉健康相关决策中异质性的能力，并加强了经济建模与临床心理健康研究之间的理论联系。其次，它提供了一个理论框架，将诸如否认、延迟寻求治疗和治疗中断等临床现象与正式的决策理论模型联系起来。第三，它通过展示污名这一可量化因素如何通过身份驱动的行动和信念扭曲系统地影响决策，为实验和实证研究提供了结构化的基础。

abstract.text: Vertical integration among health care providers is an increasingly common feature of U.S. health care. This study investigates the impact of vertical integration in the context of oncology practices launching in-house pharmacies dispensing high-cost oral cancer treatments using a stacked event study design. I find physician-pharmacy integration lowers point-of-sale drug prices paid by plans due to 1.0% lower prices at in-house pharmacies. I also find physician-pharmacy integration increases the number of patients filling new prescriptions by 6.2% and reduces time-to-fill for new prescriptions requiring prior authorization. These effects may arise because in-house pharmacies individually have limited bargaining power and because vertical integration decreases coordination costs, reflected by faster prior authorization.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2025.103085.abstractZh: 在美国家庭医疗服务中，医疗服务提供者之间的垂直整合已成为一种越来越常见的现象。本研究通过堆叠事件研究设计，探讨了在肿瘤科实践中引入内部药房提供高成本口腔癌治疗服务时，垂直整合所产生的影响。研究发现，由于内部药房的价格比传统药房低1.0%，医生与药房之间的整合降低了保险计划支付的药品销售价格。此外，研究还发现，医生与药房之间的整合使新处方的填写数量增加了6.2%，并缩短了需要事先授权的新处方的处理时间。这些效应可能源于内部药房自身的议价能力有限，以及垂直整合减少了协调成本，从而加快了事先授权的流程。

abstract.text: Governance and management, two terms that are barely understood, are precisely defined, and measured. They explain a very important part of the difference between countries, systems, and organizations. Also, in healthcare. The article devotes much attention to the indicators that address the quality of the rules of the game of society, its institutions, showing how the judgment about one or another form of social organization depends on more than one dimension. The good Spanish health system, with a poor prognosis due to its sclerosis of supply and flight to the private sector, needs to be depoliticized and debureaucratized so that the solvency of the health response provides the majority vote necessary for the sustainability of the welfare state. The entire text uses real examples and lands in the Spanish reality, finally distinguishing between what we can influence as citizens and what we as professionals are responsible for.

10.1016/j.jhqr.2024.12.003.abstractZh: 治理与管理这两个术语虽然难以理解，但可以被精确定义并衡量。它们解释了国家、体系和组织之间差异的一个重要方面。在医疗保健领域也是如此。本文特别关注那些反映社会规则质量的指标，这些规则涉及社会机构的行为准则。文章指出，对某种社会组织的评价取决于多个维度。西班牙的优质医疗体系，由于供应体系僵化以及向私营部门转移的问题，其前景并不乐观。因此，需要消除政治干预和官僚主义的束缚，使医疗系统的可持续性得以实现。全文通过真实案例，结合西班牙的实际情况，区分了作为公民我们可以影响的因素，以及作为专业人士我们应当承担的责任。

abstract.text: Prior research has established that objective, test-score-based school accountability measures impact school leaders. Subjective evaluations, on the other hand, can provide a more nuanced assessment of school quality. This paper investigates the impact of subjective school inspection ratings on the salary and career outcomes of school principals. Ratings capture not just overall school quality, but also more granular aspects such as leadership quality, teaching and student achievement. Employing a difference-in-differences framework, we find that the overall school inspection rating has substantial impact on principals’ salaries and their rate of exit from public sector schooling. These effects are highly asymmetric: worse ratings have a substantially larger impact compared to rating improvements. Our findings suggest that competition is a key mechanism through which changes in school inspection ratings affect principals. Crucially, by leveraging detailed quality ratings, we show for the first time that the labor market can distinguish between signals concerning overall school quality and those specific to senior management quality.

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2025.105524.abstractZh: 先前的研究已经表明，以客观测试成绩为基础的学校评估指标会对学校领导产生影响。而主观评估则能够提供更细致的学校质量评估。本文研究了主观学校评估评级对校长薪资和职业发展的影响。这些评级不仅涵盖了学校的整体质量，还包括了诸如领导能力、教学质量和学生成绩等更具体的方面。通过采用差异-差异框架，我们发现整体学校评估评级对校长的薪资以及他们离开公立学校的比例有着显著的影响。这些影响具有高度的非对称性：评级较差对校长的负面影响远大于评级改善带来的正面影响。我们的研究结果表明，竞争是评估评级变化影响校长的关键因素。重要的是，通过利用详细的质量评级数据，我们首次证明了劳动力市场能够区分与学校整体质量相关的信号，以及特定于高层管理质量的信号。

abstract.text: This paper provides a causal estimate of labour productivity in maternity wards. We consider an Italian law that defines the staffing requirements of hospital maternity units according to the annual number of births. We exploit the discontinuities in the availability of medical staff caused by thresholds in the law to define both instrumental variables and a regression discontinuity framework that allows us to estimate the causal effect of different teams of professionals on the mode of delivery and on the health status of newborns and mothers at delivery. The analysis is based on detailed patient-level data on births in an Italian region. We find that maternity units with annual births above the thresholds are more likely to have a 'full team' of professionals at delivery. We find that having a full team has no effect on the mode of delivery (caesarean section vs vaginal birth). However, the presence of a full team has a significant impact on health outcomes. We find an improvement in both neonatal and maternal outcomes associated with a more intensive use of medical interventions, suggesting that larger hospitals are better than smaller units at managing deliveries with appropriate treatments to avoid complications. In addition, we do not find substantial heterogeneous effects across days of the week, time of day, or nationality of mothers.

10.1016/j.labeco.2025.102760.abstractZh: 本文对产科病房的生产力进行了因果分析。我们参考了一项意大利法律，该法律根据每年的分娩数量来规定医院产科单位所需的人员配置。我们利用法律中规定的人员数量阈值所带来的医疗人员可用性的不连续性，来定义工具变量和回归不连续框架，从而能够评估不同专业团队对分娩方式以及新生儿和母亲健康状况的因果效应。分析基于意大利某地区详细的出生数据。我们发现，年分娩数量超过阈值的产科单位更有可能在分娩时拥有“完整团队”的专业人员。我们发现，拥有完整团队对分娩方式（剖宫产与阴道分娩）没有影响。然而，完整团队的存在对健康结果有显著影响。我们发现，更密集地使用医疗干预措施能够改善新生儿和母亲的健康状况，这表明规模较大的医院在管理分娩过程中能够提供更有效的治疗，从而避免并发症。此外，我们并未发现一周中的不同日期、一天中的不同时间或母亲国籍对结果产生显著差异。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Provider payment reforms (PPRs) can improve providers' efficiency, but they often generate mixed results. Since organizations mediate PPR effectiveness, examining hospitals' management capacity's association with PPR effectiveness can be useful. In the context of clear strategies, hospitals' management characteristics related to goal attainment would be key to PPR adaptation. This study examines hospitals' capacity to set goals at appropriate difficulty or specificity, provide feedback, or standardize processes. METHODS: We leverage a matched-pair, cluster randomized controlled PPR trial in a low-income Chinese province between 2014 and 2018. The reform aimed to reduce the per admission expenditure of the public insurance New Cooperative Medical Scheme (NCMS) though this may inadvertently trigger higher out-of-pocket (OOP) expenditure. We categorize 52 hospitals' baseline goal setting, feedback, and process standardization capacities using the World Management Survey and interact these characteristics with the difference-in-difference estimator to examine whether the four management characteristics modified the treatment effect. RESULTS: All four management characteristics were non-statistically significantly associated with lower NCMS expenditure growth, consistent with the PPR incentives. However, their effects were jointly significant. Much of the effect came from goal specificity and feedback. Regarding expenditure shifting to OOP sources, only process standardization amplified such behaviour while goal difficulty showed spillover control in OOP expenditure growth. CONCLUSION: Management capacity around goal attainment is an important moderator of PPR effectiveness, and future research can further unpack organizational characteristics of PPRs. Policymakers and hospital leaders may use industry peer networks to disseminate high quality goal development approaches and encourage huddles to facilitate feedback. Introducing monitoring and penalties for expenditure shifting-particularly for hospitals that can standardize operations in pursuit of profit-may be helpful.

10.1016/j.socscimed.2025.117831.abstractZh:
背景：提供者支付改革（PPRs）可以提高提供者的效率，但往往会产生不同的结果。由于组织是PPR效果的中介因素，因此研究医院的管理能力与其效果之间的关系是有用的。在明确的策略背景下，与目标达成相关的医院管理特征对于PPR的适应至关重要。本研究考察了医院在设定适当难度或具体性的目标、提供反馈或标准化流程方面的能力。

方法：我们利用了2014年至2018年间中国一个低收入省份的一项配对、群集随机对照PPR试验。该改革旨在降低公共保险新合作医疗计划（NCMS）的每次就诊支出，但这可能会无意中导致更高的自付支出。我们使用世界管理调查对52家医院的目标设定、反馈和流程标准化能力进行了分类，并通过差异-差异估计器将这些特征与治疗效果进行了分析，以检验这四种管理特征是否改变了治疗效果。

结果：所有四种管理特征都与较低的NCMS支出增长有非统计学上的显著关联，这与PPR激励措施一致。然而，它们的效果是联合显著的。其中大部分效果来自目标的具体性和反馈。在支出转向自付来源方面，只有流程标准化增强了这种行为，而目标难度的增加则对自付支出的增长产生了控制作用。

结论：围绕目标达成的管理能力是PPR效果的重要调节因素，未来的研究可以进一步探讨PPR的组织特征。政策制定者和医院领导可以利用行业同行网络来传播高质量的目标制定方法，并鼓励召开会议以收集反馈。对于能够标准化运营以追求利润的医院来说，引入对支出变动的监测和处罚措施可能会有所帮助。

abstract.text: The COVID-19 pandemic had a profound impact on the management and delivery of acute healthcare. To tackle the pandemic, hospitals redesigned their organisational models to provide a rapid increase in acute care assessment and treatment capacity for patients with COVID-19 whilst also trying to maintain delivery of care for patients with non-COVID-19 healthcare needs. This capacity to adjust and recover after COVID-19 might be shaped by both measures taken by acute hospitals and wider hospital pre-pandemic characteristics. The aim of this study is to examine how hospital characteristics in acute care are associated with recovery of elective activity after the height of the COVID-19 pandemic compared to pre-pandemic levels. Using patient-level data from Hospital Episode Statistics aggregated at monthly-trust level for all English National Health Service (NHS) acute hospital trusts in 2019 and 2021, we estimate the associations between hospital recovery rate and hospital pre-pandemic characteristics by employing linear regressions of the proportional change over time in elective activity against a set of explanatory variables related to supply factors (e.g., hospital size, workforce, type of hospital, regional location), demand factors (e.g., population need, patient case-mix) and time factors. On average, English NHS acute hospital trusts did not fully recover from the COVID-19 pandemic in 2021. The results show that the explanatory variables are not systematically associated with hospital recovery rate, excepting regional differences. Hospital trusts not located in London, especially in the North of England, are associated with a lower recovery (less resilience) of total elective activity and orthopaedic and vascular surgical elective activity. The implication for policy development is that the evolution of hospital recovery rates in elective activity varied across English regions, especially for high-volume and high-risk elective specialties, with better recovery in London than elsewhere.

10.1016/j.socscimed.2025.118062.abstractZh: COVID-19疫情对急性医疗服务的管理和提供产生了深远影响。为了应对疫情，医院重新设计了组织模式，以快速提升对COVID-19患者的医疗评估和治疗能力，同时努力满足非COVID-19患者的医疗需求。这种在疫情后进行调整和恢复的能力可能受到急性医院采取的措施以及疫情前医院特征的共同影响。本研究旨在探讨急性医疗服务中的医院特征与COVID-19疫情高峰后择期活动的恢复情况之间的关系，以及这些特征与疫情前水平相比的变化情况。我们利用了2019年和2021年英格兰国家卫生服务系统所有急性医院信托机构每月汇总的患者数据，通过线性回归分析，将择期活动随时间的变化比例与一系列解释变量进行关联分析，这些解释变量包括供应因素（如医院规模、员工数量、医院类型、地理位置）、需求因素（如人口需求、患者病例组合）和时间因素。平均而言，2021年英格兰国家卫生服务系统急性医院信托机构并未完全从COVID-19疫情中恢复。研究结果表明，除地区差异外，这些解释变量并未系统地影响医院的恢复情况。位于伦敦以外的医院信托机构，尤其是英格兰北部的医院，其择期活动的恢复情况较差，尤其是骨科和血管外科手术的择期活动。这对政策制定的启示是，英国各地区的择期手术恢复率存在差异，尤其是在高流量和高风险的择期手术领域，伦敦的恢复情况优于其他地区。

abstract.text: This study explores socioeconomic disparities in how patients trade off quality against other features when choosing their primary care provider. We use a unique registry dataset linking the choices of individuals who recently moved to a new market, and therefore need to select a new provider, with detailed individual-level measures of socioeconomic status (SES) and provider-level measures of patient satisfaction, clinical quality and travel distance in a large Swedish region. We find significant disparities in patient choice based on SES, as high-SES individuals are consistently more likely to select higher quality providers. However, the results also suggest that most of the SES disparities in observed quality are linked to differences in the availability of high-quality providers within an acceptable travel distance. Our findings suggest that patient choice can widen, rather than reduce, disparities in population health by SES - if spatial inequalities in access to high-quality care are not addressed beforehand.

10.1016/j.socscimed.2025.118351.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了患者在选择初级保健提供者时，如何在质量与其他因素之间进行权衡的社会经济差异。我们使用了独特的登记数据集，该数据集将最近迁移到新市场、因此需要选择新保健提供者的个体的选择情况联系起来，并收集了关于社会经济地位（SES）的详细个体级数据，以及关于患者满意度、临床质量和旅行距离的保健提供者级数据，这些数据来自瑞典的一个大区域。我们发现，基于社会经济地位的患者选择存在显著差异，高社会经济地位的个体更有可能选择高质量的保健提供者。然而，研究结果也表明，观察到的质量差异大多与高质量保健提供者在可接受旅行距离内的可获得性有关。我们的研究结果表明，如果事先不解决获得高质量护理的空间不平等问题，患者选择可能会扩大而非缩小社会经济地位导致的健康差异。

abstract.text: Providers' intrinsic motivation is deemed important for quality of care and responses to incentives. Building on self-determination theory, we test the hypotheses that more intrinsically motivated providers perform better and respond less to an external incentive. We exploit the introduction of a cluster randomised accreditation scheme in Danish general practice, where practices were randomised to accreditation in different years (2016-2018) at municipality level. Combining data from administrative registers and a nationwide survey, we measure practices' quality of care and their general practitioners' intrinsic motivation. Using weighted mixed linear models with municipality random effects, we compare quality of care of accredited practices and practices in transition with non-accredited practices, while taking intrinsic motivation into account. We find a positive relationship between intrinsic motivation and performance on some quality measures. We also find that intrinsic motivation moderates practices' response to accreditation. While the least intrinsically motivated practices respond to accreditation by increasing their performances, the most intrinsically motivated practices do not respond to the incentive. These findings support the self-determination theory suggesting that intrinsically motivated providers are more autonomous and therefore less susceptible to external interventions. Policymakers should therefore consider taking providers' intrinsic motivation into account when designing incentives.

10.1016/j.socscimed.2025.118378.abstractZh: 提供者的内在动机被认为对护理质量和对激励的反应至关重要。基于自我决定理论，我们测试了以下假设：具有更强内在动机的提供者的表现更好，并且对外部激励的反应较少。我们在丹麦全科医学中引入了一种集群随机认证制度，各诊所被随机分配到不同年份（2016-2018年）的认证阶段，认证工作由市政当局负责。通过结合行政登记数据和全国范围内的调查，我们评估了诊所的护理质量以及全科医生的内在动机。我们使用带有市政随机效应的加权混合线性模型，比较了获得认证的诊所与过渡期诊所以及未获得认证的诊所在护理质量方面的表现，同时考虑了内在动机的影响。我们发现内在动机与某些质量指标的表现之间存在正相关关系。此外，我们还发现内在动机对诊所对认证的反应起到了调节作用。虽然动机最弱的诊所通过提高表现来应对认证，但动机最强的诊所则对激励没有反应。这些发现支持了自我决定理论的观点，即具有内在动机的提供者更加自主，因此不太容易受到外部干预的影响。因此，政策制定者在设计激励措施时应考虑考虑提供者的内在动机。

abstract.text: While Africa has made substantial health progress, small and island states face distinct vulnerabilities and threats, demanding focused attention. Employing WHO building blocks, this study explores the health systems and financing status of small and island states in Africa, emphasizing their unique challenges in achieving universal health coverage. We undertake a comparative analysis of health systems and financing between African small and island states and larger counterparts within the region. Despite their unique challenges, African small and island states appear to perform comparatively well both in terms of health financing and for a number of key health system inputs. These findings suggest that the hypothesized structural impediments facing small and island states may be less severe than anticipated, or that good policies may have effectively mitigated these challenges within the health sector. However, many small and island states remain understudied, and further health research must be undertaken to better understand the nuances of health systems in these countries.

10.1016/j.ssmhs.2025.100104.abstractZh: 虽然非洲在健康领域取得了显著进展，但小型岛屿国家面临着独特的脆弱性和威胁，需要特别关注。本研究采用世界卫生组织的框架，探讨了非洲小型岛屿国家的卫生系统和融资状况，重点分析了它们在实现全民健康覆盖方面所面临的独特挑战。我们对非洲小型岛屿国家与该地区较大国家之间的卫生系统和融资状况进行了比较分析。尽管面临独特挑战，非洲小型岛屿国家在卫生融资以及多项关键卫生系统投入方面表现相对较好。这些发现表明，小型岛屿国家所面临的结构性障碍可能并不像预期的那样严重，或者良好的政策可能已经有效缓解了这些挑战。然而，许多小型岛屿国家仍未被充分研究，需要进一步的卫生研究来更好地理解这些国家卫生系统的复杂性。

abstract.text: This chapter discusses insurance as a central player in the purchasing of health goods and services. It points out the flaws and quirks in the insurance market that lead to an absence of perfect competition and the potential for skewed bargaining power between providers and insurers. Managed care is then outlined as an attempt by insurance companies to curtail health spending through utilization controls and narrow networks. Additional tools such as paying for wellness programs, bundling payments for episodes of care, and cost-effectiveness measures are also discussed as possibilities to improve the efficiency of payouts by insurers. The chapter concludes by reminding us that insurance companies make more money the less they pay out and that making it more difficult for beneficiaries to access care will allow them to accomplish that.

10.1017/9781009606967.008.abstractZh: 本章讨论了保险在健康商品和服务购买中的核心作用。文中指出了保险市场存在的缺陷和特殊现象，这些因素导致了完全竞争的不存在，并可能导致医疗服务提供者与保险公司之间的权力失衡。随后，文章介绍了管理式医疗作为一种尝试，即保险公司通过控制使用率和缩小服务网络来减少医疗支出。此外，还探讨了诸如为健康项目付费、将多次护理费用捆绑在一起以及采用成本效益衡量标准等工具，这些都有助于提高保险公司支付的效率。最后，文章提醒我们，保险公司通过减少支付来赚取更多利润，而让受益人更难获得医疗服务正是实现这一目标的方式之一。

abstract.text: This Element discusses the role of the government in the financing and provision of public health care. It summarises core knowledge and findings in the economics literature, giving a state-of-the-art account of public health care. The first section is devoted to health system financing. It provides policy rationales for public health insurance which rely on both equity and efficiency, the co-existence of public and private health insurance, how health systems deal with excess demand, and the effect of health insurance expansion. The second section covers the provision of health care and the effect of policy interventions that aim at improving quality and efficiency, including reimbursement mechanisms, competition, public–private mix, and integrated care. The third section is devoted to the market for pharmaceuticals, focusing on the challenges of regulating on-patent and off-patent markets, and discussing the main incentives for pharmaceutical innovation.

10.1017/9781108652537.abstractZh: 本文探讨了政府在公共医疗保健的融资与提供方面的角色。文章总结了经济学文献中的核心知识和研究成果，对公共医疗保健的现状进行了全面分析。第一部分主要讨论卫生系统的融资问题，提出了基于公平与效率的公共卫生保险政策依据，以及公共与私人保险并存的情况、卫生系统如何应对过度需求，以及保险扩围的影响。第二部分则涉及医疗保健的提供，以及旨在提高质量和效率的政策干预措施，包括报销机制、竞争机制、公共与私人部门的结合方式以及综合护理模式。第三部分则聚焦于药品市场，讨论了监管专利内与专利外市场的挑战，并探讨了推动药品创新的主要激励因素。

abstract.text: More and more people are now waiting longer for hospital care. Besides rising demand and capacity constraints (i.e. manpower and bed shortages), unnecessary days in the hospital can contribute to long waiting times for admission. Unnecessary extended hospital stays can result from both healthcare providers and patients; however, the demand-side factor is understudied in the literature. Using a novel dataset for patients undergoing elective laparoscopic cholecystectomy at the largest hospital in a major Chinese city, we examine the impacts of inpatients’ admission-day arrival time on length of stay (LOS), medical expenses, and quality of care. To identify causal effects, we use patients’ travel time to the hospital as an instrument for their arrival time. Our findings show that patients who arrive later than scheduled on admission day experience longer LOS but similar medical expenses and quality outcomes. We suggest that patients arriving later have less time for necessary examinations on the admission day, leading to the postponement of diagnostic tests and subsequent surgery schedules.

10.1080/00036846.2025.2609835.abstractZh: 如今，越来越多的人需要更长时间才能得到医院的治疗。除了需求增加和医疗设施限制（如人手不足和床位短缺）之外，不必要的住院天数也会延长等待时间。不必要的延长住院时间可能是医疗提供者和患者双方造成的，但文献中对需求方面的研究较少。我们利用一个针对中国某大城市最大医院接受择期腹腔镜胆囊切除术患者的新型数据集，研究了住院患者入院当天的到达时间对住院时间、医疗费用和护理质量的影响。为了识别因果效应，我们使用患者前往医院的旅行时间作为到达时间的工具变量。研究发现，比预定时间晚到达的患者住院时间更长，但医疗费用和护理质量相似。我们认为，晚到达的患者在入院当天没有足够的时间进行必要的检查，导致诊断测试和手术时间的推迟。

abstract.text: It is already a common practice for many health care systems in the world to opt for mixed markets where different types of health care facilities compete against each other to offer high-quality health care to patients. Nevertheless, little is known about the effects of the interaction between hospitals of the same or different type on patient health outcomes. This study estimated the impacts of aggregate and specific types of hospital competition by hospital-type on the quality of inpatient care using an analysis dataset comprising 267,183 individuals from China. The Herfindahl-Hirschman index was employed to measure the degree of hospital competition, with length of stay, readmission and mortality being used to measure the quality of inpatient care. The Poisson and binomial logistic models combined with the instrumental variable approach were constructed to estimate the impacts of hospital competition. This study generated three key findings: 1) aggregate hospital competition reduced the quality of inpatient care, as evidenced by a rise in the odds of readmission and length of stay; 2) intra-type hospital competition reduced the quality of inpatient care and in general had larger effects on reducing the quality of inpatient care than inter-type hospital competition; and 3) the only exception was in the way that competition between private nonprofit hospitals contributed to better quality of inpatient care. The overarching suggestion is that instead of treating competition as a panacea for improving health, a flexible plan tailored to specific conditions is needed.

10.1080/23288604.2025.2507975.abstractZh: 世界上许多医疗保健系统已经普遍采用混合市场模式，即不同类型的医疗机构相互竞争，以向患者提供高质量的医疗服务。然而，关于同一类型或不同类型医院之间的互动对患者健康结果的影响，目前了解甚少。本研究利用包含267,183名中国个体的数据集，估计了按医院类型划分的综合性竞争与特定类型竞争对住院护理质量的影响。采用赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数来衡量医院竞争的程度，而住院时间、再入院率和死亡率则用于衡量住院护理的质量。通过构建泊松模型和二项逻辑模型，并结合工具变量方法，来估算医院竞争的影响。研究得出三个主要结论：1）综合性医院竞争降低了住院护理的质量，表现为再入院率和住院时间的增加；2）同一类型医院之间的竞争同样降低了住院护理的质量，且总体上对住院护理质量的负面影响大于不同类型医院之间的竞争；3）唯一的例外是，私人非营利医院之间的竞争有助于提升住院护理的质量。总体建议是，不应将竞争视为改善健康的万能方案，而是需要根据具体情况制定灵活的策略。

abstract.text: This paper studies economies where firms acquire capital in primary markets and then, after idiosyncratic productivity shocks, retrade it in secondary markets that incorporate bilateral trade with search, bargaining, and liquidity frictions. We distinguish between full or partial sales (one firm gets all or some of the other’s capital) and document several long- and short-run empirical patterns between these variables and the cost of liquidity, as measured by inflation. Quantitatively, the model can match these patterns plus the standard business cycle facts. We also investigate the impact of search frictions, monetary and fiscal policy, persistence in shocks, and returns to scale.

10.1086/732522.abstractZh: 本文研究的是那些企业先在初级市场获取资本，随后在遭遇特定性生产率冲击后，在包含双边贸易、搜寻成本、谈判成本和流动性摩擦的二级市场进行再交易的经济体。我们区分了完全出售和部分出售两种情况（即一家企业获得另一家企业的全部或部分资本），并记录了这些变量与流动性成本之间的长期和短期实证关系，流动性成本通过通货膨胀来衡量。从数量上看，该模型能够匹配这些实证结果以及标准的商业周期现象。我们还研究了搜寻成本、货币政策与财政政策、冲击的持续性以及规模报酬的影响。

abstract.text: We empirically investigate how the performance of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) changes when gaining access to market information. To do so, we evaluate the impact of an information program diffused by a bank among its SME customers. Adopting firms gained access to reports with rich information about their own clientele and that of nearby establishments. While we find that adoption is associated with a 4.5% revenue increase, our instrumental variable results indicate that adoption increases revenue by 9%. The main mechanism driving our result is that the new information prompted adopting establishments to target gender-age customer groups underserved before adoption.

10.1086/732525.abstractZh: 我们通过实证研究探讨了中小企业获得市场信息后其业绩如何发生变化。为此，我们评估了一家银行向其中小企业客户推广的信息计划的影响。采用该计划的公司能够获取关于自身客户以及附近企业的大量信息。我们发现，采用该计划后，企业收入增加了4.5%，而我们的工具变量结果显示，采用该计划后，企业收入增加了9%。推动这一结果的主要机制是，新信息促使采用该计划的机构开始针对在采用前未得到充分服务的性别和年龄客户群体进行市场定位。

abstract.text: We examine how informational frictions impact schooling and work outcomes by estimating a dynamic structural model where individuals face uncertainty about their academic ability and productivity, which determine their schooling utility and wages. We account for different college types, majors, occupational search frictions, and work hours. Individuals learn from grades and wages, which may affect their choices. Removing informational frictions would increase graduation by 4.4 percentage points and by an additional 2 points without search frictions. Providing students with full information about their abilities would increase the college and white-collar wage premia while reducing the graduation gap by family income.

10.1086/732526.abstractZh: 我们研究了信息摩擦如何影响教育和工作成果，通过构建一个动态结构模型来进行分析。在该模型中，个体面临对其学术能力和生产力的不确定性，这些不确定性决定了他们的教育效用和工资。我们考虑了不同类型的大学、专业、职业搜寻摩擦以及工作时间等因素。个体通过成绩和工资来学习，这些因素可能会影响他们的选择。消除信息摩擦将使毕业率提高4.4个百分点，而在没有搜寻摩擦的情况下，毕业率还会再提高2个百分点。如果学生能够完全了解自己的能力，那么大学教育和白领职位的工资溢价将会增加，同时家庭收入对毕业差距的影响也会减少。

abstract.text: We estimate long-run trends in intergenerational relative mobility for representative samples of the US-born population. Harmonizing all surveys that include father’s occupation and own family income, we develop a mobility measure that allows for the inclusion of nonwhite individuals and women for the 1910s–1970s birth cohorts. We show that mobility increases between the 1910s and 1940s cohorts and that the decline of Black-white income gaps explains about half of this rise. We also find that excluding Black Americans, particularly women, considerably overstates the level of mobility for twentieth-century birth cohorts while simultaneously understating its increase between the 1910s and 1940s.

10.1086/732527.abstractZh: 我们估算了美国出生人口代表性样本在代际相对流动性的长期趋势。通过整合所有包含父亲职业和自身家庭收入的调查数据，我们开发了一种流动性衡量指标，能够涵盖1910年代至1970年代出生的人群，包括非白人个体和女性。我们发现，从1910年代到1940年代，流动性有所上升，而黑人与白人收入差距的缩小解释了这一上升幅度的一半左右。此外，我们发现在排除黑人美国人，尤其是女性后，对20世纪出生人群流动性的评估明显偏高，同时低估了1910年代到1940年代之间的流动性增长。

abstract.text: Asset price bubbles are situations where asset prices exceed the fundamental values defined by the present value of dividends. This paper presents a conceptually new perspective: the necessity of bubbles. We establish the bubble necessity theorem in a plausible general class of economic models: with faster long-run economic growth (G) than dividend growth (Gd) and counterfactual long-run autarky interest rate (R) below dividend growth, all equilibria are bubbly with nonnegligible bubble sizes relative to the economy. This bubble necessity condition naturally arises in economies with sufficiently strong savings motives and multiple factors or sectors with uneven productivity growth.

10.1086/732528.abstractZh: 资产价格泡沫是指资产价格超过由股息现值所定义的基本价值的情况。本文提出了一种全新的概念性视角：泡沫的必然性。我们在一类合理的经济模型中建立了泡沫必然性的定理：当长期经济增长率（G）高于股息增长率（Gd），且长期自给自足的利率（R）低于股息增长率时，所有均衡状态都会出现泡沫，且泡沫规模相对于经济规模来说是不可忽视的。这一泡沫必然性的条件自然出现在那些具有足够强的储蓄动机以及多个生产要素或行业生产率增长不均衡的经济体中。

abstract.text: Do the world’s best tennis pros play Nash equilibrium mixed strategies? We answer this question using data on serve-direction choices (to the receiver’s left, right, or body) from the Match Charting Project. Using a new approach, we test and reject a key implication of a mixed-strategy Nash equilibrium: that the probability of winning the service game is identical for all possible serve strategies. We calculate best-response serve strategies by dynamic programming (DP) and show that for most elite pro servers, the DP strategy significantly increases their win probability relative to the mixed strategies they actually use.

10.1086/732529.abstractZh: 世界上最好的网球职业选手是否采用纳什均衡的混合策略？我们通过《比赛记录项目》中关于发球方向选择的数据来回答这个问题。采用新的方法，我们测试并否定了混合策略纳什均衡的一个关键假设：即所有可能的发球策略获胜的概率都是相同的。我们通过动态规划方法计算出最佳响应发球策略，并发现对于大多数精英职业发球手来说，动态规划策略显著提高了他们的获胜概率，相对于他们实际使用的混合策略而言。

abstract.text: We combine classic occupational choice (Roy model) and frictionless matching (following Sattinger) to explain earnings by occupation and firm in a way that is consistent with double assignment. In our model, within-firm inequality is globally nonzero whenever there is asymmetry in the revenue function or the occupational skill distribution across occupations. Occupational earnings overlap each other, and, unlike in the Roy model, the distributions of potential earnings are endogenous. In line with recent empirical findings on earning decomposition, skill-biased technical change increases within-firm inequality mostly among high-wage firms and not among low-wage firms.

10.1086/732530.abstractZh: 我们结合经典的职业选择模型（Roy模型）和无摩擦匹配理论（基于Sattinger的研究），以符合双重分配理论的方式解释不同职业和企业的收入差异。在我们的模型中，当收入函数或不同职业之间的技能分布存在不对称时，企业内部的收入不平等会普遍存在。职业收入之间存在重叠，与Roy模型不同，潜在收入的分布是内生性的。这与近期关于收入分解的实证研究结果一致，即技能偏向的技术变革主要增加了高薪企业的内部收入不平等，而低薪企业则较少受到影响。

abstract.text: Working-memory (WM) capacity is a key component of a wide range of cognitive and noncognitive skills—such as fluid IQ, math, reading, and inhibitory control—but can WM training improve these skills? Here, we examine the causal impact of WM training embedded in regular school teaching, using a randomized educational intervention with 6–7-year-old children. We find substantial gains in WM capacity and document positive spillover effects on geometry, fluid IQ, and inhibitory control. Three years later, treated children are 16 percentage points more likely to enter an advanced secondary school track.

10.1086/732884.abstractZh: 工作记忆容量是多种认知和非认知技能的关键组成部分，例如流体智商、数学能力、阅读能力和抑制控制能力。但是，记忆训练是否能够提升这些技能呢？本研究通过一项针对6-7岁儿童的随机教育干预实验，探讨了学校常规教学中记忆训练对相应技能影响的因果关系。研究发现，记忆容量有显著提升，并且对几何能力、流体智商和抑制控制能力也产生了积极的溢出效应。三年后，接受训练的儿童进入高级中学的比例高出16个百分点。

abstract.text: This paper provides novel insights into the science of scaling by examining an educational mentoring program in Mexico. The empirical analysis encompasses two independent field experiments and seizes a unique opportunity to learn from the government’s implementation of the same intervention. While the program originally implemented at scale demonstrates limited effectiveness, the introduction of a new modality with enhanced mentor training significantly improves children’s outcomes. Mentor-parent interactions are found to stimulate parental engagement at the community-school level. Our findings support the hypothesis that parents can play an important role in facilitating the scalability of educational programs.

10.1086/732886.abstractZh: 本文通过研究墨西哥的一项教育指导计划，为规模扩展的科学研究提供了新的见解。实证分析涵盖了两项独立的实地实验，并抓住了从政府实施相同干预措施中学习的独特机会。虽然最初大规模实施的该计划效果有限，但引入新的指导模式并加强导师培训后，儿童的学习成果显著改善。研究发现，导师与家长的互动能够激发家长在社区-学校层面的参与积极性。我们的研究结果支持了这样的假设：家长可以在促进教育计划规模扩展方面发挥重要作用。

abstract.text: This paper examines whether informal care by family members influences the demand for long-term care insurance. Motivated by evidence that the availability of informal caregivers correlates with lower insurance demand and that informal care substitutes for formal care, I estimate a dynamic model of long-term care decisions between an elderly parent and her adult child. The availability of informal care lowers demand for insurance by 7 percentage points and suppresses Medicaid spending. A policy that provides equivalent cash benefits for informal care for such families can generate meaningful increases in insurance demand and family welfare and decreases in Medicaid spending.

10.1086/732887.abstractZh: 本文探讨了家庭成员的非正式照顾是否会影响对长期护理保险的需求。基于相关证据表明，非正式照顾者的可用性与较低的保险需求相关，并且非正式照顾可以替代正式照顾，我建立了一个动态模型来研究老年父母与其成年子女之间的长期护理决策。非正式照顾的可用性使保险需求降低7个百分点，并抑制了医疗补助支出。对于这类家庭，提供等同于非正式照顾的现金福利的政策可以显著增加保险需求、提高家庭福祉，并减少医疗补助支出。

abstract.text: We study how regulating data usage impacts innovation in digital markets. Platforms commonly use proprietary data about third-party sellers to inform their own competing offerings, dampening incentives for innovation. We model this interaction and characterize how data usage restrictions reshape these incentives. An outright ban on data usage may boost or curtail innovation, depending on the thickness of the right tail of demand for new products. More flexible rules controlling when and what data are made available can always improve the effectiveness of regulation. Our results contribute to an ongoing policy discussion regarding competition in digital markets.

10.1086/732888.abstractZh: 我们研究了数据使用监管对数字市场创新的影响。平台通常会使用关于第三方卖家的专有数据来指导自身的竞争产品，这削弱了创新的动力。我们模拟了这种互动，并分析了数据使用限制如何重塑这些激励因素。对数据使用的完全禁止可能会促进或抑制创新，这取决于对新产品的需求右尾分布的厚度。更灵活的规则，能够控制何时以及提供哪些数据，总能提高监管的有效性。我们的研究结果为关于数字市场竞争的政策讨论提供了贡献。

abstract.text: We provide a framework for analyzing search across correlated samples. The agent—a mineral prospecting team, a drug company, a politician—tracks observations over a Brownian path. The agent chooses the search speed and retrospectively picks the best observation when deciding to complete the search. We show that the optimal search speed is U-shaped: it is highest when approaching a breakthrough or when nearing search termination. Unlike search across independent samples, search optimally stops when observations are sufficiently discouraging, following a drawdown stopping boundary. We also show the tractability and features of optimal search contracts in our setting.

10.1086/732889.abstractZh: 我们提供了一个分析相关样本间搜索行为的框架。该代理——无论是矿产勘探团队、制药公司还是政治家——都会在布朗路径上追踪观测数据。代理会选择搜索速度，并在决定完成搜索时，回顾性地选择最佳观测数据。我们证明，最优搜索速度呈U形分布：在接近突破点或接近搜索终止时，搜索速度达到最高值。与独立样本间的搜索不同，最优搜索会在观测数据变得足够令人沮丧时停止，遵循一个下降停止边界。我们还展示了我们设定下最优搜索合约的可处理性和特性。

abstract.text: Popular New Keynesian macroeconomic models predict that cuts in various types of distortionary taxes are contractionary when monetary policy is constrained at the zero lower bound (ZLB). We turn to a long span of history in the United Kingdom to test this hypothesis. Using a new long-run dataset of narrative-identified tax changes from 1918 to 2020, we show that tax cuts are expansionary in both low-interest-rate environments and more normal times. We do not find evidence of a deflationary spiral at the ZLB. Tax cuts may therefore still be a useful tool to stimulate economic activity when monetary policy is constrained.

10.1086/732890.abstractZh: 流行的新凯恩斯主义宏观经济模型预测，当货币政策受到零下限约束时，各种扭曲性税收的削减会导致经济收缩。我们选取英国的历史数据来验证这一假设。通过利用1918年至2020年间记录的税收变化数据，我们发现税收削减在低利率环境下以及正常时期都具有扩张性。我们没有发现零下限条件下出现通缩螺旋的现象。因此，在货币政策受限的情况下，税收削减仍可能成为刺激经济活动的有效手段。

abstract.text: We fully solve a sorting problem with heterogeneous firms and multiple heterogeneous workers whose skills are imperfect substitutes. We show that optimal sorting, which we call mixed and countermonotonic, is comprised of two regions. In the first region, mediocre firms sort with mediocre workers and coworkers such that the output losses are equal across all these teams (mixing). In the second region, a high-skill worker sorts with low-skill coworkers and a high-productivity firm (countermonotonicity). We characterize the equilibrium wages and firm values. Quantitatively, our model can generate the dispersion of earnings within and across US firms.

10.1086/732891.abstractZh: 我们完全解决了具有异质性企业和多个异质性工人的排序问题，这些工人的技能并非完全替代关系。我们指出，最优排序分为两个区域。在第一区域，平庸的企业与平庸的工人和同事进行排序，使得所有团队之间的产出损失相等（即混合排序）。在第二区域，高技能工人与低技能同事以及高生产力企业进行排序（即反单调性）。我们描述了均衡工资和企业的价值。从数量上看，我们的模型能够预测美国企业内部及跨企业的收入分布。

abstract.text: We argue that Arrow’s independence of irrelevant alternatives (IIA) condition is unjustifiably stringent because it rules out making a social welfare function sensitive to individuals’ preference intensities. Accordingly, we propose a modified version of IIA, MIIA, that is a necessary and sufficient relaxation of IIA for taking account of intensities. Rather than obtaining an impossibility result, we show that MIIA together with several other axioms (satisfied by virtually all voting rules and social welfare functions used in practice and studied in theory) uniquely characterizes the Borda count (sometimes called rank-order voting) as a social welfare function.

10.1086/732892.abstractZh: 我们认为，阿罗无关替代条件过于严格，因为它排除了使社会福利函数能够反映个体偏好强度的可能性。因此，我们提出了一种修改后的IIA版本——MIIA，该版本是对IIA的必要且充分的放宽，能够考虑偏好强度因素。我们并没有得出不可能性的结论，而是证明了MIIA以及其他几个公理（几乎所有实际使用的投票规则和社会福利函数都满足这些公理）能够唯一地将Borda计数（有时称为排序投票）定义为一种社会福利函数。

abstract.text: We study the introduction of a noninvasive prenatal screening—cell-free DNA (cfDNA) screening—which is used to target a more costly invasive test that elevates miscarriage risk. Using Swedish administrative data, we document that coverage of cfDNA substantially increases cfDNA screening and reduces invasive testing. We develop and estimate a stylized model of prenatal choices and find that narrow targeting of cfDNA coverage can improve outcomes and reduce costs, while broader coverage also improves outcomes but with increased costs. These findings point to the potential gains from well-designed targeting of screening but at the same time highlight the importance of the targeting design.

10.1086/732893.abstractZh: 我们研究了一种非侵入性产前筛查方法的引入——细胞游离DNA（cfDNA）筛查。这种筛查旨在替代那些成本更高且会增加流产风险的侵入性检测。通过瑞典的行政数据，我们发现cfDNA筛查的覆盖率显著提高，同时减少了侵入性检测的需求。我们建立并估计了一个关于产前选择的模型，发现有针对性地扩大cfDNA筛查的覆盖范围可以改善结果并降低成本，而更广泛的覆盖范围虽然也能改善结果，但会增加成本。这些发现表明，精心设计的筛查方法具有潜在的优势，但同时也强调了筛选目标设计的重要性。

abstract.text: In this paper, we study the process of children’s skill formation using a dynamic latent factor model to identify key features of the skill production function. We develop and estimate a joint dynamic process for latent investment and skill development, incorporating both static and dynamic complementarities between parental investments and children’s skills in the technology of skill formation. Our analysis of US data reveals that early childhood investments (age 5–6) are highly effective for cognitive skill development, with greater marginal productivity for children with lower existing skills. This suggests that targeting interventions at disadvantaged young children is most beneficial.

10.1086/733396.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们采用动态潜在因子模型来研究儿童技能形成的过程，以识别技能生成函数的关键特征。我们开发并估计了一个联合动态过程，用于描述潜在投资与技能发展的关系，同时考虑了父母投资与儿童技能在技能形成技术方面的静态和动态互补性。我们对美国数据的分析表明，早期儿童投资（5-6岁）对认知技能的发展具有显著效果，且现有技能较低的儿童从中获得的边际收益更大。这表明，针对弱势儿童开展干预措施最为有益。

abstract.text: The scientific community assigns credit or “priority” to individuals who publish an important discovery first. We examine the impact of losing a priority race (colloquially known as getting “scooped”) on publication and career outcomes. To do so, we analyze data from structural biology where the nature of the scientific process together with the Protein Data Bank enables us to identify priority races and their outcomes. We find that scooped teams are less likely to publish in top journals and receive 21 percent fewer citations. We further study the implications of priority racing on research strategy, academic inequality, and scientist beliefs.

10.1086/733398.abstractZh: 科学界会给予率先发表重要发现的人以“优先权”的认可。我们研究了失去优先权竞争（俗称“被抢先发表”）对发表成果和职业生涯的影响。为此，我们分析了结构生物学的数据，通过科学过程的特性以及蛋白质数据库，我们能够识别出优先权竞争及其结果。研究发现，被抢先发表的团队在顶级期刊上的发表几率较低，获得的引用次数也减少了21%。我们还研究了优先权竞争对研究策略、学术不平等以及科学家信念的影响。

abstract.text: We conduct experiments on an online platform to investigate the causal effect of gender discrimination on labor supply decisions. Controlling for the piece-rate wage, we find that workers who face explicit negative gender-discriminatory wage inequality supply substantially less labor compared with workers who face gender-neutral wage inequality. We also examine the effect of positive discrimination, differences between men and women, and the impact of implicit rather than explicit discrimination. We identify decreased work morale as the underlying mechanism. In addition, we provide survey evidence showing that discrimination in the field reduces work morale and labor supply, corroborating our experimental results.

10.1086/733419.abstractZh: 我们在线上平台进行实验，以研究性别歧视对劳动力供给决策的因果效应。在控制按件计酬工资的情况下，我们发现面临明确的性别歧视性工资不平等的工人，其劳动力供给明显少于面临性别中立性工资不平等的工人。我们还研究了正面歧视、男女之间的差异，以及隐性而非显性歧视的影响。我们认为，工作积极性下降是其中的潜在机制。此外，我们的调查证据表明，该领域的歧视会降低工作积极性并减少劳动力供给，这与我们的实验结果相符。

abstract.text: We study China’s export growth to the United States from 1950 to 2008, using a structural model to disentangle the effects of past tariff changes from the effects of changes in expectations of future tariffs. We find that the effects of China’s 1980 Normal Trade Relations (NTR) grant lasted past its 2001 accession to the World Trade Organization (WTO), and the likelihood of losing NTR status decreased significantly during 1986–92 but changed little thereafter. US manufacturing employment trends support our findings: industries more exposed to the 1980 reform have shed workers steadily since then without acceleration around China’s WTO accession.

10.1086/733420.abstractZh: 我们研究了1950年至2008年间中国对美国的出口增长情况，采用结构模型来区分过去关税变化对出口的影响与对未来关税预期变化的影响。我们发现，中国1980年正常贸易关系协议的效应持续到了其2001年加入世界贸易组织之后，而在1986年至1992年间失去正常贸易关系协议的可能性显著下降，此后则变化不大。美国的制造业就业趋势也支持我们的研究结果：那些更受1980年改革影响的行业，自那时以来一直在稳步减少工人数量，这一趋势在China’s WTO加入后并未加速。

abstract.text: We estimate a model of savings for retired couples and singles who face longevity and medical expense risks and in which couples can leave bequests both when the first spouse dies and when the last spouse dies. We show that saving motives vary by marital status, permanent income, and age. We find that most households save more for medical expenses than for bequests but that richer households and couples, who hold most of the wealth, save more for bequests. As a result, bequest motives are a key determinant of aggregate retirement wealth.

10.1086/733421.abstractZh: 我们建立了一个模型，用于分析面临长寿和医疗支出风险的退休夫妇及单身人士的储蓄行为。该模型允许夫妇在第一个配偶去世和最后一个配偶去世时分别进行遗产分配。研究发现，储蓄动机因婚姻状况、永久收入以及年龄而异。大多数家庭在医疗支出方面的储蓄多于遗产分配，但拥有大部分财富的富裕家庭和夫妇则更倾向于为遗产分配进行储蓄。因此，遗产分配动机是决定整体退休财富的关键因素。

abstract.text: Decentralized trading motivates financial innovation, making synthetic products like derivatives nonredundant, even when all traders trade all assets. This nonredundancy arises because derivatives affect cross-security inference (information) and, in markets with large traders, equilibrium price impact (liquidity). The efficient securities differ from the underlying assets. While the market index/mutual funds are efficient in decentralized markets with competitive investors, heterogeneous portfolios that balance index tracking with liquidity transformation become efficient in markets with large traders. Efficient securities facilitate the trading of all fundamental risks but generally forgo hedging all contingencies to minimize the price impact costs associated with risk sharing and diversification.

10.1086/733422.abstractZh: 去中心化交易激发了金融创新，使得像衍生品这样的合成产品变得非冗余，即使所有交易者都交易所有资产。这种非冗余性源于衍生品对跨证券推断（信息）的影响，以及在拥有大量交易者的市场中，对均衡价格的影响（流动性）。高效的证券与基础资产有所不同。在具有竞争投资者的去中心化市场中，市场指数/共同基金是高效的；而在拥有大量交易者的市场中，平衡指数跟踪与流动性转换的异质投资组合则变得高效。高效的证券有助于交易所有基本风险，但通常会放弃对冲所有突发事件，以最小化与风险共享和多样化相关的价格影响成本。

abstract.text: We develop a model of financial crises with both a financial amplification mechanism, via frictional intermediation, and a role for sentiment, via time-varying beliefs about an illiquidity state. The model accounts for the entire crisis cycle, matching data on the frothy precrisis behavior of asset markets and credit; the sharp transition to a crisis where asset values fall, disintermediation occurs, and output falls; and the slow postcrisis recovery in output. Both the intermediation and the belief mechanism are essential to match the crisis cycle. However, modeling the belief variation via either a Bayesian or a diagnostic model can match the broad patterns.

10.1086/733423.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个金融危机模型，该模型包含两种机制：通过摩擦性中介作用实现金融放大效应，以及通过关于流动性不足状态的时变信念来影响情绪。该模型涵盖了整个危机周期，与资产市场和信贷市场在危机前的泡沫行为数据相吻合；描述了危机的急剧转变阶段，此时资产价值下跌、中介作用消失，产出下降；以及危机后的缓慢恢复阶段。无论是中介机制还是信念机制，都对描述危机周期至关重要。不过，无论是使用贝叶斯模型还是诊断模型来模拟信念变化，都能很好地描述这些宏观现象。

abstract.text: Products are increasingly made by assembling separately produced modules. Motivated by the notion that a firm’s production function drives its organization, we explore how modular production shapes a firm’s communication structure. Decisions are partitioned into modules and require closer coordination within modules than across. Each agent knows the state his decision must be adapted to. The principal decides whom each agent tells about his state, given that each communication link comes at a cost. We show that optimal communication networks follow a simple threshold rule and exhibit the threshold property. We discuss comparative statics, applications, and empirical implications.

10.1086/733424.abstractZh: 产品越来越多地通过组装单独生产的模块来制造。基于企业生产功能决定其组织结构的观点，我们探讨了模块化生产如何塑造企业的沟通结构。决策被划分为不同的模块，并且模块内部的协调比模块之间的协调更为紧密。每个参与者都了解自己的决策状态，因此必须对其进行调整。决策者决定每个参与者向谁传达自己的状态，因为每条沟通渠道都是有成本的。我们证明，最优的沟通网络遵循一个简单的阈值规则，并表现出阈值特性。我们还讨论了比较静态分析、应用以及实证意义。

abstract.text: Why does the stock market rise and fall? From 1989 to 2017, the real per capita value of corporate equity increased at a 7.2% annual rate. We estimate that 40% of this increase was attributable to a reallocation of rewards to shareholders in a decelerating economy, primarily at the expense of labor compensation. Economic growth accounted for just 25% of the increase, followed by a lower risk price (21%) and lower interest rates (14%). The period 1952–88 experienced only one-third as much growth in market equity, but economic growth accounted for more than 100% of it.

10.1086/734089.abstractZh: 为什么股市会涨跌？从1989年到2017年，企业股权的实际人均价值以每年7.2%的速度增长。我们估计，这一增长的40%是由于在经济增长放缓的经济环境中，奖励重新分配给了股东，而主要牺牲了劳动力薪酬。经济增长仅占增长的25%，其次是较低的风险价格（21%）和较低的利率（14%）。1952年至1988年期间，市场股权的增长仅达到前者的三分之一，但经济增长占其增长的100%以上。

abstract.text: This paper examines the effects of the Big Five personality traits on labor market outcomes and gender wage gaps using a job search and bargaining model with parameters that vary at the individual level. The analysis, based on German panel data, reveals that both cognitive and noncognitive traits significantly influence wages and employment outcomes. Higher conscientiousness and emotional stability and lower agreeableness levels enhance earnings and job stability for both genders. Differences in the distributions of personality characteristics between men and women account for as much of the gender wage gap as do the large differences in labor market experience.

10.1086/734092.abstractZh: 本文探讨了五大人格特质对劳动力市场结果及性别工资差距的影响，采用了一个具有个体层面差异参数的求职与谈判模型进行研究。基于德国面板数据得出的分析表明，认知与非认知特质都对工资和就业结果产生显著影响。较高的尽责性、情绪稳定性以及较低的宜人性水平都能提升男女的收入和工作稳定性。男女之间人格特征的差异与劳动力市场经验的巨大差异一样，都是造成性别工资差距的重要因素。

abstract.text: We analyze the contribution of legal status incentives on the marriage choices of natives and migrants. Access to legal status reduces the probability of immigrants intermarrying with natives by 40% and increases the hazard rate of separation for intermarriages by 20%. We develop and estimate a multidimensional equilibrium model of marriage, fertility, and separation, where individuals match on observed and unobserved characteristics. Allowing for trade-offs between cultural distance, legal status, and other socioeconomic spousal characteristics, we quantify the role of legal status and the strength of cultural preferences and evaluate the welfare consequences of granting legal status to immigrants.

10.1086/734093.abstractZh: 我们分析了法律地位激励对本地居民和移民婚姻选择的影响。获得法律地位可使移民与本地居民通婚的概率降低40%，并增加通婚导致的分离风险20%。我们开发并估计了一个多维均衡模型，该模型涉及婚姻、生育和分离等方面，其中个体根据可观察到的和不可观察到的特征进行匹配。在考虑文化距离、法律地位以及其他社会经济婚姻特征之间的权衡后，我们量化了法律地位的作用，以及文化偏好的强度，并评估了给予移民法律地位的福利后果。

abstract.text: I develop a quantitative theory of bilateral trade agreements with intellectual property (IP) provisions in a multicountry growth model. The model’s dynamics are driven by innovation and technology licensing. Imperfect IP enforcement leads to reduced royalty payments and growth. Governments negotiate tariffs and IP enforcement through Nash bargaining. Gains from the trade agreement vary along the transition. Developing countries experience short-term losses, while developed countries gain in both the short and long runs. A government with short-term goals may reduce losses but at the cost of lower growth and welfare. Tariffs could discourage developing countries from deviating from the agreement.

10.1086/734094.abstractZh: 我在一个多国增长模型中，发展了一种关于包含知识产权条款的双边贸易协议的定量理论。该模型的动态由创新和技术许可驱动。不完善的知识产权执法会导致 royalty 支付减少和经济增长放缓。各国政府通过纳什谈判来协商关税和知识产权执法措施。贸易协议带来的收益在过渡过程中会有所不同：发展中国家在短期内会遭受损失，而发达国家在短期和长期内都能获得收益。一个以短期目标为重的政府可能会减少损失，但代价是经济增长和福利水平下降。关税可能会阻止发展中国家偏离协议规定。

abstract.text: We consider general Bayesian persuasion problems where the receiver’s utility is single-peaked in a one-dimensional action. We show that a signal that pools at most two states in each realization is always optimal and that such “pairwise” signals are the only solutions under a nonsingularity condition on utilities. Our core results provide conditions under which the induced receiver action is single-dipped or single-peaked on each set of nested signal realizations. We also provide conditions for the optimality of either full disclosure or negative assortative disclosure, where all signal realizations are nested. Methodologically, our results rely on novel duality and complementary slackness theorems. Our analysis extends to a general problem of assigning one-dimensional inputs to productive units, which we call “optimal productive transport.” This problem covers additional applications including matching with peer effects (assigning workers to firms, students to schools, or residents to neighborhoods), robust option pricing (assigning future asset prices to price distributions), and partisan gerrymandering (assigning voters to districts).

10.1086/734095.abstractZh: 我们考虑了一般性的贝叶斯说服问题，其中接收者的效用在一维行动中具有单峰特性。我们证明了，在每次实现中最多只涉及两个状态的信号总是最优的，并且在效用非奇异性的条件下，这种“成对”信号是唯一的解决方案。我们的核心结果提供了条件，根据这些条件，接收者在不同嵌套信号实现下的行为要么是单凹陷的，要么是单峰的。我们还为完全披露或负面选择性披露的最优性提供了条件，其中所有信号实现都是嵌套的。在方法上，我们的结果依赖于新颖的对偶性原理和互补松弛定理。我们的分析还扩展到了将一维输入分配给生产单元的一般问题，我们将其称为“最优生产运输”。这个问题还包括其他应用，如与同伴效应的匹配（将工人分配到企业、学生分配到学校或居民分配到社区）、稳健的期权定价（将未来资产价格分配给价格分布）以及党派性选区划分（将选民分配到选区）。

abstract.text: I derive a general condition on consumer behavior ensuring that, in a standard model of demand-determined output, any path of inflation and output that is implementable via interest rate policy is also implementable through time-varying uniform transfers. In an analytical model with occasionally binding borrowing constraints, my condition holds generically. In a quantitative heterogeneous-agent model, the transfer policy that closes any given demand shortfall is furthermore well characterized by a small number of measurable sufficient statistics. My results extend to environments with investment if transfers are supplemented by another standard fiscal tool: bonus depreciation.

10.1086/734096.abstractZh: 我推导出一个关于消费者行为的一般条件，该条件确保在一个标准的需求决定产出模型中，任何通过利率政策实现的通货膨胀和产出路径，也可以通过时间变化的统一转移支付来实现。在一个具有偶尔约束性的借贷约束的分析模型中，我的条件仍然普遍成立。在一个定量异质代理人模型中，能够弥补任何给定需求缺口的转移支付政策，还可以通过少量可测量的充分统计量来很好地描述。如果转移支付辅以另一种标准财政工具——奖励性折旧政策，我的结果还可以扩展到包含投资的环境。

abstract.text: We consider a Bayesian persuasion model in which multiple receivers take one action each. We compare simultaneous procedures with sequential ones. In a simultaneous procedure, all the receivers act simultaneously following the realization of a single public signal. In a sequential procedure, receivers receive information and take actions sequentially. We characterize the conditions under which the optimal sequential procedure leads to a higher payoff and characterize the optimal ordering of actions.

10.1086/734125.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个贝叶斯说服模型，在该模型中，多个接收者各自采取一种行动。我们比较了同时进行的程序和顺序进行的程序。在同时进行的程序中，所有接收者都在一个公共信号被实现后同时采取行动。在顺序进行的程序中，接收者依次接收信息并采取行动。我们描述了在何种条件下，最优的顺序程序能够带来更高的收益，并确定了行动的最优顺序。

abstract.text: The textbook case for industrial policy is well understood: sectors with relatively large external economies of scale should be subsidized at the expense of other sectors. Little is known, however, about the magnitude of the welfare gains from such interventions. We develop an empirical strategy that leverages commonly available trade data to estimate sector-level economies of scale and, in turn, to quantify the gains from optimal industrial policy in a general equilibrium environment. Our results point toward significant economies of scale across manufacturing sectors but gains from industrial policy that are hardly transformative, even among the most open economies.

10.1086/734129.abstractZh: 关于产业政策的作用，学界已有充分的认识：那些具有相对较大外部规模经济效应的行业应当通过补贴来扶持，而牺牲其他行业的利益。然而，关于此类干预措施所带来的福利收益的具体规模，我们知之甚少。我们提出了一种实证策略，利用现有的贸易数据来估算各行业的规模经济效应，进而量化在一般均衡环境下最优产业政策所带来的收益。我们的研究结果表明，制造业各行业都存在显著的规模经济效应，但即使是在最开放的经济体中，产业政策所带来的收益也几乎不具备变革性。

abstract.text: Two players with common interests exchange information to make a decision. But they fear scrutiny. Their unencrypted communications will be observed by another agent with different interests who can object to their decision. We show how the players can implement their ideal decision rule using a back-and-forth conversation. Such a subversive conversation reveals enough information for the players to determine their best decision but not enough information for the observer to determine whether the decision was against his interest. Our results show how conversations can maintain deniability even in the face of leaks, hacks, and other public exposures.

10.1086/734130.abstractZh: 两位有共同利益的玩家通过交流信息来做出决策。但他们害怕受到审查。他们的未加密通信会被另一个有不同利益的代理人观察到，该代理人可以反对他们的决策。我们展示了这些玩家如何通过来回对话来实施他们理想的决策规则。这样的对话能够透露足够的信息，使玩家能够确定最佳决策，但这些信息不足以让观察者判断该决策是否违背了他的利益。我们的研究结果表明，即使面临泄露、黑客攻击和其他公开曝光的情况，对话也能保持否认的可能性。

abstract.text: We propose a political economy mechanism that explains the presence of fiscal regimes punctuated by crisis periods. Our model focuses on the interaction between successive deficit-biased governments subject to independently and identically distributed fiscal shocks. We show that the economy transitions between a fiscally responsible regime and a fiscally irresponsible regime, with transitions occurring during crises when fiscal needs are large. Under fiscal responsibility, governments limit their spending to avoid transitioning to fiscal irresponsibility. Under fiscal irresponsibility, governments spend excessively and precipitate crises that lead to the reinstatement of fiscal responsibility. Regime transitions can occur only if governments’ deficit bias is large enough.

10.1086/734131.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个政治经济学机制，用以解释那些以危机期为特征的财政制度的存在。我们的模型重点关注连续几个赤字倾向的政府之间在独立且同分布的财政冲击下的互动关系。我们指出，经济会在财政负责任的制度和财政不负责任的制度之间转换，这种转换会在财政需求较大的危机时期发生。在财政负责任的制度下，政府会限制支出以避免转变为财政不负责任的制度。而在财政不负责任的制度下，政府会过度支出，从而引发危机，进而促使财政负责任的制度重新确立。只有当政府的赤字倾向足够大时，制度才会发生转换。

abstract.text: We develop a model of competition in prices and infrastructure among mobile network operators. Although consolidation increases market power, it can lead to more efficient data transmission due to economies of scale, which we derive from physical principles. After estimating our model with French consumer and infrastructure data, equilibrium simulations reveal that while prices decrease with the number of firms, so do download speeds. Our framework also allows us to quantify the impact of spectrum allocation. The marginal social value of spectrum exceeds firms’ willingness to pay in our model as well as observed prices in spectrum auctions.

10.1086/734132.abstractZh: 我们建立了一个关于移动网络运营商之间价格和基础设施竞争模型。虽然市场整合会增加市场力量，但由于规模经济效应，它也可以提高数据传输效率，这一结论基于物理原理。通过利用法国的消费者和基础设施数据对模型进行估计后，均衡模拟显示，尽管企业数量减少会导致价格下降，但下载速度也会随之降低。我们的框架还允许我们量化频谱分配的影响。在我们的模型中，频谱的边际社会价值超过了企业愿意支付的金额，这一数值也高于频谱拍卖中观察到的价格。

abstract.text: Misconduct—market actions that are unethical and indicative of fraud—is a significant yet poorly understood issue that underlies many economic transactions. We design a field experiment to study the impact of two-sided antimisconduct information programs, which we deploy on the local markets for mobile money (“human ATMs”) in Ghana. The programs lead to a large reduction in misconduct (−21⁢ percentage points=−72%) and, as a result, broader improvements in overall market activity, consumer welfare, and firm revenue. We show the treatment effect is due to a combination of more accurate consumer beliefs about misconduct and increased vendor reputation concerns.

10.1086/734133.abstractZh: 不当行为——即那些不道德且可能表明欺诈的市场行为——是一个重要但被严重忽视的问题，它存在于许多经济交易中。我们设计了一项实地实验，研究双边反不当行为信息计划的影响，该计划在加纳的移动货币（“人工自动取款机”）本地市场实施。这些计划显著减少了不当行为的发生，减少了21个百分点，即减少了72%。同时，这也带来了市场活动、消费者福利以及企业收入的整体改善。我们发现，这种效果是由于消费者对不当行为的认知更加准确，以及供应商声誉的关注度增加所导致的。

abstract.text: We study the effectiveness of pay-and-chase lawsuits and upfront regulations for combating health care fraud. Between 2003 and 2017, Medicare spent $7.7 billion on 37.5 million regularly scheduled ambulance rides for patients traveling to and from dialysis facilities even though many did not satisfy Medicare's criteria for receiving reimbursements. Using an identification strategy based on the staggered timing of regulations and lawsuits across the US, we find that adding a prior authorization requirement for ambulance reimbursements reduced spending much more than pursuing criminal and civil litigation did on their own. We find no evidence that prior authorization affected patients' health.

10.1086/734134.abstractZh: 我们研究了付费诉讼和预先监管在打击医疗欺诈方面的有效性。在2003年至2017年间，医疗保险花费了77亿美元，用于为370万患者安排定期救护车接送服务，这些患者前往透析设施，尽管许多患者不符合医疗保险的报销标准。通过基于美国各地法规和诉讼时间错开的识别策略，我们发现，在救护车报销中增加预先授权要求，其减少开支的效果远远优于单独进行刑事和民事诉讼。我们没有发现预先授权对患者健康产生了任何影响。

abstract.text: This paper develops and estimates a structural auction platform model with endogenous entry of buyers and sellers to study the welfare impacts of fee changes. Estimates from a new wine auction dataset illustrate the striking feature of two-sided markets that some users can be made better off despite paying higher fees. The results also underscore the importance of addressing seller selection when endogenizing (buyer) entry onto auction platforms. Quantifying the welfare effects from (anticompetitive) fee changes through a model that accounts for important user interactions enables antitrust policy to be applied to such markets.

10.1086/734722.abstractZh: 本文开发并估计了一个具有内生买家和卖家参与的结构性拍卖平台模型，以研究费用变化对福利的影响。来自一个新的葡萄酒拍卖数据集的估计结果表明，在双边市场中，尽管用户需要支付更高的费用，但某些用户仍有可能获得更好的福利。研究结果还强调了在内生化（买家）进入拍卖平台时，解决卖家选择问题的重要性。通过一种能够考虑重要用户互动的模型来量化（反竞争性）费用变化对福利的影响，使得反垄断政策能够应用于此类市场。

abstract.text: This paper presents a method for estimating discrete games based on bounds of conditional choice probabilities. The bounds are probabilities that an action is dominant and that it is not dominated. Because the bounds are easy to compute, our method is scalable to models with many firms and discrete decisions. We apply the method to study the effects of a hypothetical merger on firm entry and product variety in local retail craft beer markets in California. We find that the merger induces firm entry. The net effect on product variety is ambiguous once a fixed cost efficiency is taken into account.

10.1086/734724.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种基于条件选择概率界限的离散博弈估计方法。这些界限表示某个行动是占优的，或者不被其他行动所支配的概率。由于这些界限易于计算，我们的方法可以扩展到包含多个企业和离散决策的模型中。我们应用该方法研究了假设性合并对加州本地零售手工啤酒市场中的企业进入和产品多样性影响。研究发现，合并确实促进了企业进入市场，但一旦考虑到固定成本效率因素，对产品多样性的影响则具有不确定性。

abstract.text: This paper evaluates the potential for global reallocation between agricultural and nonagricultural production to contribute to climate change adaptation. Empirical estimates using a global sample of firms suggest that rising temperatures reduce productivity less in nonagriculture than angriculture, implying large potential gains if hot countries could increase food imports and shift labor toward manufacturing. However, model counterfactuals show that subsistence consumption needs and high trade barriers combine to create a “food problem” in which climate change instead intensifies agricultural specialization in especially vulnerable regions. Simulations suggest that reducing trade barriers can significantly reduce climate damages, especially in poor countries.

10.1086/734725.abstractZh: 本文评估了农业与非农业生产之间在全球范围内的重新分配对适应气候变化的可能贡献。基于全球样本企业的实证分析表明，气温上升对农业与非农业生产的生产力影响不同，这意味着如果炎热国家能够增加食品进口并将劳动力转向制造业，将会有巨大的潜在收益。然而，模型反事实分析显示，生存消费需求和高贸易壁垒共同导致了“粮食问题”，即气候变化反而加剧了在特别脆弱地区的农业专业化。模拟结果表明，降低贸易壁垒可以显著减少气候损害，尤其是在贫困国家。

abstract.text: Do higher wages induce more automation innovation? We identify automation patents in machinery. We show that a higher automation intensity predicts a decline in routine tasks across US sectors. Then, we estimate how innovating firms respond to changes in their downstream firms’ low- and high-skill wages. We compute these wages by combining macroeconomic data on 41 countries with innovating firms’ global market exposure. Higher low-skill wages increase automation innovation (but not other machinery innovation), with an elasticity of 2–5. Finally, we show that the German Hartz labor market reforms reduced automation innovations by foreign firms more exposed to Germany.

10.1086/734778.abstractZh: 更高的工资是否会促进更多的自动化创新？我们重点关注机械领域的自动化专利。研究表明，较高的自动化程度会导致美国各行业的常规任务减少。接着，我们研究了创新型企业对其下游企业低技能和高技能工资变化的反应。我们通过结合41个国家的宏观经济数据以及创新型企业的全球市场影响力来计算这些工资水平。研究发现，较高的低技能工资会增加自动化创新（但不会影响其他机械领域的创新），其弹性为2-5。最后，我们发现德国的哈茨劳动市场改革减少了那些更依赖德国市场的外国企业的自动化创新。

abstract.text: Government policy uncertainty affects irreversible decisions including technology adoption and exit. This paper quantifies uncertainty surrounding the Mercury and Air Toxics Standards (MATS). We estimate a dynamic oligopoly model for coal-fired electricity generators that recovers generators’ beliefs regarding future MATS enforcement. We develop the approximate belief oligopoly equilibrium concept, where players understand that their decisions impact aggregate market states. MATS enforcement created substantial uncertainty: the perceived enforcement probability dropped to 43%. Resolving uncertainty early would increase profits by $1.39 billion but also increase pollution costs by $0.652–$1.776 billion. Had exit been unlikely, resolving uncertainty early would have decreased pollution.

10.1086/734779.abstractZh: 政府政策的不确定性会影响包括技术采用和退出在内的不可逆决策。本文量化了关于汞和空气污染物标准的不确定性。我们建立了一个动态寡头模型，用于分析燃煤发电厂的决策，该模型能够反映发电厂对未来标准执行情况的预期。我们提出了近似信念寡头均衡的概念，即各参与者都明白他们的决策会影响整个市场的状态。标准的执行造成了巨大的不确定性：人们认为标准执行的概率下降到了43%。及早解决不确定性可以带来13.9亿美元的利润增长，但同时也会增加6.52亿至17.76亿美元的污染成本。如果退出计划不太可能实现，那么及早解决不确定性反而可以减少污染。

abstract.text: Empirical models of labor market competition usually assume that employers set wages noncooperatively, despite frequent allegations of collusive employer behavior. We propose an identification approach for labor market collusion that relies on production and cost data, and we use it to study how employer collusion affected wage markdowns of 227 Belgian coal firms between 1845 and 1913. We are able to detect collusion through the 1897 coal cartel without ex ante knowledge of its timing and find that it explains the fast growth in markdowns after 1900. We find that the cartel decreased both wages and employment by 6% to 17%.

10.1086/734780.abstractZh: 关于劳动力市场竞争的实证模型通常假设雇主的薪酬设定是非合作的，尽管有频繁的指控称存在雇主勾结行为。我们提出了一种基于生产和成本数据的劳动力市场勾结识别方法，并利用该方法研究了1845年至1913年间227家比利时煤炭企业因雇主勾结而导致的薪酬下降情况。我们能够在不知道勾结时间的情况下识别出1897年的煤炭卡特尔行为，并发现该行为解释了1900年后薪酬下降的快速增长。研究发现，该卡特尔使工资和就业人数分别减少了6%到17%。

abstract.text: German long-term health insurance (GLTHI) represents the largest market for private long-term health insurance contracts in the world. We show that GLTHI’s contract design coincides with the optimal dynamic contract for individuals with constant lifetime income profiles. After estimating the key ingredients of a life-cycle model, we find that, under a variety of assumptions, GLTHI achieves welfare that is at most 4% lower than for the optimal contract. Relative to the gains of replacing short-term contracts with either of the two long-term contracts, this welfare gap is smallest when reclassification risk is high.

10.1086/734781.abstractZh: 德国长期健康保险（GLTHI）是全球私人长期健康保险合同最大的市场。我们发现，GLTHI的合同设计与具有恒定终身收入特征的个体最优动态合同相吻合。在估算了生命周期模型的关键要素后，我们发现，在多种假设条件下，GLTHI带来的福利水平最多比最优合同低4%。与用这两种长期合同替代短期合同所带来的收益相比，当重新分类风险较高时，这种福利差距最小。

abstract.text: We study the efficiency of inattentive but otherwise frictionless economies by augmenting the Arrow-Debreu framework with a flexible form of rational inattention. If attention costs satisfy an invariance condition embedded in Sims’s mutual information specification, a version of the first welfare theorem holds no matter the degree of inattention. More generally, however, a cognitive externality may emerge, and welfare may be improved by regulating and simplifying markets. We discuss how these results qualify Hayek’s argument about the informational optimality of the price system, how they link the normative question of interest to a decision-theoretic literature on stochastic choice, and how they separate paternalistic and nonpaternalistic approaches to modeling inattention.

10.1086/734870.abstractZh: 我们研究了那些虽然缺乏注意力但其他方面运作顺畅的经济体的效率问题，通过为Arrow-Debreu框架增加一种灵活的形式化的理性忽视机制。如果注意力成本满足Sims的互信息规范中的不变性条件，那么无论忽视程度如何，第一个福利定理的版本仍然成立。然而，更一般地说，可能会出现认知外部性，通过调节和简化市场，可以改善福利状况。我们讨论了这些结果如何验证Hayek关于价格体系信息最优性的论点，如何将规范性问题与随机选择的决策理论联系起来，以及如何区分以家长式方式处理忽视问题的方法与非家长式方法。

abstract.text: Using a natural experiment from a retail gasoline antitrust case, we study how asymmetric information sharing affects oligopoly pricing. Empirically, price competition softens when, following case settlement, information sharing shifts from symmetric to asymmetric, with one firm losing access to high-frequency granular rival price data. We provide theory and empirics illustrating how strategic ignorance creates price commitment, leading to higher price-cost margins. Using a structural model, we find substantial profit-enhancing effects of asymmetric information sharing. These results provide a cautionary tale for antitrust agencies regarding the potential unintended consequences of limiting price information sharing among firms.

10.1086/734872.abstractZh: 我们通过一个零售汽油反垄断案例中的自然实验，研究信息不对称共享如何影响寡头定价。实证研究表明，在案件和解后，当信息共享从对称变为不对称时，价格竞争会减弱，因为其中一家企业将无法获得竞争对手的高频价格数据。我们通过理论和实证分析，说明了战略性无知如何导致价格承诺，进而提升价格与成本之间的利润率。通过结构模型分析，我们发现信息不对称共享具有显著的利润提升效应。这些结果对于反垄断机构来说是一个警示，提醒他们在限制企业间价格信息共享时，可能会无意中引发一些不良后果。

abstract.text: Governments use policy experiments to facilitate learning, but the nature and effects of these experiments remain unclear. We analyze China's policy experimentation since 1980—among the most systematic in history—and document three facts. First, most experiments exhibit positive sample selection. Second, local politicians exert excessive efforts during experiments that are not replicable during policies’ national rollout. Third, the central government is not fully sophisticated when interpreting experimentation outcomes. These facts suggest that policy learning may be biased and national policies may be distorted. Thus, while China’s institutions enable experimentation at an unparalleled scale, the complex political environments can also limit effective policy learning.

10.1086/734873.abstractZh: 政府通过政策实验来促进学习，但这些实验的性质和影响仍然不明确。我们分析了自1980年以来中国进行的政策实验——这些实验在历史上是最系统的之一，并发现了三个事实。首先，大多数实验都表现出积极的样本选择效应。其次，地方政客在实验期间投入了过多的精力，而这些精力在政策在全国范围内实施时无法复制。第三，中央政府在解读实验结果时并不十分成熟。这些事实表明，政策学习可能存在偏差，国家政策也可能被扭曲。因此，尽管中国的制度为实验提供了前所未有的规模，但复杂的政治环境也可能限制有效的政策学习。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the conditions under which more legislation contributes to economic growth. In the context of US states, we apply natural language processing tools to measure legislative flows for the years 1965–2012. We implement a novel shift-share design for text data, where the instrument for legislation is leave-one-out legal topic flows interacted with pretreatment legal topic shares. We find that at the margin, higher legislative output causes more economic growth. Consistent with more complete laws reducing ex post holdup, we find that the effect is driven by the use of contingent clauses, is largest in sectors with high relationship-specific investments, and is increasing with local economic uncertainty.

10.1086/734874.abstractZh: 本文分析了在何种条件下，更多的立法能够促进经济增长。以美国各州为研究对象，我们运用自然语言处理工具来测量1965年至2012年间的立法活动。我们采用了一种新颖的文本数据处理方法，将立法活动分解为“留一法”的法律主题流，并与预处理阶段的法律主题份额相结合进行分析。研究发现，在边际上，更高的立法产出会导致更大的经济增长。与更完善的法律法规能够减少事后阻碍现象一致的是，我们发现这种效应主要源于偶然条款的使用，在具有高特定关系投资的行业中最为显著，并且随着当地经济不确定性的增加而增强。

abstract.text: We study optimal adversarial information design in a dynamic regime change game. Agents decide when to attack, if at all.
