Our experiments focused on downstream medical debt that had been sold to debt collectors, and one of our experiments straddled an industry-wide pullback in the reporting of medical debt to the credit bureaus, allowing us to estimate the effects of debt relief with and without counterfactual reporting. We track outcomes using credit reports, collections account data, and a multimodal survey. There are three sets of results. First, we find a modest improvement in credit access when there is counterfactual credit reporting, but no impact on credit report outcomes when there is not. Second, we estimate that debt relief causes a moderate but statistically significant reduction in payments of existing medical bills. Third, we find no effects on survey measures of mental and physical health, healthcare utilization, and financial wellness. Taken together, our results indicate that the strong correlations documented in prior research do not translate into causal effects for downstream medical debt relief.

10.1093/qje/qjae045.abstractZh: 五分之一的美国人背负着医疗债务，其中近一半的人欠款至少2,500美元。面对这一负担，政府和私人捐助者纷纷采取大规模、高调的行动来减轻医疗债务。我们与RIP Medical Debt（现更名为Undue Medical Debt）合作，在2018年至2020年间对83,401人进行了两项随机实验，以减免价值1.69亿美元的医疗债务。我们的实验重点针对已出售给债务收集机构的下游医疗债务，其中一项实验还利用了整个行业在向信用机构报告医疗债务方面的减少趋势，从而能够估算出有无反事实报告情况下的债务减免效果。我们通过信用报告、催收账户数据以及多维度调查来追踪结果。我们得到了三组结果：首先，当存在反事实信用报告时，信用获取能力有所改善，但不存在反事实报告时则没有影响；其次，我们估计债务减免导致现有医疗账单的支付金额有所减少，但这一减少幅度适中且具有统计学意义；第三，我们发现债务减免对心理健康、身体健康状况、医疗利用以及财务福祉等调查指标没有影响。综合来看，我们的结果表明，先前研究中记录的强相关性并未转化为下游医疗债务减免的因果效应。

abstract.text: We estimate productivity growth in England from 1250 to 1870. Real wages over this period were heavily influenced by plague-induced swings in the population. Our estimates account for these Malthusian dynamics. We find that productivity growth was zero before 1600. Productivity growth began in 1600—almost a century before the Glorious Revolution. Thus, the onset of productivity growth preceded the bourgeois institutional reforms of seventeenth-century England. We estimate productivity growth of 2% per decade between 1600 and 1800, increasing to 5% per decade between 1810 and 1860. Much of the increase in output growth during the Industrial Revolution is explained by structural change—the falling importance of land in production—rather than faster productivity growth. Stagnant real wages in the eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries—Engels’ Pause—is explained by rapid population growth putting downward pressure on real wages. Yet feedback from population growth to real wages is sufficiently weak to permit sustained deviations from the “iron law of wages” prior to the Industrial Revolution.

10.1093/qje/qjae046.abstractZh: 我们估算了英格兰从1250年到1870年的生产率增长情况。在此期间，实际工资受到瘟疫导致的人口波动的严重影响。我们的估算考虑了这些马尔萨斯式的动态因素。我们发现，在1600年之前，生产率增长为零。生产率增长始于1600年——几乎比光荣革命早了一个世纪。因此，生产率增长的开始早于17世纪英格兰的资产阶级制度改革。我们估算出，在1600年至1800年间，生产率以每十年2%的速度增长；而在1810年至1860年间，这一速度上升至每十年5%。工业革命期间产出增长的提升，很大程度上是由结构性变化造成的——即土地在生产中的重要性下降——而非生产率更快的增长。18世纪和19世纪早期的停滞实际工资——即恩格斯所说的“暂停”——是由于人口快速增长对实际工资施加了下行压力所致。然而，人口增长对实际工资的反馈作用足够弱，使得在工业革命之前，实际工资能够持续偏离“工资铁律”。

abstract.text: Is government guiding the invisible hand at the top of the labor market? We use new administrative data to measure physicians’ earnings and estimate the influence of health care policies on these earnings, physicians’ labor supply, and the allocation of talent. Combining the administrative registry of U.S. physicians with tax data, Medicare billing records, and survey responses, we find that physicians’ annual earnings average $350,000 and make up 8.6% of national health care spending. Business income makes up one-quarter of earnings and is systematically underreported in survey data. Earnings increase steeply early in the career, and there are major differences across specialties, regions, and firm sizes. The geographic pattern of earnings is unusual compared with other workers. We argue that these patterns reflect policy choices to subsidize demand for physician care, amplified by restrictions on physician entry, especially in certain specialties. Health policy has a major impact on the margin: 25% of physician fee revenue driven by Medicare reimbursements accrues to physicians personally. Physicians earn 8% of public money spent on insurance expansion. These policies in turn affect the type and quantity of medical care physicians supply, retirement timing, and the allocation of talent across specialties.

10.1093/qje/qjaf001.abstractZh: 政府是否在劳动力市场的顶端发挥着“看不见的手”的作用？我们利用新的行政数据来衡量医生的收入，并估算医疗政策对这些收入、医生劳动力供应以及人才分配的影响。通过结合美国医生的行政登记数据、税收数据、医疗保险账单记录以及调查数据，我们发现医生的年收入平均为35万美元，占全国医疗支出的8.6%。商业收入占收入的四分之一，但在调查数据中系统性地被低估。收入在职业生涯早期迅速增长，不同专业、地区以及公司规模之间存在显著差异。与其他工人相比，收入的地理分布模式并不寻常。我们认为，这些模式反映了政策选择对医生护理需求的补贴，这种补贴因对医生进入某些专业的限制而得到加强。医疗政策对医生收入有重大影响：由医疗保险报销产生的25%的医生费用收入直接归医生个人所有。医生获得的收入占公共在保险扩展上支出的8%。这些政策反过来又影响医生提供的医疗服务类型和数量、退休时间以及人才在不同专业之间的分配。

abstract.text: We identify phrases associated with novel technologies using textual analysis of patents, job postings, and earnings calls, enabling us to identify four stylized facts on the diffusion of jobs relating to new technologies. First, the development of economically impactful new technologies is geographically highly concentrated, more so even than overall patenting: 56% of the most economically impactful technologies come from just two U.S. locations, Silicon Valley and the Northeast Corridor. Second, as the technologies mature and the number of related jobs grows, hiring spreads geographically. This process is very slow, taking around 50 years to disperse fully. Third, while initial hiring in new technologies is highly skill-biased, over time the mean skill level in new positions declines, drawing in an increasing number of lower-skilled workers. Finally, the geographic spread of hiring is slowest for higher-skilled positions, with the locations where new technologies were pioneered remaining the focus for the technology's high-skill jobs for decades.

10.1093/qje/qjaf002.abstractZh: 我们通过文本分析专利、职位招聘信息以及收入电话会议中的相关表述，识别出与新技术相关的四个特征性现象。首先，具有经济影响力的新技术的开发在地理上高度集中，甚至比整体专利申请更为集中：56%最具经济影响力的技术来自美国的两个地区——硅谷和东北走廊。其次，随着技术成熟以及相关职位的增加，招聘活动在地理上的分布也变得更加分散。这一过程非常缓慢，需要大约50年的时间才能完全实现。第三，虽然新技术的初期招聘高度依赖技能要求，但随着时间的推移，新职位的平均技能水平逐渐下降，吸引了越来越多的低技能工人。最后，高技能职位的招聘在地理上的扩散最为缓慢，那些新技术发源地所在的地区，几十年来仍然是高技能职位的主要聚集地。

abstract.text: This article examines language patterns in U.S. television news coverage of police killings. First, we document that the media use syntactic structures—such as passive voice, nominalizations, and intransitive verbs—that obscure responsibility more often in cases of police killings than in cases of civilian killings. Through an online experiment, we demonstrate the significance of these syntactic differences, revealing that participants are less likely to hold police officers morally responsible and demand penalties when exposed to obfuscatory language, particularly in cases involving unarmed victims. Further analysis of news data shows greater use of obfuscatory language when the victims are unarmed or video footage is available—situations in which obfuscation may have the greatest impact. Exploring the causes of this differential obfuscation, we do not find evidence that it is driven by either demand-side factors or supply-side factors associated with TV station ownership and political leaning. Instead, our results suggest that narratives crafted by police departments are more likely drivers of media obfuscation. This article highlights how syntactic choices and their semantic consequences in media shape perceptions, extending beyond coverage volume and bias.

10.1093/qje/qjaf004.abstractZh: 本文探讨了美国电视新闻中对警察杀人的报道中的语言模式。首先，我们发现媒体在报道警察杀人案件时，更频繁地使用一些句法结构，如被动语态、名词化以及不及物动词，这些手段能够模糊责任归属，而在报道平民杀人案件时则较少使用这些手段。通过在线实验，我们进一步证明了这些句法差异的重要性，发现当参与者接触到这些模糊语言时，他们更不可能认为警察在道德上有责任，也不会要求对警察进行惩罚，尤其是在涉及无武装受害者的案件中。对新闻数据的进一步分析显示，当受害者无武装或存在视频资料时，媒体更可能使用模糊语言——在这些情况下，模糊语言的影响可能最为显著。在探究这种差异性的原因时，我们没有发现任何证据表明这种模糊语言的使用是由需求方因素或与电视台所有权和政治倾向相关的供给方因素所驱动的。相反，我们的研究结果表明，警察部门制作的报道更可能是导致媒体使用模糊语言的驱动因素。本文强调了句法选择及其在媒体中的语义后果如何塑造人们的认知，这种影响超越了报道的篇幅和偏见。

abstract.text: A long-standing and influential view in U.S. correctional policy is that “nothing works” when it comes to rehabilitating incarcerated individuals. We revisit this hypothesis by studying an innovative law-enforcement-led program launched in the county jail of Flint, MI: Inmate Growth Naturally and Intentionally through Education (IGNITE). We develop an instrumental variables approach to estimate the effects of IGNITE exposure, leveraging quasi-random court delays that cause individuals to spend more time in jail before and after the program’s launch. Holding time in jail fixed, we find that one additional month of IGNITE exposure reduces weekly misconduct in jail by 25% and three-month recidivism by 24%, with the recidivism effects growing over time. Surveys of staff and community members, along with administrative test-score records and within-jail text messages, suggest that cultural change and improved literacy and numeracy scores are contributing mechanisms.

10.1093/qje/qjaf005.abstractZh: 在美国的矫正政策中，一直存在一种具有影响力的观点，即对于被监禁人员的改造工作，没有任何有效的办法。我们通过研究密歇根州弗林特县监狱推出的一项由执法部门主导的创新项目来重新审视这一假设：该项目名为“通过教育自然且有意地促进囚犯成长”（IGNITE）。我们采用工具变量方法来估算IGNITE项目的影响，利用准随机的法庭延迟因素作为自变量，这些因素导致项目启动前后囚犯在监狱中的时间增加。在固定监狱羁押时间的情况下，我们发现，每增加一个月的IGNITE项目时间，每周的监狱内不当行为就会减少25%，三个月后再犯率则降低24%，且这种再犯效应会随时间逐渐增强。对工作人员和社区成员的调查，以及行政测试成绩记录和监狱内的短信记录表明，文化变革以及识字率和计算能力的提高也是该项目成功的关键因素。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of denying a wanted abortion on women and children in Colombia using high-quality administrative microdata and credibly exogenous variation in abortion access. Women can seek legal abortions through a tutela , with cases randomly assigned to judges. Female judges are 20 p.p. (32%) less likely to deny abortion cases than male judges, and we use the judge's sex as an instrument for abortion denial. Denial of a wanted abortion has both immediate and lasting effects. It increases a woman's risk of death by 2.5 p.p within nine months, mainly due to unsafe abortion procedures, and raises the likelihood of carrying the pregnancy to term by 31 p.p. Tracking outcomes up to 15 years later, we find that women denied an abortion experience more health issues, lower educational attainment, reduced labor-force participation, and higher rates of single motherhood, poverty, and reliance on government assistance. Existing children, born before their mother sought an abortion, are less likely to attend school and more likely to work.

10.1093/qje/qjaf006.abstractZh: 本文通过高质量的行政微观数据以及可置信的外生性变量，探讨了在哥伦比亚拒绝实施堕胎行为对妇女和儿童的影响。妇女可以通过“tutela”制度寻求合法堕胎，且案件会被随机分配给法官。女性法官拒绝堕胎案件的可能性比男性法官低20个百分点（32%），我们将法官的性别作为判断堕胎是否被拒绝的指标。拒绝实施堕胎行为不仅会产生即时影响，还会产生长期后果：在九个月内，因不安全堕胎程序，妇女死亡风险增加2.5个百分点；同时，将妊娠坚持到足月的可能性增加31个百分点。经过15年的追踪研究，我们发现被拒绝堕胎的妇女面临更多的健康问题，教育水平较低，劳动力参与率较低，成为单亲母亲、陷入贫困以及依赖政府援助的可能性更高。而那些在母亲寻求堕胎之前出生的孩子，则更有可能辍学或从事劳动。

abstract.text: I develop a model of the social construction of race. Racial categories emerge from labor conflict when elites privilege intrinsically irrelevant traits to divide workers against each other and extract workers’ surplus. I show that elites use color to grant unequal rights and track these rights across generations because it is heritable, observable, and relatively immutable. Depending on the demographic conditions the elites face, the system of racialization manifests either as ancestry-based or color-based categories. This approach to the social construction of race provides a unified explanation of skin-tone inequality, racial homophily in marriage, the social status of mixed-race people, the psychological wage of Jim Crow, and legal restrictions on manumission. I test for historical variations in racial boundaries using census data from the United States and Brazil and for differential patterns of skin-tone inequality between ancestry-based and color-based systems using survey data from across the Americas.

10.1093/qje/qjaf007.abstractZh: 我提出了一个关于种族社会建构的模型。种族类别源于劳动冲突，当精英阶层利用本质上无关的特征来分化工人，从而榨取工人的剩余价值时，种族分类便应运而生。我指出，精英们利用肤色来赋予不平等的权利，并将这些权利代代相传，因为肤色具有可遗传性、可观察性且相对不变。根据精英所面临的人口状况，种族分类系统表现为基于血统或基于肤色的分类。这种关于种族社会建构的方法为肤色不平等、婚姻中的种族同质性、混血人群的社会地位、吉姆·克劳法的心理代价以及法律对解放的限制等现象提供了统一的解释。我利用美国和巴西的人口普查数据来检验种族边界的历史变化，并利用来自美洲各地的调查数据来研究基于血统和基于肤色的分类体系之间肤色不平等的差异模式。

abstract.text: This article studies the unexpected retraction of a U.S. federal policy in 2016 that would have more than doubled the “overtime exemption threshold” from $455 to $913 per week and thereby grant overtime protection to an additional 20% of salaried workers. Although the policy was blocked by a federal court injunction a week before it was supposed to take effect, I show that it nevertheless had a persistent positive impact on workers’ earnings. Leveraging a bunching design with administrative payroll data from ADP, I find that employers raised workers’ salaries to the $913 threshold even after the policy was repealed. Over the next 18 months, difference-in-difference estimates reveal that employers did not slow the wage growth of workers affected by the policy relative to those already earning above $913 per week, nor did they hire new employees at a lower pay rate. Real wages remained persistently elevated relative to what they would have been absent the policy and separation rates decreased among workers bunched at the $913 threshold. Comparing highly exposed firms to unaffected firms, I find an increase in employers’ wage bills but no change in aggregate employment. Taken together, the results indicate that temporary policies impacting wage levels can have permanent effects on the labor market. Survey responses collected by the Department of Labor suggest that morale concerns play a key role in driving the wage hysteresis.

10.1093/qje/qjaf008.abstractZh: 本文研究了2016年美国一项联邦政策的意外撤销情况。该政策原本旨在将“加班豁免门槛”从455美元提高至913美元，从而为额外20%的薪资劳动者提供加班保护。尽管该政策在生效前一周被联邦法院禁令阻止，但我发现它仍然对劳动者收入产生了持续的积极影响。通过利用ADP的行政薪资数据，我发现即使在政策被废除后，雇主仍将工人的薪资提高到913美元的门槛。在接下来的18个月中，差异分解估计显示，与那些已经每周收入超过913美元的人相比，受该政策影响的工人的工资增长并未放缓，雇主也没有以较低的薪资水平招聘新员工。实际工资相对于没有该政策的情况而言持续上升，而在913美元门槛处被捆绑的工人的离职率有所下降。通过比较那些高度受影响的公司与未受影响的公司，我发现雇主的薪资支出有所增加，但总体就业人数并未发生变化。综合来看，这些结果表明，影响工资水平的临时政策可能会对劳动力市场产生持久的影响。劳工部收集的调查数据表明，士气问题在驱动工资滞后效应中起着关键作用。

abstract.text: Market-based environmental regulations are seldom used in low-income countries, where pollution is highest but state capacity is often low. We collaborated with the Gujarat Pollution Control Board (GPCB) to design and experimentally evaluate the world’s first particulate-matter emissions market, which covered industrial plants in a large Indian city. There are three main findings. First, the market functioned well. Treatment plants, randomly assigned to the emissions market, traded permits to become significant net sellers or buyers. After trading, treatment plants held enough permits to cover their emissions 99% of the time, compared with just 66% compliance with standards under the command-and-control status quo. Second, treatment plants reduced pollution emissions, relative to control plants, by 20%–30%. Third, the market reduced abatement costs by an estimated 11%, holding constant emissions. This cost-savings estimate is based on plant-specific marginal cost curves that we estimate from the universe of bids to buy and sell permits in the market. The combination of pollution reductions and low costs imply that the emissions market has mortality benefits that exceed its costs by at least 25 times.

10.1093/qje/qjaf009.abstractZh: 在低收入国家，基于市场的环境监管很少被采用，因为这些国家的污染最为严重，而政府的能力往往较低。我们与古吉拉特邦污染控制委员会合作，设计并实验性地评估了世界上第一个颗粒物排放市场，该市场覆盖了一座印度大城市的工业设施。研究得出三个主要结论：首先，该市场运行良好。被随机分配到排放市场的处理设施通过交易许可，成为重要的净卖家或买家。交易后，这些处理设施在99%的时间内能够确保排放得到控制，而在传统的命令与控制模式下，这一比例仅为66%。其次，与对照组设施相比，处理设施减少了20%至30%的污染排放。第三，在排放保持不变的情况下，该市场使减排成本降低了约11%。这一成本节约估计基于我们从市场中的买卖许可交易数据中估算出的各处理设施的边际成本曲线。污染减少与低成本相结合的结果表明，排放市场的效益至少是其成本的25倍。

abstract.text: This article investigates how competition to publish first and thereby establish priority affects the quality of scientific research. We begin by developing a model where scientists decide whether and how long to work on a given project. When deciding how long they should let their projects mature, scientists trade off the marginal benefit of higher-quality research against the marginal risk of being preempted. Projects with the highest scientific potential are the most competitive because they induce the most entry. Therefore, the model predicts these projects are also the most rushed and lowest quality. We test the predictions of this model in the field of structural biology using data from the Protein Data Bank (PDB), a repository for structures of large macromolecules. An important feature of the PDB is that it assigns objective measures of scientific quality to each structure. As suggested by the model, we find that structures with higher ex ante potential generate more competition, are completed faster, and are lower quality. Consistent with the model, and with a causal interpretation of our empirical results, these relationships are mitigated when we focus on structures deposited by scientists who—by nature of their employment position—are less focused on publication and priority. We estimate that the costs associated with improving these low-quality structures are between $1.5 and $8.8 billion since the PDB’s founding in 1971.

10.1093/qje/qjaf010.abstractZh: 本文探讨了竞争以率先发表从而确立优先地位如何影响科学研究的质量。我们首先建立了一个模型，该模型描述了科学家如何决定是否以及需要多长时间来开展某个项目。在决定项目成熟所需的时间时，科学家需要在高质量研究的边际收益与可能被抢先发表的边际风险之间进行权衡。具有最高科学潜力的项目最具竞争力，因为它们会吸引最多的参与者。因此，该模型预测这些项目也是最匆忙且质量最低的项目。我们在结构生物学领域使用蛋白质数据库（PDB）的数据来验证该模型的预测。PDB的一个重要特点是它为每个结构都赋予了科学质量的客观衡量标准。正如模型所预测的那样，我们发现那些具有更高潜在价值的结构会引发更多的竞争，完成速度更快，但质量却较低。与模型一致，并且根据我们实证结果的因果解释，当我们关注那些由于职业性质而不太注重发表和优先级的科学家所提交的结构时，这些关系会得到缓解。我们估计，自1971年PDB成立以来，改善这些低质量结构所付出的成本在15亿美元到88亿美元之间。

abstract.text: This article studies the effects of the largest residential racial desegregation initiative in U.S. history, the Gautreaux Assisted Housing Program. From the late 1970s to the 1990s, Gautreaux moved thousands of Black families into predominantly white neighborhoods to support racial and economic integration. We link historical program records to administrative data and use plausibly exogenous variation in neighborhood placements to study how desegregating moves affect children in the long run. Being placed in the predominantly white neighborhoods targeted by the program significantly increases children’s future lifetime earnings and wealth. These moves also increase the likelihood of marriage and particularly raise the probability of being married to a white spouse. Moreover, placements through Gautreaux affect neighborhood choices in adulthood. Those placed in predominantly white neighborhoods during childhood live in more racially diverse areas with higher rates of upward mobility nearly 40 years later.

10.1093/qje/qjaf011.abstractZh: 本文研究了美国历史上规模最大的住宅种族融合计划——高特罗辅助住房计划的影响。从20世纪70年代末到90年代，高特罗计划将数千个黑人家庭迁移到以白人为主的社区，以促进种族和经济融合。我们通过将历史计划记录与行政数据相结合，并利用社区安置中的外部变量，来研究这种融合措施对儿童长期发展的影响。被安置在计划目标白人社区的儿童，其未来收入与财富显著增加。这些迁移还提高了他们结婚的可能性，尤其是与白人配偶结婚的概率。此外，通过高特罗计划获得的社区安置，对成年后的社区选择也有影响。那些在童年时期被安置在白人社区的儿童，在将近40年后，居住在种族更加多元化的地区，并且拥有更高的向上流动的可能性。

abstract.text: This article posits an information channel as an explanation for sudden inflations. Households saving via nominal government bonds face a choice whether to acquire costly information about future government surpluses. They trade off the cost of acquiring information about the surpluses that back bond repayment against the benefit of a more informed saving decision. Through the information channel, small changes in the economic environment can trigger large responses in consumer behavior and prices. This setting explains why there can be long stretches of time during which government surpluses have large movements with little inflation response; then at some point, something snaps, and a sudden inflation takes off that is strongly responsive to incoming fiscal news.

10.1093/qje/qjaf012.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个信息渠道作为突发通货膨胀的解释。通过名义政府债券进行储蓄的家庭面临着一个选择：是承担获取未来政府盈余相关信息的成本，还是权衡获取这些信息的收益，以做出更明智的储蓄决策。通过信息渠道，经济环境中的微小变化能够引发消费者行为和价格的大幅反应。这一设定解释了为什么在一段时间内，政府盈余会出现大幅波动，而通货膨胀反应却很小；然后，在某个时刻，突然发生通货膨胀，这种通货膨胀对即将到来的财政消息反应非常强烈。

abstract.text: This article identifies which investments in school facilities help students and which are valued by homeowners. Using novel data on school district bonds, test scores, and house prices across 29 U.S. states and a research design based on narrowly decided elections with staggered timing, we find that increased capital spending in schools significantly improves test scores and is efficient on average. However, the effects vary widely depending on the type of project and the characteristics of the school district. Investments in essential infrastructure, such as HVAC systems or pollutant removal, yield notable improvements in student performance, while expenditures on athletic facilities show no measurable academic benefit. Socioeconomically disadvantaged districts gain disproportionately from capital investments, even after accounting for project type, yet these districts typically underinvest in such projects.

10.1093/qje/qjaf013.abstractZh: 本文探讨了哪些学校设施投资能够帮助学生，以及哪些投资受到房主的青睐。通过利用关于美国29个州学校区债券、考试成绩和房价的新型数据，并采用基于分阶段选举的研究设计，我们发现增加学校的资本投入显著提升了考试成绩，且平均而言是有效的。然而，这种效果因项目类型和学校区的特征而异。对基本基础设施的投资，如暖通空调系统或污染物去除设施，能够显著改善学生的表现，而体育设施的投资则未能显示出明显的学术效益。社会经济条件较差的学区从资本投资中获益尤为明显，即使考虑到项目类型，这些学区通常在这些项目上的投资不足。

abstract.text: What is the effect of the real minimum wage on wages and inequality? I develop a theory that nests the race between education and technology. The theory predicts that the effect of changes in minimum wages is initially small but grows over time. I present empirical evidence of these dynamic effects: the elasticity of real wages grows substantially over a three-year period. I show that minimum wages help rationalize a considerable decline in real wages of low-education workers in the 1980s and play a role in shaping the evolution of the U.S. college premium.

10.1093/qje/qjaf014.abstractZh: 实际最低工资对工资和不平等有何影响？我提出了一个将教育与技术之间的竞争纳入考虑的理论。该理论预测，最低工资变化的效应最初较小，但随着时间的推移会逐渐增强。我提供了这些动态效应的实证证据：实际工资的弹性在三年期间显著上升。我表明，最低工资有助于解释20世纪80年代低教育水平工人实际工资的显著下降，并在塑造美国大学学费溢价的过程中发挥了作用。

abstract.text: We present evidence that the high estimated marginal propensities to consume (MPCs) from the leading household studies result in implausible macroeconomic counterfactuals. Using the 2008 tax rebate as a case study, we calibrate a standard macro model with the estimated micro MPCs to construct counterfactual macroeconomic consumption paths in the absence of a rebate. The counterfactual paths imply that consumption expenditures would have plummeted in spring and summer 2008 and mostly recovered in September 2008. We use narratives and forecasts to argue that these paths are implausible. We show that standard two-way fixed effect estimates of the micro MPCs are upward biased. When we correct for the biases, we estimate smaller micro MPCs using the CEX data than the previous literature. We show that realistic modifications of the model result in general equilibrium forces that dampen rather than amplify micro MPCs. The combination of smaller micro MPCs and dampening general equilibrium forces implies general equilibrium consumption multipliers that are below 0.2.

10.1093/qje/qjaf015.abstractZh: 我们提供了证据，表明主要家庭研究中估计出的高边际消费倾向会导致不合理的宏观经济反事实结果。以2008年的税收减免为例，我们使用估计出的微观边际消费倾向对标准宏观模型进行校准，以构建在没有税收减免的情况下的宏观经济消费路径。这些反事实路径表明，2008年春季和夏季的消费支出会大幅下降，而在2008年9月才基本恢复。我们通过叙述和预测来论证这些路径是不合理的。我们发现，对微观边际消费倾向的标准双向固定效应估计存在向上偏差。当我们纠正这些偏差后，使用CEX数据得到的微观边际消费倾向比先前文献中的估计值要小。我们还发现，对模型进行现实性的修改后，一般均衡力量会抑制而不是放大微观边际消费倾向。较小的微观边际消费倾向和抑制一般均衡力量的结合，意味着一般均衡消费乘数低于0.2。

abstract.text: Low unionization rates, a falling real federal minimum wage, and outsourcing have hampered wage growth in the low-wage sector in the United States for several decades. In recent years (2014–2023), a number of large private retailers—including some of the largest employers in the United States—have opted to institute or raise company-wide, voluntary minimum wages (VMWs) for their employees. We use anonymized payroll data from a large credit bureau and a major payroll provider to study the effects of these national retailer policies on adopting employers’ own wages and employment as well as their spillovers to other employers in shared local labor markets, variously defined. Using stacked event studies centered around multiple VMW events and a continuous treatment variable defined as the gap between local-area wages and the company minimum, we find that VMWs result in sizable wage increases and reductions in turnover at the companies that implement them. Turning to wages at other companies, we estimate small, often economically negligible, spillover effects across multiple measures of exposure to VMWs and numerous definitions of relevant competitors, including firms connected by worker flows. Together, the evidence points to little role for strategic interactions in the transmission of large retailers’ wage policies to other firms. Voluntary minimum wage policies have affected over 3 million jobs at adopting employers, yet their impact on the broader labor market is limited.

10.1093/qje/qjaf016.abstractZh: 低工会化率、实际联邦最低工资的下降以及外包现象，已经阻碍了美国低薪行业的工资增长，这种情况持续了数十年。近年来（2014-2023年），包括一些美国最大的雇主在内的多家大型私人零售商选择实施或提高员工的全公司自愿最低工资。我们利用来自一家大型信用机构和主要薪资提供商的匿名薪资数据，研究这些全国性零售商政策对采用者自身工资和就业的影响，以及它们对其他共享本地劳动力市场中的雇主的溢出效应。通过以多个自愿最低工资事件为中心的堆叠事件研究，并定义一个连续的处理变量，即当地工资与公司最低工资之间的差距，我们发现自愿最低工资政策能够显著提高工资并降低企业员工的流动率。至于其他公司的工资情况，我们估计了在多种衡量标准下，以及通过员工流动联系起来的众多相关竞争对手之间，存在微小的、通常可以忽略不计的溢出效应。总体来看，证据表明，大型零售商的工资政策对其他公司的传递过程中，战略互动的作用很小。自愿最低工资政策影响了超过300万个工作岗位，但其对更广泛劳动力市场的影响有限。

abstract.text: Does family history matter for policy making in democracies? Linking members of Congress (MCs) to the census, we observe countries of birth for members, their parents, and their grandparents, allowing us to measure ancestry for the politicians in office when U.S. immigration policy changed dramatically, from closing the border in the 1920s to reshaping admittance criteria in the 1960s. We find that legislators descended from immigrant parents or grandparents support more permissive immigration legislation. They are also less likely to speak negatively about immigration in speeches before Congress. A regression discontinuity design analyzing close elections, which addresses district-level selection and holds district composition constant, confirms our results on roll call voting and speech. Efforts to account for selection into immigration—such as comparing international immigrants to domestic migrants and exploiting variation in restrictive legislation targeting specific regions of origin—further confirm the relationship between family immigration experience and more permissive stances on immigration policy. We then explore mechanisms, finding support for in-group identity in connecting family history with policy making. MCs name their children in ways that express immigrant identity, and immigrant-descended MCs discuss immigration using more personal frames, emphasizing family over economic considerations. Our findings illustrate the important role of personal background in legislative behavior in democratic societies, even on major and controversial topics like immigration, and suggest how experiences transmitted from previous generations can inform lawmakers’ views.

10.1093/qje/qjaf017.abstractZh: 家庭背景对民主国家的政策制定是否有影响？通过将国会议员与其父母和祖父母的出生地联系起来，我们能够测量在职政客的家族背景。在美国移民政策发生巨大变化的时期，从20世纪20年代的边境关闭到20世纪60年代对入境标准的重新制定，我们发现，那些有移民父母或祖父母的立法者更支持宽松的移民政策。他们在国会演讲中也不太可能发表负面意见。通过回归 discontinuity设计分析近期的选举结果，考虑到选区层面的选择因素并保持选区构成不变，结果进一步证实了我们的发现。进一步考虑移民选择因素的研究，例如将国际移民与国内移民进行比较，以及利用针对特定来源地的限制性立法的差异，也证实了家庭移民经历与更宽松的移民政策立场之间的关系。我们随后探讨了相关机制，发现群体认同在连接家庭背景与政策制定中起到了重要作用。国会议员在命名子女时会表达移民身份，而具有移民背景的国会议员在讨论移民问题时更倾向于使用个人化的视角，强调家庭因素而非经济考虑。我们的研究结果表明，个人背景在民主社会的立法行为中扮演着重要角色，即使是在像移民这样重要且具有争议性的话题上也是如此。这些发现表明，前几代人所经历的经历可以影响立法者的观点。

abstract.text: A researcher can use a tightly parameterized structural model to obtain internally consistent estimates of a wide range of economically interesting targets. We ask how reliable these estimates are when the researcher’s model may be misspecified. We focus on the case of multivariate, potentially nonlinear models where the causal variable of interest is endogenous. Reliable estimates require that the researcher’s model is flexible enough to describe the effects of the endogenous variable approximately correctly. Reliable estimates do not require that the researcher has correctly specified the role of the exogenous controls in the model. However, if the role of the controls is misspecified, reliable estimates require a property we call strong exclusion. Strong exclusion depends on having sufficiently many instruments that are unrelated to the controls. We discuss how practitioners can achieve strong exclusion, and illustrate our findings with an application to a differentiated goods model of demand for beer.

10.1093/qje/qjaf018.abstractZh: 研究人员可以使用参数化的结构模型来获得一系列具有经济意义的指标的可靠估计。我们探讨的是，当研究者的模型可能被误设时，这些估计的可靠性如何。我们重点关注多变量、可能非线性的模型，其中感兴趣的因果变量是内生的。要获得可靠的估计，研究者的模型必须足够灵活，能够准确描述内生变量的影响。可靠的估计并不要求研究者正确设定了模型中外部控制变量的作用。然而，如果控制变量的作用被误设，那么可靠的估计就需要具备我们称之为“强排除性”的特性。强排除性依赖于拥有足够多与控制变量无关的工具变量。我们讨论了实践者如何实现强排除性，并通过啤酒需求差异商品模型的应用来说明我们的发现。

abstract.text: Moral foundations theory is an influential empirical description of moral perception. According to this theory, individuals make moral judgments based on five distinct “moral foundations”: care, fairness, loyalty, authority, and sanctity. We provide a theory that explores the claimed evolutionary basis for these moral foundations. The theory conceptualizes these five moral foundations as specific modifications of fitness payoffs in a 2 × 2 game. We find that the five foundations are distinguishable from each other and evolutionarily stable. However, they are not a minimal set: strict subsets of the foundations suffice to describe all preferences that are evolutionarily stable. Not all evolutionarily stable foundations deliver social fitness improvement over the Nash equilibrium in the fitness game: we characterize which do. Finally, we study moral overdrive, that is, the situation in which the moral component of preferences totally dominates fitness payoffs and drives decision making entirely. While every one of the five foundations is compatible with moral overdrive in at least one fitness game, there is no fitness game in which moral overdrive is compatible with social fitness improvement. These results are partially extended to n × n games. We derive two testable implications from the theory and find empirical support for them.

10.1093/qje/qjaf019.abstractZh: 道德基础理论是对道德感知的一种有影响力的实证描述。根据该理论，个体基于五个不同的“道德基础”做出道德判断：关怀、公平、忠诚、权威和神圣性。我们提出了一个理论，探讨这些道德基础的进化基础。该理论将这五个道德基础概念化为2×2博弈中适应度收益的特定修正。我们发现这五个基础彼此可区分，并且在进化上也是稳定的。然而，它们并不是最小集合：严格限定这些基础就能描述所有在进化上稳定的偏好。并非所有在进化上稳定的基础都能在适应度博弈中带来社会适应度的提升：我们指出了哪些基础能够做到这一点。最后，我们研究了道德驱动现象，即偏好中的道德成分完全主导适应度收益并完全驱动决策的情况。虽然这五个基础在至少一个适应度博弈中与道德驱动相容，但不存在一个适应度博弈中道德驱动与社会适应度提升同时成立的情况。这些结果部分扩展到了n×n博弈。我们从该理论中得出了两个可检验的推论，并发现了相应的实证支持。

abstract.text: We develop a new methodology to estimate subjective beliefs from hypothetical-choice data. Our identification approach is based on the novel insight that by varying the amount of information on future realizations of stochastic variables, discrete-choice experiments can identify not only preferences but also subjective beliefs. We formally prove this result in a general setting and apply it to design a strategic survey instrument to measure Rajasthani parents’ subjective beliefs over the joint distribution of girls’ age of marriage, education, and marriage match quality. Our approach allows us to quantify the importance of perceived marriage market returns to education and youth, and perform various counterfactual simulation exercises. We find that eliminating the perceived marriage market return to education causes a 60% drop in the number of girls still in school at age 16, and almost none continue their education by age 18. Responses to our strategic survey instrument allow us accurately to predict realized schooling trajectories in follow-up data we collect from the same sample five years after our experimental data collection.

10.1093/qje/qjaf020.abstractZh: 我们开发了一种新的方法，用于从假设选择数据中估计主观信念。我们的识别方法基于一个新颖的见解：通过改变关于随机变量未来实现的信息量，离散选择实验不仅可以识别偏好，还可以识别主观信念。我们在一般情境下正式证明了这一结果，并将其应用于设计一种战略性调查工具，以测量拉贾斯坦邦父母对女孩结婚年龄、教育水平和婚姻匹配质量联合分布的主观信念。我们的方法使我们能够量化对教育及青年群体婚姻市场回报的感知重要性，并进行各种反事实模拟实验。我们发现，消除对教育婚姻市场回报的感知会导致16岁时仍在上学的女孩数量减少60%，而到18岁时几乎没有人继续接受教育。我们对战略性调查工具的回应使我们能够准确预测从同一样本在实验数据收集五年后收集到的后续数据中的教育轨迹。

abstract.text: We study optimal nonlinear taxation of single and married households. Taxes on couples depend on the earnings of both spouses and are an example of multidimensional tax schedules. We develop novel analytical techniques to study properties of such taxes. We show that the optimal marginal taxes for married individuals are generally lower than for single individuals because resource sharing in couples provides socially valuable redistribution. Under realistic assumptions, the optimal tax rates for married individuals increase with the correlation of spousal earnings, the marginal tax rates for one spouse increase (decrease) in the earnings of the other if both spouses have low (high) earnings, and the primary earner faces lower marginal taxes than the secondary earner.

10.1093/qje/qjaf021.abstractZh: 我们研究了单身和已婚家庭的最优非线性税收问题。对夫妻的征税取决于双方的收入，这属于多维税收安排的一种形式。我们开发了新的分析技术来研究这类税收的特性。我们发现，已婚个体的最优边际税率通常低于单身个体，因为夫妻之间的资源共享提供了社会价值的再分配。在现实假设下，已婚个体的最优税率随着夫妻收入相关性的增加而增加；如果双方收入都较低或较高，则一方在另一方收入较低时的边际税率会上升或下降；此外，主要收入者面临的边际税率通常低于次要收入者。

abstract.text: Economists often measure discrimination as disparities arising from the direct effects of group identity. We develop new tools to model and measure systemic discrimination, capturing how discrimination in other decisions indirectly contributes to disparities. A novel experimental design, the iterated audit, identifies systemic discrimination. We illustrate these new tools in two field experiments. The first experiment shows how racial discrimination can accumulate across multiple rounds of hiring through the interaction of two forces: greater discrimination against inexperienced workers, which affects the opportunity to obtain experience, and high subsequent returns to experience. The second experiment shows how gender-based differences in the language of recommendation letters can translate into systemic gender discrimination in STEM hiring. We discuss how our findings qualify previous results on direct discrimination and how our tools can be used to target policy interventions.

10.1093/qje/qjaf022.abstractZh: 经济学家通常将歧视视为由群体身份的直接效应引起的差异。我们开发了新的工具来建模和衡量系统性歧视，以捕捉其他决策中的歧视如何间接导致差异。一种新颖的实验设计——迭代审计，能够识别系统性歧视。我们在两个实地实验中展示了这些新工具的应用。第一个实验表明，种族歧视可以通过两种力量的相互作用在多次招聘过程中累积：对缺乏经验的工人存在更大的歧视，这影响了他们获得经验的机会，而随后对经验的回报又进一步加剧了这种歧视。第二个实验则展示了基于性别的推荐信语言差异如何转化为STEM领域招聘中的系统性性别歧视。我们讨论了这些发现如何对以往关于直接歧视的研究结果进行补充，以及这些工具如何被用于指导政策干预。

abstract.text: We leverage spatial variation in the severity of the Great Recession across the United States to examine its impact on mortality and explore the quantitative implications. We estimate that an increase in the unemployment rate of the magnitude of the Great Recession reduces the average annual age-adjusted mortality rate by 2.3%, with effects persisting for at least 10 years. Mortality reductions appear across causes of death and are concentrated in the half of the population with a high school degree or less. We estimate similar percentage reductions in mortality at all ages, with declines in elderly mortality thus responsible for about three-quarters of the total mortality reduction. Recession-induced mortality declines are driven primarily by external effects of reduced aggregate economic activity on mortality, and reduced air pollution appears to be a quantitatively important mechanism. Incorporating our estimates of procyclical mortality into a standard macroeconomic framework substantially reduces the welfare costs of recessions, particularly for people with less education, and at older ages.

10.1093/qje/qjaf023.abstractZh: 我们利用美国各地大衰退严重程度的空间差异来研究其对死亡率的影响，并探讨其定量含义。我们估计，大衰退规模的失业率上升会使平均年调整死亡率降低2.3%，且这种影响至少持续10年。死亡率下降的现象涉及多种死因，且主要集中在拥有高中学历或以下的人口中。我们在所有年龄段都估计到了类似的死亡率下降幅度，其中老年人口的死亡率下降贡献了总死亡率下降的约四分之三。衰退导致的死亡率下降主要源于经济活动减少对死亡率的外部影响，而空气污染减少似乎是一个重要的机制。将我们对顺周期死亡率的估计纳入标准宏观经济框架后，可以显著降低衰退带来的福利成本，尤其是对教育程度较低的人群以及年龄较大的人群而言。

abstract.text: We study the role of unions in improving workplaces for women. Starting in 2015, Brazil’s largest trade union federation made women central to its agenda. Using a difference-in-differences design that leverages variation in union affiliation to this federation, we find that “bargaining for women” increased female-friendly amenities in collective bargaining agreements and in practice. These changes led women to queue for jobs at treated establishments and separate from them less—both revealed-preference measures of firm value. We find no evidence that gains came at the expense of wages, employment, or firm profits. Better amenities instead reduced turnover and absenteeism, suggesting greater worker satisfaction and effort. Larger improvements occurred where women initially composed a lower share of workers or union leaders. Our findings show that shifting union priorities toward women improved workplaces without meaningful trade-offs and benefited both workers and employers. They illustrate the potential for unions to improve workplace quality by focusing on the needs of less represented workers.

10.1093/qje/qjaf024.abstractZh: 我们研究了工会在改善女性工作场所中的作用。自2015年起，巴西最大的工会联合会将女性问题置于其议程的核心位置。通过采用差异-差异设计，利用工会成员身份的差异性，我们发现“为女性争取权益”行为增加了集体谈判协议中的女性友好条款，并在实际工作中也起到了积极作用。这些变化使得女性在受到优待的用人单位中更容易获得工作机会，同时减少了她们离开这些用人单位的频率——这两种情况都体现了企业的价值。我们没有发现这些收益是以牺牲工资、就业或企业利润为代价的。相反，更好的待遇减少了员工流动率和缺勤率，这表明员工的工作满意度更高，工作积极性也更强。在女性工人占比较低或工会领导层中女性比例较低的地区，改善效果更为显著。我们的研究结果表明，工会将重点转向女性问题，可以在不造成明显权衡的情况下改善工作场所的质量，同时惠及工人和雇主。这些发现说明了工会通过关注代表性较低的工人的需求，在提升工作场所质量方面具有潜力。

abstract.text: I study the effect of industrial policies on industrial development by considering an important episode during the East Asian miracle: South Korea’s heavy and chemical industry (HCI) drive, 1973–1979. Based on newly assembled data, I use the introduction and termination of industrial policies to study their effects during and after the intervention period. I reveal that HCI policies promoted the expansion and dynamic comparative advantage of directly targeted industries. Using variation in exposure to policies through the input-output network, I demonstrate that the policy indirectly benefited downstream users of targeted intermediates. The benefits of HCI persisted even after the policy ended, and some results took time to materialize. The findings suggest that the temporary drive shifted Korean manufacturing into more advanced markets and supported durable change. This study helps clarify the lessons drawn from the East Asian growth miracle.

10.1093/qje/qjaf025.abstractZh: 我通过研究东亚奇迹时期的一个重要事件——1973年至1979年韩国重工业和化学工业的发展，来探讨产业政策对工业发展的影响。基于新收集的数据，我利用产业政策的实施与终止来研究这些政策在干预期间及之后的效果。研究发现，重工业政策促进了直接目标行业的扩张和动态比较优势。通过投入产出网络分析，我发现这些政策间接使下游用户受益。重工业政策带来的好处即使在政策结束后仍然持续，部分成果需要时间才能显现。研究结果表明，这种临时性的发展推动使韩国制造业转向更先进的市场，并支持了长期的变革。这项研究有助于阐明从东亚增长奇迹中得出的经验教训。

abstract.text: We conduct a randomized controlled trial to evaluate the effect of an innovative police patrol program on sexual harassment in public spaces in Hyderabad, India. In collaboration with the Hyderabad City Police, we randomize exposure to police patrols and the visibility of officers by deploying both uniformed and undercover officers across 350 hot spots. To assess the effect, we implement a novel, high-frequency observation exercise to measure sexual harassment at these hot spots, where enumerators recorded all observed instances of sexual harassment and women’s responses in real time. We find that although police patrols had no effect on overall street harassment, uniformed police patrols reduced severe forms of harassment (forceful touching, intimidation) by 27% and reduced the likelihood of women leaving the hot spot due to sexual harassment. We uncovered the underlying mechanisms and found that both police visibility and officers’ attitudes toward sexual harassment are key to understanding its incidence.

10.1093/qje/qjaf026.abstractZh: 我们开展了一项随机对照试验，旨在评估印度海得拉巴一项创新的警察巡逻计划对公共空间性骚扰现象的影响。与海得拉巴市警察局合作，我们通过部署制服警察和卧底警察，在350个热点区域对警察巡逻的曝光程度以及警员的可见性进行了随机分配。为了评估效果，我们实施了一种新颖的高频观察方法，以测量这些热点区域的性骚扰情况。观察员实时记录所有观察到的性骚扰事件以及女性的反应。研究发现，虽然警察巡逻并未对整体街头骚扰现象产生显著影响，但制服警察的巡逻使严重形式的骚扰（如强行触摸、恐吓）减少了27%，并降低了女性因性骚扰而离开热点区域的可能性。我们揭示了其中的潜在机制，并发现警员的可见性以及他们对性骚扰的态度是理解这一现象发生的关键因素。

abstract.text: Gender imbalance in time spent on child-rearing causes gender inequalities in labor market outcomes, human capital accumulation, and economic mobility. We conduct a large-scale field experiment with a near universe of U.S. schools to investigate a potential source of inequality: external demands for parental involvement. Schools receive an email from a fictitious two-parent household and are asked to call one of the parents back. Mothers are 1.4 times more likely than fathers to be contacted. We decompose this inequality and demonstrate that the gender gap in external demands is associated with various measures of gender norms. We also show that signaling a father’s availability substantially changes the gender pattern of callbacks. Our findings underscore a process through which agents outside the household contribute to within-household gender inequalities.

10.1093/qje/qjaf027.abstractZh: 在育儿时间上的性别失衡导致了劳动力市场结果、人力资本积累和经济流动性方面的性别不平等。我们开展了一项大规模实地实验，涉及美国近千所学校的样本，以探究不平等的一个潜在来源：对父母参与的外部要求。学校会收到来自一个虚构的双亲家庭的电子邮件，并被要求联系其中一位家长。母亲被联系到的可能性是父亲的两倍。我们进一步分析了这种不平等现象，发现外部要求中的性别差异与各种性别规范指标相关。我们还发现，表明父亲可联系性的信息显著改变了联系模式的性别特征。我们的研究结果强调了一种机制，即家庭外部的因素会加剧家庭内部的性别不平等。

abstract.text: We develop a framework to measure the welfare impact of macroeconomic shocks throughout the distribution. The first-order impact of a shock is summarized by the induced movements in agents’ feasible sets: their budget constraint and borrowing constraints. We combine estimated impulse response functions with micro-data on household consumption bundles, asset holdings, and labor income for different U.S. households. We find that inflationary oil shocks are regressive, but monetary expansions are progressive, and there is substantial heterogeneity throughout the life cycle. In all cases, the dominant channel is the effect of the shock on the cost of accumulating assets, not movements in goods prices or labor income.

10.1093/qje/qjaf028.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个框架，用于衡量宏观经济冲击对收入分配的福利影响。冲击的一阶影响主要体现在代理人可行集中的变化：他们的预算约束和借贷约束。我们将估计出的脉冲响应函数与关于美国家庭消费组合、资产持有量和劳动收入的微观数据相结合。我们发现，通货膨胀性石油冲击具有递减效应，而货币扩张则具有递增效应，并且这种效应在整个生命周期中表现出显著的异质性。在所有情况下，主导效应都是冲击对资产积累成本的影响，而非商品价格或劳动收入的变化。

abstract.text: We study markup cyclicality in a granular macroeconomic model with oligopolistic competition. We first characterize how firm, sectoral, and aggregate markups comove with output at different levels of aggregation in response to firm-level shocks. We quantify the model’s ability to reproduce salient features of the cyclical properties of measured markups in French administrative firm-level data from the bottom (firm) level to the aggregate level. We document that (i) firm-level markups rise with market share and sector-level markups with concentration, (ii) the relationship between markups and sectoral output varies by firm size—negative for small firms but positive for large ones, (iii) sector-level markups move positively with sectoral output, and (iv) sectoral markups show no systematic relationship with aggregate output. Our model helps rationalize these seemingly conflicting patterns of markup cyclicality in the data.

10.1093/qje/qjaf029.abstractZh: 我们在一个具有寡头竞争行为的微观宏观经济模型中研究了价格加成周期的变动。首先，我们描述了在不同聚合层次上，企业级、行业级和总体价格加成如何随着企业层面的冲击而发生变化。我们量化了该模型在再现法国行政企业级数据中测量到的价格加成周期性特征方面的能力，这些数据涵盖了从企业级到总体级的不同层次。我们发现：(i) 企业级价格加成随着市场份额的增加而上升，行业级价格加成则随着集中度的增加而增加；(ii) 价格加成与行业产出之间的关系因企业规模而异——对于小型企业来说为负，而对于大型企业来说则为正；(iii) 行业级价格加成随着行业产出的增加而上升；(iv) 行业级价格加成与总体产出之间没有系统性关系。我们的模型有助于解释数据中这些看似矛盾的价格加成周期性模式。

abstract.text: By augmenting the continuous-time specification of Harris and Laibson (2013) with the assumption that hard borrowing constraints do not bind in equilibrium, present bias can be tractably incorporated into rich consumption-saving models featuring stochastic income, risky and illiquid assets, and costly borrowing. I present closed-form expressions characterizing how present bias affects consumption, illiquid asset demand, and welfare. This welfare analysis specifies the channels through which present bias can matter for policy and uncovers the present-bias dilemma: present bias can have large welfare costs, but individuals have little ability to alleviate these costs using financial commitment devices like illiquid assets.

10.1093/qje/qjaf030.abstractZh: 通过增加Harris和Laibson（2013）的连续时间模型，并假设在均衡状态下硬性借贷约束并不起作用，可以将即时偏好纳入包含随机收入、风险性和流动性不足资产以及高借贷成本的丰富消费-储蓄模型中。我提出了封闭形式的表达式，用以描述即时偏好如何影响消费、流动性资产需求以及福利状况。这一福利分析明确了即时偏好对政策的影响途径，并揭示了即时偏好带来的困境：即时偏好可能会导致巨大的福利成本，而个体通过流动性资产等金融承诺手段来减轻这些成本的能力却非常有限。

abstract.text: Observed international investment positions and cross-country heterogeneity in rates of return to capital are hard to reconcile with frictionless capital markets. This article develops a theory of international capital allocation: a multi-country dynamic spatial general equilibrium model in which the entire network of cross-border investment is endogenously determined. Our model features cross-country heterogeneity in fundamental risk, a demand system for international assets, and frictions that cause segmentation in international capital markets. We measure frictions affecting international investment and apply our model to data from nearly 100 countries, using a new dataset of international capital taxes and cultural, linguistic, and geographic distances between countries (geopoliticaldistance.org). Our model performs well in reproducing the composition of international portfolios, the cross section of home bias and rates of return to capital, and other key features of international capital markets. Finally, we carry out counterfactual exercises: we show that barriers to international investment reduce world output by 7% and raise the cross-country dispersion of capital per employee, contributing in a meaningful way to global inequality.

10.1093/qje/qjaf031.abstractZh: 观察到的国际投资状况以及各国资本回报率的差异难以与无摩擦的资本市场相调和。本文提出了一种国际资本分配理论：一个多国动态空间一般均衡模型，其中所有跨境投资网络都是内生决定的。我们的模型体现了各国在基本风险方面的异质性、国际资产的需求体系，以及导致国际资本市场分割的摩擦因素。我们通过新的国际资本税数据以及国家间地理、语言和文化距离数据（geopoliticaldistance.org）来测量影响国际投资的摩擦因素，并将模型应用于近100个国家的数据。我们的模型在再现国际投资组合构成、各国资本回报率的差异以及其他国际资本市场的关键特征方面表现良好。最后，我们进行了反事实分析：我们发现，国际投资壁垒使全球产出减少了7%，并增加了各国资本与雇员数量的差异，从而显著加剧了全球不平等。

abstract.text: We characterize the contribution of changes in quality, price, and variety entry/exit to the aggregate price index for smooth, invertible demand systems, generalizing the standard results derived in the CES case. The results require the knowledge of heterogeneous cross-product elasticities of substitution. To apply them in practice, we also show how to identify rich demand systems using data only on prices and market shares, without the need for external cost-shock instruments or strong assumptions on the covariance between supply and demand shocks. Using this approach, we compute the U.S. import price index based on the Kimball demand system. We find that quality change on average lowered the inflation in import prices by around 0.007 log points annually (1989–2016). To further validate our approach, we show that it estimates price elasticities and quality changes similar to those found by the standard mixed logit (BLP) demand in data on the U.S. auto market.

10.1093/qje/qjaf032.abstractZh: 我们描述了质量、价格和品种变化对平滑、可逆需求系统总体价格指数的影响，并推广了在CES情况下得出的标准结果。这些结果需要了解异质性的交叉产品替代弹性。为了在实际应用中应用这些结果，我们还展示了如何仅使用价格和市场份额数据来识别丰富需求系统，而无需外部成本冲击工具或对供给和需求冲击之间协方差的强假设。采用这种方法，我们基于Kimball需求系统计算了美国进口价格指数。我们发现，质量变化平均每年使进口价格的通胀降低约0.007个对数点（1989-2016年）。为了进一步验证我们的方法，我们展示了该方法在基于美国汽车市场数据的标准混合Logit（BLP）需求模型中，能够估计出与标准混合Logit模型相似的价格弹性和质量变化。

abstract.text: This article quantifies the role played by education in the reduction of global poverty. I propose tools for identifying the contribution of schooling to economic growth by income group, integrating imperfect substitution between skill groups into a macroeconomic growth decomposition. I bring this “distributional growth accounting” framework to the data by exploiting a new microdatabase representative of nearly all of the world’s population, new estimates of the private returns to schooling, and historical income distribution statistics. Education can account for about 45% of global economic growth and 60% of pretax income growth among the world’s poorest 20% from 1980 to 2019. A significant fraction of these gains was made possible by skill-biased technical change amplifying the returns to education. Because they ignore the distributional effects of schooling, standard growth accounting methods substantially underestimate economic benefits of education for the global poor.

10.1093/qje/qjaf033.abstractZh: 本文量化了教育在减少全球贫困方面所起的作用。我提出了一些工具，用于识别不同收入群体中学校教育对经济增长的贡献，并将技能群体之间的不完全替代纳入宏观经济增长分解中。通过利用一个代表全球几乎所有人口的新微观数据库、对学校教育私人回报的新估计以及历史收入分布统计数据，我将这一“分配增长核算”框架应用于实际数据。在1980年至2019年间，教育约占全球经济增长的45%，以及全球最贫困20%国家税前收入增长的60%。这些收益的相当一部分得益于以技能为导向的技术变革，从而进一步提升了教育的回报。由于标准增长核算方法忽略了学校教育的分配效应，因此严重低估了教育对全球贫困人口的经济效益。

abstract.text: Introducing a new measure of scientific proximity between private firms and public research groups and exploiting a multibillion-euro financing program of academic clusters in France, we provide causal evidence of local spillovers from academic research to firms in the private sector. Our main estimate suggests that each €1 spent in academic research through this program spurred an additional €0.81 in private R&D expenditures. We also show that this shock increased the average quality of patents. We exploit reports produced by funded clusters, complemented by data on firm creation, labor mobility, and R&D public–private partnerships, to provide evidence on the channels for these spillovers. We discuss the policy implications of funding academic research to stimulate private R&D.

10.1093/qje/qjaf034.abstractZh: 通过引入一种新的衡量私营企业与公共研究团体之间科学接近性的指标，并利用法国学术集群的数十亿欧元融资计划，我们提供了关于学术研究对私营部门企业产生局部溢出效应的因果证据。我们的主要估计表明，通过这一计划进行每1欧元的学术研究支出，能够促使私营部门增加0.81欧元的研发支出。我们还发现，这种效应提升了专利的平均质量。我们利用由资助的学术集群提供的报告，并结合企业创建、劳动力流动以及公共与私营部门的研发合作数据，来揭示这些溢出效应的传导渠道。我们讨论了资助学术研究以刺激私营部门研发的政策意义。

abstract.text: We survey a large, representative sample of retail investors in China to elicit their memories of stock market investments and their return expectations. We merge these survey data with administrative transaction data to test a model in which investors selectively recall past experiences to form their beliefs. Our analysis uncovers new facts about investor memory and highlights similarity-based recall as a key mechanism of belief formation in financial markets. A rising market prompts investors to recall their past experiences more positively, leading to more optimistic forecasts of future returns. Recalled experiences can explain cross-investor variation in return expectations and, in our setting, dominate actual experiences in their explanatory power. In the transaction data, we confirm that recalled experiences are reflected in investors’ trading decisions through a belief channel.

10.1093/qje/qjaf035.abstractZh: 我们对中国大量具有代表性的零售投资者进行了调查，以了解他们对股市投资的记忆以及他们的回报预期。我们将这些调查数据与行政交易数据相结合，以检验一个模型，该模型认为投资者会选择性地回忆过去的经历来形成自己的信念。我们的分析揭示了关于投资者记忆的新事实，并强调了基于相似性的回忆是金融市场中信念形成的关键机制。市场上涨会促使投资者更积极地回忆过去的经历，从而导致对未来回报的乐观预测。被回忆起的经历可以解释不同投资者在回报预期上的差异，在我们的研究环境中，这些经历在解释力上占据了主导地位。在交易数据中，我们确认被回忆起的经历通过信念渠道反映在投资者的交易决策中。

abstract.text: Student loans with income-contingent repayment insure borrowers against income risk but can reduce their incentives to earn more. Using a change in Australia’s income-contingent repayment schedule, I show that borrowers reduce their labor supply to lower their repayments. These responses are larger among borrowers with more hourly flexibility, a lower probability of repayment, and tighter liquidity constraints. I use these responses to estimate a dynamic model of labor supply with frictions that generate imperfect adjustment. My estimates imply that the labor supply responses to income-contingent repayment limit the optimal amount of insurance in government-provided student loans. However, these responses are too small to justify fixed-repayment contracts: restructuring existing student loans from fixed repayment to a constrained-optimal income-contingent loan—while keeping the tax and transfer system unchanged—increases borrower welfare by the equivalent of a 0.8% increase in lifetime consumption at no additional fiscal cost.

10.1093/qje/qjaf036.abstractZh: 基于收入条件的学生贷款为借款人提供了收入风险保障，但可能会降低他们增加收入的动机。通过研究澳大利亚收入条件还款计划的变化，我发现借款人会减少劳动力供给以降低还款负担。这种反应在那些具有更多小时工作灵活性、还款概率较低以及流动性约束较严格的借款人中更为明显。利用这些反应，我建立了一个包含摩擦因素的劳动力供给动态模型，以解释不完全调整的原因。我的估计表明，对收入条件还款的劳动力供给反应限制了政府提供的学生贷款的最佳保险额度。然而，这些反应幅度太小，不足以支持固定还款合同的实施：将现有学生贷款从固定还款模式调整为受限最优的收入条件贷款——同时不改变税收和转移支付制度——可以在不增加财政成本的情况下，提高借款人的福利，相当于使终身消费增加0.8%。

abstract.text: We develop and estimate a dynamic model of risky prescription opioid use that allows us to unpack the role of person- and place-specific drivers of the opioid epidemic and to assess the impact of state opioid policies. Event studies indicate that, among adults receiving federal disability insurance from 2006 to 2019, moves to states with higher rates of risky use produce an immediate jump in the probability of risky use, followed by an additional gradual increase for the next several years. Using a potential outcomes framework, we show how these results map to the person- and place-specific factors in the model. Model estimates imply large effects of place on both the likelihood of transitioning to addiction and the availability of prescription opioids; they also indicate that these place effects change significantly when state laws restricting pain clinics are enacted. A one standard deviation reduction in all place effects would have reduced risky use by about 40 percent over our study period. One particular source of place effects, pain clinic laws, reduced risky use by 5 percent, but could have reduced it by 30 percent if they had been enacted earlier, with much of this magnification operating through the dynamics of addiction.

10.1093/qje/qjaf037.abstractZh: 我们开发并估计了一个动态模型，用于研究风险性处方阿片类药物使用的状况。该模型能够揭示个人和地区特定因素对阿片类药物流行的影响，并评估各州阿片类药物政策的成效。事件研究表明，在2006至2019年间，从联邦残疾保险中获得的成年人中，迁移到阿片类药物风险使用率较高的州后，风险使用的概率会立即上升，随后在接下来的几年中逐渐再次增加。通过潜在结果框架，我们展示了这些结果如何与模型中的个人和地区特定因素相对应。模型估计表明，地区因素对成瘾转化的可能性以及处方阿片类药物的可用性都有显著影响；同时，当各州实施限制疼痛诊所的法规时，这些地区效应会显著变化。在所有地区效应减少一个标准差的情况下，研究期间的风险使用量将减少约40%。其中一个具体的地区效应来源是疼痛诊所法规，它使风险使用量减少了5%，但如果这些法规更早实施，风险使用量可能会减少30%，其中大部分减少效果是通过成瘾过程的动态变化实现的。

abstract.text: We develop a tractable quantitative framework for modeling the rich patterns of spatial mobility observed in smartphone data. We show that travel is frequently undertaken as part of a travel itinerary, defined as a journey starting and ending at home that can include more than one intermediate stop on a given day. We show that these travel itineraries provide microfoundations for consumption externalities and generate both complementarity and substitutability between locations. We show that the consumption externalities implied by travel itineraries are central to matching quasi-experimental evidence from the shift to working from home. We find that these consumption externalities are key drivers of the agglomeration of economic activity in central cities and shape the relative welfare gains from alternative transport improvements in favor of investments in central cities.

10.1093/qje/qjaf038.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个可行的定量框架，用于建模在智能手机数据中观察到的丰富空间移动模式。我们发现，旅行通常作为旅行行程的一部分进行，旅行行程是指从家出发并结束于家的旅程，且在一天之内可能包含多个中途停留点。我们指出，这些旅行行程为消费外部性提供了微观基础，并使得不同地点之间存在互补性和替代性。我们还发现，由旅行行程所蕴含的消费外部性对于匹配从居家办公模式转变相关的准实验证据至关重要。研究发现，这些消费外部性是推动经济活动在中心城市聚集的关键因素，并决定了在改善其他交通方式方面，对中心城市的投资所带来的相对福利收益。

abstract.text: We study the consequences of “regime-induced” exchange rate depreciations by comparing outcomes for peggers versus floaters to the U.S. dollar in response to a dollar depreciation. Pegger currencies depreciate relative to floater currencies and these depreciations are strongly expansionary. The boom is associated with a fall in net exports, and (if anything) an increase in interest rates in the pegger countries. This suggests that expenditure switching and domestic monetary policy are not the main drivers of the boom. We show that a large class of existing models cannot match our estimated responses and develop a model with imperfect financial openness that can. Following a depreciation, uncovered interest parity deviations lower the costs of borrowing from abroad and stimulate the economy, as in the data. The model is consistent with (unconditional) exchange rate disconnect and the Mussa fact, even though exchange rates have large effects on the economy.

10.1093/qje/qjaf039.abstractZh: 我们通过比较“制度性”汇率贬值对钉住美元货币与自由浮动货币的影响，来研究其后果。钉住美元的货币相对于自由浮动货币会贬值，而这种贬值具有强烈的扩张性。这种繁荣与净出口的下降有关，而在钉住美元的国家，利率甚至有所上升。这表明，支出转移和国内货币政策并非推动繁荣的主要因素。我们证明，许多现有模型无法与我们估计的响应相匹配，而我们的模型则能够解释这种情况。在汇率贬值之后，无差异利率平价偏差会降低从国外借款的成本，从而刺激经济，这与数据相符。该模型与（无条件）汇率脱钩以及Mussa现象一致，尽管汇率对经济有较大的影响。

abstract.text: Noncarceral conviction is a common outcome of criminal court cases: for every person incarcerated, there are approximately three who were recently convicted but not sentenced to prison or jail. We extend the binary-treatment judge IV framework to settings with multiple treatments and use it to study the consequences of noncarceral conviction. We outline assumptions under which widely used 2SLS regressions recover margin-specific treatment effects, relate these assumptions to models of judge decision-making, and derive an expression that provides intuition about the direction and magnitude of asymptotic bias when a key assumption on judge decision-making is not met. We find that noncarceral conviction (relative to dismissal) leads to a large and long-lasting increase in recidivism for felony defendants in Virginia. In contrast, incarceration (relative to noncarceral conviction) leads to a short-run reduction in recidivism, consistent with incapacitation. Our empirical results suggest that noncarceral felony conviction is an important and overlooked driver of recidivism.

10.1093/qje/qjaf040.abstractZh: 非监禁性定罪是刑事法庭案件中的常见结果：在每有一个人被监禁的情况下，大约有三个人是最近被定罪但未被判处监禁。我们将二元处理法官IV框架扩展到包含多个处理的情境，并利用该框架研究非监禁性定罪的后果。我们阐述了广泛使用的2SLS回归模型能够恢复边际特定处理效应的假设条件，将这些假设与法官决策模型联系起来，并推导出一个表达式，该表达式可以直观地说明当法官决策的关键假设不满足时，渐近偏差的方向和大小。我们发现，与不予起诉相比，非监禁性定罪会导致弗吉尼亚州重罪被告的再犯率出现较大且持久的增加。相比之下，与非监禁性定罪相比，监禁则会导致短期内再犯率的降低，这与监禁措施的效果一致。我们的实证结果表明，非监禁性重罪定罪是再犯率的一个重要且被忽视的驱动因素。

abstract.text: How do social networks influence the decision to migrate? Prior work suggests two distinct mechanisms that have historically been difficult to differentiate: as a conduit of information, and as a source of social and economic support. We disentangle these mechanisms using a massive “digital trace” dataset that allows us to observe the migration decisions made by millions of individuals over several years, as well as the complete social network of each person in the months before and after migration. These data allow us to establish a new set of stylized facts about the relationship between social networks and migration. Our main analysis indicates that the average migrant derives more social capital from “interconnected” networks that provide social support than from “extensive” networks that efficiently transmit information.

10.1093/restud/rdad113.abstractZh: 社交网络如何影响迁移决策？先前的研究指出，历史上一直难以区分两种不同的机制：作为信息传播的渠道，以及作为社会和经济支持的来源。我们利用庞大的“数字追踪”数据集来分离这两种机制，该数据集使我们能够观察数百万人在数年间做出的迁移决策，以及每个人在迁移前后几个月内的完整社交网络。这些数据使我们能够建立一套关于社交网络与迁移之间关系的新事实。我们的主要分析表明，平均而言，移民从那些提供社会支持的“互联”网络中获得的社交资本更多，而不是从那些能够高效传递信息的“广泛”网络中获得的。

abstract.text: To analyse climate change mitigation strategies, economists rely on simplified climate models—so-called climate emulators—that provide a realistic quantitative link between CO2 emissions and global warming at low computational costs. In this paper, we propose a generic and transparent calibration and evaluation strategy for these climate emulators that are based on freely and easily accessible state-of-the-art benchmark data from climate sciences. We demonstrate that the appropriate choice of the free model parameters can be of key relevance for the predicted social cost of carbon. The key idea we put forward is to calibrate the simplified climate models to benchmark data from comprehensive global climate models that took part in the coupled model intercomparison project, phase 5 (CMIP5). In particular, we propose to use four different test cases that are considered pivotal in the climate science literature: two highly idealized tests to separately calibrate and evaluate the carbon cycle and temperature response, an idealized test to quantify the transient climate response, and a final test to evaluate the performance for scenarios close to those arising from economic models, and that include exogenous forcing. As a concrete example, we re-calibrate the climate part of the widely used DICE-2016, fathoming the CMIP5 uncertainty range of model responses: the multi-model mean as well as extreme, but still permissible climate sensitivities and carbon cycle responses. We demonstrate that the functional form of the climate emulator of the DICE-2016 model is fit for purpose, despite its simplicity, but its carbon cycle and temperature equations are miscalibrated, leading to the conclusion that one may want to be skeptical about predictions derived from DICE-2016. We examine the importance of the calibration for the social cost of carbon in the context of a partial equilibrium setting where interest rates are exogenous, as well as the simple general equilibrium setting from DICE-2016. We find that the model uncertainty from different consistent calibrations of the climate system can change the social cost of carbon by a factor of 4 if one assumes a quadratic damage function. When calibrated to the multi-model mean, our model predicts similar values for the social cost of carbon as the original DICE-2016, but with a strongly reduced sensitivity to the discount rate and about 1 degree less long-term warming. The social cost of carbon in DICE-2016 is oversensitive to the discount rate, leading to extreme comparative statics responses to changes in preferences.

10.1093/restud/rdae011.abstractZh: 在分析气候变化缓解策略时，经济学家依赖简化的气候模型——所谓的气候模拟器——这些模型能够在较低的计算成本下，提供CO2排放与全球变暖之间的定量关联。在本文中，我们提出了一种通用且透明的气候模拟器校准与评估策略，这些策略基于气候科学领域广泛且易于获取的最新基准数据。我们证明，正确选择自由模型参数对于预测碳的社会成本至关重要。我们的核心思想是，将简化的气候模型与参与耦合模型比较项目第五阶段（CMIP5）的综合性全球气候模型的基准数据进行校准。具体来说，我们提出了四种不同的测试案例，这些案例在气候科学文献中被视为关键：两个高度理想化的测试案例，分别用于校准和评估碳循环和温度响应；一个理想化的测试案例，用于量化瞬态气候响应；以及一个最终测试案例，用于评估接近经济模型产生的情景下的性能，这些情景还包括外源强迫因素。作为一个具体的例子，我们重新校准了广泛使用的DICE-2016模型的气候部分，分析了CMIP5模型响应的不确定性范围：包括多模型均值以及极端但仍然可接受的气候敏感性和碳循环响应。我们证明，尽管DICE-2016模型的气候模拟器形式简单，但它仍然适用于实际需求，但其碳循环和温度方程存在校准误差，这提示我们可能需要对从DICE-2016模型得出的预测结果持谨慎态度。我们研究了在部分均衡框架下，利率为外生变量时，校准对社会碳成本的重要性，以及根据DICE-2016模型构建的简单一般均衡框架下的校准效果。研究发现，如果假设损害函数为二次函数，不同校准方法导致的模型不确定性可能会使社会碳成本增加4倍。当模型校准为多模型均值时，我们的模型预测的社会碳成本与DICE-2016原始模型的结果相似，但对贴现率的敏感性显著降低，长期变暖幅度也减少了约1度。DICE-2016模型中的社会碳成本对贴现率过于敏感，导致在偏好变化时出现极端的比较静态响应。

abstract.text: We study non-monetary markets where objects that arrive over time are allocated to unit-demand agents with private types, such as in the allocation of public housing or deceased-donor organs. An agent’s value for an object is supermodular in her type and the object quality, and her payoff is her value minus her waiting cost. The social planner’s objective is a weighted sum of allocative efficiency (i.e. the sum of values) and welfare (i.e. the sum of payoffs). We identify optimal mechanisms in the class of direct-revelation mechanisms. When the social planner can design the information disclosed to the agents about the objects, the optimal mechanism has a simple implementation: a first-come first-served waitlist with deferrals. In this implementation, the object qualities are partitioned into intervals; only the interval containing the object quality is disclosed to agents. When the planner places a higher weight on welfare, optimal disclosure policies become coarser.

10.1093/restud/rdae013.abstractZh: 我们研究非货币市场，其中随时间到达的物品被分配给具有私人类型的单位需求代理人，例如公共住房分配或已故捐赠者的器官分配。代理人对某一物品的价值在其类型与物品质量之间是超模的，其收益等于其价值减去等待成本。社会规划者的目标是分配效率（即价值之和）与福利（即收益之和）的加权和。我们在直接披露机制类中确定了最优机制。当社会规划者能够设计向代理人披露有关物品的信息时，最优机制具有简单的实现方式：采用先来先服务的方式建立等待名单并允许延期。在这种实现方式中，物品质量被划分为多个区间；只有包含该物品质量的区间才会被披露给代理人。当规划者更重视福利时，最优的披露政策会变得更加宽松。

abstract.text: This article studies how firms’ screening incentives in the labour market affect the optimal design of social insurance programs and quantitatively assesses the U.S. disability policies accounting for firms’ screening of the disabled. We develop an equilibrium search model where workers with different productivities have heterogeneous preferences over non-wage benefits and firms cannot offer an employment contract that explicitly depends on worker types. In this environment, firms may use contracts to screen out a certain type of workers, distorting employment rates and contracts in equilibrium. Therefore, the optimal structure of social insurance policies depends on firms’ screening incentives. We extend and structurally estimate this framework to quantitatively understand the inefficiencies arising from firms’ incentives to screen out disabled workers and examine the optimal joint design of disability insurance (DI) and various forms of firm subsidies. We find that hiring subsidies mitigate screening distortions; at the same time, they interact with DI by reducing the labour supply disincentives it generates. The optimal policy structure leads to a considerable welfare gain by simultaneously making firm subsidies and DI benefits more generous.

10.1093/restud/rdae015.abstractZh: 本文研究企业在劳动力市场上的筛选激励如何影响社会保险计划的最优设计，并定量评估了美国的残疾政策，考虑了企业对残疾人的筛选行为。我们建立了一个均衡搜索模型，其中具有不同生产率的工人对非工资福利有着不同的偏好，而企业无法提供明确依赖于工人类型的雇佣合同。在这种环境下，企业可能会利用合同来筛选特定类型的工人，从而扭曲均衡状态下的就业率和合同安排。因此，社会保险政策的最优结构取决于企业的筛选激励。我们扩展并结构性地估计了这一框架，以定量理解企业筛选残疾工人所带来的效率低下问题，并探讨残疾保险与各种形式的企业补贴的最优联合设计。我们发现，招聘补贴可以减轻筛选扭曲；同时，它们与残疾保险相互作用，减少了残疾保险产生的劳动力供应抑制效应。最优政策结构通过同时提高企业补贴和残疾保险福利，带来显著的福利增益。

abstract.text: We construct mechanisms that can robustly implement any desired social choice function when (1) agents may incur a cost to learn the state of the world, (2) with small probability, agents’ preferences can be arbitrarily different from some baseline known to the mechanism designer, and (3) the mechanism designer does not know agents’ beliefs and higher-order beliefs about one another’s preferences. The mechanisms we propose have a natural interpretation and do not require the mechanism designer to be able to verify the state ex post. We also establish impossibility results for stronger notions of robust implementation.

10.1093/restud/rdae016.abstractZh: 我们构建了能够稳健实现任何期望的社会选择函数的机制。这些机制需要满足以下三个条件：(1) 代理人在学习世界状态的过程中可能会承担成本；(2) 以很小的概率，代理人的偏好可能与机制设计者已知的某个基准存在任意差异；(3) 机制设计者并不了解代理人以及他们彼此之间关于偏好的高级信念。我们提出的机制具有自然的解释性，且不需要机制设计者能够事后验证状态。我们还为更严格的稳健实现概念建立了不可能性结果。

abstract.text: We develop a theory of information spillovers in sovereign bond markets in which investors can learn about default risk before trading in primary and secondary markets. If primary markets are structured as multi-unit discriminatory-price auctions, an endogenous winner’s curse leads to strategic complementarities in information acquisition. Shocks to default risk in one country may trigger crisis episodes with widespread information acquisition, sharp increases in the level and volatility of yields in risky countries, low and stable yields in safe countries, market segmentation, and arbitrage profits between primary and secondary markets. These predictions are consistent with the dynamics of auction informativeness during the Eurozone Sovereign Debt Crisis, which we measure using the reaction of secondary market yields to primary market yields.

10.1093/restud/rdae017.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种关于主权债券市场信息溢出效应的理论，其中投资者在一级市场和二级市场交易之前就能了解违约风险。如果一级市场采用多单元差别定价拍卖机制，那么内生性的“赢者诅咒”会导致信息获取方面的战略互补性。一个国家的违约风险冲击可能会引发危机，导致信息获取广泛化，风险国家的收益率水平和波动性急剧上升，而安全国家的收益率则保持较低且稳定。此外，还会出现市场分割现象，以及一级市场和二级市场之间的套利行为。这些预测与欧元区主权债务危机期间拍卖信息含量的动态变化一致，我们通过衡量二级市场收益率对一级市场收益率的反应来加以验证。

abstract.text: We study the long-term effects of a randomized intervention targeting children's socio-emotional skills. The classroom-based intervention for primary school children has positive impacts that persist for over a decade. Treated children become more likely to complete academic high school and enrol in university. Two mechanisms drive these results. Treated children show fewer attention deficit/hyperactivity disorder symptoms: they are less impulsive and less disruptive. They also attain higher grades, but they do not score higher on standardized tests. The long-term effects on educational attainment thus appear to be driven by changes in socio-emotional skills rather than cognitive skills.

10.1093/restud/rdae018.abstractZh: 我们研究了针对儿童社会情感技能进行的随机干预措施的长期效果。这项针对小学儿童的课堂干预措施产生了持续超过十年的积极影响。接受干预的儿童更有可能完成高中学业并进入大学学习。两种机制推动了这些结果：接受干预的儿童表现出较少的注意力缺陷/多动障碍症状，他们更加冷静、不具破坏性。他们的成绩也更高，但在标准化测试中的分数并没有显著提高。因此，对教育成就的长期影响似乎是由社会情感技能的变化所驱动的，而非认知技能的变化。

abstract.text: How should the government respond to automation? We study this question in a heterogeneous agent model that takes worker displacement seriously. We recognize that displaced workers face two frictions in practice: reallocation is slow and borrowing is limited. We analyze a second best problem where the government can tax automation but lacks redistributive tools to fully alleviate borrowing frictions. The equilibrium is (constrained) inefficient and automation is excessive. Firms do not internalize that automation depresses the income of automated workers early on during the transition, precisely when they become borrowing constrained. The government finds it optimal to slow down automation on efficiency grounds, even when it does not value equity. Quantitatively, the optimal speed of automation is considerably lower than at the laissez-faire. The optimal policy improves efficiency and delivers meaningful welfare gains.

10.1093/restud/rdae019.abstractZh: 政府应该如何应对自动化？我们在一个考虑工人被取代问题的异质代理人模型中研究了这个问题。我们发现，被取代的工人在实践中面临两个障碍：重新分配过程缓慢，且借贷渠道有限。我们分析了一个次优问题，即政府可以对自动化征税，但缺乏有效的再分配工具来完全缓解借贷障碍。在这种情况下，均衡是低效的，且自动化程度过高。企业在转型初期并未将自动化导致自动化工人收入下降的因素内部化，而此时他们正面临借贷限制。从效率角度出发，政府认为减缓自动化进程是最优选择，即使这并不符合公平原则。从数量上看，最优的自动化速度明显低于放任自流的情况。最优政策能够提升效率，并带来显著的福利改善。

abstract.text: Regulations to design private yet publicly sponsored health insurance markets are increasingly adopted in many OECD countries. Here I combine data and economic theory to analyse the interaction between insurers’ competition and the design of premium subsidies in determining equilibrium outcomes. My empirical model includes adverse selection, rich heterogeneity in preferences for vertically and horizontally differentiated plans and accommodates alternative assumptions on pricing conduct. In the context of the Affordable Care Act in the U.S., I estimate the joint distribution of preferences and expected cost using Californian administrative records on 3.4 million plan choices between 2014 and 2017, combined with plan and survey data on medical claims. An empirical horse race between conduct assumptions favours oligopoly pricing over perfect competition. Considering alternative subsidy designs shows that, in equilibrium, shifting subsidy generosity toward the “young invincibles” would lower premiums for all enrolees while increasing enrolment and profits.

10.1093/restud/rdae020.abstractZh: 许多经合组织国家正在越来越多地采用旨在设计私人但由公共资金支持的医疗保险市场的法规。在这里，我结合数据和经济理论来分析保险公司竞争与保费补贴设计之间的相互作用对均衡结果的影响。我的实证模型考虑了逆向选择问题、对垂直和水平差异化计划的偏好差异，并考虑了关于定价行为的不同假设。在美国《平价医疗法案》的背景下，我利用加州2014年至2017年间340万份计划的行政记录，结合计划和医疗索赔数据，估计了偏好与预期成本的联合分布。实证分析表明，在定价假设中，寡头垄断定价优于完全竞争。考虑不同的补贴设计后，发现均衡情况下，将补贴重点转向“年轻且无疾病者”会降低所有参保人的保费，同时增加参保人数和利润。

abstract.text: We measure desired labour supply at the extensive (employment) margin in two representative surveys of the U.S. and German populations. We elicit reservation raises: the percent wage change that renders a given individual indifferent between employment and nonemployment. It is equal to her reservation wage divided by her actual, or potential, wage. The reservation raise distribution is the nonparametric aggregate labour supply curve. Locally, the curve exhibits large short-run elasticities above 3, consistent with business cycle evidence. For larger upward shifts, arc elasticities shrink towards 0.5, consistent with quasi-experimental evidence from tax holidays. Existing models fail to match this nonconstant, asymmetric curve.

10.1093/restud/rdae021.abstractZh: 我们通过两项针对美国和德国人口的代表性调查，从广义的（就业）边际角度来衡量期望的劳动力供给。我们计算了保留率上升的幅度：即使某个个体在就业与非就业之间产生无差异的 wage 变化百分比。这一数值等于她的保留工资除以她的实际或潜在工资。保留率上升的分布构成了非参数总体劳动力供给曲线。在局部范围内，该曲线在短期内表现出较大的弹性，超过3，这与商业周期的证据一致。对于更大的工资上升幅度，弹性逐渐趋近于0.5，这与税收减免政策下的准实验证据相符。现有的模型无法解释这种非恒定且非对称的曲线特征。

abstract.text: We study partially linear models when the outcome of interest and some of the covariates are observed in two different datasets that cannot be linked. This type of data combination problem arises very frequently in empirical microeconomics. Using recent tools from optimal transport theory, we derive a constructive characterization of the sharp identified set. We then build on this result and develop a novel inference method that exploits the specific geometric properties of the identified set. Our method exhibits good performances in finite samples, while remaining very tractable. We apply our approach to study intergenerational income mobility over the period 1850–1930 in the U.S. Our method allows us to relax the exclusion restrictions used in earlier work, while delivering confidence regions that are informative.

10.1093/restud/rdae022.abstractZh: 我们研究了当感兴趣的结果和某些协变量分别出现在两个无法关联的数据集中时的部分线性模型。这种数据组合问题在实证微观经济学中非常常见。利用最优运输理论的最新工具，我们得出了尖锐识别集的构造性描述。在此基础上，我们开发了一种新的推断方法，该方法利用了识别集的特定几何特性。我们的方法在有限样本情况下表现出良好的性能，同时保持了很高的可操作性。我们将这种方法应用于研究1850年至1930年间美国的代际收入流动性。我们的方法允许我们放宽早期工作中使用的排除限制，同时提供具有信息价值的置信区间。

abstract.text: Hundreds of millions of microenterprises in emerging economies face increased competition from the entry and expansion of large firms that offer similar products. This paper examines the impacts of the opening of chain-run convenience stores on one of the world’s most ubiquitous microenterprises: owner-operated shops. To address endogeneity in time and location of chains’ opening, I pair two-way fixed effects with a novel instrument that shifts the profitability of chains but not of shops at the neighbourhood level. Expanding the number of chain outlets from zero to the neighbourhood average of 6.7 stores reduces the number of shops by 15%, a decline driven not by increased shop exits but by decreased shop entries. Shops retain their sales of fresh products and keep 96% of their customers, but customers visit shops less frequently and spend less on packaged goods. Surviving shops leverage competitive advantages stemming from being owner operated, such as lower agency costs, cultivating relationships with neighbours, and offering customers informal credit. The welfare gains of convenience chains replacing shops increase with household income; the poorest households experience a welfare loss.

10.1093/restud/rdae023.abstractZh: 新兴经济体中有数亿微型企业面临着来自提供类似产品的大型企业的竞争加剧。本文探讨了连锁便利店开设对全球最普遍的微型企业之一——自主经营的商店的影响。为了解决连锁店开设时间和地点的内生性问题，我采用了一种新颖的工具变量，该变量能够改变连锁店的盈利能力，而不会影响社区内商店的盈利能力。当连锁店的数量从零增加到社区平均6.7家时，商店的数量减少了15%，这一下降并非由于商店的退出增加，而是由于新商店的进入减少。商店仍然能够保持新鲜产品的销售，并保留96%的顾客，但顾客访问商店的频率降低，在包装商品上的消费也减少。幸存的商店凭借自主经营带来的竞争优势，如较低的代理成本、与邻居建立的关系以及提供非正式信贷，得以生存下来。随着家庭收入的增加，连锁便利店取代商店所带来的福利收益也会增加；而最贫困的家庭则会遭受福利损失。

abstract.text: Public health systems are dominant in much of the world but often face fiscal constraints that lead to rationing of care. As a result, private sector healthcare providers could in theory beneficially supplement public systems, but evaluating the benefits of private alternatives has been challenging. We evaluate a private supplement to the free public health system for one of the world’s deadliest health problems, diabetes. We estimate enormous impacts of the private supplement, increasing the share of those treated who are under control by 69%. This effect arises through both improved treatment compliance and health behavior. We find diabetes complications fall in the short run, and that the net costs of this intervention are one-third of the gross costs. The returns to private care do not appear to reflect more productive delivery but rather more attachment to medical care, offering lessons for improving the public system.

10.1093/restud/rdae024.abstractZh: 全球大部分地区的公共卫生体系占据主导地位，但往往面临财政限制，导致医疗服务分配不均。因此，理论上私人医疗提供者可以补充公共体系，但评估私人替代方案的效益一直具有挑战性。我们评估了针对全球最致命的健康问题之一——糖尿病的私人补充方案。我们估计，该私人补充方案产生了巨大影响，使得到控制的患者比例增加了69%。这一效果源于治疗依从性的提高和健康行为的改善。我们发现，短期内糖尿病并发症有所减少，且该干预措施的净成本仅为总成本的三分之一。私人医疗服务的回报似乎并不反映更高效的医疗服务，而是更多地反映了对医疗服务的依赖，这为改善公共体系提供了启示。

abstract.text: We introduce two data-driven procedures for optimal estimation and inference in nonparametric models using instrumental variables. The first is a data-driven choice of sieve dimension for a popular class of sieve two-stage least-squares estimators. When implemented with this choice, estimators of both the structural function h0 and its derivatives (such as elasticities) converge at the fastest possible (i.e. minimax) rates in sup-norm. The second is for constructing uniform confidence bands (UCBs) for h0 and its derivatives. Our UCBs guarantee coverage over a generic class of data-generating processes and contract at the minimax rate, possibly up to a logarithmic factor. As such, our UCBs are asymptotically more efficient than UCBs based on the usual approach of undersmoothing. As an application, we estimate the elasticity of the intensive margin of firm exports in a monopolistic competition model of international trade. Simulations illustrate the good performance of our procedures in empirically calibrated designs. Our results provide evidence against common parameterizations of the distribution of unobserved firm heterogeneity.

10.1093/restud/rdae025.abstractZh: 我们提出了两种基于数据的非参数模型最优估计与推断方法，这些方法使用工具变量进行估计。第一种方法是根据数据自动选择筛选矩阵的维度，适用于一类常见的筛选两步最小二乘估计器。采用这种选择后，结构函数h0及其导数（如弹性）的估计量能够以最快的（即最小最大）速率收敛到sup-norm。第二种方法是构建h0及其导数的均匀置信带。我们的均匀置信带能够覆盖一类通用的数据生成过程，并且以最小最大速率收敛，可能还会包含一个对数因子。因此，我们的均匀置信带在渐近意义上比基于欠平滑方法的均匀置信带更高效。作为应用案例，我们估计了垄断竞争国际贸易模型中企业出口密集型边际的弹性。模拟结果表明，我们的方法在经验校准的设计中表现良好。我们的研究结果反驳了关于未观测企业异质性分布的常见参数化方法。

abstract.text: How can we motivate good politicians—those that will carry out policy that is responsive to citizens’ preferences—to enter politics? In a field experiment in Pakistan, we vary how political office is portrayed to ordinary citizens. Emphasizing prosocial motives for holding political office instead of personal returns—such as the ability to help others versus enhancing one’s own respect and status—raises the likelihood that individuals run for office and that voters elect them. A year later, the treatment improves the alignment of policy with citizens’ preferences. These effects emerge only when treatments are randomly delivered in a public setting. Taken together, the results demonstrate that how politics is perceived shapes who decides to run for office, who is elected, as well the policies that democracies deliver.

10.1093/restud/rdae026.abstractZh: 我们如何激励优秀的政治家——那些能够实施符合公民偏好的政策的人——进入政坛呢？在巴基斯坦的一项实地实验中，我们改变了普通公民对政治职位的认知。强调担任政治职务的亲社会动机，而非个人回报，比如帮助他人与提升个人声望和地位，这提高了个人竞选公职的可能性，以及选民选择这些人的可能性。一年后，这种处理方式使得政策与公民偏好更加一致。这些效应只有在公共场合随机实施时才会显现。综合来看，结果表明，对政治的认知决定了谁会竞选公职、谁会被选出来，以及民主国家会实施哪些政策。

abstract.text: We consider the effects of climate change on seasonally migrant populations that herd livestock—i.e. transhumant pastoralists—in Africa. Traditionally, transhumant pastoralists benefit from a cooperative relationship with sedentary agriculturalists whereby arable land is used for crop farming in the wet season and animal grazing in the dry season.
