Rainfall scarcity can disrupt this arrangement by inducing pastoral groups to migrate to agricultural lands before the harvest, causing conflict to emerge. We examine this hypothesis by combining ethnographic information on the traditional locations of transhumant pastoralists and sedentary agriculturalists with high-resolution data on the location and timing of rainfall and violent conflict events in Africa from 1989 to 2018. We find that reduced rainfall in the territory of transhumant pastoralists leads to conflict in neighbouring areas. Consistent with the proposed mechanism, the conflicts are concentrated in agricultural areas; they occur during the wet season and not the dry season; and they are due to rainfall’s impact on plant biomass growth. Since pastoralists tend to be Muslim and agriculturalists Christian, this mechanism accounts for a sizable proportion of the rapid rise in religious conflict observed in recent decades. Regarding policy responses, we find that development aid projects tend not to mitigate the effects that we document. By contrast, the effects are reduced when transhumant pastoralists have greater power in national government, suggesting that more equal political representation is conducive to peace.

10.1093/restud/rdae027.abstractZh: 我们研究了气候变化对非洲季节性迁徙的牧民群体的影响。传统上，这些牧民与定居的农业者之间存在合作关系，在雨季利用耕地进行农作物种植，在旱季则进行牲畜放牧。然而，降雨量的减少可能会破坏这种安排，迫使牧民在收获前迁移到农业区，从而引发冲突。我们通过结合关于牧民和农业者传统居住地的民族志资料，以及1989年至2018年间非洲降雨量和暴力冲突事件的位置和时间的高分辨率数据，来检验这一假设。研究发现，牧民活动区域降雨量的减少会导致邻近地区的冲突。与所提出的机制一致，这些冲突集中在农业区；它们发生在雨季而非旱季；并且是由于降雨对植物生物量生长的影响所致。由于牧民多为穆斯林，而农业者多为基督徒，这一机制可以解释近几十年来宗教冲突急剧增加的现象。关于政策响应，我们发现发展援助项目往往无法减轻我们所观察到的影响。相反，当牧民在国家政府中拥有更大的权力时，这些影响会有所减弱，这表明更平等的政治代表性有助于维护和平。

abstract.text: Authorities’ support policies shape the location and continuation of industrial and banking activity on their soil. Firms’ locus of activity depends on their prospect of receiving financial assistance in distress and therefore on factors such as countries’ relative resilience. We predict that global firms are global in life and national in death; and that they become less global when competition is more intense, times are turbulent, and international risk sharing (say, through swap lines) weak. We analyse the competitive benefits of industrial and banking policies as well as their limitations, such as currency appreciation.

10.1093/restud/rdae028.abstractZh: 当局的支持政策决定了工业与银行活动在其境内的位置与存续。企业的活动地点取决于其在困境中获得财政援助的可能性，因此也取决于国家的相对韧性等因素。我们预测，全球企业无论在国内还是国外都具有全球性；而当竞争加剧、经济形势动荡以及国际风险分担机制（例如通过互换协议）较弱时，企业的全球性会减弱。我们分析了工业与银行政策带来的竞争优势，同时也指出了它们的局限性，比如货币升值问题。

abstract.text: We study demand estimation in a large auction market. In our model, a dynamically evolving population of buyers with unit demand and heterogeneous and privately known preferences for a finite set of differentiated products compete in a sequence of auctions that occur in discrete time. We define an empirically tractable equilibrium concept in which bidders behave as though they are competing with the stationary distribution of opposing bids, characterize bidding strategies, and prove existence of equilibrium. Having developed this demand system, we prove that it is non-parametrically identified from panel data. We extend the model to consider a random coefficients demand system akin to workhorse demand models in industrial organization, and show that this too is non-parametrically identified. We apply the model to estimate demand and show how large sellers can exercise market power by using persistent reserve price policies, which induce higher bids and, therefore, revenues. Our analysis highlights the importance of both dynamic bidding strategies and panel data sample selection issues when analysing these markets.

10.1093/restud/rdae031.abstractZh: 我们研究了大型拍卖市场中的需求估计问题。在我们的模型中，一个动态变化的买家群体拥有单位需求，并且他们对有限种类产品的偏好具有异质性和私密性，这些买家在离散时间发生的系列拍卖中竞争。我们定义了一个经验上可行的均衡概念，其中投标者表现得像是在与固定的对手出价分布竞争，并描述了投标策略，证明了均衡的存在性。在建立了这一需求系统之后，我们证明了它可以从面板数据中非参数地识别出来。我们将模型扩展为考虑一种类似于工业组织中的工作horse需求模型的随机系数需求系统，并证明这种模型同样可以非参数地识别。我们应用该模型来估计需求，并展示了大型卖家如何通过持续保留价格策略来行使市场力量，从而诱导更高的出价和更高的收入。我们的分析强调了动态投标策略以及面板数据样本选择问题在分析这些市场时的重要性。

abstract.text: Historically, large changes in U.S. government spending induced fiscal efforts that were not all alike, with some using more progressive taxes than others. We develop a heterogeneous-agent New Keynesian model to analyse how the distribution of taxes across households shapes spending multipliers. The model yields empirically realistic distributions in marginal propensities to consume and labour elasticities, which result in lower responsiveness to tax changes for higher-income earners. In turn, multipliers are larger when spending is financed with higher tax progressivity—that is, when the tax burden falls more heavily on higher-income earners. This result is historically material. We estimate that, on average, tax rates increased more for top-income than for bottom-income earners after a spending shock. Thus, the typical U.S. spending shock was financed with higher tax progressivity. We further exploit the historical variation in the financing of spending to estimate progressivity-dependent multipliers, which we find consistent with the model.

10.1093/restud/rdae032.abstractZh: 从历史上看，美国政府支出的巨大变化引发了不同的财政措施，其中一些国家采用了更累进的税收制度。我们建立了一个异质代理人新凯恩斯模型，来分析税收分配如何影响支出乘数。该模型得出的边际消费倾向和劳动弹性分布具有现实性，这导致高收入者对税收变化的反应较低。反过来，当支出由更高的税收累进性来融资时，支出乘数会更大——也就是说，当税收负担更多地落在高收入者身上时。这一结果具有历史意义。我们估计，在支出冲击之后，最高收入者的税率平均上升幅度大于最低收入者。因此，典型的美国支出冲击是由更高的税收累进性来融资的。我们进一步利用历史上支出融资方式的变化，估算出与模型一致、依赖于累进性的支出乘数。

abstract.text: This article provides a general framework to study the role of production networks in international GDP comovement. We first derive an additive decomposition of bilateral GDP comovement into components capturing shock transmission and shock correlation. We quantify this decomposition in a parsimonious multi-country, multi-sector dynamic network propagation model, using data for the G7 countries over the period 1978–2007. Our main finding is that while the network transmission of shocks is quantitatively important, it accounts for a minority of observed comovement under the estimated range of structural elasticities. Contemporaneous responses to correlated shocks in the production network are more successful at generating comovement than intertemporal propagation through capital accumulation. Extensions with multiple shocks, nominal rigidities, and international financial integration leave our main result unchanged. A combination of TFP and labour supply shocks is quantitatively successful at reproducing the observed international business cycle.

10.1093/restud/rdae033.abstractZh: 本文提供了一个总体框架，用于研究生产网络在国际GDP波动中的作用。我们首先将双边GDP波动分解为若干组成部分，分别反映冲击的传递和关联效应。我们在一个简约的多国、多部门动态网络传播模型中量化了这一分解，并使用了1978至2007年间G7国家的数据作为样本。我们的主要发现是，尽管网络对冲击的传递在数量上非常重要，但在估计的结构弹性范围内，它仅能解释部分观察到的GDP波动。在生产网络中，对相关冲击的同步响应在产生波动方面更为有效，而通过资本积累实现的跨时传播则效果较差。在包含多重冲击、名义刚性以及国际金融一体化的扩展模型中，我们的主要结论保持不变。将技术效率与劳动力供应冲击结合起来，在再现观察到的国际商业周期方面具有显著效果。

abstract.text: We study dynamic signalling when the sender does not see the signals that her actions generate. The sender then uses her past play to forecast what a receiver believes, in turn forcing the receiver to forecast the previous forecast, and so forth. We identify a class of linear-quadratic-Gaussian games where this endogenous higher-order uncertainty can be handled. The sender’s second-order belief is key: it is a private state that she controls, and it creates a new channel for information transmission. We examine the role of higher-order uncertainty and this new signalling channel in applications to macroeconomics, reputation, and trading: inflationary biases under discretion can be larger; career-concerned agents may benefit from not knowing their reputations; and informed trades can carry more price impact. We also introduce an existence method for boundary value problems that can be used in other dynamic games.

10.1093/restud/rdae035.abstractZh: 我们研究了当发送者无法看到自己的行为所产生的信号时的动态信号传递问题。发送者利用过去的行动来预测接收者的信念，进而迫使接收者也预测之前的预测，如此循环。我们识别了一类线性-二次高斯博弈，在这种博弈中，这种内生的高阶不确定性可以被处理。发送者的二阶信念是关键：这是一个她可以控制的私人状态，它创造了一个新的信息传递渠道。我们研究了高阶不确定性和这种新的信号传递渠道在宏观经济学、声誉管理和交易中的应用：在自由裁量权下，通货膨胀偏见可能会更大；与职业相关的代理人可能从不知道自己的声誉中获益；而知情的交易可能会带来更大的价格影响。我们还提出了一种可用于其他动态博弈的边界值问题的存在性方法。

abstract.text: This study presents a new economic perspective on state-building based on a case study in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s hinterland. We explore the implications for the state of considering rebels as stationary bandits. When the state, through a military operation, made it impossible for rebels to levy taxes, it inadvertently encouraged them to plunder the assets of the very citizens they previously preferred to tax. When it negotiated with rebels instead, this effect was absent, but negotiating compromised the state’s legitimacy and prompted the emergence of new rebels. The findings suggest that attempting to increase taxation by a weak state in the hinterland could come at the expense of safety in the medium term and of the integrity of the state in the long term.

10.1093/restud/rdae036.abstractZh: 本研究基于刚果民主共和国内陆地区的案例研究，提出了一种关于国家建设的新经济视角。我们探讨了将反叛分子视为固定不变的盗匪对国家的影响。当国家通过军事行动使反叛分子无法征税时，无意中反而鼓励他们掠夺原本愿意征税的公民资产。而当国家与反叛分子进行谈判时，这种效应则不存在，但谈判行为却损害了国家的合法性，并促使新的反叛分子出现。研究结果表明，试图通过弱小国家增加税收可能会在中期损害国家安全，并在长期内破坏国家的完整性。

abstract.text: We present a novel algorithm called Dynamic Perturbation for solving large-scale macroeconomic models. Our approach involves computing first-order Taylor expansions of the policy functions along the entire equilibrium path. This method applies to a wide range of models and offers significantly higher accuracy than traditional perturbation approaches. Remarkably, even when utilising first-order approximations, our method can effectively handle models with strong nonlinearities and occasionally binding constraints, such as the zero lower bound.

10.1093/restud/rdae037.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种名为“动态扰动”的新算法，用于求解大规模宏观经济模型。我们的方法涉及对整个均衡路径上的政策函数进行一阶泰勒展开。这种方法适用于多种模型，并且比传统的扰动方法具有更高的准确性。值得注意的是，即使使用一阶近似，我们的方法也能有效处理具有强非线性特征以及偶尔存在约束条件的模型，例如零下限约束。

abstract.text: This paper develops a model to study the macroeconomic implications of supply chain disruptions with three key ingredients: (i) a firm-level network of customized supplier–customer links that generate relationship-specific productivity gains; (ii) bargaining over these relationship-specific surpluses; and (iii) an extensive margin of adjustment, whereby firms decide to form or sever relations with suppliers and customers. We establish equilibrium existence and uniqueness, provide characterization results, and present a number of comparative statics that show how supply chains and aggregate output respond to shocks. We also show that equilibrium supply chains are inefficient and exhibit an inherent fragility: small shocks can lead to discontinuous changes in output, even though the efficient allocation is always continuous in the same shocks. We explore several macroeconomic implications of this fragility.

10.1093/restud/rdae038.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个模型，用于研究供应链中断对宏观经济的影响，该模型包含三个关键要素：(i) 企业层面的定制供应商-客户关系网络，这些关系网络能够带来特定于关系的生产率提升；(ii) 对这些特定于关系的剩余资源的协商行为；(iii) 广泛的调整空间，即企业可以决定与供应商和客户建立或终止关系。我们证明了均衡的存在性和唯一性，提供了相关特征描述，并展示了供应链和总产出如何对冲击作出反应。我们还指出，均衡的供应链是低效的，并且具有内在的脆弱性：即使有效配置在相同的冲击下始终是连续的，小的冲击仍可能导致产出的不连续变化。我们进一步探讨了这种脆弱性对宏观经济的影响。

abstract.text: Interviewing is a decisive stage of most processes that match candidates to firms and organizations. This article studies how and why a candidate’s interview outcome depends on the other candidates interviewed by the same evaluator. We use large-scale data from high-stakes admission and hiring processes, where candidates are quasi-randomly assigned to evaluators and time slots. We find that the individual assessment decreases as the quality of other candidates assigned to the same evaluator increases. The influence of the previous candidate stands out, leading to a negative autocorrelation in evaluators’ votes of up to 40% and distorting final admission and hiring decisions. Our findings are in line with a contrast effect model where evaluators form a benchmark through associative recall. We assess potential changes in the design of interview processes to mitigate contrasting against the previous candidate.

10.1093/restud/rdae039.abstractZh: 面试是大多数将候选人匹配到企业和组织的过程中至关重要的阶段。本文研究了一个候选人的面试结果如何以及为何会受到同一评估者所面试的其他候选人的影响。我们利用了大规模的高风险录取和招聘过程中的数据，在这些过程中，候选人被准随机地分配到不同的评估者和时间段。我们发现，随着分配给同一评估者的其他候选人的质量提高，个体评估的可靠性会降低。先前候选人的影响尤为显著，导致评估者投票出现高达40%的负自相关现象，进而扭曲了最终的录取和招聘决策。我们的研究结果与对比效应模型相符，该模型认为评估者通过联想回忆形成了一种基准。我们评估了设计面试流程时可能的改进措施，以减轻与先前候选人的对比效应。

abstract.text: Meritocracies aspire to reward hard work and promise not to judge individuals by the circumstances into which they were born. However, circumstances often shape the choice to work hard. I show that people’s merit judgments are “shallow” and insensitive to this effect. They hold others responsible for their choices, even if these choices have been shaped by unequal circumstances. In an experiment, U.S. participants judge how much money workers deserve for the effort they exert. Unequal circumstances disadvantage some workers and discourage them from working hard. Nonetheless, participants reward the effort of disadvantaged and advantaged workers identically, regardless of the circumstances under which choices are made. For some participants, this reflects their fundamental view regarding fair rewards. For others, the neglect results from the uncertain counterfactual. They understand that circumstances shape choices but do not correct for this because the counterfactual—what would have happened under equal circumstances—remains uncertain.

10.1093/restud/rdae040.abstractZh: 精英制度旨在奖励辛勤工作，并承诺不会根据个人出生时的环境来评判他们。然而，环境往往会影响人们选择努力工作的决定。我发现，人们对自身价值的判断是“肤浅”的，对这种影响缺乏敏感度。他们会将其他人的选择归咎于这些因素，即使这些选择是由不平等的环境所塑造的。在一项实验中，美国参与者对工人所付出的努力应得的报酬进行了评估。不平等的环境使一些工人处于不利地位，从而抑制了他们努力工作的积极性。尽管如此，参与者对无论是处于不利还是有利环境的工人的努力给予了相同的奖励，而不考虑做出选择时的环境因素。对于某些参与者来说，这反映了他们对公平奖励的基本看法。对于其他人来说，这种忽视是由于不确定性的反事实造成的。他们明白环境会影响选择，但由于反事实——即在平等环境下会发生什么——仍然不确定，因此无法纠正这种忽视。

abstract.text: This article studies the problem of optimally allocating treatments in the presence of spillover effects, using information from a (quasi-)experiment. I introduce a method that maximizes the sample analogue of average social welfare when spillovers occur. I construct semi-parametric welfare estimators with known and unknown propensity scores and cast the optimization problem into a mixed-integer linear program, which can be solved using off-the-shelf algorithms. I derive a strong set of guarantees on regret, i.e. the difference between the maximum attainable welfare and the welfare evaluated at the estimated policy. The proposed method presents attractive features for applications: (i) it does not require network information of the target population; (ii) it exploits heterogeneity in treatment effects for targeting individuals; (iii) it does not rely on the correct specification of a particular structural model; and (iv) it accommodates constraints on the policy function. An application for targeting information on social networks illustrates the advantages of the method.

10.1093/restud/rdae041.abstractZh: 本文研究了在存在溢出效应的情况下如何最优分配 treatments 的问题，所采用的信息来自一个（准）实验。我提出了一种方法，该方法在出现溢出效应时最大化样本平均社会福利的类似值。我构建了具有已知和未知倾向得分的半参数福利估计器，并将优化问题转化为混合整数线性规划问题，该问题可以使用现成的算法求解。我推导了一组关于遗憾值的强保证，即最大可达福利与根据估计政策计算出的福利之间的差异。所提出的方法具有一些吸引人的应用特点：(i) 不需要目标人群的网络信息；(ii) 利用治疗效应的异质性来针对个体；(iii) 不依赖于特定结构模型的正确设定；(iv) 能够适应对政策函数的约束。一个针对社交网络信息定向的应用案例展示了该方法的优势。

abstract.text: The extent to which households can self-insure depends on family structure and wage risk. We calibrate a model of couples and singles’ savings and labour supply under two types of wage processes. The first wage process is the canonical—age-independent, linear—one that is typically used to evaluate government insurance provision. The second wage process is a flexible one. We use our model to evaluate the optimal mix of the two most common types of means-tested benefits—IW versus income floor. The canonical wage process underestimates wage persistence for women and thus implies that IW benefits should account for most benefit income. In contrast, the richer wage process that matches the wage data well, implies that the income floor should be the main benefit source, similarly to the system in place in the U.K. This stresses that allowing for rich wage dynamics is important to properly evaluate policy.

10.1093/restud/rdae042.abstractZh: 家庭能够自我保险的程度取决于家庭结构和工资风险。我们构建了一个模型，用于评估夫妻和单身者在两种工资机制下的储蓄和劳动力供给情况。第一种工资机制是典型的、与年龄无关的线性机制，这种机制通常用于评估政府保险政策。第二种工资机制则更为灵活。我们利用该模型来评估两种最常见的基于经济状况的福利措施——IW福利与收入门槛——的最佳组合。典型的工资机制低估了女性的工资稳定性，因此意味着IW福利应占大部分福利收入。相反，与工资数据更为匹配的更灵活的工资机制则表明，收入门槛应成为主要的福利来源，这与英国现行的制度类似。这强调了考虑富裕人群的工资动态对于正确评估政策至关重要。

abstract.text: This study argues that the decline of coercive labour institutions over the course of industrialization was partly driven by complementarity between physical capital and effective labour in manufacturing. Given the difficulty of extracting labour effort in care-intensive industrial tasks through monitoring and punishment, capital-owning elites ultimately chose to emancipate workers to induce their supply of effective labour and, thus, boost the return to physical capital. This hypothesis is empirically examined in the context of serf emancipation in nineteenth-century Prussia. Exploiting variation in proto-industrialization across Prussian counties, the analysis finds that, consistent with the proposed hypothesis, the initial abundance of elite-owned physical capital is associated with a higher pace of serf emancipation and lower redemption payments to manorial lords.

10.1093/restud/rdae043.abstractZh: 本研究认为，工业化过程中强制劳动制度的衰落部分是由于制造业中物质资本与有效劳动力的互补性所导致的。由于通过监督和惩罚来提取护理密集型工业任务中的劳动力努力存在困难，拥有资本的精英最终选择解放工人，以吸引他们提供有效劳动力，从而提高物质资本的回报。这一假设在19世纪普鲁士的农奴解放背景下得到了实证检验。通过分析普鲁士各郡在原始工业化进程中的差异，研究发现，与假设一致的是，精英拥有的物质资本初始充裕程度与农奴解放的速度加快以及向领主支付的赎金减少有关。

abstract.text: I model and quantify the impact of a new dimension of globalization: offshore R&D. In the model, firms employ researchers across the globe to develop new product blueprints and then engage in offshore production and exporting. Frictions impeding trade and the separation of production from R&D lead to a “market-access” motive for offshore R&D, while cross-country differences in the distributions of firm knowhow and worker ability generate a “talent-acquisition” motive. I discipline the model using empirical facts derived from a new firm-level dataset. Counterfactual experiments show that the two motives can account for a significant portion of the observed offshore R&D. Incorporating offshore R&D amplifies the gains from globalization by a factor of 1.3 and generates new implications for the impacts of traditional forms of global integration, namely trade and multinational production.

10.1093/restud/rdae044.abstractZh: 我对该全球化新维度——离岸研发的影响进行了建模和量化分析。在模型中，企业雇佣全球范围内的研究人员来开发新产品方案，然后开展离岸生产和出口活动。阻碍贸易的摩擦以及生产环节与研发环节的分离，导致了离岸研发的“市场准入”动机；而企业知识分布和工人能力的跨国差异则产生了“人才获取”动机。我通过来自新的企业级数据集的实证数据对模型进行了修正。反事实实验表明，这两种动机可以解释观察到的离岸研发行为中的相当一部分。将离岸研发纳入考虑后，全球化带来的收益增加了1.3倍，同时也为传统形式的全球整合方式——即贸易和跨国生产——的影响提供了新的启示。

abstract.text: Many studies have documented that the sales concentration of U.S. producers has risen in recent decades. In this article, we show that this increase was accompanied by more entry and growth of foreign competitors. Using confidential census data covering the universe of all firm sales in the U.S. manufacturing sector, we find that rising import competition increased concentration among U.S. firms by reallocating sales from smaller to larger U.S. firms and by causing firm exit. However, this increase in production concentration was counteracted by the expansion of foreign firms, which reduced domestic firms’ share of the U.S. market inclusive of foreign firms’ sales. We find that once the sales of foreign exporters are taken into account, U.S. market concentration in manufacturing was stable between 1992 and 2012.

10.1093/restud/rdae045.abstractZh: 许多研究指出，美国生产商的销售集中度在最近几十年有所上升。本文表明，这种增长伴随着更多外国竞争对手的进入和增长。利用涵盖美国制造业所有企业销售情况的机密普查数据，我们发现，日益激烈的进口竞争通过将销售从较小的美国企业重新分配至较大的企业，并导致企业退出市场，从而增加了美国企业的集中度。然而，这种生产集中度的增加被外国企业的扩张所抵消，后者减少了包括外国企业销售在内的美国国内企业在市场中的份额。我们发现，一旦将外国出口商的销售纳入考虑范围，美国制造业的市场集中度在1992年至2012年间保持稳定。

abstract.text: The gains from monetary policy cooperation depend on real and financial distortions in the economy and evolve dynamically with prevailing economic conditions. We show that, with international trade in assets, these gains are driven by asymmetric cross-border developments in productivity and savings, and can reach multiples of the cost of economic fluctuations. When financial flows are restricted to nonstate-contingent bonds, the gains from cooperation grow with the size of global imbalances, i.e. net-foreign-asset positions.

10.1093/restud/rdae046.abstractZh: 货币政策合作带来的收益取决于经济中的实际和金融扭曲，并且会随着当前的经济状况而动态变化。我们指出，在资产国际贸易的情况下，这些收益是由生产率和储蓄方面的不对称跨境发展所驱动的，其收益可能达到经济波动成本的几倍。而当金融流动仅限于非国家担保的债券时，合作带来的收益会随着全球失衡规模的扩大而增加，即净外国资产头寸的扩大。

abstract.text: How do innovation and education policy affect individual career choices and aggregate productivity? This paper analyses the effect of R&D subsidies and higher education policy on productivity growth through the supply of innovative talent. We put scarce talent, higher education attainment, and career choice at the centre of a new endogenous growth framework with individual-level heterogeneity in talent, financial resources, and preferences. We link the model to micro-level data from Denmark on the backgrounds of who obtains a PhD and becomes an inventor and the outcomes of a set of policy interventions. We find that R&D subsidies can be strengthened when combined with higher education subsidies, which enable talented but poor youth to pursue a career in research. Education and innovation policies not only alleviate different frictions, but also impact innovation at different time horizons. Education policy is more effective in societies with higher income inequality.

10.1093/restud/rdae047.abstractZh: 创新和教育政策如何影响个人职业选择以及整体生产力？本文通过分析研发补贴和高等教育政策对创新人才供给对生产力增长的影响，来探讨这些政策的作用机制。我们将稀缺人才、高等教育水平以及职业选择作为新的内生增长框架的核心要素，并考虑人才、财务资源和偏好在个体层面的异质性。我们将模型与丹麦关于获得博士学位并成为发明家的人群背景以及一系列政策干预结果的数据相结合。研究发现，当研发补贴与高等教育补贴相结合时，能够促使有才华但经济条件较差的年轻人从事研究工作。教育和创新政策不仅能够缓解不同的摩擦，还能在不同时间范围内影响创新活动。在收入不平等程度较高的社会中，教育政策的效果更为显著。

abstract.text: We characterize the conditions under which a socially responsible (SR) fund induces firms to reduce externalities, even when profit-seeking capital is in perfectly elastic supply. Such impact requires that the SR fund’s mandate permits the fund to trade off financial performance against reductions in social costs—relative to the counterfactual in which the fund does not invest in a given firm. Based on such an impact mandate, we derive the social profitability index, an investment criterion that characterizes the optimal ranking of impact investments when SR capital is scarce. If firms face binding financial constraints, the optimal way to achieve impact is by enabling a scale increase for clean production. In this case, SR and profit-seeking capital are complementary: Surplus is higher when both investor types are present.

10.1093/restud/rdae048.abstractZh: 我们描述了一种社会责任基金促使企业减少外部性的条件，即使寻求利润的资本供应是完全弹性的。这种影响要求社会责任基金的使命允许基金在财务表现与社会成本降低之间进行权衡——相对于基金不投资于特定企业的反事实情况而言。基于这样的影响使命，我们推导出了社会盈利能力指数，这是一个投资标准，用于描述在社会责任资本稀缺时影响投资的最佳排序。如果企业面临严格的财务限制，实现影响的最佳方式是通过促进清洁生产的规模扩大。在这种情况下，社会责任基金和寻求利润的资本是互补的：当这两种类型的资本都存在时，剩余收益会更高。

abstract.text: How does competition from online platforms affect the organization, performance, and editorial choices of newspapers? What are the implications of these changes for the information voters are exposed to and for their political choices? We study these questions using the staggered introduction of Craigslist (CL)—the world’s largest online platform for classified advertising—across U.S. counties between 1995 and 2009. This setting allows us to separate the effect of competition for classified advertising from other changes brought about by the Internet, and to compare newspapers that relied more or less heavily on classified ads ex ante. We find that, following the entry of CL, local newspapers reliant on classified ads experienced a significant decline in the number of management and newsroom staff, including in the number of editors covering politics. These organizational changes led to a reduction in news coverage of politics and resulted in a decline in newspaper readership, particularly among readers with high political interest. Finally, we document that reduced exposure to local political news was associated with an increase in partisan voting and increased entry and success of ideologically extreme candidates in congressional elections. Taken together, our findings shed light on the determinants of the decline of print media and on its broader implications for democratic politics.

10.1093/restud/rdae049.abstractZh: 在线平台竞争如何影响报纸的组织结构、运营和编辑选择？这些变化对信息受众所接触的信息以及他们的政治选择有何影响？我们通过研究1995年至2009年间美国各县陆续引入全球最大的分类广告在线平台Craigslist的情况，来探讨这些问题。这一研究设置使我们能够区分分类广告竞争对其他互联网带来的变化的影响，并比较那些在之前更依赖分类广告的报纸。研究发现，随着Craigslist的进入，依赖分类广告的本地报纸在管理层和新闻编辑部人员数量上出现了显著下降，包括负责政治报道的编辑数量也有所减少。这些组织上的变化导致政治新闻的报道减少，进而使报纸的读者数量下降，尤其是那些对政治有高度兴趣的读者。最后，我们发现，本地政治新闻的减少与党派投票的增加以及意识形态极端候选人在国会选举中的成功当选有关。综合来看，我们的研究结果揭示了印刷媒体衰落的决定因素，以及其对民主政治的更广泛影响。

abstract.text: We propose a new sequential Efficient Pseudo-Likelihood (k-EPL) estimator for dynamic discrete choice games of incomplete information. k-EPL considers the joint behaviour of multiple players simultaneously, as opposed to individual responses to other agents’ equilibrium play. This, in addition to reframing the problem from conditional choice probability (CCP) space to value function space, yields a computationally tractable, stable, and efficient estimator. We show that each iteration in the k-EPL sequence is consistent and asymptotically efficient, so the first-order asymptotic properties do not vary across iterations. Furthermore, we show the sequence achieves higher-order equivalence to the finite-sample maximum-likelihood estimator with iteration and that the sequence of estimators converges almost surely to the maximum-likelihood estimator at a nearly superlinear rate when the data are generated by any regular Markov perfect equilibrium, including equilibria that lead to inconsistency of other sequential estimators. When utility is linear in parameters, k-EPL iterations are computationally simple, only requiring that the researcher solve linear systems of equations to generate pseudo-regressors which are used in a static logit/probit regression. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate the theoretical results and show k-EPL’s good performance in finite samples in both small- and large-scale games, even when the game admits spurious equilibria in addition to one that generated the data. We apply the estimator to analyse competition in the U.S. wholesale club industry.

10.1093/restud/rdae050.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新的序贯高效伪似然估计方法（k-EPL），用于不完全信息下的动态离散选择博弈。k-EPL考虑了多个参与者同时的联合行为，而非单个参与者对其他代理人的均衡行为的响应。此外，该方法将问题从条件选择概率空间重新构建为价值函数空间，从而实现了计算上可行、稳定且高效的估计方法。我们证明k-EPL序列中的每次迭代都是一致且渐近高效的，因此一阶渐近性质在迭代过程中保持不变。此外，我们还证明了该序列与有限样本最大似然估计方法在迭代次数上达到高阶等价性，并且当数据由任何规则马尔可夫完美均衡生成时，估计序列几乎必然以超线性速率收敛到最大似然估计方法。当效用参数线性时，k-EPL的迭代过程在计算上非常简单，只需研究人员求解线性方程组即可生成用于静态逻辑回归/Probit回归的伪回归量。蒙特卡洛模拟验证了理论结果，并表明k-EPL在有限样本情况下，无论是在小规模还是大规模博弈中，都能表现出良好的性能，即使博弈中存在虚假均衡以及生成数据的均衡。我们将该估计方法应用于分析美国批发俱乐部行业的竞争情况。

abstract.text: Using large-scale survey data covering more than 110 countries and exploiting within-country variation across cohorts and surveys, we show that individuals with longer exposure to democracy display stronger support for democratic institutions, and that this effect is almost entirely driven by exposure to democracies with successful performance in terms of economic growth, control of corruption, peace and political stability, and public goods provision. Across a variety of specifications, estimation methods, and samples, the results are robust, and the timing and nature of the effects are consistent with our interpretation. We also present suggestive evidence that democratic institutions that receive support from their citizens perform better in the face of negative shocks.

10.1093/restud/rdae051.abstractZh: 通过覆盖110多个国家的大规模调查数据，并利用不同国家、不同队列和调查之间的内部差异，我们发现，长期接触民主制度的个体对民主制度的支持更为强烈，而这种效应几乎完全是由那些在经济增长、反腐败、和平与政治稳定以及公共产品提供方面表现良好的民主国家的经验所驱动的。无论是在不同的模型设定、估计方法还是样本选择下，研究结果都是稳健的，且这些效应的发生时间和性质与我们之前的解释一致。我们还提供了一些有启发性的证据，表明得到公民支持的民主制度在面临负面冲击时表现更好。

abstract.text: In the U.S., market hours worked are approximately flat across the wealth distribution. Accounting for this phenomenon is a standing challenge for standard heterogeneous-agent macro models. In these models, wealthier households consume more and work fewer hours. We propose a theory that generates the cross-sectional wealth-hours relation as in the data. We quantify this theory in a heterogeneous-agent incomplete-markets model with three key features: a quality choice in consumption, non-homothetic preferences, and a multi-sector production structure. We show that the model produces consumption expenditure patterns consistent with the data and realistic “quality Engel curves”.

10.1093/restud/rdae052.abstractZh: 在美国，不同财富等级的家庭工作市场时间大致相同。对于标准的异质代理人宏观模型来说，解释这一现象一直是一个挑战。在这些模型中，富裕家庭消费更多，工作时间则较少。我们提出了一种理论，该理论能够生成与数据一致的横截面财富工作时间关系。我们在一个具有三个关键特征的异质代理人不完全市场模型中量化了这一理论：消费中的质量选择、非同质性偏好以及多部门生产结构。我们证明，该模型产生的消费支出模式与数据一致，并且具有现实的“质量恩格尔曲线”。

abstract.text: We document five novel facts about the role of search effort in forming trading relationships among firms by combining a variety of micro and macro datasets. These facts strongly suggest the presence of search complementarities. To study the implications of these facts for aggregate fluctuations, we build a dynamic general equilibrium model, disciplined by our new firm-level evidence on search effort. The model matches key aspects of the macro and micro data that have remained unaccounted for by standard models, including the time-varying bimodal distribution of output and the strong, nonlinear propagation of shocks. Also, changes to the volatility of shocks have nonlinear effects on macroeconomic fluctuations that advance a novel interpretation of the Great Moderation. Finally, we provide a new account of the state-dependent effects of fiscal policy.

10.1093/restud/rdae053.abstractZh: 我们通过结合多种微观和宏观数据集，记录了关于搜索努力在企业间形成交易关系中的作用的五个新发现。这些发现强烈表明存在搜索互补性。为了研究这些发现对总体经济波动的影响，我们构建了一个动态一般均衡模型，该模型以我们对企业搜索努力的新证据为基础进行约束。该模型能够解释标准模型未能涵盖的宏观和微观数据中的关键特征，包括产出随时间变化的双峰分布以及冲击的强烈非线性传播。此外，冲击波动性的变化对宏观经济波动具有非线性影响，这为“大缓和”现象提供了新的解释。最后，我们提出了关于财政政策状态依赖效应的新解释。

abstract.text: This paper develops a theory of subjective beliefs that departs from rational expectations, and shows that biases in household beliefs have quantitatively large effects on macroeconomic aggregates. The departures are formalized using model-consistent notions of pessimism and optimism which are supported by extensive time-series and cross-sectional evidence from household surveys. The role subjective beliefs play in aggregate fluctuations is quantified in a business cycle model with goods and labour market frictions. Consistent with the survey evidence, an increase in pessimism generates upward biases in unemployment and inflation forecasts and lowers economic activity. The underlying belief distortions reduce aggregate demand and propagate through frictional goods and labour markets. As a by-product of the analysis, solution techniques that preserve the effects of time-varying belief distortions in the class of linear solutions are developed.

10.1093/restud/rdae054.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种基于理性预期的主观信念理论，并表明家庭信念中的偏差对宏观经济总量具有显著的量化影响。这些差异通过模型一致的悲观与乐观概念来表述，这些概念得到了大量家庭调查的时间序列和横截面数据的支持。在包含商品和劳动力市场摩擦的商业周期模型中，主观信念在总体波动中的作用得到了量化。与调查数据一致的是，悲观情绪的增加会导致失业和通货膨胀预测出现向上的偏差，并降低经济活动水平。这些潜在的信念扭曲会降低总需求，并通过商品和劳动力市场的摩擦传播开来。作为分析的副产品，本文还提出了一种解决方案技术，能够保留时间变化信念扭曲对线性解类的影响。

abstract.text: In theory, market-based regulatory instruments correct market failures at least cost. However, evidence on their efficacy remains scarce. Using administrative data, we estimate that, on average, the European Union Emissions Trading System (EU ETS)—the world’s first and largest market-based climate policy—induced regulated manufacturing firms to reduce carbon dioxide emissions by 14–16% with no detectable contractions in economic activity. We find no evidence of outsourcing to unregulated firms or markets; instead, firms made targeted investments, reducing the emissions intensity of production. These results indicate that the EU ETS induced global emissions reductions, a necessary and sufficient condition for mitigating climate change. We show that the absence of any negative economic effects can be rationalized in a model where pricing the externality induces firms to make fixed-cost investments in energy-saving capital that reduce marginal variable costs.

10.1093/restud/rdae055.abstractZh: 理论上，基于市场的监管手段能够至少纠正市场失灵。然而，关于其有效性的证据仍然很少。通过行政数据分析，我们发现，欧盟排放交易体系——世界上首个也是规模最大的基于市场的气候政策——平均使受监管的制造企业减少了14-16%的二氧化碳排放，同时并未导致经济活动出现明显的萎缩。我们没有发现企业向无监管企业或市场外包的迹象；相反，这些企业进行了有针对性的投资，降低了生产的排放强度。这些结果表明，欧盟排放交易体系确实促进了全球排放量的减少，这是减缓气候变化的一个必要且充分条件。我们的研究表明，在没有负面经济效应的情况下，可以通过对外部性进行定价来促使企业投资节能资本，从而降低边际可变成本。

abstract.text: Many households hold little wealth. In standard precautionary savings models, these households should not only display higher marginal propensities to consume (MPCs) but also higher future consumption growth. In contrast, we see from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics that such “hand-to-mouth” households do not display higher growth in spending. They also exhibit greater volatility of spending and adjust their spending to a greater extent through the number of categories consumed. Consistent with a role for preference heterogeneity, the panel data show that it is persistent differences across households, not current assets, that predict low consumption growth and other spending differences for the hand-to-mouth households. To identify the extent of preference heterogeneity, we consider the model of Kaplan and Violante with both liquid and illiquid assets, but allow heterogeneity in preferences. To match the data, many poor hand-to-mouth must be relatively impatient and have a high inter-temporal elasticity of substitution. The model shows that preferences predominantly explain the higher MPCs for low-asset households. Preference heterogeneity notably increases the spending impact of fiscal transfers, but only if targeted, while reducing that from interest rate cuts.

10.1093/restud/rdae056.abstractZh: 许多家庭的财富并不丰富。在标准的预防性储蓄模型中，这些家庭不仅应该表现出更高的边际消费倾向，而且未来的消费增长也应该更高。然而，根据收入动态面板研究的结果，我们发现这些“温饱型”家庭并没有表现出更高的消费增长。它们的消费波动性更大，并且通过消费类别的数量来调整自己的支出。与偏好异质性有关，面板数据表明，是家庭之间的持续差异，而不是当前资产，导致了这些家庭低消费增长和其他支出差异。为了识别偏好异质性的程度，我们考虑了Kaplan和Violante的模型，该模型同时考虑了流动资产和流动资产，但允许偏好上的异质性。与数据相匹配的是，许多贫困的温饱型家庭可能相对缺乏耐心，并且具有较高的跨时期替代弹性。该模型表明，偏好主要解释了低资产家庭更高的边际消费倾向。偏好异质性显著增加了财政转移对消费的影响，但前提是这些转移是定向的，而利率下调则不会产生这样的效果。

abstract.text: How does gang competition affect extortion? Using detailed data on individual extortion payments to gangs and sales from a leading wholesale distributor of consumer goods and pharmaceuticals in El Salvador, we document evidence on the determinants of extortion payments and the effects of extortion on firms and consumers. We exploit a 2016 non-aggression pact between gangs to examine how collusion affects extortion in areas where gangs previously competed. While the pact led to a large reduction in competition and violence, we find that it increased the amount paid in extortion by approximately 20%. Much of this increase was passed through to retailers and consumers: retailers experienced an increase in delivery fees, leading to an increase in consumer prices. In particular, we find an increase in prices for pharmaceutical drugs and a corresponding increase in hospital visits for chronic illnesses. The results point to an unintended consequence of policies that reduce competition between criminal organisations.

10.1093/restud/rdae057.abstractZh: 帮派竞争如何影响敲诈勒索？通过详细分析萨尔瓦多一家主要消费品和药品批发分销商向帮派支付的敲诈勒索款项以及其销售额的数据，我们发现了敲诈勒索行为决定因素的证据，以及敲诈勒索对企业和消费者的影响。我们利用2016年帮派之间达成的非敌对协议，研究了在帮派曾经竞争的地区，勾结行为如何影响敲诈勒索行为。虽然该协议大大减少了竞争和暴力行为，但我们发现敲诈勒索的金额增加了约20%。这一增加主要通过零售商和消费者传递：零售商面临更高的配送费用，导致消费者物价上涨。特别是，我们发现药品的价格上涨，以及因慢性病而进行的医院就诊次数增加。这些结果表明，减少犯罪组织之间竞争的政策可能带来了意想不到的后果。

abstract.text: We experimentally study how individuals read strategically transmitted information when they have preferences over what they will learn. Subjects play disclosure games in which Receivers should interpret messages skeptically. We vary whether the state that Senders communicate about is ego-relevant or neutral for Receivers, and whether skeptical beliefs are aligned or not with what Receivers prefer believing. Compared to neutral settings, skepticism is significantly lower when it is self-threatening, and not enhanced when it is self-serving. These results shed light on a new channel that individuals can use to protect their beliefs in communication situations: they exercise skepticism in a motivated way, that is, in a way that depends on the desirability of the conclusions that skeptical inferences lead to. We propose two behavioural models that can generate motivated skepticism. In one model, the Receiver freely manipulates his beliefs after having made skeptical inferences. In the other, the Receiver reasons about evidence in steps and the depth of his reasoning is motivated.

10.1093/restud/rdae058.abstractZh: 我们通过实验研究当个体在获取信息的选择上有偏好时，他们如何策略性地解读传递的信息。实验对象参与了一些披露游戏，在这些游戏中，接收者需要持怀疑态度来解读信息。我们改变了发送者所传达的信息对接收者来说是否具有自我相关性或中立性，以及接收者的怀疑信念是否与他们更愿意相信的内容一致。与中立情境相比，当怀疑态度具有自我威胁性时，其强度显著降低；而当怀疑态度具有自我服务性质时，其强度并未增强。这些结果揭示了个体在沟通情境中保护自身信念的一种新方式：他们以有动机的方式行使怀疑态度，即这种态度取决于怀疑性推断所得出的结论的可取性。我们提出了两种可以解释这种有动机怀疑行为的行为模型。在一个模型中，接收者在做出怀疑性推断后可以自由地调整自己的信念；在另一个模型中，接收者则分步骤地分析证据，并且其推理的深度是受到动机驱动的。

abstract.text: We study mislearning from equilibrium prices, and contrast this with mislearning from exogenous fundamentals. We micro-found mislearning from prices with a psychologically founded theory of “Partial Equilibrium Thinking” (PET), where traders learn fundamental information from prices, but fail to realize others do so too. PET leads to over-reaction, and upward sloping demand curves, thus contributing to more inelastic markets. The degree of individual-level over-reaction and the extent of inelasticity vary with the composition of traders, and with the informativeness of new information. More generally, unlike mislearning from fundamentals, mislearning from prices (i) generates a two-way feedback between prices and beliefs that can provide an arbitrarily large amount of amplification and (ii) can rationalize both over-reaction and more inelastic markets. The two classes of biases are not mutually exclusive. Instead, they interact in very natural ways, and mislearning from prices can vastly amplify mislearning from fundamentals.

10.1093/restud/rdae059.abstractZh: 我们研究了从均衡价格中产生的误学现象，并将其与从外部基本面因素中产生的误学进行了对比。我们通过“部分均衡思维”这一心理学理论，从微观层面分析了从价格中产生的误学现象。根据这一理论，交易者从价格中获取基本信息，但未能意识到其他人也在进行同样的操作。部分均衡思维会导致过度反应，并使得需求曲线呈上升趋势，从而导致市场更加缺乏弹性。个体层面的过度反应程度以及市场的缺乏弹性程度，会随着交易者的构成以及新信息的有用性而变化。更一般地说，与从基本面因素中产生的误学不同，从价格中产生的误学能够产生价格与信念之间的双向反馈，这种反馈可以放大误差，并且能够合理解释过度反应以及市场缺乏弹性的现象。这两类偏差并不是相互排斥的，它们以非常自然的方式相互作用，从价格中产生的误学可以极大地放大从基本面因素中产生的误学。

abstract.text: After a drug obtains marketing authorisation, the usage depends on the regulation of off-label prescriptions for unapproved indications. We investigate the impact of off-label prescription regulation on physicians’ behaviour, patients’ health, treatment costs, and pharmaceutical firms’ pricing with a structural demand and supply model. Exploiting rich panel data on physicians’ activities and office visits in France over 9 years, we use a model of prescription choice and health outcomes with unobserved patient-level heterogeneity. We identify the demand for on-label and off-label drugs and the effect of prescription choice on health outcomes. On the supply side, we use a Nash-in-Nash bargaining model between the government and the pharmaceutical companies that allows the partial identification of the marginal costs of drugs. Counterfactual simulations show that when we remove off-label drugs from the choice set of physicians, substitution to on-label drugs at constant prices would lead to an increase of 15% in the expenditure on prescription drugs. If we allow bargaining adjustment on drug prices under a ban on off-label prescriptions, the ban would further increase the treatment cost, by 26%, without improving health outcomes.

10.1093/restud/rdae060.abstractZh: 在药品获得上市许可后，其使用取决于非标签处方对于未批准适应症的使用情况。我们通过结构性的需求与供应模型，研究非标签处方监管对医生行为、患者健康、治疗成本以及制药公司定价的影响。利用法国医生活动和门诊就诊的丰富面板数据，我们建立了一个处方选择与健康结果的模型，并考虑了未观测到的患者层面异质性。我们确定了对标签药品和非标签药品的需求，以及处方选择对健康结果的影响。在供应方面，我们采用了政府与制药公司之间的纳什-纳什讨价还价模型，该模型能够部分识别药品的边际成本。反事实模拟显示，如果我们将非标签药品从医生的选择范围中移除，那么在固定价格下转向标签药品会导致处方药支出增加15%。如果允许在禁止非标签处方的情况下对药品价格进行讨价还价调整，禁令将使治疗成本进一步增加26%，而健康结果并未得到改善。

abstract.text: Evidence across disciplines suggests that talk therapy is more curative than antidepressants for mild-to-moderate depression and anxiety. Yet, few patients use it. We develop a dynamic choice model to analyse patient demand for the treatment of depression and anxiety. The model incorporates myriad potential impediments to therapy use along with links between mental health improvements and earnings. The estimated model reveals that mental health improvements are valuable, directly through utility and indirectly through earnings. However, patient reluctance to use therapy is nearly impervious to reasonable counterfactual policies (e.g. lowering prices or removing other costs). Patient behaviour might reflect stigma, biases in beliefs about the effectiveness of therapy, or a distaste for discussing personal or painful issues with a stranger. More broadly, the benefits of therapy estimated in randomized trials tell only half the story. If patients do not use treatments outside of an experimental setting—and we fail to understand why or how to get them to—estimated treatment effects cannot be leveraged.

10.1093/restud/rdae061.abstractZh: 不同学科的研究表明，对于轻度至中度抑郁和焦虑，谈话疗法比抗抑郁药更具疗效。然而，很少有患者选择使用谈话疗法。我们开发了一个动态选择模型来分析患者对抑郁和焦虑治疗的意愿。该模型考虑了多种可能影响治疗使用的因素，以及心理健康改善与收入之间的关系。模型分析显示，心理健康改善具有价值，既可以通过效用直接体现，也可以通过收入间接体现。然而，患者不愿使用治疗的现象几乎不受合理的政策干预所影响（例如降低价格或消除其他成本）。患者的行为可能反映了污名化、对治疗有效性的偏见，或是不愿与陌生人讨论个人或痛苦的问题。更广泛地说，随机试验中所估计的治疗益处只是部分情况。如果患者在非实验环境中不使用治疗——而我们无法理解为什么或如何促使他们这样做——那么估计的治疗效果就无法得到充分利用。

abstract.text: Two parties negotiate in the presence of external resolution opportunities (e.g. court, arbitration, or war). The outcome of external resolution depends on the privately held justifiability/strength of their claims. A justified party issues an ultimatum for resolution whenever possible, but an unjustified party strategically bluffs with an ultimatum to establish a reputation for being justified. We show that the availability of external resolution opportunities can benefit or hurt an unjustified party in equilibrium. When the chances of being justified become negligible, agreement is immediate and efficient; and if the set of justifiable demands is rich, our solution modifies the Nash–Rubinstein bargaining solution of Abreu and Gul ((2000), Econometrica, 68, 85–117) in a simple way.

10.1093/restud/rdae062.abstractZh: 两方在外部解决机会存在的情况下进行谈判（例如法院、仲裁或战争）。外部解决的成果取决于双方主张的合理性及强度。有理的一方会在可能的情况下提出最后通牒以寻求解决，而无理的一方则通过提出最后通牒来制造自己有理的声誉。我们表明，外部解决机会的可用性在均衡状态下可能对无理的一方有利或不利。当有理的机会变得微不足道时，达成协议是即时且高效的；如果有理的诉求集合较为丰富，我们的解决方案会以简单的方式修改Abreu和Gul在《Econometrica》2000年第68卷第85-117页论文中的Nash–Rubinstein谈判解决方案。

abstract.text: Inflation expectations are key determinants of economic activity and are central to the current policy debate about whether inflation expectations will remain anchored in the face of recent pandemic-related increases in inflation. This article explores evidence of inattention by constructing two novel and direct measures of consumers’ inattention, and documents greater attention when inflation is high. This relationship can explain a substantial portion of the flattening of the Phillips curve and also suggests the possibility of upward attention-price spirals.

10.1093/restud/rdae063.abstractZh: 通胀预期是经济活动的关键决定因素，也是当前关于通胀预期是否会在近期疫情相关通胀上升的情况下依然稳定的政策讨论的核心。本文通过构建两种新颖且直接的消费者忽视指标，探讨了这种忽视现象的存在，并发现当通胀较高时，消费者的关注程度会更高。这种关系可以解释菲利普斯曲线平坦化的大部分原因，同时也暗示了关注程度可能呈现上升的螺旋趋势。

abstract.text: Job applications have risen over time, yet job-finding rates remain unchanged. Meanwhile, separations have declined. We argue that increased applications raise the probability of a good match rather than the probability of job-finding. Using a search model with multiple applications and costly information, we show that when applications increase, firms invest in identifying good matches, reducing separations. Concurrently, increased congestion and selectivity over which offer to accept temper increases in job-finding rates. Our framework contains testable implications for changes in offers, acceptances, reservation wages, applicants per vacancy, and tenure, objects that enable it to generate the trends in unemployment flows.

10.1093/restud/rdae064.abstractZh: 随着时间的推移，求职申请数量有所增加，但求职成功率却保持不变。与此同时，离职率有所下降。我们认为，申请数量的增加提高了找到合适匹配者的可能性，而不是求职成功率。通过采用包含多次申请和昂贵信息的搜索模型，我们发现，当申请数量增加时，企业会投入更多资源来寻找合适的匹配者，从而减少离职现象。同时，由于竞争加剧和选择性的增加，接受职位的难度增加，从而提升了求职成功率。我们的框架包含了对职位提供、接受率、保留工资、每个职位上的申请者数量以及职位持续时间的可测试性解释，这些解释使得我们能够预测失业流动的趋势。

abstract.text: We show that in a canonical model with heterogeneous entrepreneurs, financial frictions, and an imperfectly elastic supply of capital, a fall in the interest rate has an ambiguous effect on aggregate economic activity. In partial equilibrium, a lower interest rate raises aggregate investment both by relaxing financial constraints and by prompting relatively less productive entrepreneurs to invest. In general equilibrium, however, this higher demand for capital raises its price and crowds out investment by more productive entrepreneurs. When this reallocation is strong enough, a fall in the interest rate reduces aggregate output. A numerical exploration of the model suggests that this reallocation effect is quantitatively significant and—in response to persistent changes in the interest rate—stronger than the traditional balance-sheet channel. We provide evidence of the reallocation effect using U.S. firm-level data.

10.1093/restud/rdae065.abstractZh: 我们指出，在一个具有异质企业家、金融摩擦以及资本供给弹性不足的规范模型中，利率下降对整体经济活动的影响具有双重性。在局部均衡分析中，较低的利率通过缓解金融约束以及促使生产力较低的企业家进行投资，从而提高整体投资水平。然而，在一般均衡分析中，这种对资本的高需求会推高资本价格，从而挤出生产力较高的企业家的投资。当这种重新分配效应足够显著时，利率下降会导致整体产出减少。对模型的数值模拟表明，这种重新分配效应在数量上是显著的，并且——作为对利率持续变化的响应——其效应比传统的资产负债表渠道更为强烈。我们借助美国企业级数据证明了这种重新分配效应的存在。

abstract.text: THANK is a tractable heterogeneous-agent New-Keynesian model that captures analytically core micro-heterogeneity channels of quantitative-HANK: cyclical inequality and risk; self-insurance, precautionary saving, and realistic intertemporal marginal propensities to consume. I use it to elucidate key transmission mechanisms and dynamic properties of HANK models. Countercyclical inequality yields aggregate-demand amplification and makes determinacy with Taylor rules more stringent; but solving the forward guidance puzzle requires procyclical inequality: a Catch-22. Solutions include combining inequality with a distinct risk channel, with compensating cyclicalities; I provide evidence that disposable income inequality was procyclical in the last two, Great and COVID recessions, while risk is countercyclical. Alternative policy rules also solve the Catch-22, e.g. price-level-targeting or, in the model version with liquidity, setting nominal public debt. Optimal policy with heterogeneity features a novel inequality-stabilization motive generating higher inflation volatility—but is unaffected by risk, insofar as the target efficient equilibrium entails no inequality.

10.1093/restud/rdae066.abstractZh: THANK是一个易于处理的异质代理新凯恩斯模型，它能够从分析上捕捉到量化HANK的核心微观异质性渠道：周期性不平等与风险；自我保险、预防性储蓄以及现实的跨期边际消费倾向。我利用该模型来阐明HANK模型的关键传递机制与动态特性。反周期性的不平等会导致总需求放大，并使泰勒规则的决定性更强；但解决前瞻性指导难题则需要顺周期性的不平等——这是一个进退两难的困境。解决方案包括将不平等与独特的风险渠道相结合，通过补偿性周期性特征来实现平衡；我有证据表明，在两次大衰退和COVID疫情期间，可支配收入不平等呈现顺周期性，而风险则呈现反周期性。其他政策规则也能解决这一困境，例如设定价格水平目标，或者在具有流动性的模型版本中设定名义公共债务。具有异质性特征的最优政策具有新颖的不平等稳定动机，这会导致更高的通胀波动性——但只要目标有效均衡不涉及不平等，这种政策就不会受到风险的影响。

abstract.text: An information-based model is developed where traditional and digital advertising finance the provision of free media goods and affect price competition. Digital advertising is directed toward specific consumers while traditional advertising is undirected. The equilibrium is suboptimal. Media goods, if valued by the consumer, are under provided with both types of advertising. Additionally, traditional advertising is excessive because it is undirected. The tax-cum-subsidy policy that overcomes these inefficiencies is characterized. The model is calibrated to the U.S. economy. Through the lens of the calibrated model, digital advertising increases welfare significantly. The welfare gain from the optimal policy is much smaller than the gain from digital advertising.

10.1093/restud/rdae067.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个基于信息的模型，其中传统广告与数字广告共同为免费媒体产品的提供提供资金支持，并影响价格竞争。数字广告针对特定消费者，而传统广告则不具有针对性。该模型的均衡状态并不理想：如果消费者重视媒体产品的价值，那么两种类型的广告都会导致媒体产品的供应不足。此外，传统广告的过度投放也是由于缺乏针对性造成的。文中还提出了一种通过税收补贴政策来克服这些低效问题的方案。该模型已对美国经济进行了校准。通过校准后的模型分析，可以发现数字广告能够显著提升福利水平。然而，从最优政策来看，其带来的福利增益远小于数字广告本身带来的收益。

abstract.text: Recent literature has shown that the fraction of liquidity-constrained households in the population critically determines the mix of transmission channels of monetary policy. In this article, we bring a different but important dimension of heterogeneity to the forefront: stock market participation. We show that the stock market participation rate not only shapes the mix of policy channels but also heavily affects the aggregate responses. This happens as direct rebalancing effects and indirect equilibrium effects into investment are both increasing in the number of stock market participants, reinforcing each other. We show this in a quantitative New Keynesian model designed to account for the population share of stock market participants, their position in the income and wealth distribution, and their saving rates. The model implies that, as stock market participation has increased since the 1980s, the power of monetary policy on the real economy has strengthened considerably.

10.1093/restud/rdae068.abstractZh: 近期的研究表明， liquidity受限的家庭在人口中的比例对货币政策的传导渠道组合起着至关重要的作用。在本文中，我们引入了另一个重要且不同的异质性维度：股市参与率。我们发现，股市参与率不仅决定了政策渠道的组合，还极大地影响了整体反应。这种影响既表现为直接再平衡效应，也表现为间接均衡效应，而这两种效应在股市参与者数量增加的情况下都会增强。我们在一个旨在考虑股市参与者人口比例、他们在收入和财富分配中的地位以及储蓄率的量化新凯恩斯模型中证明了这一点。该模型表明，自20世纪80年代以来，随着股市参与率的上升，货币政策对实际经济的影响显著增强。

abstract.text: Can the judiciary help root out government corruption? This article exploits the random assignment of court cases to justices who exhibit varying degrees of strictness to examine how convicting corrupt officials affects local government outcomes in the Philippines. I document that convictions improve the management of local public finances and reduce associated corruption. An exploration of mechanisms suggests that legal deterrence effects contribute to these findings. The results further indicate that convictions are effective at stifling corruption among bureaucrats, but not politicians. Consistent with this heterogeneity, convictions reduce electoral competition and consequently weaken accountability for incumbent politicians.

10.1093/restud/rdae069.abstractZh: 司法能否帮助根除政府腐败？本文通过随机分配案件给具有不同严格度的法官，来研究定罪腐败官员对菲律宾地方政府结果的影响。研究发现，定罪能够改善地方公共财政管理，并减少相关的腐败行为。对机制的进一步分析表明，法律威慑效应对这一现象起到了推动作用。研究结果还表明，定罪在抑制官僚腐败方面是有效的，但在抑制政客腐败方面则效果不佳。与这种差异性一致的是，定罪减少了选举竞争，从而削弱了现任政客的责任感。

abstract.text: How do people form beliefs about novel risks, with which they have little or no experience? Motivated by survey data on beliefs about COVID we collected in 2020, we build a model based on the psychology of selective memory. When a person thinks about an event, different experiences compete for retrieval, and retrieved experiences are used to simulate the event based on how similar they are to it. The model predicts that different experiences interfere with each other in recall and that non-domain-specific experiences can bias beliefs based on their similarity to the assessed event. We test these predictions using data from our COVID survey and from a primed-recall experiment about cyberattack risk. In line with our theory of similarity-based retrieval and simulation, experiences and their measured similarity to the cued event help account for experience effects, priming effects, and the interaction of the two in shaping beliefs.

10.1093/restud/rdae070.abstractZh: 人们是如何形成对陌生风险的信念的，即使他们几乎没有或完全没有相关经验？基于2020年关于COVID信念的调查数据，我们基于选择性记忆的心理学原理构建了一个模型。当一个人思考某个事件时，不同的经历会相互竞争以被回忆起，而被回忆起的经历会根据其与事件的相似性来模拟该事件。该模型预测，不同的经历在回忆过程中会相互干扰，且非领域特定的经历可能会因其与评估事件的相似性而影响信念的形成。我们通过COVID调查数据以及关于网络攻击风险的 priming 回忆实验来验证这些预测。与我们的基于相似性检索和模拟的理论一致，经历及其与提示事件的测量相似性有助于解释经验效应、 priming 效应以及两者在塑造信念过程中的相互作用。

abstract.text: We analyse the joint life-cycle dynamics of labour market and mental health outcomes while allowing for two-way interactions between work and mental health. We model selection into jobs on a labour market with search frictions, accounting for the level of exposure to stress in each job using data on occupational health contents. Taking our model to British data from Understanding Society combined with information from O*NET, we estimate the impact of job characteristics on health dynamics and the effects of health and job stress contents on career choices. We use our model to quantify the effects of job loss, health shocks, or job stress shocks that propagate over the life cycle through both health and work channels. We also estimate the (large) values workers attach to health, employment, or nonstressful jobs.

10.1093/restud/rdae071.abstractZh: 我们分析了劳动力市场与心理健康结果在生命周期中的共同动态变化，同时考虑了工作与心理健康之间的双向互动。我们在存在搜索摩擦的劳动力市场中对就业选择进行建模，并通过职业健康内容的数据来反映每个工作中所承受的压力水平。我们将模型应用于英国的数据，并结合《社会理解》杂志以及O*NET的信息，来估算工作特征对健康动态的影响，以及健康和工作压力内容对职业选择的影响。我们使用模型来量化工作丧失、健康冲击或工作压力冲击在生命周期中的影响，这些影响通过健康和工作的渠道传递。我们还估算了工人对健康、就业或非压力性工作的重视程度。

abstract.text: I build a macroeconomic model that features chronic excess capacity. Firms can use their capacity to compete for buyers who are not fully attentive to prices. If one firm expands capacity while other firms do not, it “steals” or attracts profitable demand from others. Theoretically, I show that this capacity competition can cause an over-accumulation of capacity. In the presence of chronic excess capacity, capital resources can be slack, and demand shocks can have large effects on output. The model is consistent with stylized facts about capacity utilization and survey evidence from Switzerland. Quantitatively, when the model is estimated to match the U.S. macro data, demand shocks turn out to be the main driving forces of business cycles.

10.1093/restud/rdae072.abstractZh: 我构建了一个宏观经济模型，该模型包含长期过剩产能的现象。企业可以利用其产能来争夺那些对价格并不十分关注的买家。如果某家企业扩大产能而其他企业不这样做，它就会“抢走”或吸引其他企业的盈利性需求。理论上，我证明了这种产能竞争会导致产能的过度积累。在存在长期过剩产能的情况下，资本资源可能会处于闲置状态，而需求冲击会对产出产生巨大影响。该模型与关于产能利用率的定型事实以及来自瑞士的调查数据是一致的。从数量上看，当模型被用来拟合美国宏观经济数据时，需求冲击被证明是商业周期的主要驱动力。

abstract.text: Do judges respond to reversals of their decisions? Using random assignment of cases across two stages of the criminal justice system in Norway and a novel dataset linking trial court decisions to reversals in appeals courts, we provide causal evidence on feedback effects in judicial decision-making. By exploiting differences in the tendencies of randomly assigned appeal panels to reverse trial court decisions, we show that trial court judges who receive a reversal of a sentence respond by updating the likelihood of imposing a prison sentence in the direction of the reversal in future cases. Consistent with a Bayesian learning model, we find that the responses are stronger for judges with weaker priors and for reversals corresponding to stronger signals. Our estimates, however, also indicate that judges overreact to reversals compared to Bayes’ rule.

10.1093/restud/rdae073.abstractZh: 法官是否会对其判决的逆转作出反应？通过随机分配案件到挪威刑事司法系统的两个阶段，并利用一个将初审法院判决与上诉法院逆转判决联系起来的新型数据集，我们提供了关于司法决策中反馈效应的因果证据。通过利用随机分配的上诉小组逆转初审法院判决的倾向差异，我们发现，收到判决逆转的初审法院法官会调整未来案件中判处监禁的可能性，以与逆转判决的方向一致。与贝叶斯学习模型一致，我们发现，对于先验知识较薄弱的法官以及对应于更强信号逆转判决的情况，他们的反应更为强烈。然而，我们的估计也表明，法官对逆转判决的反应比贝叶斯规则所预测的更为强烈。

abstract.text: As utility services expand throughout the developing world, providers must grapple with how to set prices to recover average costs. Data from a multiyear randomised pricing experiment among nearly 1,500 recently connected piped water customers in Vietnam reveal month-to-month demand persistence. Based on structural demand estimation, we document how endogenous preferences, if unaccounted for, can lead to low take-up and thereby threaten the financial viability of the new water utility. We also show that such demand persistence calls for pricing schemes that defer lump-sum payment, effectively allowing future consumers to subsidise their present selves.

10.1093/restud/rdae074.abstractZh: 随着公用事业服务在发展中国家广泛普及，服务提供商必须努力确定定价策略以收回平均成本。一项针对越南近1,500名新接入管道供水客户的多年随机定价实验数据显示，月度需求具有持续性。基于结构性需求估计，我们发现如果忽略内生性偏好因素，可能会导致供水服务的普及率低下，从而威胁到新成立的供水公司的财务可持续性。此外，这种需求持续性要求定价方案能够推迟一次性支付，从而让未来的消费者能够补贴当前的自己。

abstract.text: This paper shows that the outcome of trade wars for tariffs and welfare will be affected by the monetary policy regime. The key message is that trade policy interacts with monetary policy in a way that magnifies the welfare costs of discretionary monetary policy in an international setting. If countries follow monetary policies of flexible inflation targeting, trade wars are relatively mild, with low equilibrium tariffs and small welfare costs. Discretionary monetary policies imply much higher tariffs, high inflation rates, and substantially larger welfare costs. We quantify the effects of a global trade war among major economies using estimates of trade elasticities, economic size, net foreign assets, and trade openness. We find large welfare benefits of an inflation targeting monetary policy for all countries.

10.1093/restud/rdae075.abstractZh: 本文指出，贸易战争对关税和福利的影响会受到货币政策制度的影响。核心观点是，贸易政策与货币政策相互作用，在国际背景下会放大自由裁量性货币政策的福利成本。如果各国采用灵活的通胀目标货币政策，贸易战争就会相对缓和，均衡关税较低，福利成本也较小。而自由裁量性货币政策则会导致更高的关税、更高的通胀率以及更大的福利成本。我们通过贸易弹性、经济规模、净外国资产以及贸易开放度的估计，量化了主要经济体之间全球贸易战争的影响。我们发现，对所有国家而言，通胀目标货币政策能带来巨大的福利收益。

abstract.text: We study behavioural responses to personal wealth taxes in Colombia. We utilise tax microdata from 1993 to 2016 linked with the leaked Panama Papers to investigate offshoring to the country’s key tax havens. We leverage variation from discrete jumps in tax liability and four major reforms to the wealth tax system, including changes in tax rates and duration, using bunching and difference-in-difference techniques. We find compelling evidence that taxpayers instantly reduce the wealth they declare in response to a wealth tax. Moreover, these effects can persist for years even after the wealth tax is no longer in place, providing the first evidence of a hysteresis effect for a temporary tax policy. The response is driven by misreporting items that authorities cannot cross-verify, such as overstating debt and understating non-third-party-reported business assets. Additionally, the wealthiest taxpayers respond to wealth tax increases by hiding assets in hard-to-track entities in tax havens.

10.1093/restud/rdae076.abstractZh: 我们研究了哥伦比亚个人财富税的行为反应。我们利用1993年至2016年的税务微观数据，并结合泄露的巴拿马文件，调查了企业向该国主要避税天堂的转移情况。通过利用税收责任的离散跳跃以及财富税制度的四项重大改革（包括税率和期限的变化），我们运用捆绑分析和差异分解技术进行了研究。我们发现，纳税人会立即减少申报的财富，以应对财富税。此外，即使财富税不再实施，这些效应仍可能持续多年，这首次证明了临时税收政策的滞后效应。这种反应是由错误报告引起的，比如夸大债务或低估非第三方报告的企业资产。此外，最富有的纳税人会通过将资产隐藏在难以追踪的避税天堂实体中来应对财富税的增加。

abstract.text: We study the distributional effects of asset ownership on price informativeness in a general equilibrium model. The model features investors (oligopolists) with different degrees of price impact and abilities to learn about individual asset payoffs from private and price signals, and a competitive fringe that only learns from asset prices. We show that price informativeness is non-monotonic in the oligopolists’ aggregate size, decreasing in the sector’s concentration and in the size of the passive sector. We further show that the size effect can be decomposed into a learning channel capturing investors’ quality of private signals and an information pass-through channel measuring the sensitivity of investors’ trades to private signals, with the latter one being the primary source of variation in price informativeness relative to the size distribution.

10.1093/restud/rdae077.abstractZh: 我们研究资产所有权对价格信息含量的分配效应，模型采用一般均衡框架。模型中投资者（寡头垄断者）具有不同的价格影响程度，并且能够从私人信号和价格信号中了解个别资产收益情况；而竞争边缘群体则仅通过资产价格来获取信息。我们发现，价格信息含量随着寡头垄断者总体规模的增加而减少，且这一减少程度与行业集中度及被动行业的规模有关。进一步分析表明，规模效应可以分解为两个部分：一部分是学习渠道，反映投资者对私人信号的理解能力；另一部分是信息传递渠道，衡量投资者交易对私人信号的敏感性，后者是价格信息含量相对于规模分布变化的主要来源。

abstract.text: Criminal groups govern millions worldwide. Even in strong states, gangs resolve disputes and provide security. Why do these duopolies of coercion emerge? Often, gangs fill vacuums of official power, suggesting that increasing state presence should crowd out criminal governance. We show, however, that state and gang rule can be strategic complements. In particular, gangs could minimize seizures and arrests by keeping neighbourhoods orderly and loyal. If true, increasing state presence could increase incentives for gang rule. In Medellín, Colombia, criminal leaders told us they rule to protect drug rents from police. We test gang responses to state presence using a geographic discontinuity. Internal border changes in 1987 assigned blocks to be closer or further from state security for three decades. Gangs exogenously closer to state presence developed more governance over time. They primarily did so in neighbourhoods with the greatest potential drug rents. This suggests new strategies for countering criminal governance.

10.1093/restud/rdae079.abstractZh: 全球范围内，犯罪团体在治理数百万人口。即便在强大的国家中，犯罪团伙也负责解决纠纷并提供安全保障。这些强制性的双头统治为何会出现？通常，犯罪团伙填补了官方权力的空白，这表明加强国家干预可能会抑制犯罪团体的治理。然而，我们发现国家与犯罪团伙的统治可以构成战略互补。特别是，犯罪团伙通过维持社区的秩序和忠诚度，可以减少逮捕和没收行为。如果这一假设成立，那么增加国家的干预可能会激励犯罪团伙的治理。在哥伦比亚的梅德林，犯罪头目告诉我们，他们通过治理来保护毒品收益，避免被警方打击。我们通过地理不连续性来测试犯罪团伙对国家干预的反应。1987年，内部边界的变化使得某些街区在接下来的三十年里更接近或远离国家安全。那些更接近国家干预的犯罪团伙随着时间的推移发展出了更强的治理能力。他们主要在毒品收益潜力最大的社区中实现了这一点。这为我们提供了应对犯罪团体治理的新策略。

abstract.text: What generates the observed differences in economic outcomes by health? How costly it is to be unhealthy? We show that health dynamics are largely driven by ex-ante fixed heterogeneity, or health types, even when controlling for one’s past health history. In fact, health types are the key driver of long spells of bad health. We incorporate these rich health dynamics in an estimated structural model and show that health types and their correlation with other fixed characteristics are important to account for the observed gap in economic outcomes by health. Monetary and welfare losses due to bad health over the life-cycle are large, concentrated, and to a large extent due to factors pre-determined earlier in life. A large portion of the related monetary costs is due to income losses, especially for people of working age, while a substantial portion of the welfare losses arises because health affects life expectancy.

10.1093/restud/rdae080.abstractZh: 是什么导致了不同健康状况下经济结果的差异？不健康所带来的成本究竟有多高？我们发现，即使控制了个人的过去健康状况，健康状况的演变仍然主要由事前固定的异质性或健康类型所驱动。实际上，健康类型是长期健康状况不佳的关键因素。我们将这些丰富的健康动态纳入一个结构模型中，并发现健康类型及其与其他固定特征之间的关联对于解释不同健康状况下经济结果的差异至关重要。由于健康状况不佳而在整个生命周期中产生的货币和福利损失是巨大的，且这些损失在很大程度上是由生命早期就已确定的因素所决定的。相关货币成本的大部分是由于收入损失，尤其是对于工作年龄的人群而言；而福利损失则主要是因为健康状况影响了预期寿命。

abstract.text: For an incompatible patient–donor pair, kidney exchanges often forbid receipt-before-donation (the patient receives a kidney before the donor donates) and donation-before-receipt, causing a double-coincidence-of-wants problem. We study an algorithm, the Unpaired kidney exchange algorithm, which eliminates this problem. In a dynamic matching model, we show that the waiting time of patients under Unpaired is close to optimal and substantially shorter than under widely used algorithms. Using a rich administrative dataset from France, we show that Unpaired achieves a match rate of 63% and an average waiting time of 176 days for transplanted patients. The (infeasible) optimal algorithm is only slightly better (64% and 144 days); widely used algorithms deliver less than 40% match rate and at least 232 days waiting times. We discuss a range of solutions that can address the potential practical incentive challenges of Unpaired. In particular, we extend our analysis to an environment where a deceased donor waitlist can be integrated to improve the performance of algorithms. We show that our theoretical and empirical comparisons continue to hold. Finally, based on these analyses, we propose a practical version of the Unpaired algorithm.

10.1093/restud/rdae081.abstractZh: 对于不兼容的患者-捐赠者配对，肾脏交换通常禁止在捐赠者捐赠之前接收肾脏，以及在接收肾脏之前进行捐赠，这导致了双重需求巧合的问题。我们研究了一种算法——非配对肾脏交换算法，该算法可以解决这一问题。在动态匹配模型中，我们证明非配对算法的等待时间接近最优，且明显短于广泛使用的算法。利用来自法国的丰富行政数据集，我们发现非配对算法实现了63%的匹配率，以及移植患者平均176天的等待时间。而不可行的优化算法仅略好一些（匹配率为64%，等待时间为144天）；广泛使用的算法则实现了低于40%的匹配率，以及至少232天的等待时间。我们讨论了一系列解决方案，以应对非配对算法可能面临的实际激励挑战。特别是，我们将分析扩展到可以整合已故捐赠者等待名单的环境中，以提高算法的性能。我们证明，我们的理论和实证比较仍然成立。最后，基于这些分析，我们提出了一种实用的非配对算法版本。

abstract.text: In a broad class of sticky-price models, the non-neutrality of nominal shocks is captured by a simple sufficient statistic: the ratio of the kurtosis of the price change distribution over the frequency of price changes. We test the sufficient statistic proposition using data for a large sample of products representative of the French economy. We first extend the theory to allow for empirically relevant monetary shocks with a transitory predictable component. We then use the microdata to measure kurtosis and frequency for about 120 producer price indices industries and 220 consumer price indices categories. We use a Factor-Augmented Vector Autoregressive (FAVAR) model to measure the industries’ response to monetary shocks, under alternative identification schemes. The estimated degree of non-neutrality correlates with the kurtosis and the frequency consistently with the predictions of the theory. Several robustness checks are discussed.

10.1093/restud/rdae082.abstractZh: 在一系列粘性价格模型中，名义冲击的非中性性可以通过一个简单的充分统计量来体现：价格变化分布的峰度与价格变化频率的比率。我们使用代表法国经济的大量产品数据来检验这一充分统计量命题。我们首先将理论扩展至允许具有短暂且可预测成分的货币冲击。然后，我们使用微观数据来衡量约120个生产者价格指数行业和220个消费者价格指数类别的峰度与频率。我们使用因子增强向量自回归模型来测量各行业对货币冲击的响应，并采用不同的识别方案进行分析。估计出的非中性程度与峰度和频率呈一致相关性，这与理论预测相符。文中还讨论了几种稳健性检验。

abstract.text: In this paper, we study the effects of economic integration with democratic partners on democracy. We assemble a large country-level panel dataset from 1960 to 2015, and exploit improvements in air, relative to sea, transportation to derive a time-varying instrument for economic integration. We find that economic integration with democracies increases countries’ democracy scores, whereas the impact of economic integration with non-democracies is muted. Results are stronger when democratic partners have a longer history of democracy, grow faster, spend more on public goods, are culturally closer, and export higher quality goods. The effects we document are driven by imports, rather than exports, and by integration with democratic partners that account for a larger share of a country’s trade in institutionally intensive, cultural, and consumer goods, as well as in goods that involve more face-to-face interactions and entail higher levels of bilateral trust. These patterns are consistent with economic integration favouring the transmission of democracy by signalling the (actual or perceived) desirability of democratic institutions. Alternative mechanisms—including human capital accumulation and economic growth—cannot, alone, explain our findings.

10.1093/restud/rdae083.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了经济整合与民主伙伴之间的互动对民主的影响。我们收集了1960至2015年间的大型国家级面板数据集，并利用与海上运输相比的空中运输的改进作为经济整合的时变指标。研究发现，与民主国家进行经济整合能够提升国家的民主指数，而与非民主国家进行经济整合的影响则较为微弱。当民主伙伴拥有更长的民主历史、经济增长更快、在公共产品上的支出更多、文化上更为接近，以及出口更高品质的商品时，这些结果更为显著。我们观察到的影响是由进口而非出口驱动的，并且与那些在制度密集型、文化及消费品贸易中占据更大比例的民主伙伴进行整合更为相关，这些商品还涉及更多的面对面互动，并需要更高水平的双边信任。这些模式与经济整合促进民主传播的观点一致，因为它们表明了民主制度的实际或感知的吸引力。其他机制——包括人力资本积累和经济增长——单独无法解释我们的研究结果。

abstract.text: This article studies the origins and function of customs and norms that intend to keep women from being promiscuous. Using large-scale survey data from more than 100 countries, I test the anthropological theory that a particular form of pre-industrial subsistence—pastoralism—favoured the adoption of such customs and norms. Pastoralism was characterized by frequent and often extended periods of male absence from the settlement, implying difficulties in monitoring women’s behaviour and larger incentives to imposing restrictions on women’s promiscuity. The article shows that women from historically more pastoral societies (i) are subject to stronger anti-abortion attitudes; (ii) are more likely to have undergone infibulation, the most invasive form of female genital cutting; (iii) are more restricted in their freedom of mobility; and (iv) adhere to more restrictive norms about women’s promiscuity. At the historical society level, pastoralism predicts patrilocality, the custom of living close to the husband’s family after marriage, allowing them to monitor the bride. Instrumental variable estimations that make use of the ecological determinants of pastoralism support a causal interpretation of the results. I also provide evidence that the mechanism behind these patterns is male absence, rather than male dominance, per se, or historical economic development.

10.1093/restud/rdae084.abstractZh: 本文研究了旨在防止女性滥交的习俗和规范的起源与功能。通过来自100多个国家的大规模调查数据，我验证了人类学理论中的观点：一种特定的前工业时期生计方式——游牧生活——促进了此类习俗和规范的采纳。游牧生活的特点是男性经常长时间离开定居点，这导致了对女性行为的监控难度增加，从而更有动力对女性的滥交行为实施限制。研究表明，历史上以游牧生活为特征的社会的女性：(i) 持有更强化的反堕胎态度；(ii) 更有可能经历过割礼，这是最侵入性的女性生殖器切割形式；(iii) 在行动自由方面受到更多限制；(iv) 对女性滥交的规范更为严格。从历史社会层面来看，游牧生活与父系居住习俗相关，即婚后居住在丈夫家庭附近，以便对新娘进行监控。利用游牧生活的生态决定因素进行的工具变量估计支持了这些结果的因果解释。我还提供了证据，表明这些模式背后的机制是男性缺席，而非男性主导或历史经济发展本身。

abstract.text: In Spring 2005, the Ombud for Equal Treatment in Austria launched a campaign notifying employers and newspapers that gender preferences in job ads were illegal. At the time, over 40% of vacancies on the nation’s largest job board stated a gender preference; within a year the rate fell below 5%. We merge job board vacancies and employer records to study how the campaign affected hiring choices and the gender diversity of occupations and workplaces. Using pre-campaign data, we predict the use of gender preferences, then conduct a difference-in-differences analysis of hiring outcomes for vacancies with predicted male or female preferences, relative to those with no predicted preferences. The elimination of explicit gender preferences boosted the share of women hired for jobs that were likely to be targeted to men (and vice versa). At the firm level, we find that the campaign led to a rise in the share of women at firms that were more likely to use male stated gender preferences (SGP’s), and a symmetric increase in the share of men at firms that were likely to use female SGP’s, with no effects on firm survival, employment, or average wages.

10.1093/restud/rdae085.abstractZh: 2005年春季，奥地利平等待遇监察署发起了一项活动，向雇主和报纸通报在招聘广告中性别偏好是违法的。当时，全国最大招聘网站上有超过40%的职位声明存在性别偏好；一年后，这一比例降至5%以下。我们通过合并招聘网站上的职位信息和雇主记录，研究该活动对招聘决策以及职业和工作场所的性别多样性产生了什么影响。利用活动前的数据，我们预测了性别偏好的使用情况，然后对具有预测性男性或女性偏好职位的招聘结果进行了差异比较分析，与没有预测性偏好的职位进行了对比。结果显示，明确禁止性别偏好后，女性被聘用的职位中，那些可能被男性选择的职位比例有所上升（反之亦然）。在企业层面，我们发现该活动导致那些更可能使用男性性别偏好声明的企业的女性员工比例增加，而那些更可能使用女性性别偏好声明的企业的男性员工比例也出现对称性的增加，但并未对企业的生存、就业或平均工资产生任何影响。

abstract.text: We use natural experiments embedded in state-run lotteries and a new nationally representative survey to provide reduced-form and structural estimates of risk preferences and behavioural biases in lottery demand, and to explore the implications for optimal lottery design. We find that sales respond more to the expected value of the jackpot than to price but are unresponsive to variation in the second prize—a pattern that is consistent with probability weighting but is inconsistent with standard parameterizations. In the survey, we find that lottery spending decreases modestly with income and is strongly associated with measures of innumeracy, poor statistical reasoning, and other proxies for behavioural bias, which also decline with income. Regression predictions suggest that Americans would spend 43% less on lotteries if they were unbiased, while the remaining lottery demand is due to other factors such as anticipatory utility or entertainment value. We use these empirical moments to estimate a model of socially optimal lottery design. In the model, current multi-state lottery designs increase welfare but may harm heavy spenders.

10.1093/restud/rdae086.abstractZh: 我们利用嵌入在国有彩票中的自然实验以及一项新的全国代表性调查，来提供彩票需求风险偏好和行为偏差的简化形式和结构估计，并探讨其对最优彩票设计的影响。我们发现，彩票销售对头奖预期价值的反应比对价格的反应更为敏感，但对二等奖奖金的变化反应不大——这一模式与概率加权理论一致，但与标准参数化方法不一致。在调查中，我们发现彩票支出随收入增加而适度减少，并且与愚昧程度、统计推理能力不足以及其他行为偏差指标密切相关，这些指标也随收入增加而下降。回归预测表明，如果彩票没有偏差，美国人将在彩票上的支出减少43%，而剩余的彩票需求则是由其他因素引起的，如预期效用或娱乐价值。我们利用这些实证数据来估计一个社会最优彩票设计模型。在该模型中，当前的多州彩票设计能够提升福利，但可能会损害那些大量消费彩票的人的利益。

abstract.text: We present a model of digital advertising with three key features: (1) advertisers can reach consumers on and off a platform, (2) additional data enhances the value of advertiser–consumer matches, and (3) the allocation of advertisements follows an auction-like mechanism. We contrast data-augmented auctions, which leverage the platform’s data advantage to improve match quality, with managed-campaign mechanisms that automate match formation and price-setting. The platform-optimal mechanism is a managed campaign that conditions the on-platform prices for sponsored products on the off-platform prices set by all advertisers. This mechanism yields the efficient on-platform allocation but inefficiently high off-platform product prices. It attains the vertical integration profit for the platform and the advertisers, and it increases off-platform product prices while decreasing consumer surplus, relative to data-augmented auctions.

10.1093/restud/rdae087.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个数字广告模型，该模型具有三个关键特征：(1)广告商可以在平台上及平台外接触消费者；(2)额外数据提升了广告商与消费者匹配的价值；(3)广告的分配遵循类似拍卖的机制。我们将数据增强型拍卖与管理型广告机制进行了对比，前者利用平台的数据优势来提高匹配质量，而管理型广告机制则自动化了匹配形成和定价过程。平台最优机制是一种管理型广告机制，它将平台上赞助产品的价格与所有广告商在平台外设定的价格挂钩。这种机制能够实现平台上广告的有效分配，但平台外产品的价格却过高。这种机制为平台和广告商带来了垂直整合的利润，同时提高了平台外产品的价格，却减少了消费者的剩余，相比数据增强型拍卖，效果较差。

abstract.text: Social interactions determine many economic behaviours, but information on social ties does not exist in most publicly available and widely used datasets. We present results on the identification of social networks from observational panel data that contains no information on social ties between agents. In the context of a canonical social interactions model, we provide sufficient conditions under which the social interactions matrix, endogenous and exogenous social effect parameters are globally identified if networks are constant over time. We also provide an extension of the method for time-varying networks. We then describe how high-dimensional estimation techniques can be used to estimate the interactions model based on the adaptive elastic net Generalized Method of Moments. We employ the method to study tax competition across U.S. states. The identified social interactions matrix implies that tax competition differs markedly from the common assumption of competition between geographically neighbouring states, providing further insights into the long-standing debate on the relative roles of factor mobility and yardstick competition in driving tax setting behaviour across states. Most broadly, our identification and application show that the analysis of social interactions can be extended to economic realms where no network data exist.

10.1093/restud/rdae088.abstractZh: 社会互动决定了许多经济行为，但大多数公开可用且被广泛使用的数据集中并未包含关于社会联系的信息。我们展示了如何利用观测性面板数据来识别社会网络的方法，这些数据中并未包含关于个体之间社会联系的信息。在一个典型的社会互动模型的背景下，我们提出了充分条件，使得如果网络随时间保持不变，那么社会互动矩阵、内生和 exogenous 社会效应参数可以被全局识别。我们还为时变网络扩展了该方法。接着，我们描述了如何利用高维估计技术，基于自适应弹性网络广义矩方法来估计互动模型。我们运用该方法研究了美国各州之间的税收竞争。所识别的社会互动矩阵表明，税收竞争与通常认为的地理邻近州之间的竞争有所不同，这为长期存在的关于因素流动性和标准竞争在驱动各州税收行为中的相对作用的问题提供了进一步的见解。最广泛地说，我们的识别和应用表明，社会互动的分析可以扩展到没有网络数据的经济领域。

abstract.text: We establish that macroprudential controls limiting capital flows can curb risks arising from foreign currency borrowing by corporates in emerging markets. Firm-level data show that Indian firms tend to issue more foreign currency debt when the interest rate differential between India and the U.S. is higher. This “carry trade” relationship, however, breaks down once regulators institute more stringent interest rate caps on borrowing; in response, riskier borrowers cut issuance most. Prior to adoption of this macroprudential measure, stock price exposure of issuers to currency risk rises after issuance, as witnessed during the “taper tantrum” episode of 2013; this source of vulnerability is nullified by the measure, as confirmed during the October 2018 oil price shock and the COVID-19 outbreak. We find no evidence of the policy’s efficacy being undermined by leakage or regulatory arbitrage.

10.1093/restud/rdae089.abstractZh: 我们证实，限制资本流动的宏观审慎控制措施能够抑制新兴市场中企业因外币借款而面临的风险。企业层面的数据显示，当印度与美国之间的利率差异较大时，印度企业更倾向于发行外币债务。然而，一旦监管机构对借款实施更严格的利率上限，这种“套利交易”关系就会瓦解；作为回应，风险较高的借款者会减少发行。在采取这一宏观审慎措施之前，发行者在发行后面临货币风险，正如2013年“缩表恐慌”期间所观察到的那样；这一脆弱性在2018年10月石油价格冲击和COVID-19疫情期间得到了缓解。我们没有发现该政策的有效性因泄漏或监管套利而受到破坏的证据。

abstract.text: We study how firms target and influence expert intermediaries. In our context, pharmaceutical manufacturers provide payments to physicians during promotional interactions. We develop an identification strategy based on plausibly exogenous variation in payments driven by differential exposure to spillovers from AMC CoI policies. Using a case study of an important class of cardiovascular drugs, we estimate heterogeneous effects of payments on prescribing, with firms targeting highly responsive physicians. We also develop a model of supply and demand, which allows us to quantify how oligopoly prices reduce drug prescribing, and how payments move prescribing closer to the optimal level, but at great financial cost. In our estimated model, whether consumers are harmed by payments depends on whether there is substantial under-prescribing due to behavioural or other frictions. In a final exercise, we calibrate such frictions using clinical data and estimate that payments benefit consumers in this case study.

10.1093/restud/rdae090.abstractZh: 我们研究了企业如何针对并影响专家中间商。在我们的研究背景下，制药公司在推广活动中向医生支付报酬。我们提出了一种识别策略，该策略基于由不同溢出效应导致的支付差异，这些溢出效应来自AMC CoI政策。通过一项关于重要心血管药物类别的案例研究，我们估计了支付对处方行为的异质效应，企业主要针对反应迅速的医生。我们还建立了一个供需模型，该模型使我们能够量化寡头垄断价格如何降低药物处方量，以及支付如何使处方量接近最优水平，但会带来巨大的财务成本。在我们的估计模型中，消费者是否因支付而受损取决于是否存在由于行为或其他因素导致的过度处方现象。在最后的练习中，我们使用临床数据来校准这些因素，并估计在这种情况下支付确实对消费者有益。

abstract.text: We construct a novel panel dataset for interwar Soviet Union to study the causes of Ukrainian famine mortality (Holodomor) during 1932–3 and document several facts: (1) Ukraine produced enough food in 1932 to avoid famine in Ukraine; (2) 1933 mortality in the Soviet Union was increasing in the pre-famine ethnic Ukrainian population share and (3) was unrelated to food productivity across regions; (4) this pattern exists even outside of Ukraine; (5) migration restrictions exacerbated mortality; (6) actual and planned grain procurement were increasing and actual and planned grain retention (production minus procurement) were decreasing in the ethnic Ukrainian population share across regions. The results imply that anti-Ukrainian bias in Soviet policy contributed to high Ukrainian famine mortality, and that this bias systematically targeted ethnic Ukrainians across the Soviet Union.

10.1093/restud/rdae091.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个新型面板数据集，用于研究苏联两次世界大战期间1932-1933年乌克兰饥荒死亡事件的原因，并记录了以下几个事实：(1) 1932年乌克兰生产的粮食足以避免乌克兰地区的饥荒；(2) 1933年苏联的死亡率在乌克兰族人口比例较高的地区有所上升；(3) 这一趋势与各地区粮食产量无关；(4) 这种模式在乌克兰以外地区也存在；(5) 移民限制加剧了死亡率；(6) 乌克兰族人口比例较高的地区，实际和计划中的粮食采购量都在增加，而实际和计划中的粮食储存量（产量减去采购量）却在减少。研究结果表明，苏联政策中的反乌克兰偏见导致了乌克兰地区的高死亡率，并且这种偏见系统性地针对了苏联各地的乌克兰族人群。

abstract.text: What sows the seeds of financial crises, and what policies can help avoid them?
