Using Peruvian data, we find that wage-setting power increases with employer concentration but less so where self-employment is more prevalent. A general equilibrium model shows that in oligopsonistic labor markets, self-employment raises the supply elasticity of wage labor, weakening employer market power. However, by the same mechanism, procompetitive policies aimed at expanding wage employment and reducing reliance on self-employment may unintentionally strengthen labor market power, undermining their objectives. (JEL J22, J23, J31, J42, L13, O14, O15)

10.1257/aer.20230490.abstractZh: 本文指出，在低收入国家，个体经营方式会影响劳动力市场的力量，这对工业发展具有影响。通过秘鲁的数据分析，我们发现，随着雇主集中度的增加，工资设定权会增强，但在个体经营较为普遍的情况下，这种增强程度较小。一个一般均衡模型表明，在寡头买方垄断的劳动力市场中，个体经营会提高工资劳动的供给弹性，从而削弱雇主的市场力量。然而，通过同样的机制，旨在扩大工资就业并减少对个体经营的依赖的亲竞争政策，可能会无意中增强劳动力市场的力量，从而破坏这些政策的目标。(JEL J22, J23, J31, J42, L13, O14, O15)

abstract.text: Should central banks’ inflation targets remain set in stone? We study a dynamic mechanism design problem between a government and a central bank. The central bank has persistent private information about structural shocks. Firms learn the state from the central bank’s reports and form inflation expectations. A dynamic inflation target implements the full-information commitment allocation. The central bank is delegated the authority to adjust the target’s level and flexibility one period in advance. A declining natural interest rate and a flattening Phillips curve imply opposite optimal target adjustments. Our results speak to practical policy questions of inflation target design. (JEL D82, E12, E31, E52, E58)

10.1257/aer.20230496.abstractZh: 中央银行的通胀目标是否应保持不变？我们研究了一个政府与中央银行之间的动态机制设计问题。中央银行拥有关于结构性冲击的持久私人信息。企业通过央行的报告了解经济状况并形成通胀预期。动态通胀目标实现了完全信息承诺的分配。中央银行被授权提前一个时期调整目标水平和灵活性。自然利率的下降和菲利普斯曲线的平坦化意味着最优目标调整的相反方向。我们的研究结果对通胀目标设计的实际政策问题具有启示意义。（JEL D82, E12, E31, E52, E58）

abstract.text: This paper explores global perceptions and understanding of climate change and policies, examining factors that influence support for climate action and the impact of different types of information. We conduct large-scale surveys with 40,000 respondents from 20 countries, providing new international data on attitudes toward climate change and respondents’ socioeconomic backgrounds and lifestyles. We identify three key perceptions affecting policy support: perceived effectiveness of policies in reducing emissions, their impact on low-income households, and their effect on respondents’ households (self-interest). Educational videos clarifying policy mechanisms increase support for climate policies; those merely highlighting climate change’s impacts do not. (JEL C83, D83, D91, Q54, Q58)

10.1257/aer.20230501.abstractZh: 本文探讨了全球对气候变化及其政策的认知与理解，研究了影响气候行动支持的因素以及不同类型信息的影响。我们进行了大规模调查，涉及20个国家的40,000名受访者，获得了关于气候变化态度、受访者社会经济背景和生活方式的新国际数据。我们发现，影响政策支持的三个关键认知因素包括：政策在减少排放方面的有效性、政策对低收入家庭的影响，以及政策对受访者家庭的影响（自身利益）。能够阐明政策机制的教育视频会增加对气候政策的支持；而仅仅强调气候变化影响的视频则不会。 (JEL C83, D83, D91, Q54, Q58)

abstract.text: The conventional wisdom in finance is that competition is fierce among investors: if a group changes its behavior, others adjust their strategies such that nothing happens to prices. We estimate a demand system with flexible strategic responses for institutional investors in the US stock market. When less aggressive traders surround an investor, she adjusts by trading more aggressively. However, this strategic reaction only counteracts two-thirds of the impact of the initial change in behavior. In light of these estimates, the rise in passive investing over the last 20 years has made the demand for individual stocks 11 percent more inelastic. (JEL G11, G14, G23, G41)

10.1257/aer.20230505.abstractZh: 金融领域的传统观点认为，投资者之间的竞争非常激烈：如果一个群体改变其行为，其他投资者会调整自己的策略，以使价格保持不变。我们模拟了一个具有灵活战略响应的需求系统，用于分析美国股市中的机构投资者。当较不激进的交易者围绕某个投资者时，该投资者会通过更激进的交易行为来应对。然而，这种战略反应只能抵消最初行为变化影响的三分之二。根据这些估计，过去20年被动投资的增加使得对个股的需求变得更加无弹性，增加了11%。（JEL G11, G14, G23, G41）

abstract.text: We study how couples allocate retirement-saving contributions across each spouse’s account. In a new dataset covering over a million US individuals, we find retirement contributions are not allocated to the account with the highest employer match rate. This lack of coordination—which goes against the assumptions of most models of household decision-making—is common, costly, persistent over time, and cannot be explained by inertia, auto-enrollment, or simple heuristics. Complementing the administrative evidence with an online survey, we find that inefficient allocations reflect both financial mistakes as well as deliberate choices, especially when trust and commitment inside the households are weak. (JEL D13, G51, J26, J32)

10.1257/aer.20230524.abstractZh: 我们研究了夫妻如何分配退休储蓄资金到各自配偶的账户中。在一个涵盖超过一百万美国个体的新数据集中，我们发现退休储蓄资金并未分配到雇主匹配率最高的账户中。这种缺乏协调的现象——与大多数家庭决策模型的假设相悖——非常普遍、成本高昂且持续时间较长，无法用惯性、自动注册或简单的启发式方法来解释。通过结合行政数据以及在线调查的结果，我们发现这种低效的分配既反映了财务上的错误，也反映了有意为之的选择，尤其是在家庭内部的信任和承诺较弱的情况下。（JEL D13, G51, J26, J32）

abstract.text: High school students from non-elite backgrounds are less likely to have peers with elite-educated parents than their elite counterparts. This difference in social capital is a key driver of the high intergenerational persistence in elite education. We identify a positive elite peer effect on enrollment in elite programs and labor market earnings, then disentangle underlying mechanisms. Exploiting a lottery in assessment, a causal mediation analysis shows the overall positive peer effect reflects a positive effect on application behavior (conditional on GPA). When considering income mobility, we find that further mixing between high school elite and non-elite students could improve mobility. (JEL D31, I21, I23, I24, J31, J62, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20230582.abstractZh: 来自非精英背景的高中学生，与精英背景的学生相比，拥有精英教育背景的同伴的可能性较低。这种社会资本的差异是精英教育代际持续性的重要因素。我们发现，精英同伴对进入精英项目和劳动力市场收入有积极影响，并探讨了其背后的机制。通过评估中的抽奖机制，因果中介分析表明，整体上的正面同伴效应实际上反映了对申请行为的积极影响（前提是成绩达标）。在考虑收入流动性时，我们发现，高中精英与非精英学生之间的进一步融合可能会提升收入流动性。（JEL D31, I21, I23, I24, J31, J62, Z13）

abstract.text: This paper studies how a large increase in the price level is transmitted to the real economy through firm balance sheets. Using newly digitized macro- and micro-level data from the German inflation of 1919–1923, we show inflation led to a large reduction in real debt burdens and bankruptcies. Firms with higher nominal liabilities at the onset of inflation experienced a larger decline in interest expenses, a relative increase in their equity values, and higher employment during the inflation. The results are consistent with real effects of a debt-inflation channel that operates even when prices and wages are flexible. (JEL D22, E23, E31, G32, N14, N24)

10.1257/aer.20230685.abstractZh: 本文研究了价格水平的大幅上升如何通过企业资产负债表传递至实体经济。利用1919-1923年德国通货膨胀期间新数字化处理的宏观与微观数据，我们发现通货膨胀导致实际债务负担和破产率大幅下降。在通货膨胀初期拥有较高名义负债的企业，其利息支出减少幅度更大，股权价值相对增加，就业率也更高。这些结果与债务-通货膨胀渠道的实际效应一致，即使价格和工资具有弹性，这一渠道依然发挥作用。（JEL D22, E23, E31, G32, N14, N24）

abstract.text: The US net foreign asset position declined sharply after 2007, reaching negative 60 percent of GDP by the third quarter of 2023. This deterioration primarily reflects a US-specific rise in corporate asset values that inflated the value of US equity liabilities to the rest of the world. To interpret these trends, we develop an international macrofinance model of flows, stocks, asset valuations, the current account, and the net foreign asset position. We find that the welfare impact of rising asset values for a representative US household has been quite negative given extensive foreign ownership of US corporate equity. (JEL F32, F21, F40, G15)

10.1257/aer.20230732.abstractZh: 自2007年以来，美国的净对外资产头寸急剧下降，到2023年第三季度，这一数字达到了GDP的负60%。这种恶化主要反映了美国企业资产价值的上升，这导致美国股权负债的价值相对于世界其他地区而言被高估。为了解释这些趋势，我们开发了一个国际宏观金融模型，涵盖了资金流动、资产估值、经常账户以及净对外资产头寸等方面。我们发现，鉴于美国企业股权大量由外国人持有，资产价值上升对美国代表性家庭的福利影响相当负面。（JEL F32, F21, F40, G15）

abstract.text: Using field and laboratory experiments, we demonstrate that the complexity of incentive schemes and worker bounded rationality can affect effort provision. This is because some attributes of the incentives become opaque; that is, workers do not take them into account. In our setting, workers overprovide effort relative to a fully rational benchmark, improving efficiency. We identify contract features, and facets of worker cognitive ability, that matter for opacity. We find that even relatively small degrees of opacity can cause large shifts in behavior. Our results illustrate important implications of complexity and bounded rationality for designing and regulating workplace incentive contracts. (JEL C90, D21, D91, J22, J31, J41)

10.1257/aer.20230751.abstractZh: 通过实地和实验室实验，我们证明了激励方案的复杂性和工人的有限理性会影响努力的提供。这是因为激励方案的某些属性变得不透明，即工人并未将其考虑在内。在我们的研究中，与完全理性的基准相比，工人会过度付出努力，从而提高效率。我们识别出与不透明性相关的合同特征以及工人认知能力的相关因素。我们发现，即使是不太明显的不透明性，也可能导致行为的显著变化。我们的研究结果揭示了复杂性和有限理性对设计和规范工作场所激励合同的重要影响。（JEL C90, D21, D91, J22, J31, J41）

abstract.text: Social movements are catalysts for crucial institutional changes. To succeed, they must coordinate members’ views (consensus building) and actions (mobilization). We study union leaders within Myanmar’s burgeoning labor movement. Union leaders are positively selected on both ability and personality traits that enable them to influence others, yet they earn lower wages. In group discussions about workers’ views on an upcoming national minimum wage negotiation, randomly embedded leaders build consensus around the union’s preferred policy. In an experiment that mimics individual decision-making in a collective action setup, leaders increase mobilization through coordination. (JEL D91, J38, J51, O15)

10.1257/aer.20230758.abstractZh: 社会运动是推动重要制度变革的催化剂。为了取得成功，它们必须协调成员的观点（建立共识）和行动（动员力量）。我们研究了缅甸新兴劳工运动中的工会领袖。工会领袖在能力和人格特质方面都表现出积极的表现，这些特质使他们能够影响他人，然而他们的工资却较低。在关于工人对即将到来的国家最低工资谈判看法的小组讨论中，随机选出的领袖们能够围绕工会所期望的政策达成共识。在一个模拟个体决策在集体行动中的实验研究中，领袖们通过协调作用提升了动员能力。（JEL D91, J38, J51, O15）

abstract.text: We develop a framework to estimate the marginal cost of air pollution regulation and apply it to assess policy efficiency. We exploit a provision of the Clean Air Act that requires new plants to pay incumbent facilities to reduce emissions. This “offset” policy creates hundreds of local pollution markets, differing by pollutant and location. Theory and transaction data suggest that offset prices reveal marginal abatement costs. We compare these prices to marginal benefits of pollution reduction estimated using leading air quality models and find that, on average, marginal benefits exceed marginal costs by more than a factor of ten. (JEL D61, H23, K32, Q52, Q53, Q58)

10.1257/aer.20230761.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个框架，用于估算空气污染监管的边际成本，并将其应用于评估政策效率。我们利用了《清洁空气法》中的一项规定，即新建工厂需要向现有设施支付费用以要求其减少排放。这种“抵消”政策催生了数百个地方污染市场，这些市场在污染物和地理位置上各不相同。理论和交易数据表明，抵消价格能够反映边际减排成本。我们将这些价格与使用主流空气质量模型估算的污染减排边际收益进行比较，发现平均而言，边际收益超过边际成本十倍以上。（JEL D61, H23, K32, Q52, Q53, Q58）

abstract.text: Children spend years in foster care, and bureaucratic hurdles can unnecessarily prolong their stays. The Mi Abogado program was introduced in Chile to enhance legal aid for foster children and accelerate family reunification. In a novel approach, the Chilean government randomized the introduction of the program for children living in institutions to evaluate effects on child well-being. Using registry data, we find the program significantly reduced the duration of foster care without increasing subsequent maltreatment and placements. The exposure also decreased criminal justice involvement and improved school attendance. Results suggest that strengthening foster care services can cost-effectively improve child well-being. (JEL I21, I31, J13, K36, O15, O17)

10.1257/aer.20230947.abstractZh: 儿童在寄养环境中度过多年时间，而官僚程序可能会不必要地延长他们的寄养时间。智利引入了“Mi Abogado”计划，旨在为寄养儿童提供更好的法律援助，并加速家庭团聚。智利政府采用了一种新颖的方法，对居住在寄养机构的儿童随机实施该计划，以评估其对儿童福祉的影响。通过登记数据我们发现，该计划显著缩短了寄养时间，同时并未增加后续虐待和重新安置的情况。此外，该计划还减少了儿童在刑事司法系统中的干预次数，并提高了他们的出勤率。结果表明，加强寄养服务可以以较低的成本改善儿童福祉。（JEL I21, I31, J13, K36, O15, O17）

abstract.text: School districts historically approached conflict resolution from the perspective that suspending disruptive students was necessary to protect their classmates, even if this caused harm to perceived offenders. Restorative practices (RP)—focusing on reparation, accountability, and shared ownership of disciplinary justice—are designed to address undesirable behavior without harming students. We study Chicago Public Schools’ adoption of RP and find that suspensions and arrests decreased, driven by effects for Black students. We find null effects on test score value added, ruling out meaningful average declines. We estimate a 15 percent decrease in out-of-school arrests, consistent with RP substantively changing student behavior. (JEL D63, D74, D91, I21, I28, J15, J16)

10.1257/aer.20230971.abstractZh: 历史上，学区在解决冲突时往往采取一种观点，即必须暂停对扰乱秩序学生的处理，以保护其他同学，即使这样做可能会对被认定为违规的学生造成伤害。修复性实践（RP）侧重于赔偿、问责以及纪律正义的共享责任，旨在在不伤害学生的情况下解决不良行为问题。我们研究了芝加哥公立学校对修复性实践的采用情况，发现由于对黑人学生的影响，停学和逮捕次数有所减少。我们发现，这些措施对考试成绩的增值效果几乎没有影响，排除了平均下降的可能性。我们估计，校外逮捕次数减少了15%，这与修复性实践实质上改变了学生行为的情况相符。（JEL D63, D74, D91, I21, I28, J15, J16）

abstract.text: How quickly does a fiat money become valueless? I study the speculative hyperinflation equilibria of continuous-time economies with decentralized markets where money is essential. I establish necessary and sufficient conditions under which money dies in finite time. A necessary condition is that the liquidity return of money grows unbounded as the value of money approaches zero. Under CRRA preferences, the longevity of money shrinks with the money growth rate and the frequency of liquidity needs, but it increases with seller’s market power. Money duration also depends on the strictness of legal restrictions and the rates of return of competing currencies. (JEL E31, E42, E51, E52, E62)

10.1257/aer.20231008.abstractZh: 法定货币何其迅速地失去价值？我研究具有去中心化市场的连续时间经济体系中，投机性恶性通货膨胀的均衡状态，其中货币是不可或缺的。我确定了货币在有限时间内消亡的必要充分条件。一个必要条件是，当货币价值接近零时，货币的流动性回报会无限增长。在CRRA偏好下，货币的生命周期会随着货币增长率和流动性需求的频率而缩短，但会随着卖方市场力量的增加而延长。货币的生命周期还取决于法律限制的严格程度以及竞争性货币的回报率。（JEL E31, E42, E51, E52, E62）

abstract.text: We study changes in political discourse during campaigns, using a novel dataset of candidate websites for US House elections, 2002–2016, and manifestos for French parliamentary and local elections, 1958–2022. We find that candidates move to the center in ideology and rhetorical complexity between the first round (or primary) and the second round (or general election). This convergence reflects candidates’ strategic adjustment to their opponents, as predicted by Downsian competition: Using an RDD we show that candidates converge to the platform of opponents who narrowly qualified for the last round as opposed to those who narrowly failed to qualify. (JEL D72, D83, D91)

10.1257/aer.20231045.abstractZh: 我们研究了竞选期间政治话语的变化，使用了2002年至2016年美国众议院选举中候选人的网站数据，以及1958年至2022年法国议会和地方选举中的竞选宣言数据。我们发现，在首轮选举（或初选）和第二轮选举（或大选）之间，候选人的意识形态和修辞复杂性会向中间靠拢。这种趋同反映了候选人对其对手的战略调整，正如唐斯竞争理论所预测的那样：通过随机对照实验，我们发现候选人更倾向于采纳那些在最后一轮选举中勉强获得资格的对手的竞选纲领，而不是那些勉强未能获得资格的对手的纲领。（JEL D72, D83, D91）

abstract.text: We provide the first evidence on how workers invest in human capital after losing ability. Using quasi-random work accidents in Danish administrative data, we find that workers enroll in bachelor’s programs after physical injuries, pursuing degrees that build on their past training and experience. Exploiting institutional differences in the stackability of degrees, we find that higher education moves injured workers from disability benefits to full-time employment, earning 25 percent more than before injury. Reskilling subsidies for injured workers pay for themselves four times over, and current rates of reskilling are substantially below the social optimum, especially for middle-aged workers. (JEL I26, J14, J24, J62)

10.1257/aer.20231067.abstractZh: 我们首次提供了关于工人如何在失去劳动能力后投资于人力资本的证据。通过丹麦行政数据中的准随机工作事故数据，我们发现工人在身体受伤后会参加学士学位课程，这些课程建立在他们过去的培训和经验基础上。利用不同制度对学位可堆叠性的差异，我们发现高等教育能够将受伤工人从残疾福利转变为全职就业，其收入比受伤前高出25%。为受伤工人提供的再培训补贴的回报是投入成本的四倍，而目前的再培训率远低于社会最优水平，尤其是对于中年工人而言。（JEL I26, J14, J24, J62）

abstract.text: Ethnically diverse countries are more prone to conflict, but why do some groups engage in conflict, while others do not? I show that civil conflict in Africa is explained by ethnic groups’ cultural distance to the central government: an increase in cultural distance, proxied by linguistic distance, increases an ethnicity’s propensity to fight over government power. To identify this effect, I leverage within-ethnicity variation in linguistic distance resulting from power transitions between ethnic groups over time. I provide evidence that the effects can be attributed to differences in preferences over both the allocation and the type of public goods. (JEL D74, H41, J15, N47, O15, O17, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20231087.abstractZh: 种族多样化的国家更容易发生冲突，但为什么有些群体会参与冲突，而另一些则不会呢？我发现，非洲的民事冲突可以通过种族群体与中央政府之间的文化距离来解释：文化距离的增加，通过语言距离来体现，会增强一个种族群体争夺政府权力的倾向。为了验证这一效应，我利用了种族内部因种族群体之间的权力转换而产生的语言距离变化。我有证据表明，这种效应可以归因于对公共产品分配和类型偏好上的差异。（JEL D74, H41, J15, N47, O15, O17, Z13）

abstract.text: This paper develops a framework to extend the strategic form analysis of cursed equilibrium (CE) developed by Eyster and Rabin (2005) to multistage games. The approach uses behavioral strategies rather than normal form mixed strategies and imposes sequential rationality. We define and characterize properties of cursed sequential equilibrium (CSE) and apply it to four canonical economic applications: signaling games, reputation building, durable goods monopoly, and the dirty faces game. These applications illustrate various implications of CSE, show how and why it differs from sequential equilibrium and CE, and provide evidence from laboratory experiments that support the empirical relevance of CSE. (JEL C72, C73, D42, D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.20231130.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个框架，用于将Eyster和Rabin（2005年）提出的关于“诅咒均衡”的战略形式分析扩展到多阶段博弈中。该方法采用行为策略而非正常形式的混合策略，并强调序贯理性。我们定义并描述了“诅咒序贯均衡”的性质，并将其应用于四个典型的经济场景：信号传递博弈、声誉建设、耐用商品垄断以及“脏脸博弈”。这些应用案例展示了“诅咒序贯均衡”的各种含义，说明了它与序贯均衡和诅咒均衡之间的区别，并通过实验室实验提供了支持其实证相关性的证据。（JEL C72, C73, D42, D82, D83）

abstract.text: Are application hassles, or “ordeals,” an effective way to limit public program enrollment? We provide new evidence by studying (removal of) an auto-enrollment policy for health insurance, adding an extra step to enroll. This minor ordeal has a major impact, reducing enrollment by 33 percent and differentially excluding young, healthy, and economically disadvantaged people. Using a simple model, we show adverse selection—a classic feature of insurance markets—undermines ordeals’ standard rationale of excluding low-value individuals since they are also low-cost and may not be inefficient. Our analysis illustrates why ordeals targeting is unlikely to work well in selection markets. (JEL D82, G22, H75, I13, I18)

10.1257/aer.20231133.abstractZh: 应用程序的繁琐过程，或称为“磨难”，是否是限制公共项目注册的有效方式？我们通过研究一项取消自动注册政策的健康保险方案，提供了新的证据。这一小小的麻烦过程产生了重大影响，使注册人数减少了33%，并且不同群体受到了不同的排斥——包括年轻人、健康人群以及经济条件较差的人。利用一个简单的模型，我们表明，逆向选择——保险市场的一个典型特征——削弱了“磨难”标准理由的有效性，因为低价值个体往往也是低成本个体，且可能并不低效。我们的分析说明了为什么针对选择的“磨难”方法不太可能有效。（JEL D82, G22, H75, I13, I18）

abstract.text: We analyze a monetary quasi–experiment in Sweden from 2010–2011, when the Riksbank raised the interest rate substantially. We argue that this increase was beyond what labor market conditions warranted, driven instead by new concerns about financial stability. Using a battery of specifications that rule out domestic or international confounders, we show that this monetary tightening led to a substantial economic contraction, raising unemployment by 1–2 percentage points. Using administrative microdata, we find that sectors with nominal wage rigidity drove much of the response and that the monetary contraction was more regressive than the typical business cycle. (JEL E24, E32, E43, E52, E58)

10.1257/aer.20231167.abstractZh: 我们分析了2010至2011年间瑞典的一项货币准实验，当时瑞典央行大幅提高了利率。我们认为，这一加息幅度超出了劳动力市场状况所要求的程度，而是由对金融稳定性的新担忧所驱动。通过一系列排除国内或国际干扰因素的模型分析，我们发现这一货币紧缩导致了严重的经济收缩，失业率上升了1至2个百分点。利用行政微观数据，我们发现名义工资刚性较高的行业对经济收缩的响应最为显著，且货币紧缩的影响比典型的商业周期更为滞后。（JEL E24, E32, E43, E52, E58）

abstract.text: We construct a dataset of firms’ discount rates (i.e., required returns to capital) and perceived cost of capital using corporate conference calls. The relation between discount rates and the cost of capital is far below the one-to-one mapping assumed in standard theory, as it takes many years for changes in the cost of capital to be incorporated into discount rates. This pattern leads to large and time-varying discount rate wedges that affect firm investment. Moreover, increasing discount rate wedges can account for the recent puzzle of “missing investment.” Cross-firm variation in market power and riskiness explains the evolution of wedges. (JEL D22, E43, G12, G31, G32)

10.1257/aer.20231246.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个包含企业折现率（即资本所需回报率）和感知资本成本的数据集，这些数据是通过企业电话会议获得的。折现率与资本成本之间的关系远低于标准理论所假设的一对一映射关系，因为资本成本的变化需要多年时间才能被纳入折现率中。这种模式导致了较大且随时间变化的折现率差异，这些差异会影响企业的投资决策。此外，不断扩大的折现率差异可以解释“投资缺失”这一近期难题。企业间在市场力量和风险性方面的差异也解释了这些折现率差异的演变。（JEL D22, E43, G12, G31, G32）

abstract.text: This paper studies, through a randomized field experiment involving community health workers in Pakistan, if public sector organizations can improve worker performance by investing in their mission motivation. The findings reveal that training aimed at strengthening mission motivation improves workers' performance in their core responsibility of monthly household visits, as well as in multiple tasks performed during and outside these visits. This holistic improvement in performance leads to improved health outcomes for children in the communities served by these workers. These results highlight the importance of promoting organizational missions as a strategy to improve public sector performance in low-income countries. (JEL C93, I11, J13, J24, L31, M53, O12)

10.1257/aer.20231247.abstractZh: 本文通过一项涉及巴基斯坦社区健康工作者的随机实地实验，研究公共部门组织是否可以通过投资于员工的工作使命动机来提高其工作表现。研究发现，旨在增强工作使命动机的培训能够提升员工在每月家庭访问这一核心职责中的表现，以及在这些访问期间和之外所执行的多项任务中的表现。这种整体性的表现提升有助于改善这些工作者所服务社区中儿童的健康状况。这些结果强调了将组织使命作为策略来提升低收入国家公共部门绩效的重要性。（JEL C93, I11, J13, J24, L31, M53, O12）

abstract.text: We show that the strong negative effect of higher mortgage rates on cash-out refinancing reflects substitution into other borrowing products, not large changes in total new household borrowing. We exploit plausibly exogenous changes in interest rates due to unconventional monetary policy surprises to show that changes in cash-out and other borrowing are roughly offsetting. The elasticity of new household borrowing with respect to mortgage rates is low and varies little with the borrower’s outstanding mortgage rate. Our results suggest that the cash-out refinance channel of unconventional monetary policy is weak and not path dependent. (JEL E43, E52, G21, G51)

10.1257/aer.20231264.abstractZh: 我们指出，较高的抵押贷款利率对现金提取再融资的强烈负面影响，实际上反映了人们转向其他借款产品的替代行为，而非家庭新增借款总额的大幅变化。我们通过利用由于非常规货币政策意外导致的利率 plausible 外生变化，发现现金提取再融资与其他借款的变化大致相互抵消。家庭新增借款对抵押贷款利率的弹性较低，且随着借款人未偿还的抵押贷款利率的变化而变化不大。我们的结果表明，非常规货币政策的现金提取再融资渠道较弱，且不具有路径依赖性。（JEL E43, E52, G21, G51）

abstract.text: Military spending has large and persistent effects on output because it shifts the composition of public spending toward R&D. This boosts innovation and private investment in the medium term and increases productivity and GDP at longer horizons. Public R&D expenditure stimulates economic activities beyond the business cycle even when it is not associated with war spending. In contrast, the effects of public investment are shorter-lived, while public consumption has a modest impact at most horizons. We reach these conclusions using BVAR with long lags and 125 years of US data, including newly reconstructed series of government spending by main categories since 1890. (JEL E21, E22, E23, E62, H50, H56, O30)

10.1257/aer.20231278.abstractZh: 军事开支对产出有显著且持久的影响，因为它将公共支出的结构转向研发领域。这在中期促进了创新和私人投资，并在更长的时期内提升了生产力和GDP。公共研发支出能够刺激经济活动，即使与战争开支无关。相比之下，公共投资的影响较为短暂，而公共消费在大多数情况下影响有限。我们基于包含长期滞后的125年美国数据，使用VAR模型得出了这些结论，这些数据包括自1890年以来按主要类别重新构建的政府支出数据。（JEL E21, E22, E23, E62, H50, H56, O30）

abstract.text: International migrants may facilitate the transmission of ideas across countries. We examine the impact of migrant exposure to reproductive health policies on origin-country fertility in the Philippines. We exploit temporal variation in destination-country reproductive health policies combined with spatial variation across Philippine provinces in their migration intensity and historical composition of migrant destinations. Migrant exposure to more liberalized reproductive health policies reduces origin-community fertility. This reduction is driven by increased adoption of modern contraceptives. Visible policy changes, such as commercial advertising of contraceptives, lead to this change in behavior. Firmly established family planning values moderate the fertility response. (JEL D91, F22, I18, J13, O15, O18, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20231286.abstractZh: 国际移民可能有助于思想在各国之间的传播。我们研究了移民接触生殖健康政策对菲律宾原籍国生育率的影响。我们利用了目的地国生殖健康政策的时间差异，以及菲律宾各省份在移民强度和历史移民目的地构成上的空间差异。移民接触更为宽松的生殖健康政策会降低原籍社区的生育率。这种降低是由现代避孕方法的采用增加所驱动的。诸如避孕药物商业广告等明显的政策变化也导致了这种行为的变化。根深蒂固的计划生育价值观则缓和了生育反应。（JEL D91, F22, I18, J13, O15, O18, Z13）

abstract.text: The Supplemental Security Income program uses a birth weight cutoff at 1,200 grams to determine eligibility. Using birth certificates linked to administrative records, we find low-income families of infants born just below the cutoff receive higher monthly cash benefits (equal to 27 percent of family income) at ages 0–2 with smaller benefits continuing through age 10. Yet we detect no improvements in health care use and mortality in infancy, nor in health and human capital outcomes as observed through young adulthood for these infants. We also find no improvements for their older siblings. (JEL I12, I13, I18, I38, J13, J14, J31)

10.1257/aer.20231293.abstractZh: 补充安全收入计划以出生体重1200克为门槛来决定资格。通过结合出生证明与行政记录的分析，我们发现那些婴儿出生体重略低于门槛的低收入家庭，在0至2岁期间获得的月度现金补贴占家庭收入的27%，而这一补贴在10岁之前持续较低。然而，我们并未发现这些婴儿在婴儿期医疗使用率和死亡率方面的改善，也未观察到他们在年轻成年期在健康与人力资本方面的改善。同时，我们也未发现他们的年长兄弟姐妹在相关方面的改善。（JEL I12, I13, I18, I38, J13, J14, J31）

abstract.text: We use public finance sufficient statistic approaches to characterize the welfare effects of “nudges,” such as simplified information and warning labels, in markets with taxes and endogenous prices. While many studies focus on average effects, we show that welfare also depends on how the nudge affects the variance of choice distortions, and average effects become irrelevant with zero pass-through or optimal taxes. We implement the framework with experiments evaluating automotive fuel economy labels and sugary drink health labels. Labels decrease purchases of low-fuel economy cars and sugary drinks but may decrease welfare because they increase the variance of choice distortions. (JEL D18, D62, D83, D91, H21, L62, L66)

10.1257/aer.20231304.abstractZh: 我们采用公共财政充分统计量方法，来研究在存在税收和内生价格的市场中，诸如简化信息提示和警示标签等“助推措施”对福利影响的特性。虽然许多研究关注平均效应，但我们指出，福利还取决于这种助推措施如何影响选择扭曲的方差，而当传递效应为零或存在最优税收时，平均效应就变得无关紧要了。我们通过实验来评估汽车燃油经济性标签和含糖饮料健康标签的效果。这些标签虽然减少了低燃油经济性汽车和含糖饮料的购买，但由于增加了选择扭曲的方差，反而可能降低福利水平。（JEL D18, D62, D83, D91, H21, L62, L66）

abstract.text: Common values auction models, where bidder decisions depend on noisy signals of common values, provide predictions about Bayesian Nash equilibrium (BNE) outcomes. In settings where these common values can be estimated, these predictions can be tested. We propose a series of tests, robust to assumptions about the signal structure, to determine whether the observed data could have been generated by a Bayesian Nash equilibrium. In the setting of oil and gas lease auctions in New Mexico, we find evidence that participation decisions are correlated and that participants systematically underbid in light of ex post outcomes. (JEL D44, D82, L12, L71, Q35)

10.1257/aer.20231356.abstractZh: 基于共同价值拍卖模型的决策，其中投标者的决定依赖于关于共同价值的噪声信号，这些模型能够预测贝叶斯纳什均衡的结果。在可以估计这些共同价值的情境下，这些预测可以被验证。我们提出了一系列测试方法，这些方法对信号结构的假设具有鲁棒性，可以用来判断观测到的数据是否可能由贝叶斯纳什均衡产生。在新墨西哥州的石油和天然气租赁拍卖中，我们发现参与决策之间存在相关性，并且参与者根据事后结果系统性地出价过低。（JEL D44, D82, L12, L71, Q35）

abstract.text: Many US colleges now use test-optional admissions. A frequent claim is that by not seeing standardized test scores, a college can admit a student body it prefers, say, with more diversity. But how can observing less information improve decisions? This paper proposes that test-optional policies are a response to social pressure on admission decisions. We model a college that bears disutility when it makes admission decisions that “society” dislikes. Going test optional allows the college to reduce its “disagreement cost.” We analyze how missing scores are imputed and the consequences for the college, students, and society. (JEL I23, I28)

10.1257/aer.20231407.abstractZh: 许多美国大学现在采用测试可选录取政策。人们经常认为，通过不查看标准化测试成绩，大学可以录取更符合其需求的学生，例如，能够带来更多多样性。但是，减少信息量如何能够改善决策呢？本文提出，测试可选政策是对录取决策所面临的社会压力的回应。我们模拟了一个大学，当其做出的录取决策“不符合社会期望”时，该大学会承担相应的不满意度。采用测试可选政策可以让大学降低“不一致成本”。我们分析了缺失成绩是如何被填补的，以及这对大学、学生和整个社会的影响。（JEL I23, I28）

abstract.text: Individuals might experience negative utility from not consuming a popular product. With such externalities to nonusers, standard consumer surplus measures, which take aggregate consumption as given, fail to appropriately capture consumer welfare. We propose an approach to account for these externalities and apply it to estimate consumer welfare from two social media platforms: TikTok and Instagram. Incentivized experiments with college students indicate positive welfare based on the standard measure but negative welfare when accounting for these nonuser externalities. Our findings high-light the existence of product market traps, where active users of a platform prefer it not to exist. (JEL D62, D83, D91, L82, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20231468.abstractZh: 个人可能不会从不消费某种热门产品中获得负效用。由于存在这些对非用户的外部性，以总消费量为前提的标准消费者剩余衡量方法无法充分反映消费者的福利状况。我们提出了一种考虑这些外部性的方法，并将其应用于评估TikTok和Instagram这两个社交媒体平台的消费者福利。针对大学生的激励实验表明，基于标准衡量方法得出的福利结果是积极的，但在考虑这些非用户外部性后，福利结果则呈现负值。我们的研究结果凸显了产品市场陷阱的存在，即平台的活跃用户反而希望该平台不存在。（JEL D62, D83, D91, L82, Z13）

abstract.text: We provide a new foundation of risk aversion by showing that this attitude is fully captured by the propensity to seize insurance opportunities. In our main results, we first characterize Arrow-Pratt (1963–1964) risk aversion in terms of propensity to full insurance and the stronger notion of risk aversion of Rothschild and Stiglitz (1970) in terms of propensity to partial insurance. We then extend the analysis to comparative risk aversion by showing that the classical notion of Yaari (1969) corresponds to comparative propensity to full insurance, while the stronger notion of Ross (1981) corresponds to comparative propensity to partial insurance. (JEL D81, G22, G52)

10.1257/aer.20231529.abstractZh: 我们通过展示这种态度完全可以通过抓住保险机会的倾向来体现，从而为风险厌恶提供了一个新的理论基础。在我们的主要研究结果中，我们首先用完全保险的机会倾向来描述Arrow-Pratt（1963–1964）的风险厌恶概念，并进一步用Rothschild和Stiglitz（1970）提出的更强烈的风险厌恶概念来描述部分保险的机会倾向。随后，我们将分析扩展到比较风险厌恶，指出Yaari（1969）的经典概念对应于比较完全保险的机会倾向，而Ross（1981）提出的更强烈概念则对应于比较部分保险的机会倾向。（JEL D81, G22, G52）

abstract.text: This paper demonstrates that labor market regulations, such as minimum wages or payroll taxes, shape trade competition in labor-intensive activities. I exploit data from a large European trade program where firms from different countries supply labor services at the same location but face different payroll taxes and minimum wage rules. Country case studies and model-consistent gravity estimates show large trade responses to tax and regulatory reforms, with an elasticity of trade in services to labor costs larger than one. The results imply that absent regulatory and fiscal harmonization, export competitiveness depends, in part, on domestic labor market policies. (JEL F14, F16, F42, H25, J22, J23, K31)

10.1257/aer.20231531.abstractZh: 本文表明，劳动力市场法规，如最低工资或工资税，会塑造劳动密集型活动的贸易竞争。本文利用了一个大型欧洲贸易项目的数据，该项目中的不同国家企业在同一地点提供劳动服务，但面临不同的工资税和最低工资规定。案例研究和模型一致的重力估计显示，税收和监管改革对贸易有显著影响，服务行业的贸易对劳动力成本的弹性大于一。这些结果意味着，在没有监管和财政协调的情况下，出口竞争力在一定程度上取决于国内劳动力市场政策。（JEL F14, F16, F42, H25, J22, J23, K31）

abstract.text: We develop a bottom-up approach to estimate the slope of the primitive form of the New Keynesian Phillips curve, which features marginal cost as the real activity variable. Using quarterly micro data on prices, costs, and output, we estimate dynamic pass-through regressions that identify the slope as a function of primitive parameters. We find a high slope for the cost-based Phillips curve, which contrasts with the low estimates of the conventional output gap–based formulation found in the literature. We reconcile by showing that the output elasticity of marginal cost is low, at least during moderate inflation periods (e.g., pre-pandemic). (JEL C51, E12, E23, E31, E32, L60)

10.1257/aer.20231569.abstractZh: 我们采用自下而上的方法来估算新凯恩斯主义菲利普斯曲线的原始形式的斜率，该曲线以边际成本作为实际活动变量。利用关于价格、成本和产量的季度微观数据，我们进行了动态传递回归分析，从而确定了该斜率与原始参数的关系。我们发现，基于成本的菲利普斯曲线具有较高的斜率，这与文献中发现的基于传统产出缺口的菲利普斯曲线斜率较低的情况形成对比。我们通过研究表明，至少在中等通胀时期（例如，疫情前），边际成本的产出弹性较低，从而解释了这一现象。（JEL C51, E12, E23, E31, E32, L60）

abstract.text: We use the tools of mechanism design combined with the theory of risk measures to analyze how a cash-constrained owner of an asset with known, stochastic returns raises capital from a population of investors who differ in their risk aversion and budget constraints. The issuer partitions the asset’s cash flow into several asset-backed securities, one for each type of investor. The optimal partition conforms to the commonly observed practice of tranching into senior debt, junior debt, and equity. Tranching arises endogenously due to the differences in risk appetites among agents and in the budget constraints they face. (JEL D81, D82, G12, G41, G51)

10.1257/aer.20231597.abstractZh: 我们运用机制设计工具与风险度量理论，来分析一个现金受限的资产所有者如何向不同风险偏好和预算限制的投资者群体筹集资金，这些资产具有已知的随机回报。发行者将资产的现金流划分为多种基于资产的证券，每种类型的投资者对应一种证券。最优的划分方式符合通常的做法，即将证券分为高级债务、次级债务和股权三类。这种划分是由于各投资者之间的风险偏好差异以及他们面临的预算限制而自然产生的。（JEL D81, D82, G12, G41, G51）

abstract.text: We study one benefit to firms of selling subscriptions: the prospect that consumers will continue to pay for subscriptions they no longer value. We use comprehensive data from a large payment card network to document that months during which cards are replaced, when active renewal is required, are associated with much higher rates of cancellation. Using two stylized models of consumer inertia—driven by inattention or switching costs—we estimate that these cancellation frictions roughly double seller revenues on average, holding fixed initial subscribers. We use the estimated models to explore the impact of possible regulatory remedies. (JEL D12, D18, L81, L88)

10.1257/aer.20231612.abstractZh: 我们研究了企业销售订阅服务的一个好处：消费者可能会继续支付他们不再需要的订阅费用。我们利用一个大型支付卡网络的全面数据，发现当卡片需要更换且需要主动续订时，取消订阅的频率会显著增加。通过两种描述消费者惰性的模型——一种由忽视驱动，另一种由转换成本驱动——我们估计，在初始订阅用户数量固定的情况下，这些取消订阅的摩擦会使销售收益平均增加一倍。我们利用这些模型来探讨可能的监管解决方案的影响。（JEL D12, D18, L81, L88）

abstract.text: For whom has earnings risk changed, and why? We answer these questions by combining the Kalman filter and EM algorithm to estimate persistent and temporary earnings for every individual at every point in time. We apply our method to administrative earnings linked with survey data. We show that since the 1980s, persistent earnings risk rose by 12.5 percent for both employed and unemployed workers and the scarring effects of unemployment doubled. At the same time, temporary earnings risk declined. Using education and occupation codes, we show that rising persistent earnings risk is concentrated among high-skill workers and related to technology adoption. (JEL J22, J24, J31, J64)

10.1257/aer.20231656.abstractZh: 哪些人的收入风险发生了变化，原因是什么？我们通过结合卡尔曼滤波器和EM算法来估计每个个体在每一时间点的持续性和暂时性收入风险。我们将该方法应用于与调查数据相关的行政收入数据。研究表明，自20世纪80年代以来，无论是就业者还是失业者的持续收入风险上升了12.5%，而失业的污名效应则翻了一番。与此同时，暂时性收入风险则有所下降。通过教育和工作类别的分析，我们发现持续收入风险的增加主要集中在高技能工人中，并且与技术采用有关。（JEL J22, J24, J31, J64）

abstract.text: This paper studies housing vouchers and urban redevelopment programs by incorporating neighborhood effects into a general equilibrium overlapping-generations model with endogenous location choice and child development. We calibrate the model using US data and estimate impacts of large-scale implementations of rental voucher and place-based subsidy policies. Our core finding is that vouchers generate long-run welfare gains by reducing inequality and generating skill improvements that offset higher taxation and other GE effects. Although vouchers lead to larger welfare gains on average, we find housing supply. (JEL D63, H24, J13, J24, R23, R31, R38)

10.1257/aer.20231679.abstractZh: 本文研究了住房券和城市重建计划，将社区效应纳入一个一般均衡的重叠世代模型中，该模型包含内生性位置选择和儿童发展。我们使用美国数据对模型进行校准，并估算大规模实施租赁券和基于地点的补贴政策所带来的影响。我们的核心发现是，住房券通过减少不平等和促进技能提升来产生长期的福利收益，这些收益抵消了更高的税收和其他一般均衡效应。尽管住房券平均而言能带来更大的福利收益，但我们发现住房供应也起到了重要作用。（JEL D63, H24, J13, J24, R23, R31, R38）

abstract.text: We demonstrate that predictable uninformed cash flows forecast aggregate market stock returns. Buying pressure from dividend payments (announced weeks prior) predicts higher value-weighted market returns, with returns for the top quintile of payment days four times higher than the lowest. This holds internationally and increases when reinvestment is high and market liquidity is low. We estimate a market-level price multiplier of 1.9. These results suggest price pressure is a widespread result of flows, not an anomaly. (JEL G12, G14, G35)

10.1257/aer.20231725.abstractZh: 我们证明，可预测的、无信息的现金流能够预测整体市场的股票回报。来自股息支付的购买压力（在宣布前几周就已公布）会导致更高的价值加权市场回报，其中支付日期位于最高五分位数的股票的回报是最低五分位数的四倍。这一现象在国际上普遍存在，并且在再投资频率高且市场流动性低的情况下更为显著。我们估计市场层面的价格乘数值为1.9。这些结果表明，价格压力是现金流普遍存在的现象，而非异常现象。（JEL G12, G14, G35）

abstract.text: In additive instrumental variables models, the robustness to some failure of instrumental validity or additive separability depends on the strength of a priori restrictions on the structural relationship between outcomes and treatments. I provide theoretical analysis of the problem, discuss the implications for empirical practice, and demonstrate with a numerical study calibrated on real-world data. (JEL C26, G51, H24, J13)

10.1257/aer.20231765.abstractZh: 在加法工具变量模型中，工具变量有效性或加法可分性的稳健性取决于对结果与处理之间结构关系的先验限制的强度。我对这一问题进行了理论分析，讨论了其对实证实践的影响，并通过基于真实世界数据的数值研究进行了验证。（JEL C26, G51, H24, J13）

abstract.text: We model populism as the dissemination of a false “alternative reality,” according to which the intellectual elite conspires against the populist for purely ideological reasons. If enough voters are receptive to it, this alternative reality—by discrediting the elite's truthful message—reduces political accountability. Elite criticism, because it is more consistent with the alternative reality, strengthens receptive voters' support for the populist. Alternative realities are endogenously conspiratorial to resist evidence better. Populists, to leverage or strengthen beliefs in the alternative reality, enact harmful policies that may disproportionately harm the non-elite. These results explain previously unexplained facts about populism. (JEL D72, D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.20240010.abstractZh: 我们将民粹主义模型化为一种虚假的“另类现实”的传播，根据这种模型，知识精英出于纯粹的意识形态原因合谋反对民粹主义者。如果足够多的选民接受这种另类现实，那么通过质疑精英们真实的信息，这种另类现实就能降低政治问责性。由于精英的批评更符合这种另类现实，因此会增强选民对民粹主义者的支持。另类现实本质上具有反证据的倾向。为了强化对另类现实的信念，民粹主义者会实施可能给非精英群体带来不成比例的伤害的有害政策。这些结果解释了之前无法解释的一些关于民粹主义的现象。（JEL D72, D82, D83）

abstract.text: We conduct a field experiment with US households to study how expectations about long-run home price growth shape spending decisions. We exogenously vary survey respondents' expectations by providing different expert forecasts. Homeowners' spending, measured using rich home-scanner data, is inelastic to home price expectations. By contrast, renters reduce their spending when expecting higher home price growth. These patterns reflect positive wealth effects for owners from higher future wealth and negative income effects for both groups due to higher future housing costs. Our study highlights consequences of asset price growth and long-term expectations about the economy for household behavior. (JEL C93, D12, D84, D91, G51, R31)

10.1257/aer.20240022.abstractZh: 我们针对美国家庭进行了一项实地实验，研究对长期房价增长的预期如何影响消费决策。我们通过提供不同的专家预测，人为地改变受访者的预期。使用丰富的房屋扫描数据测量的房主支出对房价预期表现出无弹性。相比之下，当预期房价增长较高时，租户会减少支出。这些模式反映了房主因未来财富增加而获得的积极财富效应，以及两组人因未来住房成本增加而遭受的负面收入效应。我们的研究强调了资产价格增长以及对经济长期预期的预期对家庭行为的影响。（JEL C93, D12, D84, D91, G51, R31）

abstract.text: We conduct a field experiment to quantify the impact of the lifting of the Saudi women's driving ban on women's employment by randomizing rationed spaces in driver's training. Treated women are 41 percent more likely to be employed yet are 19 percent less likely to be able to make purchases without family permission. Patterns of heterogeneous treatment effects reveal that these divergent impacts of access to driving are experienced by distinct subgroups of women. The results underscore the importance of intrahousehold responses that can counteract legal gains in women's freedoms. (JEL C93, D13, J16, J22, K38, O15, O17)

10.1257/aer.20240119.abstractZh: 我们开展了一项实地实验，通过随机分配驾驶培训中的名额，来量化沙特女性驾驶禁令解除对女性就业的影响。接受实验的女性就业率提高了41%，但未经家庭许可进行购物的可能性则降低了19%。不同女性群体在驾驶权获取方面的差异效应表明，这些不同的影响是由不同的女性亚群体所经历的。研究结果强调了家庭内部反应的重要性，这种反应可以抵消法律赋予女性自由所带来的收益。（JEL C93, D13, J16, J22, K38, O15, O17）

abstract.text: We present five facts from an experiment on the marginal propensity to consume (MPC) out of transitory transfers: (1) the one-month MPC on a cash-like transfer is 23 percent; (2) it is substantially higher (61 percent) on a transfer administered via a card where remaining funds expire after three weeks, inconsistent with money fungibility; (3) the consumption response is concentrated in the first three weeks; (4) MPCs vary with household characteristics but are high even for the liquid wealthy; (5) unconditional MPC distribution exhibits large variation. Our findings inform the design of stimulus policies and pose challenges to existing macroeconomic models. (JEL D12, D91, E21, G51, I38)

10.1257/aer.20240138.abstractZh: 我们基于一项关于暂时性转移对消费边际倾向的实验，提出了以下五个发现：(1)现金类转移在一个月内的消费边际倾向为23%；(2)通过卡片进行的转移，由于剩余资金在三周后失效，消费边际倾向显著更高，这违背了货币可替代性；(3)消费反应主要集中在最初的三周内；(4)消费边际倾向因家庭特征而异，但即使对于资金充裕的富人来说，这一数值仍然较高；(5)无条件消费边际倾向的分布表现出较大的差异。我们的发现为刺激政策的设计提供了参考，并对现有的宏观经济模型提出了挑战。(JEL D12, D91, E21, G51, I38)

abstract.text: We study how individual political views shape firm behavior and labor market outcomes using new microdata from Brazil. We first show that business owners are considerably more likely to employ copartisan workers. This phenomenon is in part driven by the overlapping of political and social networks. Multiple tests—surveys, event studies, analyses of wage premia and promotions within the firm, and a field experiment—further highlight how business owners’ political preferences directly influence firms’ employment decisions. A channel of political discrimination appears more relevant than one of political quid pro quo between firms and politicians. (JEL C93, D22, D72, J23, M51, O17, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20240151.abstractZh: 我们研究了个体政治观点如何塑造企业行为和劳动力市场结果，使用了来自巴西的新微观数据。首先，我们发现企业主雇佣共同政治立场的员工的可能性显著更高。这一现象部分是由政治和社会网络的重叠所驱动的。通过多项测试——调查、事件研究、对企业内部工资奖励和晋升的分析，以及一项实地实验——进一步证实了企业主的政治偏好直接影响了企业的雇佣决策。政治歧视的渠道似乎比企业与政治家之间的政治交换更为重要。（JEL C93, D22, D72, J23, M51, O17, Z13）

abstract.text: With a growing mental health crisis and a shortage of behavioral health specialists, those seeking mental health treatment often face long wait times to obtain care. I study how clinic congestion affects mortality for veterans experiencing mental health emergencies. I find that longer waiting times make it more likely that patients miss their follow-up mental health visit, consequently increasing the probability that they permanently disengage from care. A 1 standard deviation increase in wait time between the emergency department visit and follow-up appointment date (11.7 days) increases two-year mortality by about 1.5 percent. (JEL H51, I12, I13, I18)

10.1257/aer.20240226.abstractZh: 随着心理健康危机的加剧以及行为健康专家数量的短缺，寻求心理健康治疗的人往往面临漫长的等待时间。我研究诊所拥堵如何影响经历心理健康紧急情况的退伍军人的死亡率。我发现，更长的等待时间会导致患者错过后续的心理健康检查，从而增加了他们永久脱离治疗的可能性。从急诊部门就诊到后续预约日期之间等待时间增加1个标准差（11.7天），会使两年的死亡率增加约1.5%。（JEL H51, I12, I13, I18）

abstract.text: Accelerated investment in electricity transmission could reduce total costs and enhance renewable integration. I document static allocative inefficiencies induced by incomplete market integration in 2 major US markets; these have risen over time and totaled $2 billion in 2022. I also argue that estimating firm-level impacts is important, as incumbents may have the power to block new lines and other reforms. I show that 4 firms would have experienced a collective $1.3 billion drop in net revenues in 2022 had the market been integrated, and there are reports of some of these firms blocking transmission projects. (JEL D22, D24, L13, L94, Q42, Q48)

10.1257/aer.20240276.abstractZh: 加速电力传输投资可以降低总成本并提升可再生能源的整合程度。我记录了美国两个主要市场中因市场整合不完全而导致的静态分配效率低下问题；这些问题随着时间的推移而加剧，2022年总损失达20亿美元。我还指出，评估企业层面的影响非常重要，因为现有企业可能有权阻止新的输电线路建设和其他改革措施。研究表明，如果市场能够实现整合，有4家企业的净收入将在2022年减少13亿美元，并且有报道称其中一些企业正在阻挠输电项目。（JEL D22, D24, L13, L94, Q42, Q48）

abstract.text: We design and field an innovative survey of unemployment insurance (UI) recipients that yields new insights about wage stickiness on the layoff margin. A majority of UI recipients would accept pay cuts of 5–10 percent to save their jobs, and one-third would accept a 25 percent cut. Yet worker-employer discussions about cuts in pay, benefits, or hours in lieu of layoffs are exceedingly rare. Roughly one-quarter of the layoffs in our sample violate the theoretical condition for bilaterally efficient separations. We draw on our findings and other evidence to assess theories of wage stickiness and its role in layoffs. (JEL C83, E24, J31, J63, J65)

10.1257/aer.20240309.abstractZh: 我们设计并实施了一项关于失业保险领取者的创新调查，该调查为理解裁员边缘的工资粘性提供了新的见解。大多数失业保险领取者愿意接受5-10%的减薪以保住工作，其中三分之一的人甚至愿意接受25%的减薪。然而，工人与雇主关于以减薪、福利或缩短工作时间来替代裁员的讨论却极为罕见。在我们的样本中，大约四分之一的裁员违反了双边效率分离的理论条件。我们基于这些发现以及其他证据，来评估工资粘性的理论及其在裁员中的作用。（JEL C83, E24, J31, J63, J65）

abstract.text: Consider an economy with equal amounts of N types of goods, to be allocated to agents with strict quasi-convex preferences over lotteries. We show that ex ante, all Pareto-efficient allocations give almost all agents lotteries over at most two outcomes. Our results provide a simple criterion showing that many popular allocation mechanisms are ex ante inefficient. For the case of identical preferences, we establish existence of an efficient solution where all lotteries used are equally attractive. Assuming the reduction axiom, social welfare deteriorates by first randomizing over these binary lotteries. Efficient ex ante equality is achieved if agents satisfy the compound-independence axiom. (JEL D44, D61, D82)

10.1257/aer.20240339.abstractZh: 考虑一个拥有N种商品的经济体系，这些商品需要分配给具有严格准凸偏好的代理人。我们证明，从事前来看，所有帕累托有效的分配方式都能使几乎所有代理人的彩票结果最多为两种。我们的研究结果提供了一个简单的标准，表明许多流行的分配机制在事前是低效的。对于偏好相同的情形，我们证明了存在一个有效解，其中所有使用的彩票都具有相同的吸引力。在假设减少公理的前提下，社会福利会因首先对这些二元彩票进行随机化而恶化。如果代理人满足复合独立性公理，则可以实现事前有效的平等分配。（JEL D44, D61, D82）

abstract.text: We test the effectiveness of a behavioral program grounded in the idea that status granting and self-persuasion might yield a robust behavioral change in disadvantaged adolescents. We enlist socially connected senior middle school students with high emotional intelligence as “student-teachers” and entrust them with delivering a curriculum to their junior peers. The program empowers student-teachers, leading them to improve their social environment. It reduces disciplinary incidents and antisocial behavior among student-teachers and their friendship networks. The intervention significantly enhances the likelihood of admission to selective high schools for student-teachers, offering a cost-effective way to help disadvantaged adolescents escape neighborhood disadvantages. (JEL H52, I21, I24, I28, J13, O15)

10.1257/aer.20240374.abstractZh: 我们测试了一个基于以下理念的行为计划的有效性：授予地位和自我说服可能会促使处于不利地位的青少年产生显著的行为改变。我们招募了具有高情商且社会联系紧密的中学高年级学生担任“学生教师”，并让他们负责向低年级同学传授课程。该计划使学生教师能够提升自身的社会环境，从而减少违纪事件以及学生教师及其朋友圈中的反社会行为。该干预措施显著提高了学生教师被优质高中录取的可能性，为帮助处于不利地位的青少年摆脱社区劣势提供了一种经济有效的途径。（JEL H52, I21, I24, I28, J13, O15）

abstract.text: We study the Tutoring Online Program (TOP), where tutoring is entirely online and tutors are volunteer university students matched with underprivileged middle school students. We leverage random assignment to estimate effects during and after the pandemic (2020 and 2022), investigating channels of impact. Three hours of individual tutoring per week increased math performance by 0.22 SD in 2020 and 0.20 SD in 2022. Higher dosage yielded stronger effects, while group tutoring smaller effects. TOP enhanced students’ aspirations, socioemotional skills, and psychological well-being, but only during school closures. We also estimate the impact of TOP on tutors, finding an increase in empathy. (JEL I12, I21, I23, I26, I28)

10.1257/aer.20240401.abstractZh: 我们研究了在线辅导项目（TOP），该项目的辅导完全在线进行，辅导教师是由志愿者大学生与贫困的中学生配对组成的。我们通过随机分配来估计疫情期间及之后（2020年和2022年）的效果，并探讨影响途径。每周三小时的个体辅导在2020年使数学成绩提高了0.22个标准差，在2022年提高了0.20个标准差。剂量越大，效果越显著，而小组辅导的效果则较小。TOP提升了学生的抱负、社会情感技能和心理幸福感，但这一效果仅在学校停课期间出现。我们还评估了TOP对辅导教师的影响，发现他们的同理心有所增强。（JEL I12, I21, I23, I26, I28）

abstract.text: We study neighborhood choice using a novel research design that contrasts the move rate of homeowners who receive a new different-race neighbor immediately next-door versus slightly farther away on the same block. This approach isolates a component of preferences directly attributable to neighbors’ identities. Both Black and White homeowners are more likely to move after receiving a new different-race neighbor. Findings are robust to additional controls (e.g., income) and alternative research designs. We find evidence of heterogeneity in responses, especially associated with housing density, which has implications for understanding contemporary neighborhood racial change and prospects for maintaining stable, integrated neighborhoods. (JEL D91, J15, R23, R31)

10.1257/aer.20240406.abstractZh: 我们采用一种新颖的研究设计来研究邻里选择问题，比较了在相邻街区与稍远一些的街区分别遇到新邻居时，房主搬家频率的差异。这种方法能够分离出与邻居身份直接相关的偏好因素。无论是黑人还是白人房主，在遇到新邻居后搬家的可能性都更高。研究结果在引入其他控制变量（如收入）或采用其他研究设计后依然保持稳定。我们发现，不同群体的反应存在异质性，这种异质性与住房密度有关，这对理解当代邻里种族变化以及维持稳定、融合的社区前景具有重要意义。（JEL D91, J15, R23, R31）

abstract.text: We investigate long-run earnings responses to taxes in the presence of dynamic returns to effort. First, we develop a theoretical model of earnings determination with dynamic returns to effort. In this model, earnings responses are delayed and mediated by job switches. Second, using administrative data from Denmark, we verify our model's predictions about earnings and hours-worked patterns over the life cycle. Third, we provide a quasi-experimental analysis of long-run earnings elasticities. Informed by our model, the empirical strategy exploits variation among job switchers. We find that the long-run elasticity is around 0.5, considerably larger than the short-run elasticity of roughly 0.2. (JEL D31, H24, H31, J22, J31, J62)

10.1257/aer.20240554.abstractZh: 我们研究了在努力动态回报存在的情况下，长期收益对税收的反应。首先，我们建立了一个具有努力动态回报的收益决定理论模型。在该模型中，收益反应被延迟，并通过工作转换来中介。其次，利用丹麦的行政数据，我们验证了模型关于收益和工作时间模式在生命周期中的预测。第三，我们对长期收益弹性进行了准实验分析。根据我们的模型，实证策略利用了工作转换者之间的差异。我们发现，长期弹性约为0.5，远高于短期弹性约0.2的水平。（JEL D31, H24, H31, J22, J31, J62）

abstract.text: We study whether the quality of managers can affect public service provision in the context of public health. Using novel data from public hospitals in Chile, we show how the introduction of a competitive recruitment system and better pay for public hospital CEOs reduced hospital mortality by 8 percent. The effect is not explained by a change in patient composition. We find that the policy changed the pool of CEOs by displacing doctors with no management training in favor of CEOs who had studied management. Productivity improvements were driven by hospitals that recruited higher quality CEOs. (JEL D24, G34, I11, I18, J45, M54, O15)

10.1257/aer.20240615.abstractZh: 我们研究了管理者的素质是否会影响公共卫生领域的公共服务提供。利用智利公立医院的新数据，我们发现，引入竞争性招聘机制并提高公立医院首席执行官的薪酬后，医院死亡率降低了8%。这一效果并非由患者构成的变化所解释。我们发现，该政策通过取代没有管理经验的医生，转而选择具有管理经验的首席执行官，改变了首席执行官的群体结构。生产力的提升是由那些招聘了更高质量首席执行官的医院所推动的。（JEL D24, G34, I11, I18, J45, M54, O15）

abstract.text: A college degree offers a pathway to economic mobility for low-income students. Using a multisite randomized controlled trial combined with administrative and survey data, we demonstrate that intensive advising during high school and college significantly increases bachelor’s degree attainment among lower-income students. We leverage unique data on preadvising college preferences and causal forest methods to show that these gains are primarily driven by improvements in initial enrollment quality. Our results suggest that strategies targeting college choice may be a more effective and efficient means of increasing degree attainment than those focused solely on affordability. (JEL G51, I21, I22, I23)

10.1257/aer.20240669.abstractZh: 大学学位为低收入学生提供了经济流动的途径。通过一项多地点随机对照试验结合行政数据和调查数据，我们发现高中和大学期间密集的学业指导显著提高了低收入学生获得学士学位的比例。我们利用关于大学选择偏好预调查的独特数据以及因果森林方法，表明这些收益主要源于初始入学质量的提升。我们的研究结果表明，针对大学选择的策略可能是比单纯关注经济可负担性更为有效和高效的提高学位获得率的方法。（JEL G51, I21, I22, I23）

abstract.text: We conducted a randomized trial among 14,545 households in rural Burkina Faso to test the oft-cited hypothesis that limited access to contraception is an important driver of high fertility rates in West Africa. We do not find support for this hypothesis. Women who were given free access to modern contraception for three years did not have lower birth rates; we can reject even modest effects. We cross-randomized additional interventions to address inefficiencies that might depress demand for free contraception, specifically misperceptions about the child mortality rate and social norms. Free contraception did not significantly influence fertility even in combination with these interventions. (JEL D12, J13, J16, J18, O12)

10.1257/aer.20241305.abstractZh: 我们在布基纳法索农村地区的14,545户家庭中进行了随机试验，以验证一个常被引用的假设：有限的避孕手段获取机会是西非高生育率的重要驱动因素。我们的研究并未发现这一假设得到支持。那些在三年内免费获得现代避孕措施的妇女，其出生率并未下降；我们甚至无法排除这些措施可能产生的轻微影响。我们还对其他干预措施进行了交叉随机化，以解决可能导致免费避孕措施需求下降的问题，特别是关于儿童死亡率的误解和社会规范问题。即使在这些干预措施同时实施的情况下，免费避孕措施对生育率的影响也并未显著增强。（JEL D12, J13, J16, J18, O12）

abstract.text: This paper quantifies the causal effects of exogenous health insurer exits on contract structure and health care market outcomes, proposing market concentration as a likely mechanism for these effects. Leveraging the termination of the largest health insurer in Colombia, I find that the use of fee-for-service contracts increased after the termination relative to capitation contracts. Treatment effects are larger in markets with higher provider than insurer concentration at baseline. Results suggest that equilibrium contracts place the financial risk on insurers in markets where providers have higher bargaining leverage. (JEL D86, G22, I13, I18, O15, O16)

10.1257/aeri.20240155.abstractZh: 本文量化了外部健康保险公司退出对合同结构及医疗市场结果的影响，认为市场集中度可能是这些影响的机制之一。通过研究哥伦比亚最大健康保险公司退出后的情况，我发现与按费用计费的合同相比，按服务收费的合同使用率有所上升。在初始阶段医疗服务提供者与保险公司集中度较高的市场中，这种影响更为显著。结果表明，在医疗服务提供者具有更高议价能力的市场中，均衡合同将财务风险转移给了保险公司。（JEL D86, G22, I13, I18, O15, O16）

abstract.text: This study investigates the relationship between the management of development aid and violent conflict in Africa. I exploit variation in World Bank project management quality driven by the assignment of project leaders of varying ability, combined with geo-coded data on all projects linked to performance report cards. I find that better project management reduces violent conflict across subnational aid receiving regions. Poorly managed projects increase conflict while well-managed projects do the opposite. Project monitoring is particularly important, and management matters most in regions with a recent history of warfare and for large projects that involve the transfer of appropriable resources. (JEL D74, F35, O17, O19, O22)

10.1257/pol.20220219.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了发展援助管理与非洲暴力冲突之间的关系。我利用世界银行项目管理者能力差异导致的项目管理质量变化作为研究基础，并结合了所有项目的绩效报告数据，通过地理编码数据进行分析。研究发现，更好的项目管理能够减少各次国家级援助接收地区的暴力冲突。而管理不善的项目则会加剧冲突，而管理得当的项目则能起到相反的作用。项目监控尤为重要，尤其是在战争历史较为悠久的地区，以及涉及资源转移的大型项目中，管理的重要性更为突出。（JEL D74, F35, O17, O19, O22）

abstract.text: This paper studies government and private advertising in market-based public programs. In a model of advertising, we first examine when government advertising increases welfare. Then, we estimate the effects of advertising on consumer demand and assess their welfare effects in the Affordable Care Act health insurance marketplaces. We find government advertising increases overall enrollment and enhances welfare. By contrast, the market expansion effect of private advertising is modest at most. Although private advertising increases demand for insurers in certain specifications, it is not a very efficient tool to induce consumers to select insurers with better plans due to rent-seeking competition. (JEL G22, G52, H51, I13, M37)

10.1257/pol.20220352.abstractZh: 本文研究了政府与私人广告在基于市场的公共项目中的作用。在广告模型分析中，我们首先探讨了政府广告何时能够提升福利。随后，我们评估了广告对消费者需求的影响，并在《平价医疗法案》下的健康保险市场中对这些影响进行了福利分析。研究发现，政府广告能够增加整体参保人数并提升福利水平。相比之下，私人广告的市场扩展效应较为有限。尽管在某些特定情况下，私人广告能够增加消费者对保险公司的需求，但由于寻租竞争的存在，它并不是一种非常有效的工具来促使消费者选择更优质的保险计划。（JEL G22, G52, H51, I13, M37）

abstract.text: This paper examines how physician recommendations influence patients’ dialysis facility choices, highlighting the impact of conflicts of interest and quality information on patient outcomes.

10.1287/mksc.2023.0191.abstractZh: 本文探讨了医生推荐如何影响患者的透析设施选择，重点分析了利益冲突和质量信息对患者结果的影响。

abstract.text: Although relative performance feedback in the form of rankings appears to be effective in improving health outcomes, it may have either motivating or demotivating effects for individual physicians. Potential factors influencing such effects include a physician’s ability and the design of the ranking system itself; however, there is limited understanding of these factors. Using a controlled lab-in-the-field experiment with practicing and future physicians as subjects ([Formula: see text]), we systematically analyze effort within small teams under different ranking systems. Exogenously varying the number and position of the thresholds defining the ranking system, we observe that the addition of a threshold to create a new rank is motivating—that is, increases effort—only among individuals capable of exceeding that threshold; the effort of other individuals may remain unchanged or even decrease. In particular, a highly granular ranking system with ranks spanning the entire range of possible outcomes maximizes overall physician effort; high thresholds serve to motivate high-ability individuals, whereas moderate and low thresholds provide opportunities for improvement to lower-ability individuals who cannot reach the high thresholds. Our results suggest that, to motivate their teams effectively, clinical leaders should provide rank feedback using a system under which physicians of all ability types can improve their rank through increased effort. This paper was accepted by Stefan Scholtes, healthcare management. Funding: This work was supported by C-SEB Center for Social and Economic Behavior at the University of Cologne (Junior Startup Grant No: Rd04-2016-JSUG-Huesmann) and the School of Business and Economics at the University of Münster (Junior Researcher Promotion Fund). This research was initiated while Daniel Wiesen was employed at the Institute of Health and Society at the Department of Health Management and Health Economics, University of Oslo (Norway), supported by the Research Council of Norway [IRECOHEX, Grant No. 231776]. Y. S. Ndiaye gratefully acknowledges support by the German Science Foundation through Germany’s Excellence Strategy [EXC 2126/1 390838866]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.00990 .

10.1287/mnsc.2022.00990.abstractZh: 尽管以排名形式提供的相对绩效反馈在改善健康结果方面似乎有效，但它可能对个体医生产生激励或消减动力的效果。影响这些效应的潜在因素包括医生的自身能力以及排名系统的设计；然而，对这些因素的理解仍然有限。我们通过一项针对在职及未来医生的实验室实验，系统地分析了不同排名系统下小团队内的努力情况。通过外源性改变定义排名系统的阈值数量和位置，我们发现，增加一个新的阈值来创建新的排名只会激励那些有能力超越该阈值的个体，而其他个体的努力可能保持不变甚至减少。具体而言，一个具有高度细粒度的排名系统，能够覆盖所有可能的结果范围，可以最大化全体医生的努力；高阈值能够激励能力较强的个体，而中等和低阈值则为能力较低的个体提供了改进的机会，使他们能够接近高阈值。我们的研究结果表明，为了有效激励团队，临床领导者应使用一种系统来提供排名反馈，使所有能力的医生都能通过增加努力来提高自己的排名。本文由Stefan Scholtes负责医疗管理领域的评审。资金支持：本研究得到了科隆大学C-SEB社会与经济行为中心（Junior Startup Grant No: Rd04-2016-JSUG-Huesmann）以及明斯特大学商学院的支持（Junior Researcher Promotion Fund）。这项研究是在Daniel Wiesen在挪威奥斯陆大学卫生管理与卫生经济系的卫生与社会研究所任职期间开始的，得到了挪威研究委员会的支持[IRECOHEX，资助号231776]。Y. S. Ndiaye衷心感谢德国科学基金会通过德国卓越战略提供的支持[EXC 2126/1 390838866]。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可访问https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.00990。

abstract.text: I study the role of vertical incentives between upstream issuers and downstream brokers in the retail bond market when there exist agency problems. Although arms-length transaction regulations require that vertical incentives not influence their activities, I show that both upstream issuers and downstream brokers are sensitive to vertical incentives. I then present a structural model in order to measure the degree of vertical incentives for downstream brokers, controlling for the extent of agency problems. The structural estimates show that brokers are willing to give up one dollar of their own profit if their vertically integrated issuer’s profit goes up by 1.25 dollars. This paper was accepted by Victoria Ivashina, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03572 .

10.1287/mnsc.2023.03572.abstractZh: 本文研究了在存在代理问题的情况下，上游发行人与下游经纪人之间的垂直激励在零售债券市场中的作用。尽管独立交易法规要求垂直激励不会影响他们的行为，但我发现无论是上游发行人还是下游经纪人都对垂直激励非常敏感。随后，我提出了一个结构模型，以衡量下游经纪人的垂直激励程度，同时控制代理问题的存在。结构模型的结果表明，如果其垂直整合的发行人的利润增加1.25美元，下游经纪人愿意放弃自己1美元的利润。本文已被Victoria Ivashina的金融系接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03572获取。

abstract.text: Geographic inequalities in healthcare access extend beyond rural–urban divides to include socioeconomic, racial, and other disparities. Proximity to hospitals, clinics, healthcare providers, and pharmacies varies widely, posing a challenge in deciding where to strategically locate such facilities. Demand for each service depends on local population health, individual preferences, provider capacity, and other factors. This study introduces a novel structural estimate-then-optimize (SETO) framework, combining structural demand estimation using a modified Berry–Levinsohn–Pakes approach that accounts for provider capacity with a choice-based optimal facility location model to maximize health service utilization. Our methodology is illustrated with a case study on the Federal Retail Pharmacy Program in California, a public–private partnership that administered millions of COVID-19 vaccinations. Demand estimates indicate that residents of socioeconomically vulnerable communities are more sensitive to travel distances to pharmacy-based vaccination sites. Strategically adding 500 retail stores serving lower-income communities increases predicted vaccinations by 2.9% overall (770,000 additional vaccinations statewide) and by 5.3% in the least healthy neighborhoods. Our integrative SETO approach outperforms heuristics that allocate resources based on current vaccination rates, existing service gaps, population density, or predicted demand. The case study demonstrates the importance of (1) accounting for heterogeneity in estimating demand and (2) selecting partnerships to complement existing networks with spatially heterogeneous supply and efficiently fill service gaps. Our study provides a systematic approach to optimize healthcare delivery networks, using publicly available aggregate data while accounting for individuals’ preferences, highlighting the value of combining a structural demand model with prescriptive analytics. This paper was accepted by Stefan Sholtes, healthcare management. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06274 .

10.1287/mnsc.2024.06274.abstractZh: 在医疗保健获取方面的地理不平等不仅体现在城乡差异上，还涉及社会经济、种族及其他方面的差异。人们与医院、诊所、医疗服务提供者及药店的距离差异很大，这给这些设施的选址带来了挑战。每项服务的需求取决于当地人口的健康状况、个人偏好、服务提供者的能力以及其他因素。本研究提出了一种新颖的结构性估算-优化框架（SETO），该框架结合了使用改良的Berry–Levinsohn–Pakes方法进行的结构性需求估算，同时考虑了服务提供者的能力，并通过基于选择的优化设施选址模型来最大化医疗服务利用率。我们的研究方法以加利福尼亚州的联邦零售药房计划为例进行说明，这是一个公私合作项目，负责管理数百万次COVID-19疫苗接种工作。需求估算表明，社会经济条件较为脆弱的社区居民对前往药房接种点的距离更为敏感。在低收入社区战略性地增加500家零售店后，预计疫苗接种数量将增加2.9%（全州额外接种770,000剂次），在健康状况最差的社区这一比例则增加5.3%。我们的综合性SETO方法优于那些仅基于当前疫苗接种率、现有服务缺口、人口密度或预测需求来分配资源的启发式方法。案例研究表明，考虑需求的异质性以及选择能够补充现有网络、并有效填补服务缺口的合作伙伴关系至关重要。我们的研究提供了一种系统化的方法来优化医疗保健服务网络，利用公开可用的汇总数据，同时考虑个人的偏好，强调了将结构需求模型与规范性分析相结合的价值。该论文已被Stefan Sholtes的医疗保健管理领域接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06274获取。

abstract.text: OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the underlying mechanism of the volume-outcome relationship, namely learning-by-doing and scale economies in patients with sepsis. DESIGN AND STUDY SETTING: Retrospective cohort study of adult patients with sepsis between 1 January 2010 and 31 December 2016 in 231 intensive care units (ICUs) in the UK. PARTICIPANTS: The patient was the primary unit of analysis. Patient and ICU characteristics were included for risk adjustment. Demographic and clinical data were extracted from the Intensive Care National Audit and Research Centre (ICNARC) Case Mix Programme database. STUDY DESIGN: We used the lags of quarterly sepsis volume in the ICU as a measure of the learning-by-doing effect. OUTCOME MEASURE: The outcome of hospital mortality after ICU admission for sepsis was assessed using a multilevel probit regression model of patients nested in ICUs over quarters. DATA COLLECTION/EXTRACTION METHODS: Critically ill patients with sepsis were identified by the Sepsis-3 consensus criteria. RESULTS: Our study identified a cohort of 273001 patients with sepsis admitted to 231 ICUs in the UK. Our study finds that in comparison with contemporaneous volume, lagged volume had a stronger association with acute hospital mortality. This implies that the dynamic learning-by-doing effect is more important than the static economies of scale effect. This finding was consistent across alternate specifications of learning-by-doing. CONCLUSIONS: The study provides evidence that the underlying mechanism for the volume-outcome relationship is learning-by-doing and not the static economies of scale. ICUs caring for patients with sepsis tend to improve by experience.

10.1371/journal.pone.0318808.abstractZh:
目的：评估脓毒症患者体积与结果关系背后的机制，即通过实践学习和规模经济效应。  
研究设计与实施地点：一项回顾性队列研究，针对2010年1月1日至2016年12月31日期间在英国231家重症监护病房收治的成年脓毒症患者。  
研究对象：以患者为主要的分析单位，并纳入患者特征和重症监护病房特征以进行风险调整。人口统计和临床数据来自重症监护国家审计与研究中心的病例组合数据库。  
研究设计：我们使用重症监护病房中脓毒症病例的季度滞后数据作为通过实践学习效应的衡量指标。  
结果测量：通过嵌套在重症监护病房中的患者多层次概率回归模型，评估脓毒症患者在重症监护病房入院后的医院死亡率。  
数据收集/提取方法：根据Sepsis-3共识标准识别患有脓毒症的重症患者。  
结果：本研究共识别出273001名在英国231家重症监护病房收治的脓毒症患者。研究发现，与当时的病例数量相比，滞后后的病例数量与急性医院死亡率的关联更为紧密。这表明通过实践学习的动态效应比静态的规模经济效应更为重要。这一发现在不同形式的通过实践学习效应模型中均得到验证。  
结论：本研究提供了证据，表明脓毒症体积与结果关系背后的机制是通过实践学习，而非静态的规模经济效应。负责脓毒症患者的重症监护病房往往通过经验不断改进。

abstract.text: Management practices are deemed especially critical to performance in resource-constrained settings. However, empirical evidence is limited for community-based organizations (CBOs) that provide health services. We studied the association between management domains and performance among organizations delivering HIV services to key populations. We assessed organizational performance using cost efficiency, service volume, and outreach service quality. We collected data on 67 management practices from 45 CBOs in Kenya and Malawi and classified them into six domains-community engagement, financial management, operations management, people management, performance monitoring, and target setting. We calculated the scores for each domain, adjusting them for contextual characteristics to control for observed differences across organizations. Using ordinary least squares and quantile regression models, we explored the relationship between management and performance. We also estimated the relative contribution of each management domain to the explained variation of all performance indicators via a Shapley decomposition approach. Better management was associated with lower unit costs for antiretroviral therapy (ART) ($-1,124 pval<0.05), HIV testing services (HTS) ($-45 pval<0.05), and sexually transmitted infection (STI) screening, ($-30 pval<0.01). Higher management scores correlated positively with HTS volume (2,806, pval<0.001) and outreach quality (258, pval<0.05). Financial management was the most important domain, explaining 13-49% of performance indicator variation, performance monitoring explained 31% of outreach quality variation, and target setting explained 23-34% of service volume variation. These findings suggest that targeted capacity building in management practices, especially financial management, performance monitoring, and target setting, could improve the provision of HIV health services to key populations by CBOs.

10.1371/journal.pone.0330300.abstractZh: 在资源受限的环境中，管理实践被认为对绩效至关重要。然而，对于提供健康服务的社区组织而言，相关的实证证据较为有限。我们研究了为关键人群提供艾滋病服务的组织在不同管理领域与绩效之间的关系。我们通过成本效率、服务量以及服务质量来评估组织绩效。我们收集了肯尼亚和马拉维45个社区组织关于67种管理实践的数据，并将它们分为六个领域：社区参与、财务管理、运营管理、人员管理、绩效监控和目标设定。我们计算了每个领域的得分，并调整了这些得分以考虑组织间的差异。利用普通最小二乘法和分位数回归模型，我们探讨了管理实践与绩效之间的关系。我们还通过Shapley分解方法估计了每个管理领域对所有绩效指标变异的相对贡献。更好的管理与抗逆转录病毒疗法的单位成本降低（-1,124 pval<0.05）、艾滋病检测服务的单位成本降低（-45 pval<0.05）以及性传播感染筛查的单位成本降低（-30 pval<0.01）相关。较高的管理得分与艾滋病检测服务的量（2,806，pval<0.001）和服务质量（258，pval<0.05）呈正相关。财务管理是最重要的领域，解释了13-49%的绩效指标变异；绩效监控解释了31%的服务质量变异；目标设定解释了23-34%的服务量变异。这些研究结果表明，针对管理实践中的关键领域进行能力建设，尤其是财务管理、绩效监控和目标设定方面的能力建设，能够提升民间组织为关键人群提供艾滋病健康服务的能力。

abstract.text: Background Some healthcare organisations can be characterised as “challenged:” they are prone to sub-standard performance in quality and safety, and to organisational failures. Yet the best means supporting improvement in these challenged settings remains poorly understood. English maternity services are an important example of where such understanding is much needed, given repeated high-profile scandals and evidence that a significant proportion of units are deemed to be inadequate or to require improvement by the regulator. This thesis aimed to investigate: (1) how well improvement initiatives in English maternity services have been designed, reported and evaluated; (2) how features of the institutional and organisational conditions of maternity services act to enable or limit improvement, and how these features interact in challenged services; and (3) how existing approaches to supporting improvement can be better sensitised to the contexts of challenged organisations. Methods I designed two studies to address my research questions. Study 1 involved a review of maternity improvement initiatives implemented in the English NHS in the period 2010–2023. A structured assessment of quality and reporting was undertaken of initiatives that had an available evaluation report, met definitional criteria as improvement programmes, and had a focus on intrapartum care. The review adapted the principles of scoping review methodology and drew on the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses extension for Scoping Reviews guidance. Study 2 involved a qualitative interview study of a national safety improvement programme for English maternity services. The study aimed to identify contextual features of maternity services that could act to enable or limit improvement, to explore their interaction in challenged services, and to investigate how existing approaches to supporting improvement could be better sensitised to the conditions of challenged organisations. The study design was based on semi-structured interviews with system stakeholders, maternity clinicians and managers, and researchers with expertise in the evaluation of improvement programmes. Methods of analysis were based on adaptation of the principles of the framework method. Results My review of maternity initiatives found that improvement programmes in maternity care often fell short on key features of quality. Among the programmes assessed, I identified considerable variability and weaknesses in quality of reporting, use of evidence-based interventions, implementation support, patient and public involvement, commitment to reducing inequalities, use of formal published theories, models, and frameworks, and evaluation. My interview study identified, first, five features of the institutional and regulatory contexts of English maternity services with potential to undermine improvement: problems of “many hands” and system design; problems of institutional and regulatory culture; problems linked to performance management regimes promulgated by public bodies; problems of “many eyes” and multiple accountabilities; and priority thickets generated by public bodies. Second, I identified three categories of organisational contexts of English maternity services implicated in performance and improvement: structural environmental conditions of organisations; determinants and sources of organisational capacity; and organisational culture and behaviour. Finally, the study identified three features of existing approaches to improvement in English maternity services that could be strengthened to better support improvement in challenged organisations: institutional approaches to data collection and measurement; design of improvement interventions for challenged organisations; and approaches to spread, scaling, and evaluation of improvement. Conclusion This thesis offers new insights into the underlying characteristics of healthcare services that are vulnerable to performance failures. My analysis addresses why some organisations persistently struggle to improve, even in a context of extensive regulatory oversight and support from national bodies. Specifically, the findings identify how complex interactions between institutional, regulatory, organisational, structural, and cultural contexts compound to generate conditions that entrench underperformance in challenged organisations, and place limits on their improvement capability. The findings highlight that strengthening existing approaches to supporting improvement in challenged organisations must go beyond ‘one size fits all’ forms of implementation support. It is important, where possible, to attend to enduring features of context likely to undermine improvement in these settings. At the same time, policymakers and national bodies tasked with supporting improvement must be alert to potential risks associated with provision of intensive forms of support, including the creation of dependence on additional resources among challenged services. By highlighting potential weaknesses in current policy approaches, the thesis offers a possible roadmap for improving the design, impact, and sustainability of approaches to supporting challenged organisations to improve quality and safety.

10.17863/cam.129879.abstractZh: 背景 一些医疗保健机构可以被描述为“存在挑战”：它们在质量和安全方面容易出现不合格的表现，并且容易出现组织层面的问题。然而，在这些具有挑战性的环境中支持改进的最佳方法仍然缺乏深入的理解。英国孕产妇服务就是一个需要这种理解的典型例子，因为该领域频繁发生高调的丑闻，且有证据表明相当一部分机构被认为不够完善或需要监管机构进行改进。本论文旨在研究：(1)英国孕产妇服务中的改进措施在设计、报告和评估方面的效果如何；(2)孕产妇服务中的机构和组织条件如何促进或限制改进，这些条件在具有挑战性的服务中如何相互作用；(3)现有支持改进的方法如何更好地适应具有挑战性的组织环境。方法 我设计了两项研究来回答我的研究问题。研究1涉及对2010年至2023年间英国国民医疗服务体系实施的孕产妇改进措施进行回顾。对那些有可用评估报告、符合改进计划定义标准且专注于分娩护理的改进措施进行了系统的质量评估与报告分析。该回顾采用了范围审查方法的原则，并参考了《系统评价和荟萃分析的首选报告项目》为范围审查提供的指导。研究2则涉及对英国孕产妇服务国家安全改进计划的定性访谈研究。本研究旨在识别能够促进或限制 maternity 服务改进的背景特征，探讨这些特征在面临挑战的服务中的相互作用，并研究现有支持改进的方法如何更好地适应处于挑战中的组织的实际情况。研究设计基于与系统相关方、 maternity 临床医生和管理人员以及具有改进项目评估专业知识的研究人员进行的半结构化访谈。分析方法基于对框架方法原则的改编。研究结果显示，我通过对 maternity 项目的评估发现， maternity 护理中的改进项目往往未能达到质量的关键要求。在评估的项目中，我发现报告质量、基于证据的干预措施的使用、实施支持、患者和公众的参与、减少不平等的承诺、正式出版的理论、模型及框架的使用以及评估等方面存在相当大的差异和弱点。访谈研究还发现，首先，英格兰 maternity 服务的制度和监管背景中存在五个可能阻碍改进的因素： “多手” 问题及系统设计问题；制度和监管文化问题；与公共机构推行的绩效管理制度相关的问题；“多眼” 问题及多重责任问题；以及由公共机构产生的优先事项问题。其次，我确定了英格兰 maternity 服务中涉及绩效和改进的三个组织背景类别：组织的结构环境条件；组织能力的决定因素和来源；以及组织文化和行为。最后，该研究确定了现有英语 maternity 服务改进方法的三个特点，这些特点可以通过加强来更好地支持处于困境中的组织的改进：对数据收集和测量的机构性方法；为处于困境中的组织设计改进措施；以及改进措施的传播、扩展和评估方法。结论本论文为那些容易出现绩效失败的医疗服务提供了新的见解。我的分析探讨了为什么一些组织即使在广泛的监管监督和国家机构的支持下，仍然难以持续改进。具体而言，研究发现，机构、监管、组织、结构和文化背景之间的复杂相互作用共同导致了困境中组织的低绩效，并限制了它们的改进能力。研究指出，加强现有支持改进的方法必须超越“一刀切”的实施支持方式。在可能的情况下，应关注那些可能破坏这些环境中改进效果的长期背景特征。同时，负责支持改进的政策制定者和国家机构必须警惕提供密集支持所带来的潜在风险，包括使处于困境中的服务对额外资源产生依赖。通过指出当前政策方法的潜在弱点，本论文为改进支持困境中组织改进设计、效果和可持续性的方法提供了可能的路线图，以提高质量和安全性。

abstract.text: Health at a Glance provides a comprehensive set of indicators on population health and health system performance across OECD Members, Key Partners and accession candidate countries. These indicators cover health status, non-medical determinants and risk factors, access to and quality of healthcare, health spending and health system resources. Analysis draws from the latest comparable official national statistics and other sources. Alongside indicator-by-indicator analysis, an overview chapter summarises the comparative performance of countries and major trends. This edition also includes a thematic chapter on gender and health.

10.1787/8f9e3f98-en.abstractZh: 《健康一瞥》提供了一套全面的指标，涵盖经合组织成员国、主要合作伙伴和候选国的人口健康及卫生系统绩效。这些指标包括健康状况、非医学因素与风险因素、医疗保健的获取与质量、卫生支出以及卫生系统资源。分析数据来源于最新的可比官方国家统计数据及其他来源。除了针对各项指标的详细分析外，还设有概述章节，总结各国的比较绩效及主要趋势。本版还包括一个关于性别与健康的专题章节。

abstract.text: This study examines the characteristics of public sector 3,470 hospitals with high and low risk-adjusted intra-hospital mortality rates in Brazil, using administrative data for 2023 and 2013 from the Brazilian Unified Health System (SUS) and data from the 2013 World Management Survey of 260 hospitals. In 2023, hospitals with a high risk-standardized mortality rate (RSMR) were predominantly large, urban facilities with high patient volumes, longer hospital stays, and greater ICU capacity, suggesting they treat more critically ill patients. The results also suggest that intra-hospital mortality worsened between 2013 and 2023, particularly in rural and small hospitals. Hospitals with high intra-hospital mortality in 2013 had stronger management practices, particularly in performance monitoring and target setting. These findings highlight the need for targeted policy interventions, improved resource allocation, staffing strategies, and management practices to address disparities in hospital performance and patient care quality. Our analysis also highlights the importance of developing reliable and routine measures of hospital performance, including for quality of care.

10.18235/0013863.abstractZh: 本研究考察了巴西公共部门3,470家医院中，具有高和低风险调整住院死亡率的医院特征，使用了巴西统一卫生系统2023年和2013年的行政数据，以及2013年对260家医院进行的世界管理调查数据。2023年，具有高风险标准化死亡率的医院多为大型、位于城市的医疗机构，这些医院的患者数量较多，住院时间较长，重症监护能力较强，这表明它们主要治疗重症患者。研究结果还表明，从2013年到2023年，住院死亡率有所恶化，尤其是在农村和小规模医院中。2013年住院死亡率较高的医院在管理实践方面更为完善，特别是在绩效监控和目标设定方面。这些发现强调了需要采取有针对性的政策干预措施，改进资源分配、人员配置策略和管理实践，以缩小医院绩效和患者护理质量方面的差异。我们的分析还强调了制定可靠且常规的医院绩效评估指标的重要性，包括护理质量方面的指标。

abstract.text: The optimal design of incentive contracts critically depends on whether the tasks performed by agents are complementary or substitutable, yet empirical evidence on this remains limited. This paper develops a novel empirical strategy to identify complementarities and substitutabilities in tasks, even in the absence of contract variation across agents, provided the incentive contract is piecewise linear. We apply this method to data on the management of chronic diseases by UK family physicians and find evidence that some tasks are complements, while none are substitutes. These complementarities may explain the widespread adoption of incentive contracts in healthcare. Furthermore, our findings suggest that healthcare systems centred around family physicians, rather than specialists, could achieve significant efficiency gains by consolidating complementary tasks under a single provider.

10.1920/wp.ifs.2025.0825.abstractZh: 激励合同的最优设计在很大程度上取决于代理人所执行的任务是否互补或可替代，但关于这一点的实证证据仍然有限。本文提出了一种新颖的实证策略，即使在代理人之间不存在合同差异的情况下，也能识别出任务之间的互补性和替代性，前提是激励合同是分段线性的。我们将这一方法应用于英国家庭医生管理慢性病的数据，发现某些任务具有互补性，而没有任何任务具有替代性。这些互补性可能解释了激励合同在医疗保健领域的广泛采用。此外，我们的研究结果表明，以家庭医生为中心的医疗保健系统，而非以专科医生为中心的体系，通过整合互补任务，可以实现显著的效率提升。

abstract.text: We quantify changes in concentration, market power and welfare in the UK grocery retail sector from 2002 to 2021.
