10.3386/w33999.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新的基于规则的链接方法，用于历史人口普查记录。我们基于姓名、年龄和出生地的信息，对早期的算法进行了改进（Abramitzky、Boustan、Eriksson，2012年提出的“基础ABE”算法），增加了五个匹配特征：中间名首字母、居住地县以及配偶和父母的姓名。与基础ABE相比，ABE-额外信息（ABE-EI）显著提高了匹配率，提升了准确性，并且在大多数属性上能够很好地代表人口特征，不过地理流动性是一个重要的例外。与机器学习算法相比，ABE-EI的匹配率略低，但更具代表性，并且提供了完全的复制性。我们还为女性创建了首个基于ABE的链接方法。

abstract.text: Biological drugs account for just two percent of prescriptions filled in the U.S. but fifty percent of prescription-drug spending. To explore the role patents play in explaining high biologics prices, we build the first comprehensive database of patents associated with all FDA-approved biologics. We first establish that much of what drives biologic patenting is the desire to block entry by competing biosimilars. For these purposes, we estimate the response to a 2010 Act that created an abbreviated pathway for biosimilars to receive FDA approval. We then document robust evidence consistent with two patenting strategies that may block biosimilar competition: thicketing and evergreening, whereby firms supplement primary patents with a dense web of later-expiring patents on secondary drug features. We conduct various exercises to suggest that these behaviors are undertaken with exclusionary purposes that go beyond the traditional justifications of the patent system. We then set forth various descriptive statistics surrounding biosimilar entry to suggest that these patenting strategies are, in fact, effective at delaying biosimilar entry. Finally, we simulate the degree to which biologics patent portfolios are impacted by policy proposals currently under consideration to address thicketing and evergreening.

10.3386/w34024.abstractZh: 在美国，生物药物的处方量仅占所有处方药总量的2%，但相关支出却占到了50%。为了探讨专利在解释生物药物高价格中的作用，我们建立了首个涵盖所有FDA批准生物药物的专利综合数据库。我们首先确定，推动生物药物专利制度的主要动机是阻止竞争生物仿制药的进入。为此，我们评估了2010年一项为生物仿制药简化FDA审批流程的法案的影响。随后，我们发现有大量证据支持两种可能阻碍生物仿制药竞争的专利策略：厚积策略和永生策略，即企业通过添加一系列后期失效的专利来补充主要专利，以限制生物仿制药的进入。我们通过各种模拟实验表明，这些行为的动机超出了传统专利制度的解释范围。最后，我们提供了关于生物仿制药进入市场的各种描述性统计数据，以证明这些专利策略确实有效，能够延缓生物仿制药的进入。最后，我们模拟了当前正在考虑的政策提案对生物药物专利组合的影响，以评估厚积策略和永生策略的实施程度。

abstract.text: Certificate-of-Need (CON) laws require the approval of states’ health planning agencies for health care providers to engage in regulated actions such as opening or expanding facilities or purchasing equipment. Such laws initially aimed to restrain health care costs and wasteful redundancies, but they are also now seen by advocates as helping to preserve the financial viability of struggling hospitals. Opponents of CON laws argue that they stifle competition, leading to inflated costs and limited options for accessing care. This study reviews the literature on the impacts of CON laws. All else equal, economic theory suggests that hospitals should see fewer new competitors, charge higher prices, and earn higher net revenues as a result of CON laws. Reduced competition can also weaken incentives to operate efficiently and deliver high quality care. However, these predictions assume otherwise perfectly competitive markets, and health care markets are heavily distorted in ways that change meaningfully over time. The need for new entrants to obtain regulatory approval could conceivably improve their quality of care while also helping to ensure that safety-net hospitals do not need to shut down unprofitable departments or close completely. Further, CON laws restrain not only entry of new facilities but also expansion of existing facilities, limiting their ability to leverage potential regulatory advantages. Viewed in its totality, the available evidence supports some of the predictions of conventional economic theory but not others. In at least some cases, CON laws restrict both entry of new competitors and expansion of existing hospitals. The reduction in competitors increases the number of procedures per hospital. However, there is little evidence that this translates to increased prices or higher hospital profitability, and hardly any research tests for reduced closure rates. Studies on hospital efficiency and quality of care for procedures performed exclusively at hospitals mostly point to null or negative effects, but evidence on quality is more favorable for services that can be provided outside of hospitals. We conclude that, despite the fact that the literature on CON laws is already large, more research is needed. Future work should utilize the latest tools for identifying causal effects and better account for the wide variation in CON laws across states.

10.3386/w34026.abstractZh: 需求认证法案要求各州的卫生规划机构批准医疗机构进行诸如开设或扩建设施、购买设备等受监管的行为。这些法律最初旨在控制医疗成本并防止浪费性重复建设，但现在也被认为有助于维持陷入困境的医院的经济可行性。反对需求认证法案的人认为，这些法律会抑制竞争，导致成本上升和就医选择减少。本研究回顾了关于需求认证法案影响的文献。从经济学理论来看，在其他条件相同的情况下，医院应因需求认证法案而面临较少的新竞争对手、收取更高的价格以及获得更高的净收入。然而，竞争减少也可能削弱医疗机构高效运营和提供高质量服务的动力。不过，这些预测假设市场是完全竞争的，而医疗市场存在严重的扭曲现象，这种扭曲会随着时间而变化。新进入者需要获得监管批准，这可能会提升他们的服务质量，同时也有助于确保那些缺乏盈利能力的医院不会关闭某些部门或完全关闭。此外，需求认证法案不仅限制了新设施的进入，还限制了现有设施的扩建，从而限制了它们利用潜在监管优势的能力。总体而言，现有证据支持部分传统经济理论的预测，但另一些预测则未被证实。至少在某些情况下，需求认证法案同时限制了新竞争对手的进入和现有医院的扩建。竞争对手数量的减少意味着每家医院需要进行的手术数量增加。然而，几乎没有证据表明这会导致价格上升或医院盈利能力提高，而且几乎没有研究探讨减少医院关闭率的可能性。关于医院效率和服务质量的研究大多表明，仅在医院进行的手术几乎没有负面影响，但关于服务质量的证据则更倾向于支持可以在医院外提供的服务。我们得出结论，尽管关于CON法律的相关文献已经很多，但仍需要更多的研究。未来的研究应利用最新的工具来识别因果效应，并更好地考虑各州CON法律存在的巨大差异。

abstract.text: We study the effects of state hospital regulations intended to increase breastfeeding by requiring certain care standards during the postpartum hospital stay. Policy adoption increased breastfeeding initiation by 3.3–4.1 percentage points (4.2–5.2 percent) and breastfeeding at 3 months postpartum by 6–9 percent. Further, following adoption, infant mortality declined by 0.2 deaths per 1,000 live births (3.5 percent), and infant hospitalization charges fell. Declines in mortality and charges primarily occurred among medically vulnerable infants, consistent with evidence that breast milk supports immune development. Additional evidence suggests that improvements in infant sleep practices also played a role in reducing mortality.

10.3386/w34032.abstractZh: 我们研究了旨在促进母乳喂养的州医院规定的影响，这些规定要求在产后住院期间遵循一定的护理标准。政策实施后，母乳喂养的启动率提高了3.3至4.1个百分点（4.2至5.2%），产后3个月的母乳喂养率提高了6至9%。此外，政策实施后，婴儿死亡率每1000个活产婴儿中减少了0.2例死亡（3.5%），婴儿住院费用也有所下降。死亡率和费用下降主要发生在医疗条件较差的婴儿中，这与母乳对免疫发育有积极影响的证据一致。进一步的证据表明，改善婴儿的睡眠习惯也在降低死亡率方面发挥了作用。

abstract.text: In contracting out, monitoring is an important policy tool to extract information on firm quality and incentivize quality provision. This paper examines a central quality inspection of nursing homes, a sector with significant welfare implications but widespread public concerns about care quality. We find that nursing homes exhibit strong responses to the inspection in multiple core dimensions. However, nearly all responses drop immediately once the inspection is completed. While inspection ratings are unlikely to reflect nursing homes’ absolute quality given the strategic responses, they nonetheless predict nursing homes’ relative quality: admission to higher-rated nursing homes lowers patient mortality.

10.3386/w34037.abstractZh: 在外包过程中，监控是获取企业质量信息并激励企业提供高质量服务的重要政策工具。本文研究了养老院这一对福利有重大影响但公众普遍关注护理质量的行业的核心质量检查问题。我们发现，养老院在多个核心维度上都对检查表现出强烈的响应。然而，一旦检查结束，几乎所有养老院的反应都会立即下降。尽管考虑到这些策略性反应，检查评级不太可能反映养老院的绝对质量，但它们仍然能够预测养老院的相对质量：进入评级较高的养老院可以降低患者的死亡率。

abstract.text: We conducted a large-scale field experiment in Granada, Spain, to assess the motivating effect on blood donation of matching each attempt to donate with a charitable contribution pledge for children in developing countries. The intervention involved 344 blood drives and 21,888 participants. Compared to a control condition with no pledges, the pro-social incentives significantly increased blood donation rates by approximately 5% on average. Offering a day or a week’s worth of food for vulnerable populations led to the largest and most robust increases in donations, and repeated exposure to incentives had a reinforcing effect on subsequent donation behavior, especially for individuals who previously donated when incentivized. An auxiliary survey examining the perceived importance and motivational impact of food-related incentives corroborates our findings. Our results suggest that coordination between blood donation campaigns and humanitarian aid programs could enhance the blood supply at minimal additional cost. More broadly, policymakers and nonprofit organizations can align global and local altruism by linking humanitarian assistance with initiatives promoting civic engagement and public health.

10.3386/w34038.abstractZh: 我们在西班牙格拉纳达进行了一项大规模实地实验，旨在评估将献血尝试与为发展中国家儿童提供慈善捐赠承诺相结合对献血动机的激励效果。实验涉及344次献血活动，共有21,888名参与者。与没有捐赠承诺的对照组相比，这种亲社会激励措施使平均献血率显著提高了约5%。为弱势人群提供一天或一周的食物能带来最大且最稳定的献血增加，而多次接触激励措施则对后续献血行为具有强化作用，尤其是对于那些之前在受到激励时曾献血的人。一项辅助调查进一步证实了食物相关激励措施在感知重要性和动机影响方面的效果。我们的研究结果表明，将献血活动与人道主义援助计划相结合，可以在最小的额外成本下提升血液供应。更广泛地说，政策制定者和非营利组织可以通过将人道主义援助与促进公民参与和公共健康的举措相结合，来协调全球与地方层面的利他行为。

abstract.text: This paper empirically analyzes the effects of mergers between complementary firms on competition and pricing. As these non-horizontal mergers have become more common, there is increasing interest in evaluating both potential efficiencies such as eliminating double marginalization and potential anticompetitive effects such as foreclosure and recapture. The mergers we study – hospital acquisitions of physician practices – have reshaped the $1 trillion US physician industry, nearly doubling the share of physicians working for hospitals between 2008 and 2016. We combine novel data and machine learning algorithms to identify a large number of integration events, spanning a wide range of markets with different competitive circumstances. We merge the integration events with claims data from a large national insurer to study their effects on prices. Focusing on childbirths, the most ubiquitous admission among the privately insured, we find that, on average, these mergers led to price increases for hospitals and physicians of 3.3% and 15.1%, respectively, with no discernible effects on quality measures. Using demand estimation to characterize substitution patterns for both physicians and hospitals, we construct tests that demonstrate price increases are larger among transactions with greater scope for foreclosure and recapture. Our estimates suggest that the costs of these mergers of hospitals and physicians have been substantial, and our mechanism tests offer guidance in predicting where the anticompetitive effects of non-horizontal mergers are likely to be strongest.

10.3386/w34039.abstractZh: 本文通过实证分析，研究了互补性企业之间的合并对竞争和定价的影响。随着这种非横向合并变得越来越普遍，人们越来越关注评估其潜在的效率提升，例如消除双重边缘化现象，以及潜在的反竞争效应，例如市场封锁和再捕获现象。我们研究的合并案例是医院收购医生诊所的行为，这一行为重塑了美国价值1万亿美元的医生行业，在2008年至2016年间，为医院工作的医生比例几乎翻了一番。我们结合新颖的数据和机器学习算法，识别出大量整合事件，这些事件发生在具有不同竞争环境的各种市场中。我们将这些整合事件与大型全国性保险公司的索赔数据相结合，以研究其对价格的影响。以私人保险中最为常见的分娩为例，我们发现，这些合并平均导致医院和医生的价格分别上涨了3.3%和15.1%，而对质量指标的影响则不明显。通过需求估计来描述医生和医院之间的替代模式，我们构建了测试，结果表明，在存在较大市场封锁和再捕获风险的情况下，价格涨幅更大。我们的估计表明，医院和医生之间的这种合并所带来的成本相当可观，而我们的机制测试为预测非横向合并的反竞争效应最强烈的情况提供了指导。

abstract.text: We examine the impact of temperature during the growing season on household diets in the subsequent year in rural India, a setting with a high prevalence of small family farms. High growing season temperatures reduce crop yields, which would presumably reduce incomes and home-grown food for consumption. However, household adaptation could mitigate how the reductions in yields affect diets. We find that heat increases the number of strongly undernourished households in the subsequent year, as measured by the consumption of calories, iron, zinc, thiamine, and niacin. We also find suggestive evidence that households adapt to heat-induced losses of home-grown crops by purchasing more food.

10.3386/w34047.abstractZh: 我们研究了印度农村在生长季节温度对次年家庭饮食的影响，该地区小型家庭农场非常普遍。生长季节的高温会降低作物产量，这可能会减少收入以及家庭自产食物的摄入。然而，家庭的适应能力可以减轻产量减少对饮食的影响。我们发现，高温会增加次年严重营养不良家庭的数量，这一情况可以通过热量、铁、锌、硫胺素和烟酸的摄入量来衡量。我们还发现，家庭会通过购买更多食物来应对因高温导致的自产作物损失。

abstract.text: We characterize the causal impact of having a child with Down syndrome relative to having one without Down syndrome using event studies around birth and population-wide Swedish administrative data from 1990 to 2019. The incremental effect of having a child with Down syndrome is to increase the likelihood of parental co-habitation and subsequent child-bearing. These effects exist both in an environment with essentially no prenatal testing – where the birth of a child with Down syndrome is random conditional on maternal age – as well as once prenatal screening and testing is more common. In both contexts, total income also increases due to the presence of a generous allowance for families with a child with a disability, but the impact on labor earnings differs. In the “no-testing” environment, having a child with Down syndrome leads to a greater decrease in maternal earnings post-birth relative to having a child without Down syndrome, but this effect reverses sign once testing is available. Our results speak to the impact on families of a child with Down syndrome in a setting where families are largely insured against any additional financial costs.

10.3386/w34064.abstractZh: 我们通过围绕出生事件的研究以及1990至2019年瑞典全国性的行政数据，来探讨生育唐氏综合征儿童与生育非唐氏综合征儿童之间的因果影响。生育唐氏综合征儿童所带来的影响是增加了父母同居以及后续生育的可能性。这种影响存在于几乎没有产前检测的环境之中——在这种情况下，唐氏综合征儿童的出生是随机发生的，取决于母亲的年龄——同时也存在于产前筛查和检测较为普遍的环境之中。在两种情况下，由于有针对残疾儿童的慷慨补贴，家庭的总收入也会增加，但劳动收入受到的影响有所不同。在“没有检测”的环境中，生育唐氏综合征儿童会导致母亲产后收入比生育非唐氏综合征儿童时减少更多，但一旦有了检测手段，这种影响就会逆转。我们的研究结果表明，在家庭基本能够抵御额外经济成本的情况下，生育唐氏综合征儿童对家庭的影响是显著的。

abstract.text: This paper shows that effective reskilling can have profound mental health benefits for workers and their partners. Using institutional variation in access to higher education after work accidents in Denmark, we find that reskilling prevents one case of depression for every three injured workers. Strikingly, the spillover effects on partners are just as large. These mental health gains are accompanied by higher partner employment and increased separation rates, suggesting that reskilling frees partners from costly relationship commitments. Together, the mental health and partner benefits add 83% to the direct labor earnings gains from reskilling.

10.3386/w34095.abstractZh: 本文表明，有效的再培训能够显著改善工人及其伴侣的心理健康状况。通过对丹麦工伤后接受高等教育机会的体制差异进行分析，我们发现，每有三名受伤工人接受再培训，就能防止一例抑郁症的发生。值得注意的是，这对伴侣的积极影响同样显著。这些心理健康方面的改善伴随着伴侣就业率的提升以及离婚率的降低，这表明再培训使伴侣免于承担昂贵的情感承诺。总体而言，心理健康和伴侣方面的益处直接增加了再培训带来的劳动收入增长的83%。

abstract.text: Using linked health insurance claims and malpractice lawsuit records from a Chinese city, we study how lawsuits shape physicians’ behavior. After a lawsuit, physicians practice more defensively––rejecting high-risk patients, reducing surgeries, and increasing diagnostic tests and traditional Chinese medicine––without improving patient outcomes. The effects spread to departments not named in the suit and dissipate within ten weeks. Evidence points to psychological rather than financial costs as the main drivers of defensive response: physicians respond similarly whether hospitals win or lose, and far more strongly to a nonfatal violent assault on a colleague. Our findings are also consistent with salience: departments clinically similar to the litigant department respond more strongly; responses do not vary with hospitals’ prior lawsuit exposure, and reactions to patient deaths depend on the recency of the last lawsuit. Overall, lawsuits trigger short-lived, mental-cost-driven defensive medicine.

10.3386/w34115.abstractZh: 我们利用中国某城市链接的医疗保险索赔记录和医疗事故诉讼记录，研究诉讼如何影响医生的行为。在诉讼之后，医生的行为变得更加防御性——拒绝治疗高风险患者、减少手术次数、增加诊断测试和中医治疗，但这些措施并未改善患者的治疗效果。这种影响会扩散到诉讼未涉及的科室，并在十周内消失。证据表明，心理成本而非经济成本是驱动防御性行为的的主要因素：无论医院胜诉还是败诉，医生的行为都相似，而对同事的非致命暴力攻击的反应则更为强烈。我们的研究结果也与显著性理论一致：与诉讼部门临床相似的科室反应更为强烈；医生的行为并不受医院之前是否发生过诉讼的影响，而对患者死亡的反应则取决于上一次诉讼的间隔时间。总体而言，诉讼引发了短暂且由心理成本驱动的防御性医疗行为。

abstract.text: Medicaid finances U.S. nursing home care through federal matching grants that reward verifiable volume, not quality. We show that states exploit this through creative financing, diverting funds earmarked for nursing homes. This turns the federal match into a pure volume subsidy and generates a novel allocative distortion we term public moral hazard. We develop the mechanism theoretically and test its predictions using 24 federal audits and administrative microdata from Indiana. Event studies show Medicaid dementia volume rises 12%; structural quality estimates show the expansion concentrates in the lowest-quality facilities, reallocating patients toward worse providers and reducing one-year survival.

10.3386/w34118.abstractZh: Medicaid通过联邦配套资金为美国的养老院护理提供资金，这些资金以可验证的投入量为奖励标准，而非服务质量。我们发现，各州通过创新的融资方式利用这一机制，将原本用于养老院的资金转移出去。这使得联邦配套资金变成了纯粹的投入补贴，并导致了一种我们称之为“公共道德风险”的新型分配扭曲现象。我们从理论上阐述了这一机制，并使用印第安纳州的24项联邦审计结果和行政微观数据来验证其预测结果。事件研究结果显示，Medicaid对痴呆症患者的投入增加了12%；结构质量分析表明，这种扩张主要集中在质量最差的设施中，导致患者被转移到质量更差的医疗机构，并降低了患者的一年生存率。

abstract.text: This chapter explores the multifaceted relationship between culture and health from an economic perspective, integrating insights from anthropology, psychology, and political science. It begins by examining how culture provides meaning to illness and suffering and explores how culturally grounded “disease theory systems” influence beliefs about what causes illness, how and whether suffering should be remedied, and the appropriate role of the state in allocating health care resources. The importance of culture in defining the boundary between normal and abnormal pathology is highlighted via case studies. The chapter next reviews evidence on how health behaviors such as smoking, firearm ownership, dietary practices, and reproductive decisions are influenced by cultural norms of masculinity and religiosity. Lastly, it examines how firms, governments, and civil society leverage and advance cultural narratives to influence individual behavior and public policy. Thus, culture in relation to health both naturally evolves and is actively constructed, with implications for health inequality and health policy.

10.3386/w34134.abstractZh: 本章从经济学的角度探讨了文化与健康之间的多方面关系，整合了人类学、心理学和政治学的见解。首先，本文探讨了文化如何为疾病和痛苦赋予意义，以及基于文化的“疾病理论体系”如何影响人们对疾病成因的认知、对痛苦的补救方式及补救与否的看法，以及国家在分配医疗资源方面的适当角色。通过案例研究，强调了文化在界定正常与异常病理界限方面的重要性。接下来，本文回顾了关于健康行为（如吸烟、持有枪支、饮食习惯和生育决策）如何受到男性气质和宗教性文化规范影响的证据。最后，本文探讨了企业、政府和民间社会如何利用文化叙事来影响个人行为和公共政策。因此，与文化相关的健康问题既具有自然演变的特性，也受到积极构建的影响，这对健康不平等和健康政策具有重要意义。

abstract.text: We study how couples in the Medicare Part D program choose an insurance plan. Over 70 percent of enrollees choose the same plan as their spouse. Even among those with differing healthcare needs, well over half do so. Discrete-choice models suggest beneficiaries value being on the same plan as their spouse at over a thousand dollars per year. Using a regression-discontinuity design, we show that younger spouses disproportionately follow their older spouse’s plan choice. Joint plan choice contributes modestly to overall overspending, but increases costs substantially for the couples with different cost-minimizing plans.

10.3386/w34137.abstractZh: 我们研究了Medicare Part D计划中的夫妻如何选择保险计划。超过70%的参保者选择与配偶相同的保险计划。即使是在有不同医疗需求的人群中，也有超过一半的人选择相同的保险计划。离散选择模型表明，受益人每年因与配偶使用相同保险计划而获得的价值超过一千美元。通过回归不连续设计，我们发现年轻的配偶更倾向于跟随年长配偶的保险计划选择。共同选择保险计划虽然对总体过度支出贡献不大，但对于那些成本最小化计划不同的夫妻来说，却会显著增加费用。

abstract.text: In 2019, the United States implemented new regulations for Organ Procurement Organizations (OPOs) aimed at increasing transparency and strengthening accountability. These rules introduced stronger performance incentives designed to improve organ procurement outcomes. This paper examines the impact of the reform on organ donations, transplant activity, and associated system costs, with a particular focus on kidneys, given their clinical characteristics and the structure of the reform’s organizational incentives. We estimate that the new policy led to an average increase of 7.13 kidneys procured per OPO per month, relative to a baseline mean of 24.78. The largest effects are observed among top-performing OPOs prior to the reform, with similar patterns for transplanted organs. Consistent with these findings, we document an overall rise in total OPO costs, with statistically significant increases concentrated among low-performing OPOs. Finally, we present a back-of-the-envelope calculation estimating the fiscal impact of the reform.

10.3386/w34140.abstractZh: 2019年，美国对器官采购组织实施了新的法规，旨在提高透明度并加强问责制。这些法规引入了更强的绩效激励措施，以改善器官采购效果。本文探讨了该改革对器官捐赠、移植活动及相关系统成本的影响，特别关注肾脏，因为肾脏具有独特的临床特性，且改革中的组织激励结构也与此相关。我们估计，新政策使每个器官采购组织每月平均可采购的肾脏数量增加了7.13个，相对于基线平均值24.78个。在改革前表现最佳的采购组织中，这种影响最为显著，移植器官的情况也呈现出类似的趋势。与这些发现一致的是，我们观察到整体器官采购组织成本有所上升，而统计上显著的增加主要集中在表现不佳的采购组织。最后，我们提供了估算该改革对财政影响的初步计算。

abstract.text: A common approach to markets with adverse selection is to regulate competition to minimize inefficiencies, while preserving consumer choice among different firms. We study the role of procurement auctions—leading to sole provision by the winning firm—as an alternative market design. Relative to competition, auctions affect product variety, quality, and markups, and remove cream-skimming incentives. We develop an empirical framework to study this comparison and apply it to individual health insurance in the US. We find that procurement auctions would increase consumer welfare in most markets, mainly by limiting inefficiencies from adverse selection and market power, while increasing quality.

10.3386/w34141.abstractZh: 对于存在逆向选择问题的市场，常见的做法是通过监管竞争来最小化效率低下现象，同时保留消费者在不同企业之间的选择权。我们研究了采购拍卖作为一种替代性市场设计的作用——这种拍卖方式通常导致唯一一家胜出企业提供产品或服务。与竞争方式相比，拍卖方式会影响产品的多样性、质量以及价格加成，并消除牟取暴利的动机。我们建立了一个实证框架来研究这种比较，并将其应用于美国的个人健康保险领域。研究发现，采购拍卖在大多数市场中都能提高消费者福利，主要是通过限制逆向选择和市场力量带来的效率低下问题，同时提升产品质量。

abstract.text: We estimate the impacts of large-scale unconditional cash transfers on child survival. One-time transfers of USD 1000 were provided to over 10,500 poor households across 653 randomized villages in Kenya. We collected census data on over 100,000 births, including on mortality and cause of death, and detailed data on health behaviors. Unconditional cash transfers (accounting for spillovers) lead to 48% fewer infant deaths before age one and 45% fewer child deaths before age five. These improvements appear to arise from better maternal health and nutrition, a 53% reduction in labor supply around the time of childbirth, and a 45% increase in hospital delivery. There is a transient 10% increase in fertility, but mortality reductions are largest in households receiving transfers after pregnancies began, ruling out selection bias. Mortality effects dissipate rapidly when cash is distributed more than three months from the birth. Mortality reductions are concentrated among households with limited (monetary) consumption gains, suggesting a trade-off between financial and health investments.

10.3386/w34152.abstractZh: 我们估算了大规模无条件现金转移对儿童生存的影响。在肯尼亚的653个随机选取的村庄中，超过10,500个贫困家庭获得了一次性1000美元的现金转移。我们收集了超过100,000例出生数据的普查资料，包括死亡率和死因信息，以及详细的健康行为数据。无条件现金转移（考虑了溢出效应）使1岁前婴儿死亡率降低48%，5岁前儿童死亡率降低45%。这些改善似乎源于更好的母婴健康与营养状况、分娩时劳动力供应减少53%，以及医院分娩率提高45%。虽然短期内生育率会上升10%，但死亡率的降低主要发生在接受现金转移的家庭在妊娠开始后，这排除了选择偏差的可能性。当现金在出生三个月后分发时，死亡率的降低效果会迅速消失。死亡率的降低主要集中在那些获得现金转移后货币消费收益有限的家庭，这表明在财务投资与健康投资之间存在权衡。

abstract.text: Health insurance lowers the out-of-pocket price of healthcare, and it is well-established that this leads to higher utilization of care. This manifestation of “moral hazard” is typically viewed as a social cost of insurance. Within a standard model, this paper shows that a consumer’s ability to change her behavior in response to insurance can also play a central role in the ability of insurance to protect her from risk. We provide a theoretical characterization of this channel and quantify its importance empirically. Under standard parameterizations and estimates in the literature, we find that insurance-induced healthcare utilization can account for more than half of the total value of risk protection derived from insurance. Preventing consumers from changing their behavior would lower healthcare spending, but also result in a major loss of risk protection, on-net reducing social welfare in some cases. Our results suggest that under-utilization of healthcare may thus be an equally important threat to welfare as over-utilization.

10.3386/w34156.abstractZh: 健康保险可以降低医疗服务的自付费用，而这一做法已被广泛证实会促进医疗服务的利用。这种“道德风险”的表现通常被视为保险的社会成本。在标准的模型框架内，本文指出，消费者根据保险情况改变其行为的能力，同样在保险保护其免受风险方面发挥着核心作用。我们对这一关系进行了理论分析，并通过实证数据量化了其重要性。根据文献中的标准参数设定和估计结果，我们发现保险引发的医疗服务利用可能占保险提供的风险保护总价值的半数以上。如果阻止消费者改变其行为，将会降低医疗支出，但同时也会造成重大的风险保护损失，在某些情况下甚至会导致社会福利的下降。我们的研究结果表明，医疗服务的利用不足可能与过度利用一样，对福利构成同等重要的威胁。

abstract.text: While numerous papers document the effects of mergers on cost and quality, the effects of hospital mergers on access to care are less certain. Merging hospitals may limit access by closing one of the affected hospitals or eliminating individual service lines. However, hospital systems may have more resources to improve care delivery. We study the impact of hospital mergers on obstetric care in rural markets, where there may be heightened concern about the availability of local care options. Using a differences-in-differences approach, we find that when rural hospitals are acquired, there are substantial increases in the probability of obstetric unit closures, with resulting large reductions in the number of births at the hospital. We find mixed effects on health outcomes: there are small increases in maternal morbidity, but no changes in newborn outcomes on average. However, there are improvements of newborns with Medicaid coverage. Additionally, we find decreases in maternal transfers and increases in procedures consistent with women delivering in more resourced hospitals.

10.3386/w34159.abstractZh: 虽然许多论文探讨了合并对成本和质量的影响，但医院合并对就医可及性的影响尚不明确。合并医院可能会通过关闭受影响的医院或取消个别服务线来限制就医可及性。然而，医院系统可能拥有更多资源来改善医疗服务。我们研究了医院合并对农村市场产科护理的影响，在这些地区，人们对当地医疗服务的可获得性可能更为关注。采用差异-差异方法分析后发现，当农村医院被收购时，产科病房关闭的概率显著上升，导致医院内的分娩数量大幅减少。我们对健康结果的影响持混合态度：孕产妇发病率略有上升，但新生儿的结局平均没有变化。不过，接受医疗补助的新生儿状况有所改善。此外，我们还发现，随着孕妇在资源更丰富的医院分娩，孕产妇转院次数减少，相关手术数量增加。

abstract.text: We compare care for Black versus white patients following pulse oximetry, a widely-used device for measuring blood oxygen levels which over-estimates oxygen saturation in darker-skinned patients. Black patients are therefore medically more appropriate for follow-up care than white patients with the same pulse oximetry reading. Yet, using data from the Veterans Health Administration on 3.5 million emergency department visits between 2014 and 2018, we find that Black patients systematically receive lower rates of follow-up care than white patients with the same reading. Our findings illustrate how bias in a medical screening device can be propagated and potentially amplified in downstream care.

10.3386/w34168.abstractZh: 我们比较了黑人和白人患者在脉搏血氧仪检测后的护理情况。脉搏血氧仪是一种广泛用于测量血氧水平的设备，但它会高估深色皮肤患者的血氧饱和度。因此，对于具有相同脉搏血氧仪检测结果的黑人和白人患者来说，黑人患者在医疗护理方面更合适。然而，根据美国退伍军人健康管理局在2014年至2018年间关于350万次急诊就诊的数据，我们发现黑人患者在相同检测结果下，后续护理的接受率明显低于白人患者。我们的研究结果表明，医疗筛查设备中的偏见可能会在下游护理过程中被放大。

abstract.text: Existing structural analyses of the harmful effects of market consolidation focus on either product or labor markets in isolation, ignoring that product market competitors often compete for workers as well. This paper develops a unified framework for merger evaluation, finding that firms’ simultaneous exercise of oligopoly power in the product market and oligopsony power in the labor market amplifies the harm from mergers to both consumers and workers. The model also demonstrates how merger-induced gains in labor market power incentivize firms to reduce product quality, highlighting an additional channel for consumer harm. The model’s predictions are tested and quantified in the context of the recent consolidation of the US hospital industry. Linking panel data from several sources on all US hospitals from 1996-2022, a difference-in-differences design is estimated for nearly 150 high-concentration within-market mergers. Hospital mergers significantly reduce patient volume, increase prices, reduce employment, lower wages, and deteriorate quality of care, resulting in higher patient mortality. After recovering the structural parameters, the estimated model replicates observed merger impacts. Counterfactual exercises reveal that ignoring increased labor (product) concentration would lead one to under-predict the harm of mergers to consumers (workers).

10.3386/w34180.abstractZh: 现有的关于市场整合危害效应的结构分析往往只关注产品或劳动力市场，而忽略了产品市场的竞争者通常也会在劳动力市场上竞争人才。本文提出了一个统一的合并评估框架，发现企业在产品市场行使寡头垄断力量，在劳动力市场行使寡头买方力量，这会加剧合并对消费者和工人的危害。模型还揭示了合并导致的劳动力市场力量增强如何促使企业降低产品质量，从而增加了对消费者的另一种危害途径。该模型的预测在美国医院行业近期整合的背景下得到了验证和量化。通过整合1996年至2022年间来自多个来源的美国医院面板数据，对近150起高集中度市场内合并事件进行了差异-差异设计的分析。医院合并显著减少了患者数量，提高了价格，减少了就业机会，降低了工资，并恶化了护理质量，导致患者死亡率上升。在恢复了结构参数后，估计的模型与观察到的合并影响一致。反事实分析表明，如果忽略劳动力（产品）集中度的增加，将会低估合并对消费者（工人）的危害。

abstract.text: The Drug-Free Communities (DFC) Support Program aims to reduce youth substance use by fostering multi-sector collaboration and implementing locally tailored strategies within the community. This study is among the first to evaluate the program’s impact on youth development outcomes in the United States. Using the Callaway and Sant’Anna (2021) difference-in-differences (CSDID) estimator, we find that the DFC program significantly reduces drug-related juvenile crime and improves academic performance. The effects are particularly pronounced in communities where coalitions include government agencies, highlighting the critical role of institutional coordination in mobilizing local resources. We also explore behavioral mechanisms, documenting reductions in marijuana use and opioid-related inpatient hospitalizations. A cost-benefit analysis indicates substantial welfare gains, suggesting that early-life prevention represents a cost-effective investment in public health.

10.3386/w34182.abstractZh: “无毒品社区支持计划”旨在通过促进多部门合作并在社区内实施因地制宜的策略，来减少青少年的物质使用。本研究是首批评估该计划对美国青少年发展影响的研究之一。利用Callaway和Sant’Anna（2021年）提出的差异-差异估计方法，我们发现该计划显著减少了与毒品相关的青少年犯罪，并提升了青少年的学业表现。在包含政府机构的联盟中，这些效果尤为明显，这凸显了机构协调在调动当地资源方面的重要性。我们还探讨了行为机制，发现大麻使用量和与阿片类药物相关的住院人数均有所减少。成本效益分析表明，早期预防对公共健康具有显著的好处，说明早期预防是一种具有成本效益的公共卫生投资。

abstract.text: The use of telemedicine has been on the rise. Although telemedicine has increased access to health care, little is known about how the medium changes providers’ medical decision-making. To evaluate how telemedicine differs from in-person care, we compare the quality and cost of in-person clinic visits and virtual visits over the phone for common conditions in Rwanda. To control for patient selection, we conduct an audit study with 2,532 standardized patient visits, where individuals portraying real patients presented standardized cases for malaria and upper respiratory infection (URI). We find that the quality of virtual care is higher than that of in-person care for URI and equally as good for malaria. Telemedicine providers also asked more questions about symptoms and medical history and prescribed more optional medicines for symptom management than in-person providers. We further find that telemedicine is more efficient than in-person care: virtual consultations were faster, had shorter wait times, resulted in fewer unnecessary medications and tests, and cost less for patients. Controlling for a rich set of provider characteristics, we show that provider selection does not appear to drive the results. Instead, better provider-patient communication over the phone emerges as a key mechanism. Providers report that it is easier to treat, get information from, and relate to patients over the phone. Providers also report feeling less social pressure during phone consultations. Consistent with survey evidence, we find that providers prescribe unnecessary antibiotics when asked by patients face-to-face, but not over the phone.

10.3386/w34185.abstractZh: 远程医疗的使用正在不断增加。尽管远程医疗提高了医疗服务的可及性，但关于这一方式如何改变医疗服务提供者的决策过程，我们知之甚少。为了评估远程医疗与面对面护理之间的差异，我们比较了卢旺达常见疾病情况下，面对面诊所就诊和电话虚拟就诊的质量和成本。为了控制患者选择的影响，我们进行了一项包含2,532次标准化患者就诊的审计研究，其中个体扮演真实患者，呈现了疟疾和上呼吸道感染的标准化病例。我们发现，对于上呼吸道感染而言，虚拟护理的质量高于面对面护理；对于疟疾而言，两者相当。远程医疗提供者还会询问更多关于症状和病史的问题，并开具更多用于症状管理的可选药物，相比之下，面对面提供者的做法较少。我们进一步发现，远程医疗比面对面护理更高效：虚拟咨询更快捷，等待时间更短，减少了不必要的药物和检查，且患者的费用更低。在控制了丰富的提供者特征后，我们发现提供者的选择似乎并不决定结果。相反，更好的电话提供者与患者沟通机制成为关键。提供者表示，通过电话治疗、获取信息以及与患者交流更为容易。此外，提供者还表示在电话咨询中感受到的社会压力较小。与调查结果一致，我们发现当患者面对面询问时，提供者会开具不必要的抗生素，但在电话中则不会。

abstract.text: In a large-scale field experiment, we tested low-cost methods to inform Medicaid enrollees with an imminent renewal deadline about available assistance. A phone call after written outreach (postcard or text message) increased Medicaid renewal by 1 percentage point, including among tribal members (by 4 pp), children (by 2 pp), lower-income people (1 pp), and people with chronic disease (by 2 pp). Variations in written outreach did not affect renewal outcomes. Over 20% of addresses or phone numbers were potentially incorrect. These data show administrative frictions reduce coverage, including for people with chronic disease, and provide practical lessons for outreaching beneficiaries.

10.3386/w34191.abstractZh: 在一项大规模实地实验中，我们测试了低成本的方法，以向即将面临续费截止日期的Medicaid参保者提供有关可用援助的信息。在书面宣传（明信片或短信）之后进行电话联系，能够将Medicaid的续费率提高1个百分点，其中部落成员（提高4个百分点）、儿童（提高2个百分点）、低收入人群（提高1个百分点）以及患有慢性疾病的人群（提高2个百分点）的续费率提升更为明显。书面宣传方式的不同并未对续费结果产生影响。超过20%的地址或电话号码可能存在错误。这些数据表明，行政上的障碍会降低覆盖范围，包括对患有慢性疾病的人群而言。这些发现为向受益人开展宣传工作提供了实际性的启示。

abstract.text: An old and debated line of research examines the income-mortality relationship and finds mixed evidence. In this paper, we re-evaluate previous studies using a new dataset and implementing a difference-in-difference model based on a Notch in Social Security retirement benefits to overcome selection and endogeneity issues. We employ Social Security Administration death records and find a positive income-longevity relationship. Moreover, we find more pronounced effects among low-educated individuals and people from low socioeconomic status families. Analyses using census data suggest that part of the reductions in retirement income are offset by wage income due to post-retirement labor force participation. Past age 80, the net adverse effects of the policy on both income and longevity become more pronounced.

10.3386/w34199.abstractZh: 一项历史悠久且备受争议的研究探讨了收入与死亡率之间的关系，研究结果存在争议。在本文中，我们采用新的数据集，并基于社会保障退休金中的“缺口”问题，运用差异-差异模型重新评估了以往的研究，以克服选择偏差和内生性问题。我们通过社会保障管理局的死亡记录发现，收入与寿命之间存在正相关关系。此外，我们发现低教育水平的人群以及来自低社会经济地位家庭的人群中，这种关系更为明显。使用人口普查数据的分析表明，退休收入的部分减少被退休后参与劳动力市场的工资收入所抵消。在80岁以后，该政策对收入和寿命的负面影响变得更加明显。

abstract.text: This study investigates consumer stated preferences for manufactured cigarettes, roll-your-own tobacco, and vapes in Türkiye, with a focus on how product attributes shape choices of adult consumers. A discrete choice experiment embedded in an online survey examines the role of prices of these products, flavor availability, and most importantly the legal status of vapes. Results indicate strong price sensitivity, both to own prices and to the prices of substitutes. In addition, legal status emerges as a critical factor that shapes stated preferences: consumers exhibit a marked aversion to products that are banned or sold illegally. However, scenario analyses suggest that vapes would capture a substantial market share even under strict prohibition. The hypothetical scenario of a complete ban would likely have a modest effect on the cessation of nicotine products while shifting choices toward traditional combustible tobacco products. These findings highlight the limits of prohibition and underscore the importance of regulatory design. In particular, the treatment of legal status, together with pricing and taxation policies, plays a decisive role in shaping consumer behavior and public health outcomes.

10.3386/w34201.abstractZh: 本研究调查了土耳其消费者对于制造香烟、自制烟草和电子烟的偏好，重点关注产品属性如何影响成年消费者的选择。通过在线调查中的离散选择实验，研究了这些产品的价格、口味可获得性，以及最为重要的电子烟的合法地位对消费者选择的影响。研究结果表明，消费者对于价格表现出强烈的敏感性，无论是自身产品的价格还是替代产品的价格。此外，合法地位成为影响消费者偏好的关键因素：消费者明显厌恶被禁止或非法销售的产品。然而，情景分析表明，即使在严格禁止的情况下，电子烟仍有可能占据相当大的市场份额。完全禁止的假设情景可能会对尼古丁产品的使用产生轻微影响，同时将消费者的选择转向传统的可燃烟草产品。这些发现凸显了禁令的局限性，并强调了监管设计的重要性。特别是，合法地位的处置方式，以及定价和税收政策，在塑造消费者行为和公共健康结果方面起着决定性作用。

abstract.text: There is increasing evidence on regional variations in US Medicare health care utilization based on older patients who move. Yet moving for the elderly population is typically endogenous, and evidence is limited for younger populations. In this paper, we harness the mandatory migration of military personnel to estimate supply and demand factors in a system of care for younger enrollees in which military physicians are salaried and copayments and deductibles are negligible. Our preferred estimates imply that supply effects explain between one-half and two-thirds of overall regional variation. These variations cannot be explained by differences in quality of care, but appear consistent with location-specific differences in physician beliefs.

10.3386/w34204.abstractZh: 越来越多的证据表明，美国Medicare医疗服务的利用存在地区差异，这主要与老年人迁移有关。然而，老年人迁移通常是内生的现象，而对于年轻人群的相关证据则较为有限。在本文中，我们利用军人强制迁移的现象来估算年轻参保者的医疗服务系统中的供需因素，其中军人医生获得固定工资，且共付额和免赔额可以忽略不计。我们的估算结果显示，供应因素可以解释整体地区差异的半数到三分之二。这些差异并非由医疗服务质量的差异所导致，而是与特定地区的医生观念差异相一致。

abstract.text: We investigate missing markets for innovation: contexts where intellectual property rights necessary to incentivize research investment are either unavailable or unenforceable. A simple theoretical model formalizes the conditions that yield missing investment. We identify an empirical setting—research into new uses for existing drugs— with sharp variation in the enforceability of intellectual property rights on comparable inventions. We show that when intellectual property rights become unenforceable, research investment and commercialization nearly cease. Estimates of the value of this missing investment are in the trillions of dollars. We discuss the implications of these findings for the design of innovation policy.

10.3386/w34222.abstractZh: 我们研究了创新领域的缺失市场：即那些无法获得或无法执行知识产权以激励研究投资的情境。一个简单的理论模型阐述了导致投资缺失的条件。我们确定了一个实证案例——对现有药物的新用途的研究，其中知识产权的可执行性在可比发明上存在显著差异。研究表明，当知识产权变得无法执行时，研究投资和商业化几乎会停止。这种缺失投资的价值估计达到数万亿美元。我们讨论了这些发现对创新政策设计的影响。

abstract.text: Can economic tools help inform the puzzlingly low rate of flu vaccination? Existing interventions focus on misinformation or nudges, not preferences over or beliefs about vaccine characteristics. Using an online experiment, we find a key role for effectiveness and short-run side-effects: equalizing only beliefs and preferences about these characteristics nearly eliminates the vaccination-intention gap between the vaccine hesitant and confident. Fear of needles, inconvenience, and perceived long run health risks play smaller roles. The vaccine hesitant hold pessimistic but plausible beliefs about effectiveness but greatly overestimate side-effect risks. We estimate the impact of correcting inaccurate beliefs and potential subsidies on vaccination rates.

10.3386/w34230.abstractZh: 经济工具能否帮助解释流感疫苗接种率如此之低的谜题？现有的干预措施主要集中在错误信息或激励上，而非人们对疫苗特性的偏好或信念。通过在线实验，我们发现有效性和短期副作用起着关键作用：仅平等化人们对这些特性的信念和偏好，就能几乎消除犹豫不决者与坚定支持者之间的疫苗接种意愿差距。对针头的恐惧、不便以及感知到的长期健康风险的作用较小。犹豫不决者往往持有悲观但合理的疫苗有效性信念，同时严重高估了副作用的风险。我们估算了纠正错误信念和提供潜在补贴对疫苗接种率的影响。

abstract.text: This paper examines how people adjust their time use when they experience an increase in time spent alone, which is a growing share of adults’ lives. We utilize the dramatic rise in remote work following the onset of the pandemic, which is associated with a large decline in time spent in the physical presence of non-household members during the workday, to observe the extent to which individuals substitute toward more in-person interactions in non-work settings. We first document that on days that individuals work from home, they spend 3.5 additional hours in activities spent entirely alone and over 5 fewer hours in activities that include any non-household members. We then use a difference-in-difference strategy to ask what happens to time allocations when workers are induced toward remote work by analyzing changes over time in how workers in teleworkable occupations—who experienced the lion’s share of the post-COVID increase in remote work—spend their time relative to workers in non-teleworkable occupations. Averaging over all days of the week, we see a relative increase in time spent in activities spent entirely alone by 32 minutes and a decrease in activities that include any non-household members by 38 minutes for workers in teleworkable jobs. Normalizing by the increase in average daily remote work time (46 minutes), these estimates are of a similar magnitude to what we observe in our descriptive analysis. When individuals are induced to work from home, they exhibit almost no substitution toward spending more time with others who are not in their household to make up for the loss of time with others at work.

10.3386/w34239.abstractZh: 本文探讨了当人们经历独处时间增加时，他们如何调整自己的时间使用方式。随着疫情的发生，远程工作的比例不断增加，这导致在工作日中，人们与非家庭成员面对面交流的时间大幅减少。我们利用这一现象来观察个体在非工作环境中替代面对面交流的时间使用情况。首先，我们发现当个体在家工作时，他们独自进行活动的时间增加了3.5小时，而包含非家庭成员的活动时间则减少了5小时以上。随后，我们采用差异-差异策略，通过分析可远程工作的职业人员在疫情后远程工作时间的增长情况，来研究当劳动者被诱导进行远程工作时，他们的时间分配发生了哪些变化。平均而言，每周的某些日子里，可远程工作的职业人员在完全独自进行的活动中花费的时间增加了32分钟，而包含非家庭成员的活动时间则减少了38分钟。考虑到平均每日远程工作时间的增加（46分钟），这些估计值与我们的描述性分析结果相当。当个体被诱导在家工作时，他们几乎没有替代与家庭以外的人进行更多互动的时间，以弥补在工作时与他人互动时间的减少。

abstract.text: We study how abortion access affects economic hardship and crime. Using a database of abortion provider locations and operations in Texas from 2009–2019, we exploit variation in travel distance to the nearest facility created by clinic closures following the enforcement of Texas HB-2 in 2013. We confirm previous evidence that increased distance to the nearest abortion facility reduces abortions and increases births. We provide novel evidence that reduced access to abortion also leads to significant economic hardship, reflected in lower labor force participation, rising debt, widening income inequality, and heightened housing insecurity. This financial strain translates into higher rates of financially motivated crime, such as theft and burglary, with no detectable effect on aggregate violent crime. These effects are consistent with economic hardship that extends beyond directly affected individuals to the broader household and community. These findings suggest far-reaching consequences of restricted access to reproductive healthcare.

10.3386/w34245.abstractZh: 我们研究了堕胎服务的获取如何影响经济困境和犯罪率。通过利用2009至2019年间德克萨斯州堕胎机构的位置和运营数据，我们分析了2013年德克萨斯州HB-2法案实施后诊所关闭导致前往最近堕胎机构的距离发生变化的情况。我们的研究证实了先前的研究结果，即距离最近的堕胎机构越远，堕胎次数就越少，而出生人数则会增加。此外，我们还发现，堕胎服务的获取受限还会导致严重的经济困境，表现为劳动力参与率下降、债务增加、收入不平等加剧以及住房安全问题恶化。这种经济压力会导致以经济动机为目标的犯罪率上升，如盗窃和入室盗窃等，而对总体暴力犯罪率则没有明显影响。这些效应表明，经济困境的影响不仅限于直接受影响的个人，还波及更广泛的家庭和社区。这些发现揭示了限制生殖健康服务的获取所带来的深远影响。

abstract.text: This paper considers quantile-welfare evaluation of social welfare as an alternative to utilitarian evaluation. Maximization of quantile utility has previously been studied as a model of individual decision making under uncertainty, whose properties differ from maximization of expected utility. Particularly noteworthy is that individual maximization of quantile utility requires only an ordinal formalization of utility, not a cardinal one. This paper concerns analysis of social planning rather than individual decision making. We first summarize basic welfare-economic properties of quantile welfare in general terms. We then turn attention to health cost-effectiveness analysis and consider measurement and econometric issues arising in this important applied context. We propose a procedure to nonparametrically bound the quantile welfare of health states using data from binary-choice time-tradeoff (TTO) experiments of the type regularly performed by health economists.

10.3386/w34247.abstractZh: 本文探讨了以分位数福利评估作为功利主义评估的替代方案。以往的研究将分位数效用最大化视为个体在不确定性下的决策模型，其性质与期望效用最大化有所不同。值得注意的是，个体分位数效用的最大化仅需要序数的效用形式化，而非基数形式化。本文关注的是社会规划的分析，而非个体决策。我们首先概述了分位数福利的一般性福利-经济属性。随后，我们转向健康成本效益分析，并探讨了这一重要应用背景下的测量和计量经济学问题。我们提出了一种非参数化方法，利用健康经济学家经常进行的二元选择时间权衡实验数据来估算健康状态的分位数福利。

abstract.text: An important but poorly understood way that economic development may influence health is through the private incentives that it creates for individuals to invest in their own health. In this paper, we study how individuals' forward-looking health investments respond to changes in expected future (but not current) wealth. Focusing on institutional features of Chile's public pension overhaul in 1981, we link administrative microdata to a detailed household panel survey, and we then exploit discrete breaks in the resulting cohort pension wealth profile using a fuzzy regression kink design (RKD). Although theoretically ambiguous, empirically we find that greater expected pension wealth increases the use of important preventive medical care (and to a lesser extent, promotes more costly healthy lifestyle behaviors) – leading to measurable increases in chronic disease diagnosis (a requisite for appropriate disease management), reductions in disease prevalence, and measurably lower mortality in old age (particularly due to chronic diseases). In general, these results provide new evidence that economic development can have a meaningful incentive effect on health.

10.3386/w34249.abstractZh: 经济发展对健康影响的一个重要但被忽视的途径，是通过其为个人提供投资自身健康的私人激励。本文研究个人对未来健康的投资如何响应预期未来财富的变化（而非当前财富）。以1981年智利公共养老金改革中的制度特征为研究对象，我们将行政微观数据与详细的家庭面板调查相结合，并利用模糊回归断裂设计来分析由此产生的群体养老金财富状况的变化。尽管从理论上来看存在不确定性，但实证研究表明，更高的预期养老金财富会增加重要预防性医疗服务的使用（在较小程度上，也会促进更昂贵的健康生活方式行为），从而带来慢性疾病诊断数量的显著增加（这是适当疾病管理的前提）、疾病发病率的降低，以及老年死亡率的显著降低（尤其是由于慢性疾病导致的）。总体而言，这些结果提供了新的证据，表明经济发展能够对健康产生有意义的激励效应。

abstract.text: We study the effects of state paid sick leave (PSL) mandates on mental healthcare use. To do so, we use all-payer health insurance claims data from IQVIA 2015-2022 combined with difference-in-differences methods. Findings suggest that overall mental healthcare use does not change post-PSL mandate. The null finding overall masks clinically relevant changes along the intensive margin: patients substitute away from lower levels of care to higher levels of care as time constraints are relaxed. Further, analysis of survey data hints that this change in treatment use improves mental health.

10.3386/w34254.abstractZh: 我们研究了州政府规定的带薪病假政策对心理健康医疗服务使用的影响。为此，我们使用了IQVIA在2015-2022年间提供的全保健康保险索赔数据，并结合差异-差异方法进行分析。研究结果表明，在带薪病假政策实施后，心理健康医疗服务的整体使用并未发生变化。不过，这一结论掩盖了在重症监护边缘出现的临床相关变化：随着时间限制的解除，患者会转向更高水平的医疗服务。此外，对调查数据的分析表明，这种治疗方式的转变有助于改善心理健康。

abstract.text: A county’s fraction of adults in 1990 on Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) is a strong predictor of growth in local drug death rates after 2000. The part of the SSDI rate related to drug deaths is not proxying for well-known contributors to the drug crisis, e.g. OxyContin. Instead, it appears to capture the fraction of people in chronic pain. We show that in the late 1990s, physicians began prescribing opioids more aggressively to treat pain. Taken together, our estimates suggest that drug deaths rates would be 43% lower in 2015 had prescribing practices stayed at 1995 levels.

10.3386/w34265.abstractZh: 1990年，一个县拥有社会保障残疾保险资格的成年人比例，是2000年后当地药物死亡率增长的强预测因子。与药物死亡相关的社会保障残疾保险资格比例，并非代表那些众所周知的导致药物危机的因素，例如奥施康定。相反，它似乎反映了慢性疼痛患者所占的比例。我们的研究表明，在1990年代末，医生开始更积极地使用阿片类药物来治疗疼痛。综合来看，我们的估计表明，如果处方行为保持在1995年的水平，2015年的药物死亡率将降低43%。

abstract.text: Using individual-level data from the Add Health surveys, we leverage idiosyncratic variation in gender composition across cohorts within the same school to examine whether being exposed to a higher share of female peers affects mental health and school satisfaction. We find that being exposed to a higher proportion of female peers, despite only improving school satisfaction for boys, improves mental health for both boys and girls. The benefits are greater among boys of low socioeconomic backgrounds, who would otherwise be more likely to be exposed to violent and disruptive peers. We find suggestive evidence that the mechanisms driving our findings are consistent with stronger school friendships for boys and better self-image and grades for girls.

10.3386/w34269.abstractZh: 利用Add Health调查中的个体级数据，我们利用同一所学校内不同队列中性别构成的独特差异，来研究接触更多女性同龄人是否会影响心理健康和学校满意度。我们发现，尽管接触更多女性同龄人仅能改善男孩的学校满意度，但也能改善男孩和女孩的心理健康。这种好处在低社会经济背景的男孩身上更为明显，因为这类男孩更容易接触到暴力或具有破坏性的同龄人。我们发现，导致这些结果的机制与男孩之间更牢固的校友情以及女孩更好的自我形象和成绩相一致。

abstract.text: This paper provides the first nationwide U.S. evidence on the effects of electric vehicle (EV) adoption on air quality and child health. Using county-level data from 2010–2021, we link EV registrations to air pollution, birth outcomes, and emergency department visits. Endogenous adoption is addressed using two-way fixed effects and an instrumental variables strategy exploiting the rollout of federally designated Alternative Fuel Corridors. Greater EV adoption significantly lowers nitrogen dioxide and improves infant and child health, reducing very low birth weight, prematurity, and asthma-related emergency visits. The largest health gains occur in high-pollution areas and exceed $1.2–$4.0 billion annually.

10.3386/w34278.abstractZh: 本文首次提供了关于电动汽车采用对空气质量及儿童健康影响的全国性美国数据。通过2010至2021年的县级数据，我们将电动汽车注册量与空气污染、出生结果以及急诊就诊情况进行了关联分析。采用双向固定效应模型和工具变量策略，结合联邦指定的替代燃料走廊的推广情况，来研究电动汽车采用的影响。研究发现，电动汽车的广泛采用显著降低了二氧化氮浓度，并改善了婴儿和儿童的健康状况，减少了极低出生体重、早产以及与哮喘相关的急诊就诊情况。在污染严重的地区，这种健康效益最为显著，每年带来的经济效益超过12亿至40亿美元。

abstract.text: While policymakers routinely limit the sale of goods thought to be of risk to public health, relatively less is known about whether and how these policies affect firm performance. Using 2000-2018 National Establishment Time-Series data and a difference-in-differences strategy, we show that state “pill mill” laws intended to reduce the overprescribing of opioids reduced retail pharmacy sales and employment. These reductions were most pronounced in highly competitive areas and for standalone pharmacies – two characteristics associated with pharmacy drug diversion. Meanwhile, pharmacies located across the border in states without a pill mill law experienced increases in sales and employment. Next, we show that state pill mill laws were associated with an increase in standalone pharmacy closures, though the total number of pharmacies was unchanged. Our results are consistent with these laws adversely affecting pharmacies filling inappropriate opioid prescriptions without meaningfully altering patient access to retail pharmacies.

10.3386/w34281.abstractZh: 虽然政策制定者通常会限制被认为对公共健康有风险的商品的销售，但关于这些政策是否以及如何影响企业绩效，我们知之甚少。利用2000-2018年的全国企业时间序列数据，并采用差异-差异策略，我们发现旨在减少阿片类药物过度处方的州级“药丸工厂”法律减少了零售药店的销售额和就业人数。这些减少在竞争激烈的地区和独立药店中最为明显——这两个特征与药品滥用行为有关。与此同时，位于没有药丸工厂法律的州境内的药店则经历了销售额和就业人数的增加。此外，我们还发现，州级药丸工厂法律与独立药店的关闭数量增加有关，尽管药店的总数并未发生变化。我们的研究结果表明，这些法律对药店产生了负面影响，但并未显著改善患者获得零售药店服务的机会。

abstract.text: We quantify the impact of perceived cancer risk on housing values using widely advertised national reclassifications of chemical carcinogenicity in the United States. Combining these information events with an empirical design that compares changes in house values closer to affected toxic plants against those farther away isolates the effect of cancer risk news from other local factors. Focusing on plants previously emitting reclassified carcinogenic chemicals, we estimate a 1-2% decline in housing values within a 3-mile radius compared to those located farther away. The effects are stronger in areas with higher media presence underscoring the role of salience as a mechanism.

10.3386/w34305.abstractZh: 我们通过美国广泛宣传的化学致癌性重新分类数据，量化了感知到的癌症风险对房价的影响。将这些信息事件与实证设计相结合，比较了受受影响的有毒植物附近房价的变动与远离这些植物的房价的变动，从而将癌症风险新闻的影响与其他当地因素区分开来。针对之前释放重新分类的致癌化学物质的植物，我们估计在3英里范围内，房价会下降1-2%。在媒体关注度较高的地区，这种影响更为明显，这进一步证明了显著性作为影响房价机制的作用。

abstract.text: This paper studies how product market competition shapes the impact of private equity (PE) acquisitions on consumers. We examine nursing home buyouts and observe that PE-owned facilities exhibit greater competitive sensitivity: competing more aggressively when competitive incentives are strong and exploiting market power more aggressively when competitive incentives are weak. We find that PE-owned facilities are more sensitive to local market competition—even when comparing effects only across facilities purchased as part of the same acquisition—and are more responsive to a pro-competitive policy helping consumers compare facilities. This suggests that regulators should attend to the competitive sensitivity of acquirers and the concentration of markets where acquisitions occur, as well as consider pro-competitive policies to mitigate or even reverse PE’s potentially adverse consequences.

10.3386/w34306.abstractZh: 本文研究了产品市场竞争如何影响私募股权收购对消费者的影响。我们研究了养老院收购的情况，发现由私募股权公司拥有的机构表现出更强的竞争敏感性：在竞争激励较强的环境下，这些机构会采取更激进的竞争策略；而在竞争激励较弱的情况下，它们则会更积极地利用市场力量。我们发现，由私募股权公司拥有的机构对当地市场竞争更为敏感——即使是在同一收购过程中购买的多个机构之间进行比较时也是如此。此外，这些机构对于有助于消费者比较不同机构的亲竞争政策也更为敏感。这表明，监管机构应当关注收购方的竞争敏感性以及收购发生市场的集中度，并考虑实施亲竞争政策来减轻甚至逆转私募股权公司可能带来的负面影响。

abstract.text: Satellite imagery and machine learning (SIML) are increasingly being combined to remotely measure social and environmental outcomes, yet use of this technology has been limited by insufficient understanding of its strengths and weaknesses. Here, we undertake the most extensive effort yet to characterize the potential and limits of using a SIML technology to measure ground conditions. We conduct 115 standardized large-scale experiments using a composite high-resolution optical image of Earth and a generalizable SIML technology to evaluate what can be accurately measured and where this technology struggles. We find that SIML alone predicts roughly half the variation in ground measurements on average, and that variables describing human society (e.g. female literacy, R²=0.55) are generally as easily measured as natural variables (e.g. bird diversity, R²=0.55). Patterns of performance across measured variable type, space, income and population density indicate that SIML can likely support many new applications and decision-making use cases, although within quantifiable limits.

10.3386/w34315.abstractZh: 卫星图像和机器学习技术正越来越多地被结合使用，以远程测量社会和环境状况。然而，由于对这两种技术的优势和劣势了解不足，其应用一直受到限制。本研究是我们迄今为止最为广泛的研究，旨在评估使用机器学习技术测量地面状况的潜力和局限性。我们进行了115项标准化的大规模实验，利用高分辨率地球光学图像和通用的机器学习技术，来评估哪些数据可以被准确测量，以及该技术在哪些方面存在困难。研究发现，机器学习技术平均可以预测大约一半的地面测量数据变化，而描述人类社会的变量（例如女性识字率，R²=0.55）通常也像自然变量一样容易被测量（例如鸟类多样性，R²=0.55）。根据测量变量的类型、空间、收入以及人口密度等因素，我们发现机器学习技术很可能支持许多新的应用和决策场景，尽管这些应用和场景都需要在可量化的范围内进行。

abstract.text: Immunotherapy is a breakthrough innovation in cancer care but is also among the most expensive treatments, with costs exceeding $150,000 per patient. We study the introduction of immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs), the most widely used class of immunotherapy drugs. In 2022, ICIs accounted for 44% of the $17.5 billion Medicare Part B cancer drug spending. We focus on metastatic melanoma, the first approved indication for ICIs. While overall cancer mortality rates declined since the 1990s, melanoma mortality rates increased through the early 2010s. Following the first ICI approvals in 2011 and 2014, melanoma mortality declined sharply. Using traditional Medicare claims, we estimate the impact of the introduction of ICIs on healthcare utilization, costs, and 1-year survival for patients with metastatic melanoma, relative to metastatic colorectal cancer (CRC), where ICIs were not approved until 2017. Variation in approval timing allows us to isolate the effect of ICIs from broader cancer care trends. We find that ICIs reduced 1-year mortality by 6.2%. Since about 1 in 5 metastatic melanoma patients received ICIs, this implies a 27.5% reduction among treated patients. The introduction of ICIs also reduced chemotherapy and radiation use, but increased Medicare spending by 59.3% or about 260% among ICI-treated patients. Accounting for life expectancy gains beyond one year, the benefits of ICIs for melanoma patients appear comparable, or potentially even greater, than the substantial added Medicare costs. Nonetheless, ICI use remains relatively low given large survival benefits and few alternative treatments, suggesting that costs and other barriers limit patient access.

10.3386/w34317.abstractZh: 免疫疗法是癌症治疗领域的重大突破，但也是成本最高的治疗方法之一，每位患者的治疗费用超过15万美元。我们研究了免疫检查点抑制剂的引入情况，这类药物是最常用的免疫疗法药物。2022年，免疫检查点抑制剂占Medicare Part B癌症药物支出的44%，总额达175亿美元。我们重点关注转移性黑色素瘤，这是免疫检查点抑制剂首次被批准用于的适应症。虽然自1990年代以来癌症的整体死亡率有所下降，但转移性黑色素瘤的死亡率在2010年代初有所上升。在2011年和2014年首次批准免疫检查点抑制剂后，转移性黑色素瘤的死亡率显著下降。通过传统的Medicare报销数据，我们估算了免疫检查点抑制剂的引入对转移性黑色素瘤患者医疗利用、成本以及1年生存率的影响，与未获批准免疫检查点抑制剂的转移性结直肠癌相比，免疫检查点抑制剂的引入带来了显著的效果。免疫检查点抑制剂的引入时间差异使我们能够将其效果与更广泛的癌症治疗趋势区分开来。我们发现，免疫检查点抑制剂使1年死亡率降低了6.2%。由于大约五分之一的转移性黑色素瘤患者接受了免疫检查点抑制剂治疗，这意味着接受治疗的患者死亡率降低了27.5%。免疫检查点抑制剂的引入还减少了化疗和放疗的使用，但使接受治疗的患者的Medicare支出增加了59.3%，即约260%。考虑到一年后的预期寿命有所提高，免疫检查点抑制剂对黑色素瘤患者的益处似乎与巨大的Medicare支出相当，甚至可能更大。尽管如此，鉴于巨大的生存益处和较少的替代治疗方法，免疫检查点抑制剂的使用仍然相对较低，这表明成本和其他障碍限制了患者的使用。

abstract.text: This paper contributes to the literature on the impact of early-life health on education by estimating the effect of genetic predisposition to a higher body mass index (BMI) on educational attainment and related outcomes. The identification strategy exploits the randomness in which genes one inherits from one's parents by estimating sibling fixed effects models of the polygenic score for a higher BMI. These models are estimated using rich administrative data from Denmark for over 14,000 full siblings. We find that a one-standard-deviation increase in the genetic predisposition to a higher BMI is associated with a 1.4 percentage point (4.4%) lower probability of earning a high school diploma, a 1.7 percentage point (12.3%) lower probability of a college degree, and a 1.7 percentage point (3.7%) higher probability of vocational training. An investigation into mechanisms suggests that youth with a greater genetic predisposition to a higher BMI are more likely to report being bullied, have greater school absences, and lower test scores.

10.3386/w34322.abstractZh: 本文通过估计遗传倾向导致较高体重指数（BMI）对教育成就及相关结果的影响，为关于早期健康对教育影响的文献做出了贡献。研究采用了一种利用父母遗传基因随机性的识别策略，通过估计多基因评分模型来探讨较高BMI的遗传倾向。这些模型是基于丹麦超过14,000对全兄弟姐妹的丰富行政数据进行的估计。研究发现，遗传倾向导致较高BMI的偏差值为1个标准差时，获得高中毕业文凭的概率会降低1.4个百分点（4.4%），获得大学学位的概率会降低1.7个百分点（12.3%），而接受职业培训的概率则会提高1.7个百分点（3.7%）。进一步机制分析表明，具有较高BMI遗传倾向的青少年更有可能遭受欺凌、缺课次数更多，以及测试成绩较低。

abstract.text: We use detailed data on the evolution of health for about 0.8 million Black and 5.4 million white nursing home patients covered by Medicare between 2011 and 2019 to estimate race-specific value-added measures for more than 8,000 nursing homes in the United States. We estimate that the average nursing home value-added experienced by Black patients is about 30% lower than that received by white patients. Most of this gap reflects differences in value-added experienced by similar Black and white patients within the same nursing home, rather than differences in value-added across the nursing homes they go to.

10.3386/w34324.abstractZh: 我们利用2011年至2019年间约80万黑人患者和540万白人患者入住医疗保险覆盖的养老院的健康数据，估算了美国8000多家养老院中不同种族患者的增值情况。研究结果显示，黑人患者入住养老院所体验的平均增值约为白人患者的一半。这一差距主要源于同一养老院内黑人患者与白人患者所体验的增值存在差异，而非不同养老院之间的增值差异。

abstract.text: For difference-in-differences methods, there has been great attention to obtaining consistent estimates of treatment effects, especially when the treatment effects are heterogeneous. However, there has been little discussion of the importance of weights in aggregating those treatment effects into an overall average treatment effect on the treated. There are many possible ways to aggregate estimated cohort-time treatment effects. We show that the standard software used to estimate Callaway and Sant’Anna’s method uses weights that are not just the number of treated observations in treated years. Instead, the software uses weights that include the number of observations in the reference pre-period instead of only the number of observations in the treated periods. We discuss why the aggregation weights matter and under what circumstances the weights make the most difference.

10.3386/w34331.abstractZh: 在差异-差异方法中，人们非常关注如何获得一致的处理效应估计值，尤其是在处理效应存在异质性的情况下。然而，对于在汇总这些处理效应以得到对受处理者整体的平均处理效应时，权重的重要性却鲜有讨论。有多种方法可以用来汇总估计的队列时间处理效应。我们发现，用于估计Callaway和Sant’Anna方法的标准软件所使用的权重并非仅仅是处理年份中受处理者的观测数量。相反，该软件使用的权重包含了参考前期中的观测数量，而不仅仅是处理期中的观测数量。我们探讨了为什么汇总权重如此重要，以及在什么情况下这些权重会产生最大的影响。

abstract.text: Over one third of children in the U.S. are investigated by the child protection system (CPS) by age 18, but the effects of this interaction on families and children are largely unknown. Investigations aim to protect children from harm and direct services to families in need. However, they also bring the implicit threat of child removal, which can generate both stress and institutional distrust among affected families. Using a regression discontinuity design, we study the impacts of this interaction on child health. Children who are just above the threshold for being “defaulted” into an investigation see a reduction in injuries and an increase in preventative care in the two months following the referral. Effects are consistent across child gender, race and age. Finally, investigations increase the likelihood that a parent is jailed, suggesting that investigations also detect criminal activity within the home. An exploration of mechanisms suggests that it is the investigation, rather than home removal or parental criminal justice system involvement, which improves child health.

10.3386/w34334.abstractZh: 在美国，超过三分之一的儿童在18岁之前会接受儿童保护系统的调查。然而，这种干预措施对家庭和儿童的影响尚不清楚。调查的目的是保护儿童免受伤害，并将服务直接提供给有需要的家庭。然而，这种干预也隐含着将儿童带走的风险，这可能会给受影响的家庭带来压力和制度性不信任。我们使用回归不连续设计来研究这种干预对儿童健康的影响。那些处于“默认调查”门槛之上的儿童，在转诊后的两个月内，受伤情况有所减少，预防性护理也有所增加。这些效果在不同性别、种族和年龄的儿童中都是一致的。此外，调查还增加了父母被监禁的可能性，这表明调查也能够发现家庭内部的犯罪活动。对机制的探讨表明，改善儿童健康的因素是调查本身，而不是家庭被带走或父母参与刑事司法系统。

abstract.text: Cities across America are adopting civilian crisis response programs as alternatives to traditional policing, yet causal evidence on their impact and cost-effectiveness is scarce. This paper evaluates Durham, North Carolina’s HEART program, which diverts nonviolent 911 calls from police. Using a difference-in-differences design, we find that HEART reduces crime reports, arrests, and response times—primarily through civilian phone and in-person responses, rather than police-civilian co-responses. The program increases future 911 calls, which suggests it fosters public trust. Based on an original contingent valuation survey and applying the marginal value of public funds framework, we conclude that HEART is a fiscally self-sustainable intervention.

10.3386/w34344.abstractZh: 美国的城市正在采用平民危机应对计划作为传统警务的替代方案，但关于这些计划的影响和成本效益的实证证据却很少。本文评估了北卡罗来纳州达勒姆市的HEART计划，该计划将非暴力报警电话从警方转接至平民。通过差异-差异设计，我们发现HEART计划减少了犯罪报告、逮捕次数和响应时间——主要是通过平民电话和亲自响应，而非警方与平民的联合响应。该计划增加了未来的报警电话数量，这表明它有助于增强公众信任。基于一项原创的边际价值评估调查，并运用公共资金边际价值框架，我们得出结论：HEART计划是一种经济上可自我维持的干预措施。

abstract.text: This research considers the role of income for subjective longevity assessments. The analysis uses the 2022 Survey of Consumer Finances. My findings indicate that treating subjective health and longevity assessments as jointly determined is important to understanding the role of income for both judgments. Income has a positive effect on health judgments and does not have a statistically significant effect on subjective longevity when health is rated as excellent or good. Surveys framing the longevity question in direct or probabilistic terms may have complementary roles in estimating subjective longevity.

10.3386/w34347.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了收入在主观寿命评估中的作用。分析采用了2022年消费者财务调查数据。我的研究结果表明，将主观健康和寿命评估视为相互影响的变量，对于理解收入对这两种评估的影响至关重要。收入对健康评估有积极影响，但在健康被评为优秀或良好时，对主观寿命的影响并不显著。以直接或概率方式提出寿命问题的调查，可能在估算主观寿命方面发挥互补作用。

abstract.text: Empirical research has revolutionized how we understand the global economic impacts of climate change. Recent empirical analyses have tested theoretical ideas, challenged prior estimates, and revealed important and unexpected impacts. Further, the credibility and replicability of empirical results have played a critical role in guiding high-stakes climate policies. Here, I describe the landscape of empirical economic research on global impacts, I explain elements of modern analyses, I summarize recent findings on a range of topics, and I point towards promising new areas of investigation. In particular, I focus on empirical perspectives for six “grand challenges” in the field: understanding climate change’s global impact on economic output, health, conflict, food security, disasters, and migration. Overall, I argue that interwoven empirical findings across outcomes are aligning to paint an increasingly coherent picture of a future global economy impacted by climate change. Taking the literature as a whole, the global consequences of unmitigated climate change are likely to be substantial, unequal, negative in net economic value and potentially destabilizing.

10.3386/w34357.abstractZh: 实证研究彻底改变了我们理解气候变化对全球经济影响的方式。最近的实证分析检验了理论观点，挑战了先前的估计，并揭示了重要且意想不到的影响。此外，实证结果的可信度和可复制性在指导高风险的气候政策方面发挥了关键作用。在这里，我描述了关于全球影响的实证经济研究的现状，解释了现代分析的方法，总结了近期在多个主题上的研究发现，并指出了有前景的新研究领域。特别是，我重点关注该领域六个“重大挑战”的实证视角：理解气候变化对全球经济产出、健康、冲突、粮食安全、灾害和移民的全球影响。总体而言，我认为不同研究结果之间的相互关联正在描绘出一个越来越清晰的未来全球经济受气候变化影响的图景。从整体来看，未缓解的气候变化所带来的全球后果可能是巨大的、不平等的，对净经济价值产生负面影响，并可能破坏稳定。

abstract.text: Women commonly take extended work leaves for caregiving. These absences impose costs on firms and employees, but their consequences for consumers are less understood. We study these effects in pediatric primary care, and analyze whether pediatricians’ childbirths impact their patients’ care utilization. Using linked California birth records and Medicaid claims, we find substantial and persistent reductions in young patients’ preventive care: two years after a PCP’s childbirth, mothers’ patients have 32% fewer well visits and score 0.12 standard deviations lower on an index of vaccinations and screening tests. Notably, we do not find a lasting impact on acute or chronic care, indicating that preventive care decisions are particularly susceptible to disruptions. We present evidence suggesting that these long-lasting effects reflect a lapse in families’ preventive care habits, rather than ongoing limitations in PCP access, and that incentives and reminders from government agencies can mitigate these adverse effects. We estimate that similar disruptions could affect one in five young children in Medicaid, implying 1 million foregone vaccines and 200,000 fewer screenings annually.

10.3386/w34360.abstractZh: 女性通常会长期休假以照顾家人。这些休假行为会给企业和员工带来成本，但其对消费者的影响则尚不明确。我们研究了这一现象在儿科初级保健中的表现，并分析了儿科医生的分娩情况是否会影响患者的护理使用。通过结合加利福尼亚州的出生记录和医疗补助索赔数据，我们发现年轻患者的预防性护理服务显著减少：在儿科初级保健医生分娩后两年，患者的体检次数减少了32%，疫苗接种和筛查测试的指数也低了0.12个标准差。值得注意的是，我们并未发现对急性或慢性护理的持久影响，这表明预防性护理决策特别容易受到干扰。我们的证据表明，这些长期影响反映了家庭预防性护理习惯的缺失，而非儿科初级保健医生服务的持续限制。政府机构的激励和提醒措施可以减轻这些负面影响。我们估计，类似的干扰可能会影响五分之一的低收入家庭儿童，这意味着每年会少接种100万剂疫苗，并减少20万次筛查。

abstract.text: Human capital formation enhances worker productivity and firm performance. However, firms may not fully internalize the financial benefits from investing in employee skill-building, which can disincentivize worker training and suggest roles for government support. We examine these tradeoffs in the context of physician training through “residency” programs. Using the universe of Medicare inpatient and outpatient records from 2014-2019 and differences-in-differences analyses, we show that hospitals’ productivity and revenues grow by 10-20% after underwriting a procedure-oriented residency––though heterogeneity exists. The hospitals benefiting from trainee labor conservatively net over $2 million per year, revealing substantive private incentives to finance physician training.

10.3386/w34365.abstractZh: 人力资本的形成能够提升工人的生产力和企业的绩效。然而，企业可能无法完全将投资于员工技能提升所带来的财务收益内部化，这可能会抑制工人的培训积极性，因此政府需要提供一定的支持。我们研究了在医生培训“住院医师”项目的背景下，这些权衡关系。通过利用2014-2019年医疗保险住院和门诊记录数据，并采用差异差异分析，我们发现医院在提供以手术为导向的住院医师培训后，生产力和收入会增长10-20%——尽管存在差异。受益于这些培训项目的医院每年净收益超过200万美元，这表明存在显著的私人激励因素来资助医生培训。

abstract.text: How does community rating distort relative prices for vertically differentiated plans in insurance markets? We show that common community-rating approaches can distort price differentials in the opposite direction to the distortions in overall price levels. Partial age-based community rating in the U.S. private health insurance exchanges causes older individuals to pay marginal prices for generous coverage significantly above marginal cost, while younger enrollees are subsidized on the margin. These distortions are large enough that older individuals often face and sometimes choose dominated options. We present simulations and theoretical discussions of community rating’s impacts on efficiency and distributional outcomes.

10.3386/w34367.abstractZh: 社区评级如何扭曲保险市场中垂直差异化计划的相对价格？我们发现，常见的社区评级方法可能会使价格差异朝着与整体价格水平扭曲相反的方向发展。在美国私人健康保险交易所中，基于部分年龄的社区评级导致年长人士支付远高于边际成本的慷慨保险费用，而年轻参保者则获得边际补贴。这些扭曲效应非常显著，以至于年长人士常常面临甚至选择被支配的选项。我们通过模拟和理论分析，探讨了社区评级对效率和分配结果的影响。

abstract.text: We provide novel evidence on how healthcare decision-making responds to changes in government recommendations by studying the United States Preventive Services Task Force’s 2009 decision to stop recommending mammogram screenings for women aged 40-49. Using a difference-in-differences identification strategy, we find that the guideline revision reduced mammography among 40-49-year-old women by 6-10 percent (from a baseline rate of 48.8 percent) relative to their older counterparts. We also identify large spillovers onto women aged 30-39 who were subsequently 25 percent less likely to receive a mammogram recommendation (from a baseline rate of 22.8 percent) and up to 60 percent less likely to receive a mammogram (from a baseline rate of 12.6 percent). Additional analyses suggest the revision reduced overdiagnosis of early-stage tumors. Finally, we find that the 2009 update increased confusion about recommendations for preventing cancer.

10.3386/w34368.abstractZh: 我们通过研究美国预防服务工作组在2009年决定停止推荐40-49岁女性进行乳房X光筛查这一决策，为研究医疗决策如何响应政府建议的变化提供了新的证据。利用差异-差异识别策略，我们发现这一指南修订使得40-49岁女性接受乳房X光筛查的比例降低了6-10%（从基准率的48.8%降至42.8%）。我们还发现，这一变化对30-39岁的女性产生了显著影响：她们接受乳房X光筛查的概率降低了25%（从基准率的22.8%降至18.6%），接受乳房X光筛查的概率甚至降低了60%（从基准率的12.6%降至7.8%）。进一步的分析表明，这一修订还减少了早期肿瘤的过度诊断。最后，我们发现2009年的更新增加了对癌症预防建议的困惑。

abstract.text: We examine information versus hassle costs in the context of Medicaid prior authorization requirements for preschool antipsychotic prescribing. Such prescribing increased in the 1990s, despite substantial side effects and the absence of FDA approval. State Medicaid programs began to require prior authorization for antipsychotic prescribing to young children after 2005. We evaluate these policies using hand-collected policy data and national prescription data for 2006-2019. We find that prior authorization reduced prescriptions to children under six by 22-30% in the two years after implementation. There were no effects on privately insured or older children, suggesting little role for information spillovers.

10.3386/w34369.abstractZh: 我们研究了在Medicaid预先授权要求下，对学龄前儿童使用抗精神病药物的行为与相关成本之间的关系。尽管存在严重的副作用且未获得FDA批准，这种用药行为在1990年代仍有所增加。自2005年起，各州Medicaid计划开始要求对幼儿使用抗精神病药物进行预先授权。我们利用手工收集的政策数据以及2006至2019年的全国处方数据来评估这些政策。研究发现，在实施后的两年中，预先授权措施使6岁以下儿童的处方数量减少了22%至30%。而对于私人保险覆盖的儿童或年龄较大的儿童，这种措施并未产生任何影响，这表明信息溢出效应并不显著。

abstract.text: Are state-imposed behavioral remedies effective substitutes for federal antitrust enforcement? We evaluate state regulation of hospital mergers under Certificates of Public Advantage (COPAs). Using hospital data from 1996-2022, we compare COPA-regulated mergers to unregulated mergers with similar anticompetitive potential. In highly concentrated markets, COPA mergers result in 11.1 p.p. lower price growth but 0.5 p.p. greater increases in 30-day mortality rates. We find a negative correlation between price and mortality effects for COPA mergers, consistent with theoretical predictions that binding price caps exacerbate quality deterioration. Our findings suggest that COPA contracts are poor substitutes for traditional antitrust enforcement.

10.3386/w34373.abstractZh: 州政府实施的行为性补救措施能否有效替代联邦反垄断执法？我们评估了州政府对医院合并的监管情况，这些合并受到《公共优势证书》的约束。利用1996年至2022年的医院数据，我们将受《公共优势证书》约束的合并与具有类似反竞争潜力的未受监管合并进行了比较。在高度集中的市场中，《公共优势证书》约束下的合并导致价格增长降低11.1个百分点，但30天死亡率却增加了0.5个百分点。我们发现，《公共优势证书》约束下的合并与价格和死亡率之间存在负相关关系，这与理论预测一致，即价格上限的设定会加剧质量下降。我们的研究结果表明，《公共优势证书》约束下的合并并不能替代传统的反垄断执法。

abstract.text: This paper examines how hospital competition and insurance reimbursement policies shape the diffusion of medical innovations. Using patient-level data from Taiwan’s drug-eluting stent (DES) market in the Taipei area, we estimate a structural model that integrates patient demand with hospitals’ endogenous portfolio and pricing decisions. We document a fundamental trade-off: intensified competition reduces prices but weakens hospitals’ incentives to adopt new technologies. Counterfactual simulations that vary market structure and incorporate selective contracting or targeted patient coupons show that the effectiveness of reimbursement policies depends critically on hospitals’ strategic responses and the surrounding competitive environment.

10.3386/w34374.abstractZh: 本文探讨了医院竞争和保险报销政策如何影响医疗创新的扩散。通过利用台湾台北地区药物洗脱支架市场的患者数据，我们建立了一个结构模型，将患者需求与医院的内生投资组合和定价决策相结合。我们发现了一个基本的权衡：激烈的竞争会降低价格，但会削弱医院采用新技术的动力。通过模拟不同的市场结构，并考虑选择性合同或定向患者优惠券等因素，我们发现报销政策的有效性在很大程度上取决于医院的战略反应以及周围的竞争环境。

abstract.text: What does homeless shelter achieve? We leverage administrative records of homeless services in Los Angeles County to construct a novel dataset of daily, site-level counts of shelter beds and occupants from 2014 to 2019. We pair this with daily, block-level crime incident data and daily, hospital-level data on ER visits to assess the relationship between shelter and area crime and health. We exploit variation from shocks to shelter availability from Los Angeles County's winter shelters program to study the effects of providing temporary shelter. We find that reducing unsheltered homelessness significantly reduces crime and ER visits for psychiatric conditions. We conclude with evidence that entering shelter also reduces short-run mortality but find no evidence that temporary shelter reduces future homelessness more than street outreach or other non-shelter services. Our findings suggest that shelter functions as a public good with high social benefits. When agents charged with provision of homeless services are evaluated on their ability to reduce overall homelessness, they are unlikely to internalize these benefits and may under provide shelter.

10.3386/w34376.abstractZh: 无家可归者收容所能实现什么？我们利用洛杉矶县的无家可归者服务行政记录，构建了一个包含2014年至2019年每日、站点级别的收容所床位和居住者数量的数据集。我们将这些数据与每日的街区犯罪事件数据以及每日的医院急诊就诊数据相结合，以评估收容所与地区犯罪和健康状况之间的关系。通过研究洛杉矶县冬季收容所计划对收容所可用性的影响，我们进一步探讨了提供临时收容所的效果。研究发现，减少无家可归者数量显著降低了犯罪率和精神疾病的急诊就诊率。我们的结论表明，进入收容所还能降低短期死亡率，但并未发现临时收容所比街头援助或其他非收容服务更能减少未来的无家可归现象。我们的研究结果表明，收容所作为一种公共产品，具有极高的社会效益。当评估负责提供无家可归者服务机构的成效时，它们不太可能意识到这些好处，因此可能会提供不足的收容服务。

abstract.text: Several competing theories in a number of disciplines point to a possible influence of fertility history on health and mortality. However, the direction of effects is theoretically a-priori unknown and the empirical evidence is also inconclusive. This paper examines the effects of fertility during midlife on later-life longevity using Social Security Administration death records linked with the full-count 1940 census. We tackle endogeneity and selection concerns in the longevity-fertility association by implementing an instrumental variable based on the sex composition of first two children. Our findings indicate that having an extra child is linked to a decrease in women’s longevity by approximately 5 months. Men, on the other hand, experience smaller and insignificant reductions in longevity of about 3.3 months. This divergence in effects suggests that biological factors may play a small role in the relationship between fertility and later-life longevity.

10.3386/w34378.abstractZh: 多个学科中的竞争理论指出，生育历史可能对健康和死亡率产生影响。然而，这些影响的方向在理论上尚不清楚，实证证据也并不明确。本文利用社会保障管理局的死亡记录与1940年人口普查数据，研究了中年生育对晚年寿命的影响。我们通过使用第一个孩子的性别构成作为工具变量，来解决寿命与生育之间的内生性和选择问题。研究发现，多生一个孩子会使女性的寿命减少约5个月。而男性的寿命减少幅度较小，约为3.3个月。这种差异表明，生物学因素在生育与晚年寿命之间的关系中可能起着较小的作用。

abstract.text: Certificate of Need (CON) laws regulate entry and capital investments in healthcare with the goal of containing costs while preserving access and quality. This paper examines the relationship between these laws and overall mortality as well as leading causes of mortality: cancer and cardiovascular disease. Using county-level death records, we conducted an event-study analysis comparing mortality rates in states that repealed their CON laws to states that did not between 1979 and 2004. The repeal of CON laws was associated with short-run reductions in cancer mortality, primarily from reductions in lung cancer mortality. Cardiovascular mortality and all-cause mortality rates were unchanged.

10.3386/w34403.abstractZh: 需求认证法案对医疗保健领域的准入和资本投资进行监管，其目标是在保持医疗服务可及性和质量的同时控制成本。本文探讨了这些法案与总体死亡率以及主要死因——癌症和心血管疾病之间的关系。通过利用县级死亡记录，我们对1979年至2004年间废除需求认证法案的州与未废除该法案的州之间的死亡率进行了事件研究分析。结果显示，废除需求认证法案在短期内降低了癌症死亡率，尤其是肺癌死亡率的下降。心血管死亡率和全因死亡率则没有变化。

abstract.text: Studies of intergenerational mobility have begun to expand outside of the traditional outcomes such as income, education and occupation, into using alternative measures of wellbeing. In this chapter we survey the evidence on studies of these alternative measures with a focus on health, consumption and life satisfaction. We also incorporate lessons from the income mobility literature that may be relevant for how we think about these alternative measures both conceptually and empirically. We highlight a few approaches that researchers can consider to incorporate alternative measures and we conclude that a widening of our conception of intergenerational mobility to incorporate measures of wellbeing may identify shortfalls in some of our current approaches.

10.3386/w34407.abstractZh: 关于代际流动性的研究已经开始超越传统的收入、教育和职业等衡量指标，扩展到使用其他福祉指标。在本章中，我们回顾了这些替代指标的研究证据，重点关注健康、消费和生活满意度等方面。我们还借鉴了关于收入流动性的文献中的经验，这些经验可能在概念上和实证上对我们理解这些替代指标有所帮助。我们强调了研究人员可以考虑的一些方法，以纳入这些替代指标，并得出结论：扩大我们对代际流动性的概念，纳入福祉指标，可能会发现我们当前方法中的一些不足。

abstract.text: Taxes on sweetened beverages have been widely adopted in response to increases in diet-related chronic disease. An episode of particular interest occurred in Cook County, Illinois, where a beverage tax was announced, implemented, and then repealed. This paper is the first to estimate the effects of this tax using household-level data on purchases. We estimate difference-in-differences models that compare the change in beverage purchases over time in Cook County to that in comparison areas. The results indicate that consumer purchases did not detectably respond to the announcement of the tax. Implementation of the tax reduced purchases by 22.5% for all taxed beverages, 16.5% for high-calorie taxed beverages and a 33% for low-calorie (e.g. diet) taxed beverages. This implies a price elasticity of demand of -0.66 for all taxed beverages, -0.48 for high-calorie taxed beverages and -0.97 for low-calorie taxed beverages. The impact of the tax did not vary by household income, and there is no detectable impact of the tax on purchases of possible substitutes (bottled water, fruit juice, milk). After repeal of the tax, purchases of taxed beverages returned to their baseline quantities; there was no evidence of habit formation.

10.3386/w34412.abstractZh: 为应对与饮食相关的慢性疾病增加，对含糖饮料征税已得到广泛采用。伊利诺伊州库克县发生了一起值得关注的案例：当地宣布实施饮料税，随后又取消了该政策。本文首次利用家庭购买数据来估算该税的影响。我们通过差异模型分析库克县饮料购买量随时间的变化情况，并与对照地区进行比较。结果显示，消费者对饮料购买的响应并未因税收政策的宣布而显著变化。该税的实施导致所有含糖饮料的购买量减少了22.5%，高卡路里含糖饮料减少了16.5%，低卡路里含糖饮料（如减肥饮料）则减少了33%。这表明所有含糖饮料的需求弹性分别为-0.66、-0.48和-0.97。税收政策对家庭收入的影响并不明显，且对替代产品（如瓶装水、果汁、牛奶）的购买量也没有显著影响。该税取消后，含糖饮料的购买量恢复到了基线水平，且没有证据表明消费者形成了依赖习惯。

abstract.text: We study the health consequences of redistributing political power through the 1975 extension of the Voting Rights Act, which eliminated barriers to voting for previously disenfranchised nonwhite populations. The intervention led to broad declines in under-five mortality but sharply contrasting effects in other age groups: mortality fell among non-white children, younger adults, and older women, yet rose among whites and older non-white men. These differences cannot be reconciled by changes in population composition or material conditions. Instead, we present evidence suggesting psychosocial stress and retaliatory responses arising from perceived status threat as key mechanisms.
