10.3386/w34421.abstractZh: 我们研究了1975年《投票权法》的扩展对政治权力重新分配所带来的健康影响。该法案消除了此前被剥夺投票权的非白人群体的投票障碍。这一干预措施导致五岁以下儿童死亡率大幅下降，但其他年龄段的死亡率则呈现明显差异：非白人儿童、年轻成年人和老年女性的死亡率下降，而白人和年长非白人男性的死亡率则上升。这些差异无法通过人口构成或物质条件的变化来解释。相反，我们有证据表明，心理社会压力和因感知到身份威胁而产生的报复性反应是这些差异的关键机制。

abstract.text: The 911 system, a vital component of public safety, responds to over 210 million emergency calls each year. We examine the effect of small exogenous public health stressors – pollen emissions – on the operation of the 911 call system in Seattle, Washington. Leveraging daily variation in pollen levels, we evaluate pollen’s impact on the volume of 911 calls. We find that a 100% increase in pollen levels – the modal day-over-day variation we observe in our data – results in six additional 911 calls per day. We further show that elevated pollen levels influence the quality of emergency and non-emergency response. The 911 system responds to increased strain by prioritizing more urgent calls – and as a result, increasing response time to non-urgent calls. Though all calls are connected to a dispatcher, there are increased missed connections – canceled emergency response, missing records of response, and false reports. Despite the prioritization of urgent calls, these additional daily calls lead to reallocation of resources in ways that potentially impede service quality. Thus, our findings suggest that common and small shocks may lead to under-provision of valuable services to communities across the U.S.

10.3386/w34428.abstractZh: 911系统是公共安全的重要组成部分，每年会处理超过2.1亿个紧急呼叫。我们研究了小型公共健康压力源——花粉排放——对华盛顿州西雅图市911呼叫系统运行的影响。通过利用花粉水平的日变化，我们评估了花粉对911呼叫数量的影响。我们发现，花粉水平增加100%——这是我们数据中观察到的日变化幅度——会导致每天额外增加6个911呼叫。我们还发现，花粉水平升高会影响紧急和非紧急呼叫的响应质量。911系统通过优先处理紧急呼叫来应对增加的压力，因此非紧急呼叫的响应时间会延长。尽管所有呼叫都与调度员相连，但错失联系的情况有所增加，包括紧急响应被取消、响应记录缺失以及虚假报告。尽管优先处理紧急呼叫，但这些额外的日常呼叫会导致资源重新分配，从而可能降低服务质量。因此，我们的研究结果表明，常见且较小的冲击可能会导致美国各地社区的重要服务得不到充分提供。

abstract.text: Most nations in the world have side-by-side private and public health care systems. Policymakers worry that “dual practice” across sectors might reduce care to the public sector. This concern led regions in Spain to offer “exclusivity bonuses” to physicians who practice exclusively in the public sector. We show theoretically that the impact of these bonuses on the public sector is ambiguous. We demonstrate empirically that the bonuses backfired: they did increase exclusive participation in the public sector, but significantly reduced hours of work. When regions added offsetting bonuses for dual practice, they were largely ineffective.

10.3386/w34433.abstractZh: 世界上大多数国家都同时拥有私人医疗系统和公共医疗系统。政策制定者担心，不同部门之间的“双重执业”可能会减少公共部门的医疗服务。出于这一担忧，西班牙的一些地区向仅在公共部门执业的医生提供“独占奖金”。我们从理论上表明，这些奖金对公共部门的影响并不明确。实证研究表明，这些奖金反而产生了反效果：它们确实增加了在公共部门的执业人数，但显著减少了医生的工作时间。当这些地区为双重执业的医生提供抵消奖金时，这些措施基本上无效。

abstract.text: We examine the causal impact of being denied benefit access on the financial well-being of marginally-excluded households. Using experimental and quasi-random variation in the flexibility of mandatory intake interviews and a unique linkage between administrative Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) and credit report data, we find that households screened out of SNAP due to administrative barriers suffer tangible downstream economic consequences. Specifically, we find that process-related denials increase debt and delinquencies, and decrease credit scores. These results highlight the economic importance of implementation design and its role in strengthening (or undermining) the financial protection provided by social insurance programs.

10.3386/w34434.abstractZh: 我们研究了被拒绝享受福利对边缘化家庭财务福祉的因果影响。通过实验和准随机方式改变强制接受访谈的灵活性，并结合行政层面的补充营养援助计划数据与信用报告数据的独特关联，我们发现因行政障碍而被排除在SNAP之外的家庭会面临明显的经济后果。具体而言，我们发现与流程相关的拒绝行为会增加债务和逾期情况，同时降低信用评分。这些结果凸显了实施设计在经济上的重要性，以及其在加强或削弱社会保险计划所提供的财务保护方面的作用。

abstract.text: Cannabis legalization has increased substantially in the past two decades with state-level policies that permit possession this product. A potential concern with cannabis legalization and the corresponding increase in consumption is that – because smoking is the most common consumption mode – respiratory health could worsen. In this study, we offer new evidence on the impact of recreational cannabis laws on asthma outcomes. To do so, we combine commercial health insurance claims and survey data over the period 2008 to 2022 with difference-in-differences and event-study methods. Our findings suggest that asthma diagnoses do not change following legalization of recreational cannabis, while asthma-related dispensed prescription medications decline, and asthma-related outpatient visits and inpatient hospitalizations are stable. An analysis of changes in use of smoked and non-smoked cannabis post-law suggests that, on net, the increase in overall cannabis use attributable to legalization is driven by use of non-smoked cannabis, which may explain why we find limited evidence that asthma outcomes worsen post-law. Collectively, these results suggest that expanded access to legal cannabis has not worsened respiratory health overall, and hint that some patients may use cannabis to manage asthma symptoms.

10.3386/w34435.abstractZh: 在过去二十年里，大麻合法化的情况显著增加，许多州都出台了允许持有大麻的政策。然而，大麻合法化带来的一个潜在问题是——由于吸烟是最常见的消费方式——呼吸健康可能会受到影响。在这项研究中，我们提供了关于娱乐性大麻法律对哮喘影响的新证据。为此，我们结合了2008至2022年期间商业健康保险索赔数据以及调查数据，并运用了差异-差异法和事件研究法进行分析。我们的研究发现表明，娱乐性大麻合法化后，哮喘诊断数量并未发生变化，而与哮喘相关的处方药使用量有所下降，而哮喘相关的门诊就诊和住院情况则保持稳定。对合法化后大麻使用方式变化的分析显示，整体大麻使用量的增加主要来自于非吸烟大麻的使用，这可能解释了为什么我们发现哮喘症状在合法化后并没有恶化。总的来说，这些结果表明，大麻合法化的扩大使用并未导致呼吸健康整体恶化，并且暗示一些患者可能会使用大麻来管理哮喘症状。

abstract.text: The Low Income Housing Tax Credit (LIHTC) Program is the largest federal affordable housing program in the U.S. Yet, little is known about its impacts on children and families. This paper shows how LIHTC exposure during childhood affects women’s health outcomes in early-adulthood, as well as the health of their infants. Using geocoded Florida Natality data for 1980-2024 and addresses for LIHTC units we study women born to mothers without any college education between 1980-1999. We use a matching model to compare women born into Census tracts that receive LIHTC during their childhoods to women born into Census tracts without LIHTC during their childhoods. These women and their infants are then observed in adulthood when they first give birth in Florida. We find that a standard deviation increase in childhood LIHTC exposure improves the maternal health index and the infant health index by a small but statistically significant 0.007 standard deviations, and improves an index of maternal SES by 0.005 standard deviations. Given that the average treated tract in our sample has only 0.023 LIHTC units per resident, there is considerable room for increasing exposure. LIHTC exposure during childhood improves outcomes the most for Black women, consistent with Black women being more likely to live in LIHTC units, and also more likely to live in Census tracts that receive LIHTC.

10.3386/w34464.abstractZh: 低收入住房税收抵免计划是美国最大的联邦经济适用房项目。然而，关于该计划对儿童和家庭的影响，我们知之甚少。本文探讨了儿童时期接触低收入住房税收抵免对女性早期健康状况及其婴儿健康的影响。我们利用1980-2024年佛罗里达州的人口统计数据，并结合低收入住房税收抵免项目的地址信息，研究了1980-1999年间母亲没有大学教育背景的女性。我们通过匹配模型，比较了在童年时期接受低收入住房税收抵免的社区出生的女性与在童年时期未接受该项目的社区出生的女性。这些女性在成年后首次在佛罗里达州生育时，我们继续对其健康状况进行观察。研究发现，儿童时期接触低收入住房税收抵免的幅度每增加一个标准差，母亲健康指数和婴儿健康指数就会分别改善0.007个标准差，同时母亲的社会经济地位指数也会改善0.005个标准差。考虑到我们样本中的平均处理社区每居民仅拥有0.023个低收入住房税收抵免项目，因此仍有很大的空间来增加儿童时期的接触机会。儿童时期接触低收入住房税收抵免对黑人女性的影响最为显著，这与黑人女性更可能居住在低收入住房税收抵免项目中以及更可能居住在接受该项目的社区这一事实相符。

abstract.text: Many countries are expanding public health insurance for the uncovered, but administrative barriers can reduce enrollments. However, lowering barriers may insure people with marginal health benefits and crowd out services to incumbents. We use novel longitudinal administrative childbirth data to examine the impact of Medical Insurance Century XXI (SMS), a children’s program that auto-enrolled family members in Mexico’s Seguro Popular (SP) health insurance. SMS increased SP coverage among pregnant women, especially those who previously delivered in private hospitals. This group increased the utilization of prenatal care, without significant changes in birth outcomes, and without negative spillover effects on incumbent women.

10.3386/w34465.abstractZh: 许多国家正在为未覆盖的人群扩大公共健康保险，但行政障碍可能会降低参保人数。然而，降低障碍可能会让那些健康收益较低的人获得保险，从而挤占现有机构的服务资源。我们利用新颖的纵向行政分娩数据来研究“医疗保险世纪XXI”项目的影响。该项目是墨西哥的“人民保险”健康保险计划的一部分，旨在自动为家庭成员提供保险。该项目提高了孕妇的保险覆盖率，尤其是那些之前在私立医院分娩的孕妇。这一群体增加了产前护理的利用率，但并未对分娩结果产生显著影响，也没有对现有机构产生负面影响。

abstract.text: Cesarean section rates vary widely across U.S. counties, yet it remains unclear how much of this variation reflects demand-side factors (such as patient risk or preferences) versus supply-side factors (such as physician practices or hospital incentives). We develop a new empirical strategy to isolate the influence of supply-side forces. Exploiting hospital obstetric unit closures from 1989–2019 that reallocate some mothers to counties with different C-section rates, we find that a one–percentage-point increase in the delivery county’s rate raises a mother’s likelihood of a C-section by roughly one point. The results point to a dominant role for provider behavior and local practice norms in driving geographic variation in C-section use, the most common major surgery in the United States.

10.3386/w34469.abstractZh: 美国各县的剖宫产率存在很大差异，但尚不清楚这种差异有多少是由于需求方面的因素（如患者风险或偏好）造成的，又有多少是由于供应方面的因素（如医生执业或医院激励措施）造成的。我们提出了一种新的实证策略，以分离出供应方面的因素的影响。通过研究1989年至2019年间医院产科部门的关闭情况，这些关闭使得一些母亲被分配到剖宫产率不同的县，我们发现，分娩所在县的剖宫产率每提高一个百分点，母亲接受剖宫产手术的可能性就会增加大约一个百分点。这些结果表明，医疗服务提供者的行为和当地执业规范在驱动剖宫产使用的地理差异中起着主导作用，而剖宫产是美国最常见的重大手术之一。

abstract.text: The United States lacks a federal paid sick leave policy. However, 18 states and the District of Columbia have adopted or announced paid sick leave employer mandates to increase access to this benefit, creating a quasi-experimental setting to study whether paid sick leave affects healthcare use. People enrolled in Medicaid are an important population to study in terms of state paid sick leave policies as the majority of non-disabled enrollees are employed, but frequently work in jobs without paid sick leave. Given enrollees’ lower incomes, losing earnings to receive healthcare may be a significant barrier to care. In this study, we examine the effect of state paid sick leave policies on Medicaid-financed dispensed prescription medications. Using difference-in-differences methods that are robust to bias associated with a staggered treatment rollout, we show that Medicaid-financed dispensed prescription medications increase by 6.7% following adoption of a state paid sick leave policy. These findings suggest that state paid sick leave policies promote engagement with the healthcare system and use of healthcare services among financially constrained populations.

10.3386/w34485.abstractZh: 美国缺乏联邦层面的带薪病假政策。然而，18个州和哥伦比亚特区已经采纳或宣布了雇主必须提供带薪病假的规定，以增加人们获得这一福利的机会，从而创造了一个准实验环境来研究带薪病假是否会影响医疗服务的使用。在州带薪病假政策研究中，参加医疗补助计划的人群是一个重要的研究对象，因为大多数非残疾参保者都有工作，但他们经常从事没有带薪病假的工作。考虑到参保者的收入较低，失去收入以支付医疗费用可能是他们获得医疗服务的重大障碍。在这项研究中，我们考察了州带薪病假政策对医疗补助计划资助的处方药物使用的影响。通过使用对偏见具有抵抗力的差异-差异方法，我们发现，在采纳州带薪病假政策后，医疗补助计划资助的处方药物使用量增加了6.7%。这些发现表明，州带薪病假政策有助于促进经济困难人群对医疗系统的参与以及医疗服务的使用。

abstract.text: Inspections are a common tool for acquiring information and incentivizing compliance. Though typically unannounced, they often follow a predictable schedule. We study how this predictability shapes firm effort and patient outcomes in U.S. nursing homes. Nursing homes “slack” in the low-risk period following an inspection and ramp up effort as their next inspection approaches. Patient survival mirrors this pattern, suggesting meaningful consequences for care quality. We embed these estimates in a dynamic model capturing how inspection regimes incentivize effort and reveal quality. Unpredictability induces as much additional effort as increasing inspection frequency by 10%, with minimal loss of informational value.

10.3386/w34491.abstractZh: 检查是获取信息和激励合规的常见手段。虽然通常是不预先通知的，但检查往往遵循可预测的时间表。我们研究了这种可预测性如何影响美国养老院中的企业努力和患者生存状况。在检查后的低风险时期，养老院会懈怠，而在下一次检查临近时则会加大努力。患者的生存情况也呈现出类似的模式，这表明这对护理质量有着重要的影响。我们将这些估计结果纳入一个动态模型中，以了解检查制度如何激励企业努力并揭示质量状况。不可预测性会导致额外的努力，其程度相当于检查频率增加10%，而信息价值损失却很小。

abstract.text: Forecasts about research findings affect critical scientific decisions, such as the treatments an R&D lab invests in or the statistical power of an experiment. How accurate are these forecasts, and what are the implications of potentially inaccurate beliefs? We analyze a unique data set of all 100 projects posted on the Social Science Prediction Platform from 2020 to 2024, which received 53,298 forecasts in total, including 66 projects for which we have results. We show that forecasters, on average, over-estimate treatment effects; however, the average forecast is quite predictive of the actual treatment effect. We also examine differences in accuracy. Academics have higher accuracy than non-academics, but expertise in a field does not increase accuracy. A panel of motivated repeat forecasters has higher accuracy, but this does not extend to all repeat forecasters. Confidence in the accuracy of one’s forecasts is perversely associated with lower accuracy. We also document substantial cross-study correlation in accuracy and identify a group of "superforecasters". Integrating these lessons, we show how to design optimal forecasts that are appropriately shrunk and that place more weight on high-accuracy predictions. We then highlight how these optimal forecasts can be used in experimental design to increase statistical power.

10.3386/w34493.abstractZh: 关于研究发现的预测会影响关键的科学决策，例如研发实验室投入的研究方法或实验的统计功效。这些预测的准确性如何，以及潜在不准确信念会带来什么影响？我们分析了2020年至2024年间在社会科学预测平台上发布的全部100个项目的数据，这些项目共获得了53,298条预测，其中66个项目我们有了结果。我们发现，预测者平均会高估处理效应；然而，平均预测结果与实际处理效应相当一致。我们还研究了预测准确性的差异。学者的准确性高于非学者，但某一领域的专业知识并不会提高准确性。一群有动力的重复预测者具有更高的准确性，但这并不适用于所有重复预测者。对预测准确性的信心与较低的准确性形成了矛盾的关系。我们还发现了不同研究之间在准确性上的显著相关性，并识别出一群“超级预测者”。结合这些经验，我们展示了如何设计最优预测，这些预测需要适当调整，并更重视高准确性的预测结果。最后，我们强调了这些最优预测如何用于实验设计，以提高统计功效。

abstract.text: We use comprehensive tax data to study how saving behavior responds to the Health Savings Account (HSA) “catch-up” contribution provision, which raises HSA contribution limits for individuals aged 55 and older. Using a regression discontinuity design, we find a sharp increase in contributions among those previously near the limit and smaller increases among unconstrained savers. Induced contributions are not immediately withdrawn and do not appear to crowd out retirement savings. Responses are strongest among payroll contributors and long-term savers. However, married couples do not appear to coordinate their HSA behavior to take advantage of the complex spousal rules governing catch-up contributions. Our findings highlight how tax incentives shape HSA saving and suggest that tax-advantaged account design meaningfully affects household financial behavior.

10.3386/w34499.abstractZh: 我们利用全面的税务数据来研究储蓄行为对健康储蓄账户“补补”贡献条款的反应。该条款提高了55岁及以上个人的健康储蓄账户贡献限额。通过回归 discontinuity设计，我们发现那些原本接近限额的人的贡献显著增加，而那些没有约束的储蓄者的贡献增加幅度较小。这些被诱导的贡献并没有立即被撤回，并且似乎并没有挤占退休储蓄。这种反应在工资缴纳者和长期储蓄者中最为明显。然而，已婚夫妇似乎并没有协调他们的健康储蓄账户行为，以利用复杂的配偶规则来管理补补贡献。我们的研究结果强调了税收激励如何塑造健康储蓄账户的储蓄行为，并表明税收优惠账户的设计确实对家庭财务行为产生了重要影响。

abstract.text: We estimate and compare impacts of cash and in-kind transfers on the consumption of temptation goods in the same population, and explore normative implications. We use two decades of data from South Carolina on cash benefits from Supplemental Security Income (SSI) and in-kind benefits from the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) linked to detailed data on adults’ health care use. Our empirical strategy examines outcome changes in the several days following each transfer’s scheduled monthly payout. Emergency department visits for drug and alcohol use increase by 20-30 percent following SSI receipt, but do not respond to SNAP receipt. Fills of prescription drugs for new illnesses also increase following SSI receipt but do not respond to SNAP receipt. Motivated by these non-fungibility results, we develop a model of a paternalistic social planner choosing the mix of cash and SNAP for a fixed-budget transfer program when consumers have self-control problems and may engage in mental accounting. We show that the planner’s optimal SNAP share is strictly positive and weakly increasing as self-control worsens. Moreover, with heterogeneity in self-control and mental accounting, the planner may choose to use SNAP even when they have access to a uniform Pigouvian tax on the temptation good.

10.3386/w34506.abstractZh: 我们估计并比较了现金和实物转移对同一人群中诱惑性商品消费的影响，并探讨其规范意义。我们使用了南卡罗来纳州二十年的数据，包括补充保障收入计划中的现金福利以及补充营养援助计划中的实物福利，这些数据与成人医疗使用的详细数据相关联。我们的实证策略考察了每次转移计划中的月度支付发放后几天内结果的变化。在收到补充保障收入计划后，因药物或酒精使用而前往急诊室的次数增加了20-30%，但收到补充营养援助计划后这一情况并未改变。因新疾病而补充的处方药数量在收到补充保障收入计划后也有所增加，但收到补充营养援助计划后这一情况并未改变。基于这些不可替代的结果，我们建立了一个家长式社会规划者的模型，该规划者在选择固定预算转移计划中的现金和补充营养援助计划的比例时，考虑到消费者存在自我控制问题，可能会进行心理账户行为。我们表明，随着自我控制能力的下降，规划者最优选择的补充营养援助计划比例严格为正且呈上升趋势。此外，由于自我控制和心理账户行为的异质性，即使规划者能够获取对诱惑性商品征收的统一皮古威税，他们也可能选择使用补充营养援助计划。

abstract.text: Suicide rates among older adults have been rising over time in the United States. At the same time, more individuals have been suffering with chronic pain and illness, which are often underlying risk factors for suicide. As self-medication with marijuana has become common, we ask whether access to legal marijuana for medical and recreational purposes reduces suicides rates among older individuals. We find that suicide rates among older age groups decline following the opening of recreational marijuana dispensaries, especially among older Whites, and middle-aged White males and females with low levels of education.

10.3386/w34519.abstractZh: 在美国，老年人群的自杀率随时间呈上升趋势。与此同时，越来越多的个体遭受慢性疼痛和疾病的困扰，而这些往往是导致自杀的潜在风险因素。随着大麻自我用药现象的普遍化，我们探讨了为医疗和娱乐目的合法使用大麻是否有助于降低老年人群的自杀率。研究发现，随着娱乐性大麻店的开业，老年人群的自杀率有所下降，尤其是在老年白人、教育水平较低的白人中年男性和女性中。

abstract.text: This paper examines the effect of nutrition—delivered during pregnancy via the Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC)—on infant health. We contribute to the literature by adding new data on WIC rollout from the National Archives, employing novel methods, investigating new mechanisms, and analyzing previously unexplored infant outcomes, including the distribution of birth weight. We find robust evidence that access to WIC in a woman’s county of residence by the start of their second trimester led to a reduction in the probability of an infant being of low birth weight and to a higher average birth weight, with larger in magnitude effects for infants with Black mothers than for those with White mothers. Our results suggest a lower bound for treatment-on-the-treated effects for low birth weight of -0.9 percentage points and for birth weight of around 33 grams for infants with Black mothers, both economically significant. For White mothers, the effects on low birth weight are much smaller in magnitude and statistically insignificant. These findings show WIC reduced overall disparities between Blacks and Whites in low birth weight by 3.6 percent.

10.3386/w34521.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在孕期通过妇女、婴儿和儿童特殊营养补充计划提供营养对婴儿健康的影响。我们通过从国家档案馆获取关于该计划实施的新数据，采用新的研究方法，调查新的机制，并分析之前未被探索的婴儿结果，包括出生体重的分布情况，为相关文献做出了贡献。我们发现，在女性怀孕第二孕期之前，如果她们所在地区有该计划的资源，那么婴儿出生时体重较低的概率会下降，平均出生体重也会提高。对于黑人母亲所生的婴儿来说，这种影响更为显著。我们的研究结果表明，对于黑人母亲所生的婴儿而言，该计划对降低低出生体重的影响下限为-0.9个百分点，对出生体重的影响约为33克，这些数值都具有统计学意义。而对于白人母亲所生的婴儿来说，这种影响较小，且在统计上并不显著。这些发现表明，WIC计划使黑人与白人在低出生体重方面的差异减少了3.6%。

abstract.text: Climate change is already increasing temperatures and raising the frequency of natural disasters in the United States. In this paper, we examine several major vectors through which climate change affects US households, including cost increases associated with home insurance claims and increased cooling, as well as sources of increased mortality. Although we consider only a subset of climate costs over recent decades, we find an aggregate annual cost averaging between $400 and $900 per household; in 10 percent of counties, costs exceed $1,300 per household. Costs vary significantly by geography, with the largest costs occurring in some western regions of the United States, the Gulf Coast, and Florida. Climate costs also typically disproportionately burden lower-income households. Our work suggests the importance of research that looks beyond rising temperatures to extreme weather events; so far, natural disasters account for the bulk of the burden of climate change in the United States.

10.3386/w34525.abstractZh: 气候变化已经导致美国的气温上升和自然灾害频率增加。在本文中，我们研究了气候变化对美国家庭影响的几个主要方面，包括与房屋保险索赔相关的成本增加、制冷费用的上升，以及死亡率的增加。尽管我们仅考虑了近几十年来的部分气候成本，但我们发现，平均每户每年的成本在400美元到900美元之间；在10%的县中，每户的成本超过1300美元。成本在不同地区存在显著差异，美国西部某些地区、墨西哥湾沿岸和佛罗里达州的成本最高。气候成本通常不成比例地落在低收入家庭身上。我们的研究表明，需要开展超越气温上升的研究，以关注极端天气事件；迄今为止，自然灾害仍然占美国气候变化带来的负担的主要部分。

abstract.text: We evaluate the effect of California's 11 percent excise tax on firearms, introduced in July 2024, on retail prices. Using price quotes for 48 popular firearms from over 2,200 licensed dealers, we compare California prices to those in other states and to pre-tax trends. We find that prices in California increase by about 10% in response to the 11% tax. Results are consistent across gun types and show no evidence of border spillovers. These findings indicate that firearm excise taxes can effectively raise consumer prices.

10.3386/w34527.abstractZh: 我们评估了2024年7月加州实施的枪支消费税（11%）对零售价格的影响。通过从2,200多家持牌经销商处获取48种常见枪支的价格信息，我们将加州的价格与其他州的价格以及税前价格趋势进行了比较。研究发现，由于11%的消费税，加州枪支价格上升了约10%。研究结果适用于各种枪支类型，并且没有发现边境溢出效应的证据。这些发现表明，枪支消费税能够有效地提高消费者价格。

abstract.text: The FDA does not formally regulate representativeness, but if trials under-enroll vulnerable patients, the resulting evidence may understate harm from drugs. We study the relationship between trial participation and the risk of drug-induced adverse events for cancer medications using data from the Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results Program linked to Medicare claims. Initiating treatment with a cancer drug increases the risk of hospitalization due to serious adverse events (SAEs) by 2 percentage points per month (a 250% increase). Heterogeneity in SAE treatment effects can be predicted by patient’s comorbidities, frailty, and demographic characteristics. Patients at the 90th percentile of the risk distribution experience a 2.5 times greater increase in SAEs after treatment initiation compared to patients at the 10th percentile of the risk distribution yet are 4 times less likely to enroll in trials. The predicted SAE treatment effects for the drug’s target population are 14% larger than the predicted SAE treatment effects for trial enrollees, corresponding to 1 additional induced SAE hospitalization for every 21 patients per year of treatment. We formalize conditions under which regulating representativeness of SAE risk will lead to more externally valid trials, and we discuss how our results could inform regulatory requirements.

10.3386/w34534.abstractZh: 美国食品药品监督管理局并未对代表性进行正式监管，但如果试验招募的弱势患者数量不足，由此产生的证据可能会低估药物的危害。我们利用与医疗保险索赔相关的监测、流行病学和最终结果计划的数据，研究了试验参与情况与癌症药物引起的不良事件风险之间的关系。使用癌症药物开始治疗会使因严重不良事件住院的风险每月增加2个百分点（即增加250%）。通过患者的合并症、虚弱状况以及人口统计特征，可以预测不良事件治疗效果的异质性。风险分布处于第90百分位的患者在开始治疗后，不良事件的风险增加2.5倍，而处于第10百分位的患者的风险增加则仅为4倍，但后者参与试验的可能性却要低4倍。对于该药物的目标人群，预测出的不良事件治疗效果比试验参与者高出14%，这意味着每21名患者在治疗过程中会多出现1例不良事件住院。我们明确了在何种条件下，规范不良事件风险的代表性能够带来更具外部效度的试验，并讨论了我们的研究结果如何为监管要求提供指导。

abstract.text: We provide causal evidence that patient peer effects generate mortality impacts comparable to provider quality differences. Drawing on administrative records covering 2.6 million stays (2000–2010) across 7,200 U.S. nursing homes, we exploit plausibly exogenous roommate assignments identified through unique room identifiers. We estimate that assignment to a roommate diagnosed with Alzheimer’s disease (AD) or Alzheimer’s disease related dementias (ADRD), relative to placement in a private room, increases 90-day mortality by 2.1 percentage points (14% of baseline)—equivalent to receiving care at a nursing home one full standard deviation worse in quality. Effects differ sharply by patient type: patients with AD/ADRD benefit substantially from cognitively healthy roommates but not from private rooms, suggesting important peer monitoring and support roles. In contrast, mortality of patients without AD/ADRD does not depend on roommate cognitive health but is reduced in private rooms. A simple assignment rule exploiting this heterogeneity could reduce overall mortality by 0.8 percentage points without additional resources.

10.3386/w34538.abstractZh: 我们提供了因果证据，表明患者之间的同伴效应所产生的死亡率影响与护理提供者质量的差异相当。基于涵盖260万次入住记录（2000-2010年）的7,200家美国养老院的管理数据，我们利用通过独特房间标识符识别出的合理外生性室友分配情况。我们估计，与住在私人房间相比，被分配到患有阿尔茨海默病或阿尔茨海默病相关痴呆症的室友身边，会使90天的死亡率增加2.1个百分点（相当于基线水平的14%），这相当于在质量较差的养老院接受护理。不同类型患者的效果差异显著：患有AD/ADRD的患者从认知健康的室友那里获得显著的好处，而私人房间则没有这种好处，这表明同伴之间的监督和支持作用非常重要。相比之下，没有AD/ADRD的患者死亡率并不取决于室友的认知健康状况，而是在私人房间中有所降低。一个简单的分配规则可以利用这种异质性，在不增加额外资源的情况下将总体死亡率降低0.8个百分点。

abstract.text: Opioid use disorder (OUD) among pregnant women in the United States has risen more than fourfold since 1999, making substance use a leading cause of maternal mortality. Medicaid finances the majority of births and substance use disorder treatment in the U.S., yet until recently, coverage typically ends 60 days postpartum, potentially disrupting care continuity. The American Rescue Plan of 2021 extends postpartum Medicaid coverage from two months to 12 months, creating a natural experiment to evaluate the impact of coverage on access to medications for OUD (MOUD), the gold-standard treatment. We use linked nationwide all-payer medical and retail pharmacy claims from IQVIA in a difference-in-differences framework comparing postpartum MOUD continuity between Medicaid- and commercially-insured parents with a prenatal history of MOUD use. Extended Medicaid postpartum coverage increases Medicaid-financed MOUD months by 8.55%, the likelihood of continuing MOUD beyond 60 days by 5.12%, and total MOUD supply days by 7.99%. These gains are slightly offset by other payer reductions, yet result in a net 5.10% increase in overall MOUD months and 4.64% rise in treatment adherence. Findings highlight the importance of coverage duration as a practical lever to sustain MOUD treatment in the crucial first year after delivery period.

10.3386/w34541.abstractZh: 自1999年以来，美国孕妇中的阿片类药物使用障碍数量增加了四倍多，使得物质使用成为孕产妇死亡的主要原因之一。在美国，大多数分娩和物质使用障碍治疗都由医疗补助资金资助，但直到最近，医疗补助的覆盖通常只在产后60天内有效，这可能会中断护理的连续性。2021年的《美国救援计划》将产后医疗补助的覆盖期限从两个月延长至12个月，从而创造了一个自然实验，以评估覆盖期限对阿片类药物使用障碍治疗药物获取的影响。我们利用了IQVIA提供的全国范围内的所有支付方医疗和零售药房索赔数据，通过差异-差异框架比较了拥有产前阿片类药物使用史的父母在医疗补助和商业保险下产后阿片类药物使用障碍治疗的连续性。延长的医疗补助产后覆盖期限使医疗补助资助的阿片类药物使用障碍治疗月份增加了8.55%，使继续治疗超过60天的可能性增加了5.12%，并使阿片类药物使用障碍治疗的总天数增加了7.99%。这些收益被其他支付方的减少所略微抵消，但总体上使阿片类药物使用障碍治疗月份增加了5.10%，治疗依从性提高了4.64%。研究结果强调了覆盖期限作为维持分娩后关键第一年阿片类药物使用障碍治疗的实际手段的重要性。

abstract.text: Paid sick leave mandates (PSLs), which have been adopted by 18 states and the District of Columbia, require employers to provide regular wages when workers take short-term leave for their own or a family member’s medical needs. This study is the first to explore the effects of PSL adoption on participation in the Supplemental Security Income (SSI) and Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) programs, as well as the health of persons with disabilities. We find that statewide PSLs are associated with a 6-9 percent increase in initial claims for SSI and joint SSI/SSDI benefits. These applications translate to an increase in beneficiaries, strongest among children under age 18. An exploration of the primary mechanisms likely underlying this result reveals PSL-induced (1) increases in time spent offering informal caregiving of those with disabilities, which may reduce the costs of applying to SS(D)I programs, and (2) increases in health care utilization among children with disabilities. Evidence for negative work hours effects of PSLs is weaker, concentrated among spouses of persons with disabilities. Finally, we find that PSL mandates lead to modest improvements in health among both children and adults with disabilities.

10.3386/w34542.abstractZh: 带薪病假规定已被18个州和哥伦比亚特区采纳，要求雇主在员工因个人或家庭成员的医疗需求而短期休假时支付正常工资。本研究首次探讨了带薪病假规定对参与补充保障收入计划和社会安全残疾保险计划的影响，以及这对残疾人士健康的影响。研究发现，全州范围内的带薪病假规定导致补充保障收入计划的初始申请数量增加6-9%，同时SSI和SSDI福利的申请数量也相应增加。这些申请的增加意味着受益人的数量增加，其中18岁以下的儿童受益最为明显。对这一现象的主要机制进行分析后发现，带薪病假规定可能导致：(1)为残疾人士提供非正式护理的时间增加，这可能降低申请社会保障残疾保险计划的成本；(2)残疾儿童的健康护理使用率增加。关于带薪病假规定对工作时间影响的证据较为薄弱，主要集中在残疾人士的配偶身上。最后，我们发现带薪病假规定对残疾儿童和成人的健康状况都有一定的改善作用。

abstract.text: The rise in nicotine vaping among U.S. teenagers in the late 2010s prompted tobacco control advocates to press for higher electronic nicotine delivery system (ENDS) taxes to curb their use. This study is the first to explore how the impact of e-cigarette taxation on youth nicotine vaping has evolved over time. Using data from several nationally representative data sources and a generalized difference-in-differences approach, we find that since 2020, the effect of a one dollar increase in electronic nicotine delivery systems (ENDS) taxes on teenage ENDS use has declined by over 50 percent. This erosion in tax responsiveness is consistent with the marginal youth vaper becoming more tax inelastic over time. Descriptive evidence shows that the composition of youth ENDS users has shifted toward those with a higher addictive stock and a greater taste for risk, factors that, in part, may make current youth vapers less tax responsive. In contrast, for adults, for whom there is less evidence of decline in ENDS use or such compositional shifts, their behavioral response to ENDS taxation has remained largely unchanged over time.

10.3386/w34544.abstractZh: 在2010年代末，美国青少年中尼古丁电子烟的使用率上升，这促使烟草控制倡导者要求提高电子尼古丁输送系统的税收，以限制其使用。本研究首次探讨了电子香烟税收对青少年尼古丁电子烟使用的影响随时间的变化情况。通过利用多个具有全国代表性的数据来源，并采用广义差异比较方法，我们发现自2020年以来，电子尼古丁输送系统税收每提高一美元，青少年使用电子尼古丁输送系统的比例下降了超过50%。这种税收响应能力的减弱与青少年使用者逐渐变得对税收更加不敏感有关。描述性证据表明，青少年电子尼古丁输送系统使用者的构成发生了变化，他们具有更高的成瘾倾向和对风险的更大偏好，这些因素可能使得当前青少年使用者对税收的敏感度降低。相比之下，对于成年人来说，虽然没有证据表明他们的电子尼古丁输送系统使用率或构成发生了显著变化，但他们对税收的反应基本保持不变。

abstract.text: Do restrictions on public funding create unintended reliance on social assistance? In this paper, we study the 1976 Hyde Amendment, which barred federal funding for abortion. Using county-level data and an event-study design, we show that reduced federal funding for abortion increased fertility among young women by 2%. These effects were concentrated among non-white women, who subsequently experienced greater welfare participation in states with larger abortion funding declines. The consequences extend into the next generation: non-white girls born after Hyde were more likely to rely on public assistance in adulthood. Abortion funding restrictions reinforce long-run economic inequality across generations.

10.3386/w34548.abstractZh: 对公共资金的限制是否会导致人们意外依赖社会救济？本文研究了1976年的海德修正案，该修正案禁止联邦政府提供堕胎资金。通过县级数据及事件研究设计，我们发现联邦堕胎资金的减少使年轻女性的生育率上升了2%。这些影响主要集中在非白人女性身上，在堕胎资金减少幅度较大的州，她们随后更有可能参与社会福利项目。这一影响甚至延续到下一代：在海德修正案实施之后出生的非白人女孩，在成年后更有可能依赖公共救济。堕胎资金的限制加剧了代际间的长期经济不平等。

abstract.text: This paper surveys econometric innovations related to differences-in-differences estimators and to event-study models with time-varying treatment effects. Our discussion highlights tricky normalization issues, heterogeneous policy effects, the interpretation of exposure designs, pretrends pretesting, and the ever-bothersome question of logs versus levels. Key ideas are illustrated with applications.

10.3386/w34550.abstractZh: 本文综述了与差异差异估计量以及具有时变处理效应的事件研究模型相关的计量经济学创新。我们的讨论涉及了复杂的标准化问题、异质性的政策效应、暴露设计的解释、预趋势的预测试，以及 Logs 与水平值之间的选择问题。文中通过实例说明了这些关键概念的应用。

abstract.text: The education-mortality gradient has increased sharply in the last three decades, with the life-expectancy gap between people with and without a college degree widening from 2.6 years in 1992 to 6.3 years in 2019 (Case and Deaton 2023). During the same period, mortality inequality across counties rose 30 percent, accompanied by an increasing rural health penalty. Using county- and state-level data from the 1992–2019 period, we demonstrate that these three trends arose due to a fundamental shift in the geographic patterns of mortality among college and non-college populations. First, we find a sharp decline in both mortality rates and geographic inequality for college graduates. Second, the reverse was true for people without a college degree; spatial inequality became amplified. Third, we find that rates of smoking play a key role in explaining all three empirical puzzles, with secondary roles attributed to income, other health behaviors, and state policies. Less well-understood is why “place effects” matter so much for smoking (and mortality) for those without a college degree.

10.3386/w34553.abstractZh: 在过去三十年中，教育与死亡率之间的差距显著扩大，拥有大学学位与没有大学学位的人之间的预期寿命差距从1992年的2.6年增加到2019年的6.3年（Case和Deaton 2023）。在同一时期，各县的死亡率不平等程度上升了30%，同时农村地区的健康问题也日益严重。通过利用1992年至2019年间的县级和州级数据，我们发现这三种趋势的出现是由于大学毕业生与非大学毕业生之间死亡率的地理分布发生了根本性的变化。首先，我们发现大学毕业生无论是死亡率还是地理上的不平等程度都显著下降。其次，非大学毕业生的情况则相反，地理上的不平等程度反而加剧。第三，我们发现吸烟率在解释这三种现象中起着关键作用，而收入、其他健康行为以及州政策则起到次要作用。目前尚不清楚为什么“地域效应”对没有大学学位的人来说在吸烟（以及死亡率）方面如此重要。

abstract.text: Governments often concurrently deploy multiple policy instruments to tackle a common objective, yet researchers typically analyze each policy's impacts independently. We study interactions across policies and their implications within the context of efforts to reduce Medicare-financed home health services. We consider two geographically targeted policies: strike force prosecutions of suspected fraud and moratoria on the entry of new home health agencies. Depending on location and time, we observe either both, one, or neither policy in place. Individually, each policy reduced home health use substantially, and was well-targeted to places with higher treatment effects. Although we estimate only a modest interaction between the two policies, we find that optimally allocating them across the areas that received at least one policy could have increased their total impact by about 20% relative to the observed placement. Our exercise highlights the potential gains from coordination across different policy instruments pursuing similar objectives.

10.3386/w34554.abstractZh: 政府通常会同时采用多种政策工具来达成共同目标，但研究人员通常独立分析每种政策的影响。我们研究了在减少由医疗保险资助的家庭健康服务方面的政策之间的相互作用及其影响。我们考虑了两项具有地理针对性的政策：对涉嫌欺诈的嫌疑人进行打击性起诉，以及暂停新家庭健康机构的注册。根据地点和时间的不同，我们观察到这两项政策中的一项、两项或都没有实施。单独来看，每项政策都显著减少了家庭健康服务的使用，并且主要针对那些治疗效果较高的地区。尽管我们仅估计了这两项政策之间的适度相互作用，但我们发现，在至少实施了一项政策的地区中，最优地分配这些政策可能会使它们的总影响比实际实施情况增加约20%。我们的研究强调了在追求类似目标的不同政策工具之间进行协调所带来的潜在收益。

abstract.text: We study an intervention that reduced cesarean deliveries among low-risk first-time mothers, using California birth records linked to earnings data. Exposed mothers were 8% less likely to have a c-section, with no adverse health effects. We find suggestive evidence that they were more likely to return to their pre-birth employer and had higher within-firm earnings rankings in the quarter post-birth. These labor market gains fade over time. However, mothers who had a second child were less likely to have a c-section or preterm delivery, suggesting our estimated effects from avoiding a first c-section may be lower bounds on total gains.

10.3386/w34556.abstractZh: 我们研究了一项干预措施，该措施减少了低风险首次生育的母亲进行剖宫产的情况，研究数据来源于与收入数据相关的加州出生记录。接受该干预措施的母亲进行剖宫产的可能性降低了8%，且并未出现不良健康影响。我们发现，这些母亲更有可能回到分娩前的雇主处工作，并且在分娩后的一个季度内，她们在公司的收入排名有所提升。然而，这些劳动力市场上的收益会随着时间而消失。不过，有第二个孩子的母亲进行剖宫产或早产的可能性更低，这表明我们估计的通过避免首次剖宫产所带来的总收益可能只是下限。

abstract.text: We estimate the short-term cognitive effects of fine particulate matter (PM2.5) exposure using highly time-resolved, individual-level data collected during cognitive testing in Kenya. By linking real-time portable monitor readings to Harmonized Cognitive Assessment Protocol (HCAP) scores, we identify acute impacts of pollution on general and domain-specific cognition. Higher PM2.5 exposure during testing is associated with lower cognitive performance, particularly in memory, executive function, and visuospatial tasks. Nonlinear models suggest threshold effects, with larger declines at higher exposure levels. Notably, effects are significantly larger among more educated individuals, possibly due to greater task demands or lower chronic exposure that limits physiological adaptation. Given that cognitive impairment is evident even at PM2.5 levels below Kenya’s annual regulatory threshold of 35 μg/m³, the findings suggest that short-term exposure may impose underappreciated human capital costs that current regulatory standards fail to mitigate. The results highlight the potential cognitive and economic returns to interventions that reduce air pollution exposures in low-resource settings.

10.3386/w34557.abstractZh: 我们利用在肯尼亚进行认知测试时收集的高时间分辨率的个体级数据，估算了细颗粒物（PM2.5）暴露对短期认知影响的效应。通过将实时便携式监测仪的读数与统一认知评估协议（HCAP）得分进行关联，我们发现了污染对一般认知和特定领域认知的急性影响。在测试期间，较高的PM2.5暴露水平与较低的认知表现相关，尤其是在记忆、执行功能和视觉空间任务方面。非线性模型表明存在阈值效应，暴露水平越高，认知下降幅度越大。值得注意的是，受教育程度较高的个体所受影响更为显著，这可能是由于任务要求更高或慢性暴露限制生理适应的缘故。鉴于即使在肯尼亚年度监管阈值35微克/立方米以下的PM2.5水平下，认知损伤也是显而易见的，这些发现表明短期暴露可能会带来被低估的人力资本成本，而当前的监管标准未能有效缓解这一问题。研究结果强调了在资源匮乏的环境中，减少空气污染暴露的干预措施可能带来的认知和经济效益。

abstract.text: Private health insurers play a central role in determining the cost and quantity of health care in the United States. Despite this centrality, there has been limited empirical work studying how insurers differentially affect spending and consumption, especially for expensive and pervasive chronic conditions. We use hundreds of natural experiments involving employers switching their primary health insurer, together with a movers design, to estimate these causal effects. We find meaningful differences in total cost and prices for medical and pharmaceutical spending. Within-person changes in spending caused by forced reassignment across pairs of insurers, holding fixed plan generosity, are as large as 30% of total medical spending and 37% of drug spending. We also find substantial dispersion in insurer causal effects on health care spending and quantities for patients with diabetes, hypertension, and other chronic conditions. We find strong evidence for drug offsets as insurers who causally increase drug utilization also reduce medical costs and quantities overall and by condition. Finally, we find that employers do not select plans that reduce costs for their employees based on the match between employee conditions and estimated plan treatment effects, leaving significant cost savings on the table.

10.3386/w34561.abstractZh: 私人健康保险公司在决定美国医疗保健的成本和数量方面发挥着核心作用。尽管具有这种核心地位，但关于保险公司如何不同地影响支出和消费的研究却非常有限，尤其是在针对昂贵且普遍存在的慢性疾病的方面。我们利用了数百个涉及雇主更换主要健康保险公司的自然实验，并结合了移动设计来估计这些因果效应。我们发现，在医疗和药品支出方面，总成本和价格存在显著的差异。在固定计划福利水平的情况下，由于被迫更换保险公司而导致的个人支出变化，其幅度可达医疗总支出的30%和药品支出的37%。我们还发现，对于糖尿病、高血压和其他慢性病患者来说，不同保险公司在医疗支出和数量上的影响存在显著差异。我们发现，那些导致药物使用增加的保险公司，实际上也降低了整体医疗成本和数量。最后，我们发现雇主并不会根据员工病情与估计的保险计划治疗效果之间的匹配来选择能够降低员工成本的保险计划，从而留下了巨大的成本节省空间。

abstract.text: Policymakers at the state and federal levels have argued that restricting online sales of e-cigarettes is a crucial policy tool to curb youth vaping. This study is the first to explore the effectiveness of statewide restrictions on online sales of electronic nicotine delivery systems (ENDS) on teen and young adult ENDS use. Using data from four national datasets (Monitoring the Future, State and Combined Youth Risk Behavior Surveillance System surveys, Population Assessment of Tobacco and Health, and Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System survey) and a generalized difference-in-differences approach, we find no evidence that such laws are effective at curbing youth ENDS use. With 95 percent confidence, we can rule out that online sales restrictions reduced prior-month ENDS use by more than 3.6 percent of the pre-treatment mean vaping rate. An exploration of mechanisms suggests that (1) while restrictions on online sales may have a small negative effect on online purchases, youths are able to substitute to other sources for ENDS products to compensate for reduced online access, and (2) online sources are a very rare source of e-cigarettes for youths. Finally, we also find no evidence that online sales restrictions reduce adult ENDS use.

10.3386/w34565.abstractZh: 州和联邦层面的政策制定者认为，限制电子香烟的在线销售是遏制青少年使用电子烟的关键政策工具。本研究首次探讨了全州范围内对电子尼古丁输送系统在线销售的限制对青少年和年轻成年人使用此类产品的影响。通过利用四个全国数据集（Monitoring the Future、State and Combined Youth Risk Behavior Surveillance System调查、Population Assessment of Tobacco and Health以及Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System调查）以及广义差异比较方法，我们发现这些法律在遏制青少年使用电子尼古丁输送系统方面并未有效。我们有95%的置信度可以排除在线销售限制使前一个月的电子尼古丁输送系统使用率降低超过3.6%的可能性。对机制的分析表明，虽然在线销售限制可能对在线购买产生轻微的负面影响，但青少年能够通过其他渠道获取电子尼古丁输送系统产品来弥补在线购买的减少，而且在线渠道对青少年来说是非常罕见的获取途径。最后，我们也没有发现在线销售限制能够减少成年人使用电子尼古丁输送系统的现象。

abstract.text: Studies show that U.S. state cannabis legalization has increased adult cannabis use, but the effects on youth use are mixed. This study considers whether omission of enforcement of the minimum legal sales age (MLSA) might help explain prior mixed findings. We combine biennial survey data for 6th, 8th, 10th, and 12th grade students from the 2010-2023 Washington Healthy Youth Survey with administrative data on premise and compliance checks from the Washington State Liquor and Cannabis Board (WSLCB). Premise checks educate retailers on any potential violations but do not involve penalties or fines. Compliance checks, on the other hand, involve increasing penalties imposed on retailers if they are found to be noncompliant with sales to minors. We use difference-in-differences (DID) methods that are robust to a staggered policy rollout with dynamic and heterogeneous treatment effects and assess impacts of both types of inspections on past month cannabis use. We conduct a series of sensitivity and robustness checks of the impact of both types of inspections based on student’s grade, length of time since inspection, inclusion of alcohol/tobacco retail compliance checks, and alternative measures of cannabis use. Our research suggests that the implementation of regular random compliance checks with stiff penalties on retailers for noncompliance may help reduce the influence of legal markets on youth use. Unobserved heterogeneity within and across states in the enforcement of MLSAs may contribute to mixed findings of the impact of legalization on youth cannabis use.

10.3386/w34567.abstractZh: 研究表明，美国各州大麻合法化后，成年人的大麻使用量有所增加，但其对青少年使用的影响则不一。本研究探讨了是否取消最低合法销售年龄的规定可能有助于解释这些不一致的结果。我们结合了2010年至2023年华盛顿州健康青年调查中关于6年级、8年级、10年级和12年级学生的双年度调查数据，以及华盛顿州酒类和大麻管理局提供的关于店铺检查和合规情况的行政数据。店铺检查旨在教育零售商了解潜在的违规行为，但并不会涉及罚款或处罚。而合规检查则涉及对不遵守禁止向未成年人销售规定的零售商增加处罚。我们采用了差异中的差异方法，该方法能够应对分阶段政策实施的情况，同时能够处理动态且异质性的处理效果，并评估这两种检查类型对过去一个月大麻使用的影响。我们还进行了一系列敏感性分析和稳健性检验，以评估基于学生年级、检查时间、是否包含酒精/烟草零售合规检查以及替代的大麻使用衡量标准等因素，这两种检查类型对大麻使用的影响。我们的研究指出，定期随机进行合规检查，并对不合规的零售商实施严厉的处罚，可能有助于减少法律市场对青少年使用大麻的影响。各州在实施最低合法销售年龄规定方面的差异，也可能导致关于合法化对青少年大麻使用影响的研究结果出现不一致的情况。

abstract.text: The Istanbul Convention is an international treaty aimed at protecting women against violence. We employ survey datasets and investigate its effect on attitudes toward violence against women in Europe. Using difference-in-differences models we compare individuals in countries that signed and ratified the Convention with those in countries that signed but either never ratified or did so after the surveys were fielded. Entry into the Convention significantly reduced the likelihood that lower-educated individuals view violence against women as acceptable, but only in countries outside the former Eastern Bloc. In former Eastern Bloc countries, the Convention affected attitudes only among younger less-educated individuals who had limited exposure to communism—those who were no older than teenagers when the Soviet Union collapsed in 1990. We show that younger cohorts in these countries tend to hold more individualistic and less pro-government attitudes and express greater trust in the courts and the justice system than older individuals. Finally, we find no effect of the Convention on attitudes toward other forms of norm-violating behavior, such as tax evasion, bribery, fare evasion, or drug use. These results indicate that the Convention had a targeted impact, and that its influence on shaping preferences depends on the broader cultural context which is itself shaped by institutions.

10.3386/w34568.abstractZh: 《伊斯坦布尔公约》是一项旨在保护女性免受暴力的国际条约。我们采用调查数据集，研究该公约对欧洲对暴力侵害妇女态度的影响。通过差异-差异模型，我们将签署并批准该公约的国家与那些仅签署但未批准或是在调查完成后才批准的国家中的个体进行比较。加入该公约显著降低了低教育水平群体将暴力侵害妇女视为可接受的可能性，但这一效果仅在前东欧集团国家中存在。在前东欧集团国家，该公约只对那些年轻且受教育程度较低、对共产主义了解有限的群体产生了影响——这些人在1990年苏联解体时还不到青少年年龄。我们发现，这些国家的年轻群体往往持有更个人主义且对政府态度更消极的观点，并且比年长群体更信任法院和司法系统。最后，我们发现该公约对其他形式的违反规范行为，如逃税、贿赂、逃票或吸毒等，没有产生影响。这些结果表明，该公约具有针对性，其对偏好塑造的影响取决于更广泛的文化背景，而这一背景又受到制度的塑造。

abstract.text: I argue that in long-term consumer–producer relationships, menus of contracts can be advantageously replaced by a single generous contract such that, at any point in time, the sum of a consumer’s transfers is equal to the sum of transfers they would have made under the contract that is the best for them in hindsight. Such generous long-term contracts can increase skeptical consumers’ demand for complex and higher-powered contracts while approximately implementing the same outcomes as the underlying menu evaluated by a rational decision maker. Applications include voluntary load shedding in retail electricity markets and cost sharing in health insurance.

10.3386/w34593.abstractZh: 我认为，在长期消费者与生产者关系中，合同方案可以有利地被单一且慷慨的合同所替代。这样一来，在任何时间点，消费者的转移总额都等同于在事后看来对自己最有利的合同下他们本应做出的转移总额。这种慷慨的长期合同能够增加持怀疑态度的消费者对复杂且功能更强的合同的需求，同时大致实现与理性决策者评估的基础方案相同的结果。其应用包括零售电力市场的自愿负荷削减以及健康保险中的成本分担。

abstract.text: How does academic research inform presidential economic policy? This paper investigates the sources of evidence in the Economic Report of the President from 2010 to 2025. We construct a novel dataset of 4,140 unique references cited across the Obama, Trump, and Biden administrations to map the evidence base used by the Council of Economic Advisers. Our analysis shows that peer-reviewed articles, comprising 66.62% of all these references, are heavily concentrated in top-tier economics journals. While the specific articles cited change with policy priorities, the hierarchy of journals remains moderately stable across years and administrations. A co-author network analysis reveals a scholarly landscape of distinct intellectual camps. Crucially, a small number of high-centrality scholars act as brokers, connecting these disparate research communities. Together, our findings illuminate the social structure of evidence-based policymaking, demonstrating how journal hierarchies and scholarly networks shape the flow of economic knowledge to the White House.

10.3386/w34597.abstractZh: 学术研究如何为总统的经济政策提供信息？本文研究了2010年至2025年间《总统经济报告》中证据来源的情况。我们构建了一个包含4,140个独特引用文献的新数据集，涵盖了奥巴马、特朗普和拜登政府时期的资料，以了解经济顾问委员会所使用的证据基础。分析显示，占所有引用文献66.62%的同行评审文章主要集中在顶级经济学期刊上。虽然具体引用的文章会随着政策重点的变化而发生变化，但期刊的层级结构在不同年份和不同政府期间保持相对稳定。作者网络分析揭示了不同的学术阵营。重要的是，少数高影响力的学者充当了桥梁，将这些不同的研究社区联系起来。我们的研究结果揭示了基于证据的政策制定的社会结构，说明了期刊层级和学术网络如何塑造经济知识向白宫的传递。

abstract.text: We leverage the introduction of the first antibiotic therapies in 1937 to examine the long run effects of early childhood pneumonia on adult educational attainment, employment, income, and work-related disability. Using census data, we document large average gains on all outcomes, alongside substantial heterogeneity by race and gender. On average, Black men exhibit smaller schooling gains than white men but larger employment and earnings gains. Among Black men (and women), we identify a pronounced gradient in gains linked to systemic racial discrimination in the pre–Civil Rights era: individuals born in more discriminatory Jim Crow states realized much smaller gains than those born in less discriminatory states. There is no similar gradient among white Americans. Women of both races exhibit smaller education and earnings gains than men on average, consistent with cultural and institutional barriers to women’s work. Our findings highlight the role of opportunities in shaping the extent to which investments in early-life health translate into longer run economic gains.

10.3386/w34606.abstractZh: 我们借助1937年首次引入抗生素疗法这一契机，来研究儿童期肺炎对成年人教育水平、就业、收入和职业障碍的长期影响。通过人口普查数据，我们发现所有相关指标均呈现出显著的平均收益，但不同种族和性别之间存在显著差异。总体而言，黑人男性的教育收益低于白人男性，但就业和收入收益则更高。在黑人男性（及女性）中，我们发现与种族歧视相关的收益存在明显的梯度差异：出生在歧视性更强的吉姆·克劳州的人，其收益远低于出生在歧视性较弱的州的人。而在白人美国人中，则不存在类似的梯度差异。无论何种种族，女性的教育和收入收益均低于男性，这与文化和制度对女性工作的阻碍有关。我们的研究结果强调了机会在决定早期健康投资能否带来长期经济收益方面的作用。

abstract.text: Introduction: Hospital competition has been a common feature in healthcare reforms worldwide, yet scant attention has been paid to its impact on healthcare quality in China. This study aims to comprehensively evaluate the impact of hospital competition on healthcare quality under China's healthcare reform. Methods: This study used multiple datasets comprising city-level and individual-level data of 21,974 individuals across 150 districts. We employed a two-way fixed effects model to estimate the impact of hospital competition on healthcare quality. To mitigate endogeneity concerns, we instrumented hospital competition with the inverse of the average distance and average travel time from patients to hospitals and performed the Two-Stage Least Squares methods. Results: This study showed a positive effect of hospital competition on both technical and non-technical healthcare quality. The impact is larger for primary hospitals and inpatient services; it is significantly positive for technical healthcare quality in public hospitals. Additionally, our findings implied that hospital competition affects healthcare income, which in turn affects non-technical healthcare quality, but healthcare income and demand jointly influence the relationship between hospital competition and technical healthcare quality. Conclusion: The finding provides new evidence of the impact of hospital competition on both technical and non-technical healthcare quality in China, highlighting a positive relationship that differs from some previous studies. This evidence offers valuable policy implications on hospital competition and also emphasizes the importance of considering the heterogeneity of hospitals and services in policy-making.

10.3389/fpubh.2025.1543884.abstractZh: 引言：医院竞争是全球医疗改革中的常见现象，但对中国医疗质量的影响却鲜有研究。本研究旨在全面评估医院竞争对中国医疗质量的影响。方法：本研究使用了包含21,974名个体在150个地区的城市级和个体级数据，采用双向固定效应模型来估计医院竞争对医疗质量的影响。为缓解内生性问题的困扰，我们通过使用患者到医院的平均距离的倒数和平均出行时间作为工具变量，并采用两阶段最小二乘法进行分析。结果：研究结果显示，医院竞争对医疗质量的技术和非技术方面都有积极影响。对于初级医院和住院服务而言，这种影响更为显著；对于公立医院的技术医疗质量，影响则较为明显。此外，研究还发现，医院竞争会影响医疗收入，而医疗收入又会影响非技术医疗质量，但医疗收入和需求共同影响着医院竞争与技术医疗质量之间的关系。结论：本研究为医院竞争对中国医疗质量的影响提供了新的证据，揭示了与一些先前研究不同的正相关性。这些发现为医院竞争的政策制定提供了有价值的参考，同时也强调了在政策制定中考虑医院和服务异质性的重要性。

abstract.text: Background: The global misallocation of healthcare resources has emerged as a critical impediment to public health. In China, healthcare resources are predominantly concentrated in major cities and high-tier hospitals, while primary care facilities suffer from inadequate capacity, contributing to issues such as "difficult and expensive access to healthcare." Despite numerous healthcare reforms, significant disparities in resource distribution persist. Objective: This study seeks to elucidate the causal effects of healthcare system reform on the misallocation of medical resources and to investigate the underlying mechanisms. Focusing on the healthcare reform implemented in Sanming in 2012 as a quasi-natural experiment, the research employs the synthetic control method (SCM) to assess the policy's impact on resource misallocation. Methods: The synthetic control method is applied to estimate the causal impact of the Sanming Medical Reform on the misallocation of healthcare resources. By constructing a weighted control group that replicates Sanming's counterfactual resource allocation trajectory in the absence of the reform, the model controls for covariates such as industrial structure, GDP, and human resources to ensure precise estimation of the policy effect. Data were obtained from the National Bureau of Statistics, local health commissions, and other sources, forming a balanced panel dataset of 203 cities spanning 2007 to 2022. Results: The analysis reveals that the Sanming Medical Reform markedly reduced the misallocation of healthcare resources. Following the 2012 intervention, Sanming exhibited a substantial decline in misallocation, with the misallocation index decreasing by an average of 0.1412 between 2013 and 2017. Both city-level and time placebo tests confirm that the observed policy effect is statistically significant and not attributable to random variation. Mechanism analysis further indicates that the reform achieved its outcomes by increasing government expenditure on health and refining the structure of health insurance. Conclusion: The empirical evidence demonstrates that the Sanming Medical Reform effectively alleviated the misallocation of healthcare resources and bolstered primary care capacity through enhanced government spending and optimized health insurance payment structures. These findings offer valuable insights and empirical support for healthcare reforms in China and other countries, paving the way for more equitable and efficient resource allocation.

10.3389/fpubh.2025.1671174.abstractZh:
背景：全球医疗资源的错配已成为公共卫生面临的重要障碍。在中国，医疗资源主要集中在大城市和高端医院，而基层医疗机构的容量不足，导致“就医难、就医贵”的问题。尽管进行了多次医疗改革，资源分配上的差异仍然显著。  
目的：本研究旨在阐明医疗体系改革对医疗资源错配的因果效应，并探讨其背后的机制。以2012年实施的三明医改作为准自然实验，采用合成控制法来评估该政策对资源错配的影响。  
方法：采用合成控制法来估算三明医改对医疗资源错配的因果影响。通过构建一个加权对照组，模拟在没有改革的情况下三明医疗资源分配的轨迹，从而控制产业结构、GDP和人力资源等变量，以确保对政策效果的精确估计。数据来源于国家统计局、地方卫生委员会等渠道，形成了涵盖2007至2022年203个城市的平衡面板数据集。  
结果：分析显示，三明医改显著减少了医疗资源的错配。在2012年改革后，三明市的医疗资源错配程度大幅下降，2013至2017年间，错配指数平均减少了0.1412。城市和时间的安慰剂测试都证实，观察到的政策效果具有统计学意义，且不能归因于随机变异。机制分析进一步表明，该改革通过增加政府在医疗方面的支出以及优化医疗保险结构来实现其效果。结论：实证证据表明，三明医疗改革有效缓解了医疗资源的错配问题，并通过增加政府支出和优化医疗保险支付结构，提升了基层医疗能力。这些发现为中国及其他国家的医疗改革提供了宝贵的见解和实证支持，为更公平、高效的资源配置铺平了道路。

abstract.text: Background: With the rapid development of China's social economy, the state has introduced a number of social security and employment policies, which are centered on the principles of stabilizing employment, ensuring people's livelihood, and supporting key groups. Empirical research often employs cross-sectional data to examine the impact of low-quality employment on the mental health of workers, but the evidence regarding the correlation between employment quality and mental health remains insufficient. Methods: This study aims to analyze the potential long-term impact of low-quality employment on mental health. By applying the employment arrangement typology method, we utilized the survey data from the China Family Longitudinal Survey (CFPS) from 2016 to 2018 to explore the association between employment quality and mental health, and further investigated whether the strength of work-family values (i.e., the emphasis on career success and child-rearing) and gender differences led to differences in this association pattern. Conclusion: Through potential category clustering analysis of representative Chinese panel data, we identified six types of employment quality: standard employment, unstable and unsustainable employment, full-time but unstable employment, mild standard employment, mixed employment, and protected parttime employment. After controlling for sociodemographic characteristics, the research results show that compared with the standard employment pattern, men engaged in unstable and unsustainable jobs, as well as women in full-time unstable jobs, have significantly lower mental health levels two years later. Although protected part-time jobs have a more negative impact on the mental health of people with middle and high working family values, the interaction analysis shows that the moderating role of values in the relationship between employment quality and mental health does not present a clear pattern among different gender groups. Discussion: It is suggested that future research should replicate these findings in different countries to verify the correlation.

10.3389/fpubh.2025.1677809.abstractZh: 背景：随着中国社会经济的快速发展，国家出台了一系列社会保障和就业政策，这些政策以稳定就业、保障民生和支持关键群体为核心原则。实证研究通常采用横截面数据来研究低质量就业对工人心理健康的影响，但关于就业质量与心理健康之间关联性的证据仍然不足。方法：本研究旨在分析低质量就业对心理健康的潜在长期影响。通过应用就业安排类型学方法，我们利用2016至2018年中国家庭纵向调查的数据，探讨就业质量与心理健康之间的关联，并进一步研究工作家庭价值观（即对职业成功和育儿的重视程度）以及性别差异是否导致这种关联模式的差异。结论：通过对代表性中国面板数据的潜在类别聚类分析，我们识别出六种类型的就业质量：标准就业、不稳定且不可持续的就业、全职但不稳定的就业、轻度标准就业、混合就业以及受保护的兼职就业。在控制社会人口学特征后，研究结果表明，与标准就业模式相比，从事不稳定且不可持续工作的男性，以及从事全职不稳定工作的女性，在两年后的心理健康水平明显较低。尽管受保护的兼职工作对具有中高工作价值观的人的心理健康有更负面的影响，但交互分析表明，价值观在就业质量与心理健康之间的关系中所起的调节作用在不同性别群体中并没有呈现出明显的模式。讨论：建议未来的研究应在不同国家进行重复实验，以验证这种相关性。

abstract.text: This study examines how the organizational work climate shapes the effectiveness of supervision on employee performance. While traditional management theory assumes supervision universally enhances productivity, we observe a puzzling paradox: facing identical tasks and wage systems, some firms rely heavily on hierarchical supervision while others thrive with minimal oversight. Through a four-month field experiment across two Chinese agricultural enterprises (5851 observations), we test whether the supervision’s effectiveness depends on the alignment between leadership practices and organizational climate. In formal management firms (FMFs) characterized by hierarchical governance and arm’s-length employment relationships, directive supervision significantly reduces task completion times by 0.126 standard deviations, equivalent to approximately 4.3 s or 2.8% of the average completion time, with this effect remaining stable throughout the workday. Conversely, in network-embedded firms (NEFs) operating through trust-based relational contracts and social norms, identical supervisory practices yield no performance gains, as informal social control mechanisms already ensure high effort levels, rendering formal supervision redundant. These findings challenge the “best practices” paradigm in strategic HRM, demonstrating that HR success requires a careful alignment between leadership approaches and the organizational climate—an effective HR strategy is not about implementing standardized practices but about achieving a strategic fit between supervisory leadership styles and existing work climates. This climate–leadership partnership is essential for optimizing both employee performance and organizational success.

10.3390/admsci15100385.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了组织工作氛围如何影响对员工绩效的监督效果。传统管理理论认为监督普遍能提升生产力，但我们观察到一种令人困惑的悖论：在任务相同且薪酬体系一致的情况下，一些企业依赖严格的层级监督，而另一些企业则通过最少的监督就能取得良好效果。通过在中国两家农业企业进行的为期四个月的实地实验（共观测了5851次数据），我们测试了监督效果是否取决于领导方式与组织氛围的契合程度。在具有层级治理和独立雇佣关系的正式管理企业中，指令性监督显著缩短了任务完成时间，减少了0.126个标准差，相当于平均完成时间的约4.3秒或2.8%，且这一效果在工作日中保持稳定。相反，在基于信任关系和社会规范运作的网络型企业中，相同的监督方式并未带来绩效提升，因为非正式的社会控制机制已经确保了较高的工作投入度，使得正式监督变得多余。这些发现挑战了战略人力资源管理的“最佳实践”范式，表明人力资源管理的成功需要领导方式与组织氛围之间的精确匹配——有效的HR策略不是实施标准化做法，而是实现监督领导风格与现有工作氛围之间的战略契合。这种氛围与领导方式的结合对于优化员工绩效和组织成功至关重要。

abstract.text: Expensive medical devices, especially in the areas of orthopedics, and cardiology, have a significant impact on hospital costs and the delivery of high-quality services. These medical supplies are known as physician preference items (PPIs), as they act as “surrogate buyers”—impacting the selection and sourcing of products. There is a gap between the purchasing strategy and the adoption of tactical activities for these complex medical supplies. In the context of the healthcare exceptionalism thesis, this research investigates how healthcare organizations can successfully adopt suitable sourcing levers aiming to achieve different purchasing results. This research conducts a multi-case study in 15 healthcare organizations in nine countries. Three new sourcing levers specific to the healthcare sector emerged, based on the healthcare exceptionalism thesis. It was possible to identify five main sourcing levers clusters. The fit between strategy and tactical level can be allowed by the implementation of suitable sourcing levers—facilitating the achievement of the desired objectives. Healthcare procurement practitioners should assess the fit between strategy and the tactical level by employing suitable sourcing levers. Organizations wishing to move towards a value-based procurement approach should adopt a set of supporting sourcing levers to enable this transition.

10.3390/hospitals2020012.abstractZh: 昂贵的医疗设备，尤其是在骨科和心脏病学领域的设备，对医院成本和优质服务的提供有着显著的影响。这些医疗用品被称为“医生偏好物品”，因为它们充当了“替代购买者”，影响着产品的选择和采购。在采购策略与这些复杂医疗用品的采用之间存在着差距。在医疗例外论的背景下，本研究探讨了医疗机构如何成功采用合适的采购手段，以实现不同的采购结果。本研究对九个国家中的15个医疗机构进行了多案例研究。基于医疗例外论，发现了三个新的针对医疗行业的采购手段。可以识别出五个主要的采购手段集群。通过实施合适的采购手段，可以实现策略与战术层面的契合，从而帮助实现预期目标。医疗采购从业者应通过采用合适的采购手段来评估策略与战术层面的契合度。希望转向基于价值的采购方式的组织应采纳一系列支持性采购手段，以实现这一转变。

abstract.text: Background: Carbon pricing in the form of fuel taxes is an important tool for abating climate change. This study examines the impact and pass-through of fuel taxes in the truckload freight market. Methods: State-level truckload market data, integrated with retail diesel prices, are analyzed using fixed-effects regression modeling. Results: Taxes and fuel costs are not only passed on by diesel retailers to motor carriers; the results reveal the overshifting of diesel taxes from motor carriers to shippers. Conclusions: The findings are consistent with inelastic short-term demand for long-haul carriage, indicating that relatively large price increases will be necessary to reduce diesel consumption in the trucking industry.

10.3390/logistics9030121.abstractZh: 背景：以燃油税形式实施的碳定价是减缓气候变化的重要工具。本研究探讨了燃油税对卡车货运市场的影响及传递机制。方法：通过固定效应回归模型，分析了各州卡车货运市场的数据，并结合零售柴油价格进行了分析。结果：柴油零售商不仅将税费和燃油成本转嫁给货运公司，研究还揭示了柴油税从货运公司向发货人的过度传递现象。结论：研究结果与长途运输市场短期需求的非弹性特征一致，表明需要相对较大的价格涨幅才能减少卡车行业的柴油消耗。

abstract.text: In the context of growing global climate change awareness and intensifying environmental degradation, technological innovation in renewable energy has become a key realization method for sustainable development. This paper uses data samples from 30 provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions in China (excluding Tibet, Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan due to data availability) from 2007–2022, constructs an SFA model to measure carbon emission efficiency, and innovatively investigates the U-shaped impact of technological innovation in renewable energy on carbon emission efficiency along with the moderating effects of informatization level and fiscal decentralization. The empirical findings reveal the following: (1) Technological innovation in renewable energy demonstrates a U-shaped impact on carbon emission efficiency, with a negative impact before inflection point 2.596605 and a positive impact after the inflection point. (2) The informatization level plays a positive regulating role in the impact of technological innovation in renewable energy toward carbon emission efficiency, while fiscal decentralization exerts a negative regulating effect. (3) The impact of technological innovation in renewable energy concerning carbon emission efficiency varies depending on regional differences, industrial structure levels, and technological innovation levels in renewable energy. The conclusions of this paper are helpful for promoting the development of technological innovation in renewable energy, improving carbon emission efficiency, and advancing sustainable socio-economic development.

10.3390/su17156940.abstractZh: 在全球气候变化意识增强和环境退化加剧的背景下，可再生能源领域的技术创新已成为实现可持续发展的关键手段。本文采用2007至2022年中国30个省份、直辖市和自治区的数据样本（因数据限制，未包括西藏、香港、澳门和台湾），构建了一个单变量回归模型来测量碳排放效率，并创新性地研究了可再生能源技术创新对碳排放效率的U形影响，以及信息化水平和财政分权对这种影响的调节作用。实证结果发现：(1) 可再生能源技术创新对碳排放效率具有U形影响，在拐点2.596605之前表现为负面影响，在拐点之后则表现为正面影响。(2) 信息化水平对技术创新对碳排放效率的影响具有正向调节作用，而财政分权则具有负向调节效应。(3) 可再生能源技术创新对碳排放效率的影响因地区差异、产业结构水平以及可再生能源技术创新水平的不同而有所差异。本文的结论有助于促进可再生能源技术创新的发展，提高碳排放效率，推动可持续的社会经济发展。

abstract.text: This research analyzes the relationships among environmental factors, organizational structure, strategic orientation, and organizational performance within the Romanian medical system, addressing a theoretical gap in this context. A quantitative approach was applied, analyzing data from 502 employees in the Romanian medical sector. The study used a dual framework, integrating gestalt theory and mediation to examine the environment–structure–strategy–performance relationship. Two-stage cluster analysis, one-way analysis of variance, and partial least squares structural equation modeling tested direct and mediated effects among the variables. From a gestalt perspective, five distinct clusters demonstrated the interplay between environment, structure, and strategy. Romanian healthcare organizations align their structural elements and strategic decisions coherently and distinctly, considering contextual constraints, with implications for several performance dimensions, including patient satisfaction, financial stability, innovation, and internal process improvement. From a mediation perspective, both direct and mediated relationships indicate that organizational structure and strategic orientation positively affect organizational performance and suppress the negative contextual effects. This study contributes theoretically by extending contingency and gestalt theories to the Romanian healthcare context, showing that contextual fit, rather than structural uniformity, determines performance variation. Practically, the findings guide healthcare managers and policymakers in attenuating contextual shocks and improving organizational performance through strategic alignment and flexible structural design.

10.3390/systems13111018.abstractZh: 本研究分析了罗马尼亚医疗体系内环境因素、组织结构、战略导向与组织绩效之间的关系，填补了这一领域的理论空白。研究采用了定量分析方法，对罗马尼亚医疗行业502名员工的数据进行了分析。研究采用了整体论与中介效应分析框架，探讨了环境-结构-战略-绩效之间的关系。通过两阶段聚类分析、单因素方差分析和偏最小二乘结构方程模型，检验了变量之间的直接和中介效应。从整体论的角度来看，五个不同的聚类揭示了环境、结构和战略之间的相互作用。罗马尼亚医疗机构在做出战略决策时，会综合考虑情境约束，使结构要素与战略决策保持一致性和明确性，这对多个绩效维度都有影响，包括患者满意度、财务稳定性、创新能力和内部流程改进。从中介效应的角度来看，直接和中介关系表明，组织结构和战略导向对组织绩效有积极影响，并能抑制负面情境效应。本研究在理论上为罗马尼亚医疗体系提供了额外的理论支持，表明情境适应性而非结构一致性决定了绩效差异。在实际应用中，这些发现为医疗管理者和政策制定者提供了指导，帮助他们通过战略协调和灵活的结构设计来减轻情境冲击并提高组织绩效。

abstract.text: Auctions versus fixed prices: Lessons from a procurement pilot for rehabilitation services Private health care providers are often acquired through procurement auctions to produce publicly financed services. In this study, we examine the costs and benefits of fixed-price procurements compared to auctions. We examine the effects of a fixed-price procurement pilot in the Finnish rehabilitation markets in 2020. We analyze the effects of the pilot on the number of service providers using synthetic control method with data that covers three subsequent procurements. The analysis shows that the fixed price was higher than the average price of the accepted providers of the comparison services, but the number of participating providers decreased. Auctions provide information about service providers who are the most attractive in terms of pricequality ratio. The fixed price possibly caused some of the potential providers to opt out of the procurement.

10.37450/ht.138294.abstractZh:
拍卖与固定价格：来自康复服务采购试点项目的经验  
私人医疗服务提供者通常通过采购拍卖获得，以提供公共资助的服务。本研究探讨了固定价格采购与拍卖相比的成本与收益。我们分析了2020年芬兰康复市场中的固定价格采购试点项目的影响。通过合成控制方法，利用涵盖随后三次采购的数据，分析了该试点项目对服务提供者数量的影响。分析结果显示，固定价格高于比较服务中被接受提供者的平均价格，但参与提供者的数量却有所减少。拍卖能够提供关于在价格与质量比方面最具吸引力的服务提供者的信息。固定价格可能促使一些潜在提供者选择不参与采购。

abstract.text: A principal can restrict an agent's information (the persuasion problem) or discretion (the delegation problem). We study these two problems under standard single‐crossing assumptions on the agent's marginal utility. We show that these problems are equivalent on the set of monotone stochastic mechanisms, implying, in particular, the equivalence of deterministic delegation and monotone partitional persuasion. We also show that the monotonicity restriction is superfluous for linear persuasion and linear delegation, implying their equivalence on the set of all stochastic mechanisms. Finally, using tools from the persuasion literature, we characterize optimal delegation mechanisms, thereby generalizing and extending existing results in the delegation literature.

10.3982/ecta17051.abstractZh: 委托人可以限制代理人的信息获取（说服问题）或决策自由（委托问题）。我们在关于代理人边际效用的标准单交叉假设下研究了这两个问题。我们证明，在单调随机机制集合上，这两个问题是等价的，这特别意味着确定性委托与单调分割说服是等价的。我们还表明，对于线性说服和线性委托来说，单调性限制是多余的，这意味着它们在所有随机机制集合上是等价的。最后，利用说服领域的工具，我们描述了最优委托机制，从而推广并扩展了委托领域现有的研究成果。

abstract.text: Welfare depends on the quantity, quality, and range of goods consumed. We use trade data, which report the quantities and prices of the individual goods that countries exchange, to learn about how the gains from trade and growth break down into these different margins. Our general equilibrium model, in which both quality and quantity contribute to consumption and to production, captures (i) how prices increase with importer and exporter per capita income, (ii) how the range of goods traded rises with importer and exporter size, and (iii) how products traveling longer distances have higher prices. Our framework can deliver a standard gravity formulation for total trade flows and for the gains from trade. We find that growth in the extensive margin contributes to about half of overall gains. Quality plays a larger role in the welfare gains from international trade than from economic growth due to selection.

10.3982/ecta17510.abstractZh: 福利取决于消费的商品数量、质量和种类。我们利用贸易数据，这些数据记录了各国交换的各类商品的数量和价格，以此来了解贸易和增长带来的收益如何分配到不同的领域。我们的一般均衡模型认为，质量和数量都对消费和生产都有影响，能够反映以下现象：(i) 价格随着进口国和出口国人均收入的增加而上升；(ii) 随着进口国和出口国规模的扩大，交易商品的范围也会增加；(iii) 运输距离较长的商品价格更高。我们的框架能够为总贸易流量和贸易收益提供一个标准的分析框架。我们发现，广域边际的增长贡献了大约一半的总收益。与经济增长相比，国际贸易在福利收益方面对质量的依赖更为显著，因为质量的选择对福利的影响更大。

abstract.text: Landmines affect the lives of millions in many conflict‐ridden communities long after the end of hostilities. However, there is little research on the role of demining. We examine the economic consequences of landmine removal in Mozambique, the only country to transition from heavily contaminated in 1992 to mine‐free in 2015. First, we present the self‐assembled georeferenced catalog of areas suspected of contamination, along with a detailed record of demining operations. Second, the event‐study analysis reveals a robust association between demining activities and subsequent local economic performance, reflected in luminosity. Economic activity does not pick up in the years leading up to clearance, nor does it increase when operators investigate areas mistakenly marked as contaminated in prior surveys. Third, recognizing that landmine removal reshapes transportation access, we use a market‐access approach to explore direct and indirect effects. To advance on identification, we isolate changes in market access caused by removing landmines in previously considered safe areas, far from earlier nationwide surveys. Fourth, policy simulations reveal the substantial economywide dividends of clearance, but only when factoring in market‐access effects, which dwarf direct productivity links. Additionally, policy counterfactuals uncover significant aggregate costs when demining does not prioritize the unblocking of transportation routes. These results offer insights into the design of demining programs in Ukraine and elsewhere, highlighting the need for centralized coordination and prioritization of areas facilitating commerce.

10.3982/ecta17951.abstractZh: 地雷在许多冲突频发的社区中，即使在敌对行动结束后，仍影响着数百万人的生活。然而，关于排雷作用的研究却很少。我们研究了莫桑比克的地雷清除所带来的经济后果，该国在1992年受到严重地雷污染，到2015年实现了无地雷状态。首先，我们提供了疑似污染区域的自组装地理参考目录，以及详细的排雷行动记录。其次，事件研究分析显示，排雷活动与当地经济表现之间存在密切关联，这种关联体现在经济活动的活跃程度上。在清除地雷之前的几年里，经济活动并未出现明显增长，而当排雷人员调查之前被误标为污染区域的土地时，经济活动也没有增加。第三，考虑到地雷清除改变了交通通道，我们采用市场接入方法来探讨直接和间接影响。为了进一步分析，我们分离出因清除地雷而带来的市场接入变化，这些变化发生在远离早期全国范围调查的安全区域。第四，政策模拟显示，地雷清除对整体经济产生了显著的正面影响，但这只有在考虑市场接入效应的情况下才能体现，这些效应远远超过直接的生产力提升。此外，政策反事实分析表明，如果不优先解决交通路线的畅通问题，排雷工作将带来显著的总成本。这些结果为乌克兰及其他地区的排雷计划设计提供了重要启示，强调了需要集中协调并优先处理有利于商业发展的区域。

abstract.text: The 2009 CARD Act limited credit card lenders' ability to raise borrowers' interest rates on the basis of new information. Pricing became less responsive to public and private signals of borrowers' risk and demand characteristics, and price dispersion fell by one‐third. I estimate the efficiency and distributional effects of this shift toward more pooled pricing. Prices fell for high‐risk and price‐inelastic consumers, but prices rose elsewhere in the market and newly exceeded willingness to pay for over 30% of the safest subprime borrowers. On net, average traded prices fell and consumer surplus rose at all credit scores. Higher consumer surplus was partly driven by a fall in lender profits, and partly by the Act's insurance value to borrowers who could retain favorable pricing after adverse changes to their default risk. The relatively high level of pre‐CARD‐Act markups was crucial for realizing these surplus gains.

10.3982/ecta18063.abstractZh: 2009年的《信用卡法案》限制了信用卡放贷机构根据新信息提高借款人的利率。定价对公共和私人因素反映借款人风险与需求特征的反应减弱，价格分散度下降了三分之一。我估算了这种转向更集中定价方式的效率和分配效应。对于高风险和价格弹性低的消费者来说，价格下降，但在市场的其他部分，价格上升，对于最安全的次级借款人来说，新价格甚至超过了他们的支付意愿。总体而言，所有信用评分的消费者交易价格下降，消费者剩余增加。较高的消费者剩余部分是由于放贷机构利润下降，部分是由于该法案为借款人提供了保险价值，使他们能够在违约风险出现不利变化后仍能保持有利的定价。在《信用卡法案》实施之前，较高的价格加成对于实现这些收益至关重要。

abstract.text: Transparency versus opacity is an important dimension of college admission policy. Colleges may gain useful information from a holistic review of applicants' materials, but in doing so may contribute to uncertainty that discourages potential applicants with poor information. This paper investigates the impacts of admissions transparency in the context of Texas' Top Ten Percent Plan, using survey and administrative data from Texas and a model of college applications, admissions, enrollment, grades, and persistence. I estimate that two thirds of the plan's 9.1 point impact on top‐decile students' probability of attending a flagship university was due to information rather than mechanical effects. Students induced to enroll are more likely to come from low‐income high schools, and academically outperform the students that they displace. These effects would be larger if complemented by financial‐aid information, and are driven by transparency, not misalignment between the rules used for automatic and discretionary admissions.

10.3982/ecta18385.abstractZh: 透明性与不透明性是大学录取政策中的一个重要维度。大学可以通过全面审查申请者的材料来获取有用信息，但这样做可能会带来不确定性，从而让信息不足的潜在申请者望而却步。本文研究了在德克萨斯州“前百分之十计划”背景下，录取透明性所带来的影响，使用了德克萨斯州的调查和行政数据，以及关于大学申请、录取、注册、成绩和持续表现的数据模型。研究估计，该计划对前十分之一学生进入顶尖大学概率的9.1点影响中，有三分之二是由于信息因素而非机械效应造成的。被诱导注册的学生的家庭背景通常来自低收入家庭，且在学业表现上优于被替代的学生。如果这些影响能结合财务援助信息，其效果将会更大，而这些影响是由透明度驱动的，而非自动录取和自主录取规则之间的不一致性所决定的。

abstract.text: Fiduciary duty aims to solve principal‐agent problems, and the United States is in the middle of a protracted debate surrounding the merits of extending it to all financial advisers. Leveraging a transaction‐level data set of deferred annuities and state‐level variation in common law fiduciary duty, we find that it raises risk‐adjusted returns by 25 bp and leads to a 16% decline in the entry of affected firms. Through the lens of a model of entry and advice provision, we show that this effect can be due to both an increase in fixed costs and an increase in the cost of providing low‐quality advice. We show how to disentangle these channels and find that both are empirically relevant. Counterfactual simulations show that further increases in the stringency of fiduciary duty monotonically improve advice quality.

10.3982/ecta18492.abstractZh: 信托责任旨在解决委托-代理问题，而美国正在就是否应将这一责任扩展到所有金融顾问的问题进行长期辩论。通过利用关于递延年金的交易级数据集以及普通法信托责任在州级上的差异，我们发现这会使风险调整后的回报提高25个基点，并导致受影响公司的进入率下降16%。通过进入和咨询提供模型的分析，我们发现这种效应可能是由于固定成本的增加以及提供低质量咨询的成本增加所导致的。我们展示了如何区分这两种渠道，并发现两者在实证上都是相关的。反事实模拟表明，进一步加强对信托责任的严格要求会显著提高咨询质量。

abstract.text: Econometric analysis typically focuses on the statistical properties of fixed estimators and ignores researcher choices. In this article, I instead approach the analysis of experimental data as a mechanism‐design problem that acknowledges that researchers choose between estimators, sometimes based on the data and often according to their own preferences. Specifically, I focus on covariate adjustments, which can increase the precision of a treatment‐effect estimate, but open the door to bias when researchers engage in specification searches. First, I establish that unbiasedness as a requirement on the estimation of the average treatment effect can align researchers' preferences with the minimization of the mean‐squared error relative to the truth, and that fixing the bias can yield an optimal restriction in a minimax sense. Second, I provide a constructive characterization of treatment‐effect estimators with fixed bias as sample‐splitting procedures. Third, I discuss the implementation of second‐best estimators that leave room for beneficial specification searches.

10.3982/ecta18640.abstractZh: 计量经济学分析通常关注固定估计量的统计特性，而忽略了研究者的选择。在本文中，我将实验数据的分析视为一个机制设计问题，承认研究者会在不同估计量之间进行选择，有时是基于数据，而更多时候则是基于他们的个人偏好。具体来说，我关注协变量调整，这可以提高处理效应估计的精确度，但在研究者进行规格搜索时，也可能引入偏差。首先，我证明了作为平均处理效应估计要求的无偏性可以将研究者的偏好与相对于真实值的均方误差的最小化相结合，并且固定偏差可以在极小极大意义上产生最优限制。其次，我提出了一种具有固定偏差的处理效应估计量的构造性描述，这些估计量属于样本分割程序。第三，我讨论了实施第二优估计量的方法，这些方法为有益的规格搜索留下了空间。

abstract.text: We recover valuations of time using detailed data from a large ride‐hail platform, where drivers bid on trips and consumers choose between a set of rides with different prices and wait times. Leveraging a consumer panel, we estimate demand as a function of both prices and wait times and use the resulting estimates to recover heterogeneity in the value of time across consumers. We study the welfare implications of personalized pricing and its effect on the platform, drivers, and consumers. Taking into account drivers' optimal reaction to the platform's pricing policy, personalized pricing lowers consumer surplus by 2.5% and increases overall surplus by 5.2%. Like the platform, drivers benefit from personalized pricing. By conditioning prices on drivers' wait times and not on consumers' data, the platform can capture a significant portion of the profits garnered from personalized pricing, and simultaneously benefit consumers.

10.3982/ecta18838.abstractZh: 我们利用一个大型叫车平台的详细数据来估算时间的价值。在该平台上，司机竞标出行任务，而消费者则需要在不同价格与等待时间的出行选项中做出选择。通过利用消费者调查数据，我们估计了需求与价格和等待时间之间的关系，并利用这些估计结果来揭示不同消费者对时间价值的差异。我们研究了个性化定价对平台、司机和消费者的福利影响。考虑到司机对平台定价政策的最佳反应，个性化定价使消费者剩余减少了2.5%，而整体收益则增加了5.2%。与平台一样，司机也从个性化定价中受益。通过将价格与司机的等待时间相关联，而非与消费者的数据相关联，该平台能够获取来自个性化定价的大部分利润，同时还能为消费者带来好处。

abstract.text: New technologies have recently led to a boom in real‐time pricing. I study the most salient example, surge pricing in ride hailing. Using data from Uber, I develop an empirical model of spatial equilibrium to measure the welfare effects of surge pricing. The model is composed of demand, supply, and a matching technology. It allows for temporal and spatial heterogeneity as well as randomness in supply and demand. I find that, relative to a uniform pricing counterfactual in which Uber sets the overall price level, surge pricing increases total welfare by 2.15% of gross revenue. Welfare effects differ substantially across sides of the market: rider surplus increases by 3.57% of gross revenue, whereas driver surplus and the platform's current profits decrease by 0.98% and 0.50% of gross revenue, respectively. Riders at all income levels benefit. Among drivers, those who work long hours are hurt the most, especially women.

10.3982/ecta19106.abstractZh: 最近，新技术推动了实时定价的兴起。我研究了其中一个最典型的例子——拼车服务的溢价定价。通过利用Uber的数据，我建立了一个空间均衡的实证模型，以衡量溢价定价的福利效应。该模型包括需求、供应以及匹配技术三个要素。模型能够考虑到时间和空间上的异质性，以及供需的随机性。研究发现，与Uber统一定价的情况相比，溢价定价使总福利增加了2.15%的总收入。市场的不同参与者所受到的福利影响也各不相同：乘客的福利增加了3.57%的总收入，而司机的福利和平台的当前利润则分别减少了0.98%和0.50%的总收入。所有收入水平的乘客都能从中受益。在司机群体中，工作时间较长的司机受到的损害最大，尤其是女性司机。

abstract.text: We propose flexible Gaussian representations for conditional cumulative distribution functions and give a concave likelihood criterion for their estimation. Optimal representations satisfy the monotonicity property of conditional cumulative distribution functions, including in finite samples and under general misspecification. We use these representations to provide a unified framework for the flexible maximum likelihood estimation of conditional density, cumulative distribution, and quantile functions at parametric rate. Our formulation yields substantial simplifications and finite sample improvements over related methods. An empirical application to the gender wage gap in the United States illustrates our framework.
