10.3982/ecta19153.abstractZh: 我们提出了用于条件累积分布函数的灵活高斯表示方法，并给出了其估计的凹似然准则。最优表示满足条件累积分布函数的单调性属性，即使在有限样本情况下或存在一般性的模型误设时也是如此。我们利用这些表示方法来提供一个统一的框架，用于以参数速率对条件密度、累积分布和分位数函数进行灵活的最大似然估计。我们的方法相较于相关方法，实现了显著的简化和有限样本情况下的改进。通过对美国性别工资差距的实证应用，验证了我们的框架的有效性。

abstract.text: We propose strategies to estimate and make inference on key features of heterogeneous effects in randomized experiments. These key features include best linear predictors of the effects using machine learning proxies, average effects sorted by impact groups , and average characteristics of most and least impacted units . The approach is valid in high‐dimensional settings, where the effects are proxied (but not necessarily consistently estimated) by predictive and causal machine learning methods. We post‐process these proxies into estimates of the key features. Our approach is generic; it can be used in conjunction with penalized methods, neural networks, random forests, boosted trees, and ensemble methods, both predictive and causal. Estimation and inference are based on repeated data splitting to avoid overfitting and achieve validity. We use quantile aggregation of the results across many potential splits, in particular taking medians of p ‐values and medians and other quantiles of confidence intervals. We show that quantile aggregation lowers estimation risks over a single split procedure, and establish its principal inferential properties. Finally, our analysis reveals ways to build provably better machine learning proxies through causal learning: we can use the objective functions that we develop to construct the best linear predictors of the effects, to obtain better machine learning proxies in the initial step. We illustrate the use of both inferential tools and causal learners with a randomized field experiment that evaluates a combination of nudges to stimulate demand for immunization in India.

10.3982/ecta19303.abstractZh: 我们提出了一些策略，用于估计和推断随机实验中异质效应的关键特征。这些关键特征包括使用机器学习代理对效应进行最佳线性预测，按影响组排序的平均效应，以及受影响最严重和最轻的单元的平均特征。该方法适用于高维环境，其中效应可以通过预测性和因果性机器学习方法进行代理（但不一定能够一致地估计）。我们将这些代理处理后，得到关键特征的估计值。我们的方法具有通用性，可以与惩罚性方法、神经网络、随机森林、提升树和集成方法结合使用，无论是预测性还是因果性方法。估计和推断基于重复的数据分割，以避免过拟合并确保有效性。我们采用分位数聚合方法处理多个潜在分割的结果，特别是取p值的中位数以及置信区间的其他分位数。我们证明，分位数聚合可以降低单个分割过程的估计风险，并确立了其主要推断特性。最后，我们的分析揭示了通过因果学习构建更优机器学习代理的方法：我们可以利用我们开发的目标函数来构建效应的最佳线性预测器，从而在初始步骤中获得更好的机器学习代理。我们通过一个随机实地实验来说明使用这两种推断工具和因果学习器的效果，该实验评估了刺激印度免疫需求的各种措施组合。

abstract.text: We develop and estimate a model of consumer search with spatial learning. Consumers make inferences from previously searched objects to unsearched objects that are nearby in attribute space, generating path dependence in search sequences. The estimated model rationalizes patterns in data on online consumer search paths: search tends to converge to the chosen product in attribute space, and consumers take larger steps away from rarely purchased products. Eliminating spatial learning reduces consumer welfare by 12%: cross‐product inferences allow consumers to locate better products in a shorter time. Spatial learning has important implications for product recommendations on retail platforms. We show that consumer welfare can be reduced by unrepresentative product recommendations and that consumer‐optimal product recommendations depend on both consumer learning and competition between platforms.

10.3982/ecta19576.abstractZh: 我们开发并估计了一个包含空间学习的消费者搜索模型。消费者根据之前搜索过的物品来推断属性空间中附近未搜索过的物品，从而在搜索序列中产生路径依赖性。该模型能够解释在线消费者搜索路径上的数据模式：搜索往往趋向于收敛到属性空间中选定的产品，而消费者会远离很少购买的产品。消除空间学习会使消费者福利减少12%：交叉产品推断使得消费者能够在更短的时间内找到更好的产品。空间学习对零售平台上的产品推荐具有重要影响。我们表明，不具代表性的产品推荐会降低消费者福利，而消费者最优的产品推荐则取决于消费者的学习能力和平台之间的竞争。

abstract.text: We exploit the implementation of a rural pension policy in China to estimate the average rural‐to‐urban migration cost for workers affected by the policy and the average underlying sectoral productivity difference. Our estimates, based on a large panel data set, reveal significant migration costs and substantial sectoral productivity differences, with sorting playing a minor role in accounting for sectoral labor income gaps. We construct and structurally estimate a general equilibrium household model with endogenous labor supply and migration. The results of this model align with the reduced‐form findings and illustrate how the rural pension policy influences migration, GDP, and welfare through improving within‐household labor allocation. Counterfactual analyses based on the model show that the positive effects of the policy remain even if migration costs were significantly lower, and that scaling up the rural pension policy would lead to even larger improvements in labor allocation, GDP, and welfare.

10.3982/ecta19699.abstractZh: 我们利用中国实施农村养老金政策的机会，估算了受该政策影响的工人从农村迁移到城市的平均成本，以及相关行业的平均生产率差异。基于大规模面板数据的估算结果显示，农村迁移成本较高，行业生产率差异也较大，而排序因素在解释行业劳动力收入差距中的作用较小。我们构建并结构性地估计了一个包含内生劳动力供给和迁移的一般均衡家庭模型。该模型的结果与简化形式的研究结果一致，表明农村养老金政策通过改善家庭内部的劳动力分配，对迁移、GDP和福利产生了积极影响。基于该模型的反事实分析表明，即使迁移成本显著降低，政策的积极效应仍然存在，并且扩大农村养老金政策的实施范围将带来更大的劳动力分配、GDP和福利改善。

abstract.text: Policymakers often choose a policy bundle that is a combination of different interventions in different dosages. We develop a new technique— treatment variant aggregation (TVA)—to select a policy from a large factorial design. TVA pools together policy variants that are not meaningfully different and prunes those deemed ineffective. This allows us to restrict attention to aggregated policy variants, consistently estimate their effects on the outcome, and estimate the best policy effect adjusting for the winner's curse. We apply TVA to a large randomized controlled trial that tests interventions to stimulate demand for immunization in Haryana, India. The policies under consideration include reminders, incentives, and local ambassadors for community mobilization. Cross‐randomizing these interventions, with different dosages or types of each intervention, yields 75 combinations. The policy with the largest impact (which combines incentives, ambassadors who are information hubs, and reminders) increases the number of immunizations by 44% relative to the status quo. The most cost‐effective policy (information hubs, ambassadors, and SMS reminders, but no incentives) increases the number of immunizations per dollar by 9.1% relative to the status quo.

10.3982/ecta19739.abstractZh: 政策制定者通常会选择一种包含多种不同干预措施的政策组合，这些干预措施的具体实施方式各不相同。我们提出了一种新的技术——处理变量聚合（TVA）——来从复杂的因子设计中筛选出最优政策。TVA将那些差异不大的政策变体合并在一起，并剔除那些被认为无效的政策。这样，我们就能将注意力集中在聚合后的政策变体上，同时一致地评估它们对结果的影响，并估算出在考虑胜者诅咒的情况下最佳政策效果。我们将TVA技术应用于一项大规模的随机对照试验，该试验旨在测试在印度哈里亚纳邦刺激免疫接种需求的干预措施。所考虑的政策包括提醒、激励措施以及社区动员的本地代表。通过交叉随机化这些干预措施，并分别采用不同的实施方式或类型，我们得出了75种可能的组合方案。其中，结合激励措施、作为信息枢纽的本地代表以及提醒措施的政策，使免疫接种数量比现状增加了44%。而成本效益最高的政策（仅包括信息枢纽、本地代表和短信提醒，但不包含激励措施）则使每美元投入的免疫接种数量比现状增加了9.1%。

abstract.text: India's Industrial Disputes Act (IDA) requires large manufacturing plants to pay substantial costs if they wish to shrink their workforce. Since the early 2000s, these large plants have dramatically increased their use of contract workers who are not subject to these regulatory constraints. Between 2000 and 2015, the contract labor share in non‐managerial employment nearly doubled at establishments with more than 100 workers (from 21 to 40 percentage points), while it only increased from 14 to 17 percentage points at establishments with less than 50 workers. Over the same period, the thickness of the right tail of the establishment size distribution in formal Indian manufacturing plants increased, the average product of labor at large plants declined, the job creation rate for large plants increased, and the probability that large plants introduced new products rose. We argue that these changes were caused by the increased adoption of contract labor. In a model of establishment growth subject to firing costs, we show that easing access to contract labor increased TFP in Indian manufacturing by 7.3% since the early 2000s, occurring all through a one‐time reduction in misallocation between large and small plants with negligible change in the long‐run growth rate.

10.3982/ecta20046.abstractZh: 印度的《工业纠纷法》要求大型制造企业在缩减劳动力时支付巨额费用。自21世纪初以来，这些大型工厂大幅增加了对不受该法规约束的合同工人的使用。在2000年至2015年间，拥有超过100名工人的工厂中，合同劳动力在非管理岗位中的比例几乎翻了一番（从21个百分点增加到40个百分点），而拥有少于50名工人的工厂中，这一比例仅增加了14个百分点至17个百分点。在同一时期，印度正规制造业工厂规模分布的右尾部分厚程度增加，大型工厂的劳动力生产率下降，大型工厂的就业创造率上升，以及大型工厂推出新产品的可能性增加。我们认为，这些变化是由于合同劳动力的使用增加所致。在一个受解雇成本影响的工厂增长模型中，我们发现，自21世纪初以来，放宽对合同劳动力的限制使印度制造业的全要素生产率提高了7.3%，而这一变化是通过减少大型和小型工厂之间的错配来实现的，对长期增长率的影响微乎其微。

abstract.text: This study provides a structural analysis of detailed, alternating‐offer bargaining data from eBay, deriving bounds on buyers and sellers private value distributions and the gains from trade using a range of assumptions on behavior and the informational environment. These assumptions range from weak (assuming only that acceptance and rejection decisions are rational) to less weak (e.g., assuming that bargaining offers are weakly increasing in players' private values). We estimate the bounds and show what they imply for consumer negotiation behavior and inefficient breakdown. For the median product, bargaining ends in impasse in 37% of negotiations even when the buyer values the good more than the seller.

10.3982/ecta20125.abstractZh: 本研究对eBay的详细交替报价交易数据进行了结构分析，基于一系列关于行为和信息环境的假设，推导出了买卖双方私人价值分布的范围以及交易带来的收益。这些假设从较为宽松的（仅假设接受和拒绝决策是理性的）到较为严格的（例如，假设报价在玩家私人价值上呈递增趋势）不等。我们估算了这些范围，并展示了它们对消费者谈判行为以及交易失败的影响。对于中位数产品而言，即使买方对商品的重视程度高于卖方，仍有37%的谈判以僵局告终。

abstract.text: Trade policy is often cast as a solution to the free‐riding problem in international climate agreements. This paper examines the extent to which trade policy can deliver on this promise. We incorporate global supply chains of carbon and climate externalities into a multi‐country, multi‐industry general equilibrium trade model. By deriving theoretical formulas for optimal carbon and border taxes, we quantify the maximum efficacy of two trade policy solutions to the free‐riding problem. Adding optimal carbon border taxes to existing tariffs proves largely ineffective, delivering only 3.4% of what could be achieved under globally optimal carbon pricing. In contrast, Nordhaus's (2015) climate club framework, in which border taxes are used as contingent penalties to deter free‐riding, can achieve 33–68% of the globally optimal carbon reduction, depending on the initial coalition (EU, EU + US, or EU + US + China). In all cases, the climate club ensures universal compliance, thereby preserving free trade.

10.3982/ecta20153.abstractZh: 贸易政策常被视为解决国际气候协议中“搭便车”问题的方案。本文探讨了贸易政策在多大程度上能够实现这一承诺。我们将碳排放和气候外部性的全球供应链纳入一个多国、多行业的通用均衡贸易模型中。通过推导最优碳税和边境税的理论公式，我们量化了这两种贸易政策解决方案在解决“搭便车”问题上的最大效果。将最优碳边境税与现有关税结合使用，效果并不显著，仅能实现全球最优碳定价所能达到效果的3.4%。相比之下，Nordhaus（2015）提出的气候俱乐部框架中，边境税被用作惩罚措施以遏制“搭便车”行为，其减排效果可达全球最优碳减排量的33%至68%，具体效果取决于初始联盟成员（欧盟、欧盟与美国或欧盟、美国与中国）。在所有情况下，气候俱乐部都能确保普遍遵守规则，从而维护自由贸易。

abstract.text: While the mechanism design paradigm emphasizes notions of efficiency based on agent preferences, policymakers often focus on alternative objectives. School districts emphasize educational achievement, and transplantation communities focus on patient survival. It is unclear whether choice‐based mechanisms perform well when assessed based on these outcomes. This paper evaluates the assignment mechanism for allocating deceased donor kidneys on the basis of patient life‐years from transplantation (LYFT). We examine the role of choice in increasing LYFT and compare realized assignments to benchmarks that remove choice. Our model combines choices and outcomes in order to study how selection affects LYFT. We show how to identify and estimate the model using instruments derived from the mechanism. The estimates suggest that the design in use selects patients with better post‐transplant survival prospects and matches them well, resulting in an average LYFT of 9.29, which is 1.75 years more than a random assignment. However, the maximum aggregate LYFT is 14.08. Realizing the majority of the gains requires transplanting relatively healthy patients, who would have longer life expectancies even without a transplant. Therefore, a policymaker faces a dilemma between transplanting patients who are sicker and those for whom life will be extended the longest.

10.3982/ecta20203.abstractZh: 虽然机制设计范式强调基于代理人偏好的效率概念，但政策制定者往往关注其他目标。学区重视教育成就，而移植社区则关注患者的生存状况。目前尚不清楚基于选择的机制在根据这些结果进行评估时是否表现良好。本文基于患者的生存年数，评估了分配已故捐赠者肾脏的分配机制。我们研究了选择对增加生存年数的影响，并将实际分配结果与去除选择的基准进行了比较。我们的模型结合了选择和结果，以研究选择如何影响生存年数。我们展示了如何使用从机制中衍生出的工具来识别和估计模型。估计结果显示，所采用的机制能够选择出具有更好移植后生存前景的患者，并将他们进行良好的匹配，使得平均生存年数为9.29年，比随机分配多出1.75年。然而，最大的平均生存年数为14.08年。要实现大部分收益，需要移植相对健康的患者，因为这些患者即使不进行移植，其预期寿命也会更长。因此，政策制定者在移植病情更严重的患者与能够延长最长寿命的患者之间面临着两难选择。

abstract.text: We study the implications of optimal insurance provision for long‐run welfare and inequality in economies with persistent private information. A principal insures an agent whose private type follows an ergodic, finite‐state Markov chain. The optimal contract always induces immiseration : the agent's consumption and utility decrease without bound. Under positive serial correlation, it also backloads high‐powered incentives : the sensitivity of the agent's utility with respect to his reports increases without bound. These results extend—and help elucidate the limits of—the hallmark immiseration results for economies with i.i.d. private information. Numerically, we find that persistence yields faster immiseration, higher inequality, and novel short‐run distortions. Our analysis uses recursive methods for contracting with persistent types and allows for binding global incentive constraints.

10.3982/ecta20404.abstractZh: 我们研究了在具有持久私人信息的经济体系中，最优保险供给对长期福利和不平等的影响。一个主体为另一个代理人提供保险，后者的私人类型遵循一个遍历的、有限状态的马尔可夫链。最优契约总是会导致贫困化：代理人的消费和效用无限减少。在正序列相关的情况下，还会产生高强度的激励：代理人效用对其报告的反应敏感度无限增加。这些结果扩展了——并有助于阐明——在具有独立同分布私人信息的经济体系中，贫困化结果的局限性。从数值上看，我们发现持久性会导致更快的贫困化、更高的不平等程度，以及新的短期扭曲现象。我们的分析采用了递归方法来处理具有持久类型的情况，并允许存在具有约束力的全球激励约束。

abstract.text: Renewable energy and battery storage are seen as complementary technologies that can together facilitate reductions in carbon emissions. We develop and estimate a framework to calculate the equilibrium effects of large‐scale battery storage. Using data from California, we find that the first storage unit breaks even by 2024 without subsidies when the renewable energy share reaches 50%. Equilibrium effects are important: the first 5000 MWh of storage capacity would reduce wholesale electricity prices by 5.6%, but an increase from 25,000 to 50,000 MWh would only reduce these prices by 2.6%. Large‐scale batteries will reduce revenues to both dispatchable generators and renewable energy sources. The equilibrium effects lead battery adoption to be virtually non‐existent until 2030, without a storage mandate or subsidy. A 30% capital cost subsidy—such as the one in the U.S. Inflation Reduction Act—achieves 5000 MWh of battery capacity by 2024, similar to the level required under California's storage mandate.

10.3982/ecta20411.abstractZh: 可再生能源和电池储能被视为互补技术，能够共同促进碳排放的减少。我们开发并估算了一个框架，用于计算大规模电池储能的均衡效应。根据加州的数据，当可再生能源占比达到50%时，首个储能单元将在2024年无需补贴即可实现盈亏平衡。均衡效应非常重要：最初的5000兆瓦时的储能容量可使批发电价降低5.6%，但储能容量从25,000兆瓦时增加到50,000兆瓦时，则只能使电价降低2.6%。大规模电池储能将减少可调度发电机组和可再生能源的收入。在没有储能强制规定或补贴的情况下，均衡效应使得电池储能的采用在2030年之前几乎不存在。如美国《通胀削减法案》中规定的30%资本成本补贴，可以在2024年实现5000兆瓦时的电池容量，这与加州储能强制规定要求的水平相当。

abstract.text: We estimate valence measures of candidates running in U.S. House elections from data on vote shares. Our identification and estimation strategy builds on ideas developed for estimating production functions, allowing us to control for possible endogeneity of campaign spending and sample selection of candidates due to endogenous entry. We find that incumbents have substantially higher valence measures than challengers running against them, resulting in about 3.5 percentage‐point differences in the vote share, on average. Eliminating differences in the valence of challengers and incumbents results in an increase in the winning probability of a challenger from 6.5% to 12.1%. Our measure of candidate valence can be used to study various substantive questions of political economy. We illustrate its usefulness by studying the source of incumbency advantage in U.S. House elections.

10.3982/ecta20496.abstractZh: 我们基于投票份额数据，对参加美国众议院选举的候选人进行了价值度量的估计。我们的识别与估计策略基于用于估计生产函数的思想，这使我们能够控制竞选支出的内生性以及由于内生性进入而导致的候选人样本选择问题。我们发现，现任者与挑战者相比，其价值度量大得多，平均而言，投票份额的差异约为3.5个百分点。消除挑战者与现任者之间价值差异后，挑战者获胜的概率从6.5%增加到12.1%。我们对候选人价值的度量可以用于研究各种政治经济学问题。我们通过研究美国众议院选举中现任优势的来源，来说明这一度量方法的有效性。

abstract.text: We conduct a series of experiments and document a robust behavioral pattern whereby people behave more morally in uncertain environments than degenerate deterministic ones. We show that this pattern is weakened when the moral implication of behavior is diminished or when uncertainty pertains to others rather than oneself. These findings are incompatible with standard models that respect dominance. We propose a mechanism based on the anxiety aspect of uncertain environments whereby people act morally as if their moral behavior can help deliver a better outcome. We further delve into the complexity aspect of uncertainty to arrive at a more comprehensive understanding of these findings.

10.3982/ecta20574.abstractZh: 我们进行了一系列实验，并发现了一个稳健的行为模式：在不确定环境中，人们比在确定性较低的环境中表现出更道德的行为。我们发现，当行为的道德含义减弱，或者不确定性涉及他人而非自身时，这种模式会减弱。这些发现与那些基于支配关系的标准模型并不一致。我们提出了一种基于不确定环境中焦虑因素的机制，人们会表现出道德行为，仿佛他们的道德行为能够帮助带来更好的结果。我们进一步探讨了不确定性的复杂性，以更全面地理解这些发现。

abstract.text: We create a novel reign‐level data set for European monarchs, covering all major European states between the 10th and 18th centuries. We first document a strong positive relationship between rulers' cognitive ability and state performance. To address endogeneity issues, we exploit the facts that (i) rulers were appointed according to hereditary succession, independent of their ability, and (ii) the widespread inbreeding among the ruling dynasties of Europe led over centuries to quasirandom variation in ruler ability. We code the degree of blood relationship between the parents of rulers, which also reflects “hidden” layers of inbreeding from previous generations. The coefficient of inbreeding is a strong predictor of ruler ability, and the corresponding instrumental variable results imply that ruler ability had a sizeable effect on the performance of states and their borders. This supports the view that “leaders made history,” shaping the European map until its consolidation into nation states. We also show that rulers mattered only where their power was largely unconstrained. In reigns where parliaments checked the power of monarchs, ruler ability no longer affected their state's performance.

10.3982/ecta20830.abstractZh: 我们为欧洲君主创建了一个新的统治层数据集，涵盖了10至18世纪所有主要欧洲国家。我们首先发现，君主的认知能力与国家绩效之间存在强烈的正相关关系。为了解决内生性问题，我们利用了以下事实：(i) 君主的任命基于世袭继承，与其能力无关；(ii) 欧洲统治王朝中普遍存在的近亲繁殖现象，导致几个世纪以来君主能力的随机变化。我们对君主父母之间的血缘关系进行了编码，这同时也反映了前几代近亲繁殖的“隐性”影响。近亲繁殖系数是君主能力的强预测因子，相应的工具变量结果表明，君主能力对国家的绩效和边界有着显著的影响。这支持了“领导者塑造历史”的观点，他们影响了欧洲地图的演变，直至国家形式的形成。我们还发现，君主的影响力仅存在于他们的权力基本不受限制的情况下。在议会能够制约君主权力的统治时期，君主的能力不再影响国家的绩效。

abstract.text: The Mussa (1986) puzzle is the observation of a sharp and simultaneous increase in the volatility of both nominal and real exchange rates following the end of the Bretton Woods System of pegged exchange rates in 1973. It is commonly viewed as a central piece of evidence in favor of monetary non‐neutrality because it is an instance in which a change in the monetary regime caused a dramatic change in the equilibrium behavior of a real variable—the real exchange rate—and is often further interpreted as direct evidence in favor of models with nominal rigidities in price setting. This paper shows that the data do not support this latter conclusion because there was no simultaneous change in the properties of the other macro variables, nominal or real; an extended set of Mussa facts falsifies both conventional flexible‐price RBC models and sticky‐price New Keynesian models. We present a resolution to the broader Mussa puzzle based on a model of segmented financial market, in which the bulk of the nominal exchange rate risk is held by financial intermediaries and is not shared smoothly throughout the economy, emphasizing the importance of monetary transmission via the risk premium channel.

10.3982/ecta20849.abstractZh: Mussa（1986）的谜题是指1973年布雷顿森林体系解禁汇率挂钩制度后，名义汇率和实际汇率的波动性同时出现急剧上升的现象。这一现象通常被视为货币非中性性的重要证据，因为它表明货币制度的改变会导致实际变量——实际汇率——的均衡行为发生显著变化，并且这一现象常被解释为价格设定存在名义刚性模型的直接证据。本文指出，数据并不支持这一结论，因为其他宏观经济变量的性质并没有同时发生变化，无论是名义变量还是实际变量。Mussa的一系列事实不仅反驳了传统的灵活价格RBC模型，也否定了粘性价格的新凯恩斯主义模型。我们提出了一种基于分割金融市场模型的解决方案，该模型认为名义汇率风险主要由金融中介机构持有，并未在整个体制中均匀分配，从而强调了通过风险溢价渠道实现货币传导的重要性。

abstract.text: We develop a stylized model that allows us to estimate a value-added measure for nursing homes ("SNFs") which accounts for patient selection both into and out of a SNF. We use the model, together with detailed data on the physical and mental health of about 6 million Medicare SNF patients between 2011 and 2016, to estimate the value added for about 14,000 distinct SNFs. We document substantial heterogeneity in value added. Nationwide, compared to a 10th percentile SNF, a 90th percentile SNF is able to discharge a patient at the same health level almost a week sooner, or one quarter of the median length of stay. Heterogeneity in value added within a market is almost as large as it is nationwide. Our results point to the potential for substantial gains through policies that encourage reallocation of patients to higher-quality SNFs within their market.

10.3982/ecta21016.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个简化模型，用于估算疗养院的价值增值，该模型能够考虑到患者进入和离开疗养院的过程。我们利用该模型，结合2011年至2016年间约600万名Medicare疗养院患者的身体和心理健康数据，对大约14,000家不同的疗养院的价值增值进行了估算。我们发现，各疗养院的价值增值存在显著的差异。在全国范围内，与排名第十的疗养院相比，排名第九的疗养院能够更早在相同健康水平的患者身上结束治疗，其治疗时间几乎缩短了一半，即中位住院时间的四分之一。市场内部的价值增值差异几乎与全国范围的一样大。我们的研究结果表明，通过政策鼓励患者重新分配到质量更高的疗养院，可以带来显著的价值增值。

abstract.text: We provide a decision‐theoretic analysis of bandit experiments under local asymptotics. Working within the framework of diffusion processes, we define suitable notions of asymptotic Bayes and minimax risk for these experiments. For normally distributed rewards, the minimal Bayes risk can be characterized as the solution to a second‐order partial differential equation (PDE). Using a limit of experiments approach, we show that this PDE characterization also holds asymptotically under both parametric and non‐parametric distributions of the rewards. The approach further describes the state variables it is asymptotically sufficient to restrict attention to, and thereby suggests a practical strategy for dimension reduction. The PDEs characterizing minimal Bayes risk can be solved efficiently using sparse matrix routines or Monte Carlo methods. We derive the optimal Bayes and minimax policies from their numerical solutions. These optimal policies substantially dominate existing methods such as Thompson sampling; the risk of the latter is often twice as high.

10.3982/ecta21075.abstractZh: 我们提供了在局部渐近性假设下的强盗实验的决策理论分析。在扩散过程框架内，我们定义了适用于这些实验的渐近贝叶斯风险与最小极大风险的概念。对于正态分布的奖励，最小贝叶斯风险可以被描述为一个二阶偏微分方程的解。通过实验极限方法，我们证明了这一微分方程描述在参数分布和非参数分布下都具有渐近性。该方法进一步描述了在渐近意义上需要关注的变量，并为降维问题提供了实用策略。描述最小贝叶斯风险的微分方程可以通过稀疏矩阵算法或蒙特卡洛方法高效求解。我们从这些数值解中推导出最优贝叶斯策略与最小极大策略，这些最优策略在性能上显著优于现有的方法，如汤普森抽样法；后者的风险通常是其两倍。

abstract.text: In low‐income communities in both rich and poor countries, redistributive transfers within kin and social networks are frequent. Such arrangements may distort labor supply—acting as a “social tax” that dampens the incentive to work. We document that across countries, from the United States to Côte d'Ivoire, low‐income groups report strong pressure to share earned income with others; in addition, social groups that undertake more interpersonal transfers work fewer hours. Using a field experiment, we enable piece‐rate factory workers in Côte d'Ivoire to shield income using blocked savings accounts over 9 months. Workers may only deposit earnings increases, relative to baseline, mitigating income effects on labor supply. Offering Private accounts raises work attendance by 6.5% and earnings by 9.4%. These treatment effects are concentrated among workers who report higher redistributive pressure at baseline. To obtain further suggestive evidence on mechanisms, in a supplementary experiment, we vary whether blocked accounts are private or known to the worker's network. When accounts are private, take‐up is substantively higher (60% vs. 14%), with a resultant 8.8% higher earnings. Outgoing transfers do not decline, indicating no loss in redistribution. The welfare benefits of informal redistribution may come at a cost, depressing labor supply and productivity.

10.3982/ecta21078.abstractZh: 在富裕国家和贫困国家的低收入社区中，亲属和社会网络内部的再分配转移现象十分常见。这种安排可能会扭曲劳动力供应，起到“社会税”的作用，削弱人们工作的积极性。我们的研究表明，从美国到科特迪瓦，低收入群体面临着强烈的与他人分享收入的压力；此外，进行更多人际转移的社会群体工作时间更少。通过一项实地实验，我们让科特迪瓦的工厂工人能够在9个月内通过封闭储蓄账户来规避收入影响。工人只能存入相对于基线的收入增加部分，从而减轻收入对劳动力供应的影响。提供私人账户可使工作出勤率提高6.5%，收入增加9.4%。这些效应主要集中在那些在基线时报告有较高再分配压力的工人身上。为了进一步了解相关机制，我们在一项补充实验中改变了封闭账户是私人账户还是工人网络所知晓的情况。当账户为私人账户时，接受度明显更高（60%对比14%），同时收入也增加了8.8%。向外转移的资金并未减少，表明再分配并没有造成损失。非正式再分配带来的福利收益可能伴随着成本，即降低劳动力供应和生产力。

abstract.text: There has been a call for caution regarding the standard procedure for Bayesian inference in set‐identified structural vector autoregressions on the grounds that the common practice of using a uniform prior over the set of orthogonal matrices induces a non‐uniform prior for individual impulse responses or other quantities of interest. This paper challenges this call by formally showing that when the focus is on joint inference, the uniform prior over the set of orthogonal matrices is not only sufficient but also necessary for inference based on a uniform joint prior distribution over the identified set for the vector of impulse responses. In addition, we show how to conduct inference based on a uniform joint prior distribution for the vector of impulse responses.

10.3982/ecta21101.abstractZh: 有观点认为，在集合识别的结构性向量自回归问题中，贝叶斯推断的标准程序需要谨慎对待。因为通常的做法是使用一组正交矩阵作为均匀先验，这可能会导致个体脉冲响应或其他感兴趣的量具有非均匀的先验分布。本文通过正式论证，当关注于联合推断时，使用一组正交矩阵作为均匀先验不仅足够，而且对于基于集合识别后的脉冲响应向量的均匀联合先验分布进行推断是必需的。此外，我们还展示了如何基于均匀联合先验分布对脉冲响应向量进行推断。

abstract.text: Policymakers and market intermediaries often use quality scores to alleviate asymmetric information about product quality. Scores affect the demand for quality and, in equilibrium, its supply. Equilibrium effects break the rule whereby more information is always better, and the optimal design of scores must account for them. In the context of Medicare Advantage, I find that consumers' information is limited, and quality is inefficiently low. A simple design alleviates these issues and increases total welfare by 3.7 monthly premiums. More than half of the gains stem from scores' effect on quality rather than information. Scores can outperform full‐information outcomes by regulating inefficient oligopolistic quality provision, and a binary certification of quality attains 98% of this welfare. Scores are informative even when coarse; firms' incentives are to produce quality at the scoring threshold, which consumers know. The primary design challenge of scores is to dictate thresholds and thus regulate quality.

10.3982/ecta21182.abstractZh: 政策制定者和市场中介经常使用质量评分来缓解关于产品质量的不对称信息问题。这些评分会影响对质量的需求，并在均衡状态下影响其供应。均衡效应打破了“信息越多越好”的规则，因此评分的最优设计必须考虑这些因素。在Medicare Advantage的情境中，我发现消费者的信息有限，而质量水平则低得不合理。简单的评分设计能够解决这些问题，并增加3.7个月的保费总额，使总福利提升。其中一半以上的收益来自评分对质量的影响，而非对信息的影响。通过调节低效的寡头质量供应，评分可以超越完全信息条件下的结果，而二元质量认证则能够实现98%的福利提升。即使评分标准较为粗略，评分仍然具有信息价值；企业的动机是生产达到评分标准的质量产品，而消费者也知道这一点。评分设计的主要挑战在于确定评分标准，从而调节质量水平。

abstract.text: This paper shows that product design shapes search frictions and that intermediaries leverage this channel to increase their rents in the context of the U.S. municipal bond market. The majority of bonds are designed via negotiation between a local government and its underwriter. They are then traded in a decentralized market, where the underwriter often also acts as an intermediary. Exploiting variations in state regulations that limit government officials' conflicts of interest, we provide evidence that the underwriter benefits from designing and trading complex bonds, which induces an increase in search frictions. Interestingly, a simpler bond may not necessarily benefit the government, as bond complexity affords flexibility in debt repayment. Motivated by these findings, we build and estimate a model of bond origination and trading to quantify the welfare implications of a policy mandating bond standardization.

10.3982/ecta21277.abstractZh: 本文指出，产品设计能够影响搜索成本，而中介机构则利用这一渠道来增加自身的收益，这一现象在美国市政债券市场尤为明显。大多数债券都是通过地方政府与其承销商之间的协商来设计的。这些债券随后在分散化的市场中进行交易，而承销商通常也同时担任中介角色。通过利用州法规对政府官员利益冲突的限制，我们发现承销商从设计和交易复杂债券中获益，这会增加搜索成本。有趣的是，较简单的债券未必能给政府带来好处，因为债券设计的复杂性为债务偿还提供了灵活性。基于这些发现，我们构建并估计了一个债券发行和交易模型，以量化强制债券标准化的政策对福利的影响。

abstract.text: We study how criminal organizations affect economic development. We exploit a natural experiment in El Salvador, where these criminal organizations emerged due to an exogenous shift in American immigration policy that led to the deportation of gang leaders from the United States to El Salvador. Using a spatial regression discontinuity design that focuses on the gang‐created system of borders, we find that individuals in gang‐controlled neighborhoods have less material well‐being, income, and education than individuals living only 50 meters away but outside of gang territory. None of these discontinuities existed before the arrival of the gangs. A key mechanism behind the results is that gangs restrict individuals' mobility, affecting their labor‐market options by preventing them from commuting to other parts of the city. The results are not determined by high rates of selective migration, differential exposure to extortion and violence, or differences in public goods provision.

10.3982/ecta21305.abstractZh: 我们研究了犯罪组织如何影响经济发展。我们利用了萨尔瓦多的一项自然实验，这些犯罪组织的出现是由于美国移民政策的外生变化，导致帮派头目被驱逐到萨尔瓦多。通过采用空间回归不连续设计，重点关注帮派形成的边界系统，我们发现生活在帮派控制区的个体在物质福祉、收入和教育方面都低于仅居住在50米范围内但不在帮派势力范围之外的个体。在帮派出现之前，这些差异并不存在。研究结果背后的关键机制是，帮派限制了个体的流动性，通过阻止他们前往城市其他区域工作，从而影响了他们的劳动力市场选择。这些结果并非由高比例的选择性迁移、不同的敲诈和暴力风险，或是公共产品供给的差异所决定。

abstract.text: We estimate the employment effects of a large program of public investment subsidies to private firms that ranked applicants on a score reflecting both objective rules and local politicians' discretion. Leveraging the rationing of funds as an ideal Regression Discontinuity Design, we characterize the heterogeneity of treatment effects and cost‐per‐new‐job across inframarginal firms and estimate the cost‐effectiveness of subsidies under factual and counterfactual allocations. Firms ranking high on objective rules and firms preferred by local politicians generated larger employment growth on average, but the latter did so at a higher cost per job. We estimate that relying only on objective criteria would reduce the cost per job by 11%, while relying only on political discretion would increase such cost by 42%.

10.3982/ecta21319.abstractZh: 我们估算了一项针对私营企业的大规模公共投资补贴计划的就业效应。在评估申请者时，我们依据客观标准以及地方政治人物的偏好对申请者进行评分。利用资金分配的“配给”机制作为理想的“回归不连续设计”，我们描述了处理效应和每新增就业岗位的成本在不同类型企业中的差异，并估算了在实际情况与假设情况下，补贴的成本效益。结果显示，那些在客观标准上排名较高以及受到地方政治人物青睐的企业，平均能够带来更大的就业增长，但后者的成本则更高。我们估计，仅依赖客观标准可以将每新增就业岗位的成本降低11%，而仅依赖政治决策则会使这一成本增加42%。

abstract.text: We consider a classical auction setting in which an asset/project is sold to buyers who privately receive signals about expected payoffs, and payoffs are more sensitive to a bidder's signal if he runs the project than if another bidder does. We show that a seller can increase revenues by sometimes allocating cash‐flow rights and control to different bidders, for example, with the highest bidder receiving cash flows and the second‐highest receiving control. Separation reduces a bidder's information rent, which depends on the importance of his private information for the value of his awarded cash flows. As project payoffs are most sensitive to a bidder's information if he controls the project, allocating cash flow to another bidder lowers bidders' informational advantage. As a result, when signals are close, the seller can increase revenues by splitting rights between the top two bidders.

10.3982/ecta21343.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个经典的拍卖场景，其中一项资产/项目被出售给买家，这些买家私下会收到关于预期收益的信号。如果投标者自己负责项目运营，他对收益的反应会比其他投标者更为敏感。我们证明，卖家可以通过将现金流权和控制权分配给不同的投标者来增加收入，例如，让出价最高的投标者获得现金流，而出价第二高的投标者获得控制权。这种分离可以降低投标者的信息租金，这取决于其私人信息对获得现金流价值的重要性。由于项目收益对投标者的信息最为敏感，将现金流分配给其他投标者会降低投标者的信息优势。因此，当信号相近时，卖家可以通过在两位出价最高的投标者之间分配权利来增加收入。

abstract.text: This paper shows the endogeneity of amenities plays a crucial role in determining the welfare distribution of a city's residents. We quantify this mechanism by building a dynamic model of residential choice with heterogeneous households, where consumption amenities are the equilibrium outcome of a market for non‐tradables. We estimate our model using Dutch microdata and leveraging variation in Amsterdam's spatial distribution of tourists as a demand shifter, finding significant heterogeneity in residents' preferences over amenities and in the supply responses of amenities to changes in demand composition. This two‐way heterogeneity dictates the degree of horizontal differentiation across neighborhoods, residential sorting, and inequality. Finally, we show the distributional effects of mass tourism depend on this heterogeneity: following rent increases due to growing tourist demand for housing, younger residents—whose amenity preferences are closest to tourists—are compensated by amenities tilting in their favor, while the losses of older residents are amplified.

10.3982/ecta21394.abstractZh: 本文揭示了便利设施的内生性在决定城市居民福利分配中的关键作用。我们通过构建一个具有异质家庭的住宅选择动态模型来量化这一机制，其中消费便利设施是非交易商品市场的均衡结果。我们使用荷兰微观数据对模型进行估计，并利用阿姆斯特丹游客空间分布的变化作为需求变动因素，发现居民对便利设施的偏好以及便利设施对需求结构变化的供给反应存在显著的异质性。这种双向异质性决定了不同社区之间的水平分化程度、住宅排序以及不平等现象。最后，我们指出大规模旅游的分配效应依赖于这种异质性：随着旅游需求增加导致房价上涨，那些便利设施偏好与游客最为接近的年轻居民会获得有利于自己的便利设施，而老年居民的损失则会进一步加剧。

abstract.text: We propose a double robust Bayesian inference procedure on the average treatment effect (ATE) under unconfoundedness. For our new Bayesian approach, we first adjust the prior distributions of the conditional mean functions, and then correct the posterior distribution of the resulting ATE. Both adjustments make use of pilot estimators motivated by the semiparametric influence function for ATE estimation. We prove asymptotic equivalence of our Bayesian procedure and efficient frequentist ATE estimators by establishing a new semiparametric Bernstein–von Mises theorem under double robustness; that is, the lack of smoothness of conditional mean functions can be compensated by high regularity of the propensity score and vice versa. Consequently, the resulting Bayesian credible sets form confidence intervals with asymptotically exact coverage probability. In simulations, our method provides precise point estimates of the ATE through the posterior mean and delivers credible intervals that closely align with the nominal coverage probability. Furthermore, our approach achieves a shorter interval length in comparison to existing methods. We illustrate our method in an application to the National Supported Work Demonstration following LaLonde (1986) and Dehejia and Wahba (1999).

10.3982/ecta21442.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种在无混杂条件下对平均处理效应进行双稳健贝叶斯推断的程序。对于我们的新贝叶斯方法，我们首先调整条件均值函数的先验分布，然后修正由此产生的平均处理效应的后验分布。这两种调整都利用了由平均处理效应估计的半参数影响函数所激发的引导估计量。我们通过建立一个新的半参数伯恩斯坦-冯·米塞斯定理来证明我们的贝叶斯程序与高效的频率主义平均处理效应估计量在渐近意义上是等价的；也就是说，条件均值函数的不光滑性可以通过倾向得分的高规则性来补偿，反之亦然。因此，由此产生的贝叶斯可信集形成了具有渐近精确覆盖概率的置信区间。在模拟实验中，我们的方法通过后验均值提供了平均处理效应的精确点估计，并且得到的可信区间与名义覆盖概率非常接近。此外，与现有方法相比，我们的方法实现了更短的区间长度。我们在LaLonde（1986）和Dehejia与Wahba（1999）的研究基础上，将我们的方法应用于国家支持工作示范项目。

abstract.text: Many argue that minimum wages can prevent efficiency losses from monopsony power. We assess this argument in a general equilibrium model of oligopsonistic labor markets with heterogeneous workers and firms. We decompose welfare gains into an efficiency component that captures reductions in monopsony power and a redistributive component that captures the way minimum wages shift resources across people. The minimum wage that maximizes the efficiency component of welfare lies below $8.00 and yields gains worth less than 0.2% of lifetime consumption. When we add back in Utilitarian redistributive motives, the optimal minimum wage is $11 and redistribution accounts for 102.5% of the resulting welfare gains, implying offsetting efficiency losses of −2.5%. The reason a minimum wage struggles to deliver efficiency gains is that with realistic firm productivity dispersion, a minimum wage that eliminates monopsony power at one firm causes severe rationing at another. These results hold under an EITC and progressive labor income taxes calibrated to the U.S. economy.

10.3982/ecta21466.abstractZh: 许多人认为，最低工资可以防止由于垄断买方力量导致的效率损失。我们在一个具有异质工人和企业的寡头买方市场的通用均衡模型中评估了这一论点。我们将福利增益分解为两个部分：效率部分，反映减少垄断买方力量的效果；以及再分配部分，反映最低工资如何在不同人之间分配资源。能够最大化福利效率部分的最低工资低于8美元，所带来的增益不到一生消费量的0.2%。当我们将功利主义再分配动机考虑进去时，最优最低工资为11美元，而再分配占最终福利增益的102.5%，这意味着效率损失为-2.5%。最低工资难以带来效率增益的原因是，在实际的企业生产率分布下，消除一家企业的垄断买方力量会导致另一家企业面临严重的资源分配问题。这些结果在考虑了美国经济实际情况的EITC和累进劳动所得税制度下仍然成立。

abstract.text: Policymakers often test expensive new programs on relatively small samples. Formally incorporating informative Bayesian priors into impact evaluation offers the promise to learn more from these experiments. We evaluate a Colombian program for 200 firms which aimed to increase exporting. Priors were elicited from academics, policymakers, and firms. Contrary to these priors, frequentist estimation cannot reject null effects in 2019, and finds some negative impacts in 2020. For binary outcomes like whether firms export, frequentist estimates are relatively precise, and Bayesian posterior intervals update to overlap almost completely with standard confidence intervals. For outcomes like increasing export variety, where the priors align with the data, the value of these priors is seen in posterior intervals that are considerably narrower than the confidence intervals. Finally, for noisy outcomes like export value, posterior intervals show almost no updating from priors, highlighting how uninformative the data are about such outcomes. Future policy experiments could use these posteriors as priors in a Bayesian or empirical Bayesian analysis.

10.3982/ecta21567.abstractZh: 政策制定者通常会在相对较小的样本上测试昂贵的新项目。将信息性贝叶斯先验正式纳入影响评估中，有望从这些实验中获得更多启示。我们评估了一个哥伦比亚项目，该项目针对200家企业，旨在增加出口。先验信息来自学者、政策制定者和企业。与这些先验信息相反，频率主义估计在2019年无法拒绝零效应，而在2020年则发现了一些负面影响。对于像企业是否出口这样的二元结果，频率主义估计相对精确，贝叶斯后验区间几乎完全与标准置信区间重叠。对于像增加出口种类这样的结果，当先验信息与数据一致时，这些先验信息在后验区间中的价值表现得更为明显，后验区间明显比置信区间更窄。最后，对于像出口价值这样的噪声结果，后验区间几乎没有从先验信息中更新，这凸显了数据对于这类结果的无信息性。未来的政策实验可以使用这些后验信息作为贝叶斯或经验贝叶斯分析中的先验信息。

abstract.text: I study whether platform competition in app‐based transportation generates waste and whether consolidating competing networks would improve efficiency. I build a spatial model of a ride‐hailing market where competing platforms set prices strategically and estimate it using detailed data from two major platforms in New York City. Comparing the status quo to simulated counterfactuals, I find that: (i) platform market power and the fragmentation of users across networks cause a $176 million annual loss in social welfare and waste 21% of driver‐generated traffic; (ii) a platform merger would trade off gains from pooling all users into a single network against harms from greater market power, reducing traffic by 8% but lowering consumer surplus by $77 million per year due to a 4% price hike; and (iii) interoperability regulations would bring these gains without undermining competition, reducing wasteful traffic by 6% while raising consumer surplus by $63 million per year.

10.3982/ecta21773.abstractZh: 我研究基于应用程序的运输平台竞争是否会导致资源浪费，以及整合竞争网络是否可以提高效率。我构建了一个网约车市场的空间模型，其中竞争平台会策略性地设定价格，并基于纽约市两个主要平台的详细数据进行估算。通过比较现状与模拟的反事实情况，我发现：(i) 平台的市场力量以及用户在不同网络中的分散导致年度社会福利损失1.76亿美元，同时浪费了21%的司机产生的交通流量；(ii) 平台合并会在将所有用户整合到一个网络中的收益与更大的市场力量带来的损害之间进行权衡，这将使交通流量减少8%，但由于价格上涨4%，消费者剩余每年将减少7700万美元；(iii) 互操作性法规可以在不破坏竞争的情况下带来这些收益，使浪费的交通流量减少6%，同时每年增加6300万美元的消费者剩余。

abstract.text: We develop a tractable small‐open‐economy framework to characterize the constrained efficient use of the monetary policy rate, foreign exchange (FX) intervention, capital controls, and domestic macroprudential measures. The model features dominant currency pricing, positive premia on local currency debt arising from financiers' portfolio constraints, and occasionally‐binding external and domestic borrowing constraints. We characterize the conditions under which the traditional prescription—relying solely on the policy rate and exchange rate flexibility—remains sufficient, even in the presence of externalities. By contrast, to manage noise trader flows into and out of the local currency debt market, FX intervention and in some cases capital inflow taxes should be used instead of the traditional prescription. Moreover, if a country faces a mix of local currency premia and external borrowing constraints, we establish that certain regulations to limit FX mismatch may alleviate the external borrowing constraint but exacerbate the local currency premia. Finally, we show that capital controls may dominate domestic macroprudential measures in cases when external shocks trigger stress in domestic housing markets.

10.3982/ecta21802.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个易于处理的小开放经济体框架，用于描述货币政策利率、外汇干预、资本管制以及国内宏观审慎措施在受限条件下的有效使用。该模型具有主导性货币定价机制，金融投资者因投资组合限制而对本地货币债务支付正溢价，同时外部和国内借贷约束具有偶尔的约束力。我们分析了在何种条件下，仅依赖货币政策利率和汇率灵活性这一传统方法仍然足够，即使存在外部性影响。相比之下，为了管理进入和退出本地货币债务市场的噪声交易者，应采用外汇干预，在某些情况下还需征收资本流入税，而非采用传统方法。此外，如果一个国家同时面临本地货币溢价和外部借贷约束，我们指出，某些限制外汇错配的法规可能会缓解外部借贷约束，但会加剧本地货币溢价。最后，我们表明，在外部冲击引发国内住房市场压力的情况下，资本管制可能会取代国内宏观审慎措施发挥作用。

abstract.text: We study the joint design of dynamic incentives and performance feedback for an environment with a coarse (all‐or‐nothing) measure of performance, and show that hiding information from the agent can be an optimal way to motivate effort. Using a novel approach to incentive compatibility, we derive a two‐phase solution that begins with a “silent phase” where the agent is given no feedback and is asked to work non‐stop, and ends with a “full‐transparency phase” where the agent stops working as soon as a performance threshold is met. Hiding information leads to greater effort, but an ignorant agent is also more expensive to motivate. The two‐phase solution—where the agent's ignorance is fully frontloaded—stems from a “backward compounding effect” that raises the cost of hiding information as time passes.

10.3982/ecta21871.abstractZh: 我们研究了在具有粗略的“全有或全无”性能衡量标准的环境中，如何联合设计动态激励与绩效反馈机制。研究发现，向代理人隐藏信息可能是激励其努力的最佳方式。我们采用了一种新颖的激励相容性方法，提出了一种两阶段解决方案：第一阶段是“沉默阶段”，代理人得不到任何反馈，只能持续工作；第二阶段是“完全透明阶段”，一旦达到绩效阈值，代理人就会停止工作。隐藏信息确实能带来更大的努力，但让无知的代理人继续努力则成本更高。这种两阶段解决方案——代理人对信息的无知是逐步累积的——源于“逆向累积效应”，即随着时间的推移，隐藏信息的成本会不断增加。

abstract.text: Empirical research typically involves a robustness‐efficiency tradeoff. A researcher seeking to estimate a scalar parameter can invoke strong assumptions to motivate a restricted estimator that is precise but may be heavily biased, or they can relax some of these assumptions to motivate a more robust, but variable, unrestricted estimator. When a bound on the bias of the restricted estimator is available, it is optimal to shrink the unrestricted estimator towards the restricted estimator. For settings where a bound on the bias of the restricted estimator is unknown, we propose adaptive estimators that minimize the percentage increase in worst‐case risk relative to an oracle that knows the bound. We show that adaptive estimators solve a weighted convex minimax problem and provide lookup tables facilitating their rapid computation. Revisiting some well‐known empirical studies where questions of model specification arise, we examine the advantages of adapting to—rather than testing for—misspecification.

10.3982/ecta21991.abstractZh: 实证研究通常涉及稳健性与效率之间的权衡。当研究人员试图估计一个标量参数时，他们可能会基于强假设来构建一个精确但可能存在较大偏差的受限估计量，或者他们可以放宽一些假设，以构建一个更为稳健但具有可变性的不受限估计量。当受限估计量的偏差界限已知时，将不受限估计量向受限估计量靠拢是最优选择。对于受限估计量的偏差界限未知的情况，我们提出了自适应估计量，这些估计量能够最小化与知晓界限的预言者相比，最坏情况下风险的增加百分比。我们证明自适应估计量解决了一个加权凸极小化问题，并提供了便于快速计算的查找表。在重新审视一些存在模型设定问题的知名实证研究时，我们探讨了适应而非测试模型设定错误的优势。

abstract.text: We study the effect of incarceration on wages, self-employment, and taxes and transfers in North Carolina and Ohio using two quasi-experimental research designs: discontinuities in sentencing guidelines and random assignment to judges. Across both states, incarceration generates short-term drops in economic activity while individuals remain in prison. As a result, a year-long sentence decreases cumulative earnings over five years by 13%. Beyond five years, however, there is no evidence of lower employment, wage earnings, or self-employment in either state, as well as among defendants with no prior incarceration history. These results suggest that upstream factors, such as other types of criminal justice interactions or pre-existing labor market detachment, are more likely to be the cause of low earnings among the previously incarcerated, who we estimate would earn just $5,000 per year on average if spared a prison sentence.

10.3982/ecta22028.abstractZh: 我们研究了监禁对北卡罗来纳州和俄亥俄州工资、自雇以及税收和转移支付的影响，采用了两种准实验研究设计： sentencing指南的不连续性和随机分配法官。在这两个州，监禁会导致经济活动在个体仍被关押期间的短期下降。因此，一年的监禁会使五年的累计收入减少13%。然而，在五年之后，无论是哪个州，也没有证据表明就业率、工资收入或自雇率有所下降，即使是没有先前监禁历史的被告也是如此。这些结果表明，诸如其他类型的刑事司法互动或预先存在的劳动力市场脱节等上游因素，更可能是先前被监禁者收入低下的原因。据我们估计，如果这些人免于监禁，他们的年收入平均仅为5,000美元。

abstract.text: Two opposed interested parties (IPs) compete to influence citizens with heterogeneous priors which receive news items produced by a variety of sources. The IPs fight to capture the coverage conveyed in these items. We characterize the equilibrium level of capture of item as well as the equilibrium level of information transmission. Capture increases the prevalence of the ex ante most informative messages and can explain the empirical distribution of slant at the news‐item level. Opposite capturing efforts do not cancel each other and instead undermine social learning as rational citizens discount informative messages. Citizen skepticism makes efforts to capture the news strategic substitutes. Because of strategic substitution, competition for influence is compatible with horizontal differentiation between successful media. In equilibrium, rational citizens choose to consume messages from aligned sources despite knowledge of the bias in a manner consistent with recent empirical evidence.

10.3982/ecta22072.abstractZh: 两个相互对立的利益方竞争，试图影响具有不同先验知识的公民，这些公民会接收来自各种来源的新闻信息。这两个利益方竞相获取这些信息中的内容。我们描述了信息获取的平衡水平以及信息传输的平衡水平。获取行为会增加那些在事前最具信息量的信息的传播频率，并能解释新闻信息中带有倾向性的实际分布。不同的获取努力并不会相互抵消，反而会削弱社会学习的效果，因为理性公民会忽略那些具有信息性的消息。公民的怀疑态度使得获取新闻的努力变成了战略性的替代选择。由于这种战略性替代，影响力的竞争与成功媒体之间的横向分化是相容的。在均衡状态下，理性公民会选择从立场一致的信息源获取信息，尽管他们知道这些信息中存在偏见，但这种选择与最近的实证证据是一致的。

abstract.text: Public disability insurance (DI) programs in many countries face growing fiscal pressures, prompting efforts to reduce spending. In this paper, we investigate the welfare effects of expanding the role of private insurance markets in the face of public DI cuts. We exploit a reform that abolished one part of German public DI and use unique data from a large insurer. We document modest crowding‐out effects of the reform, such that private DI take‐up remains incomplete. We find no adverse selection in the private DI market. Instead, private DI tends to attract individuals with high income, high education, and low disability risk. Using a revealed preference approach, we estimate individual insurance valuations. Our welfare analysis finds that partial DI provision via the voluntary private market can improve welfare. However, distributional concerns may justify a full public DI mandate.

10.3982/ecta22113.abstractZh: 许多国家的公共残疾保险计划面临着日益增加的财政压力，这促使人们努力减少支出。在本文中，我们研究了在公共残疾保险削减的情况下，扩大私人保险市场作用所带来的福利效应。我们利用了德国一项废除部分公共残疾保险改革的案例，并使用了来自一家大型保险公司的独特数据。我们发现，这项改革产生了适度的挤出效应，即私人残疾保险的市场参与度仍然不足。我们没有发现私人残疾保险市场存在逆向选择问题。相反，私人残疾保险倾向于吸引收入高、教育水平高且残疾风险低的个体。通过揭示性偏好方法，我们估算了个体对保险的估值。我们的福利分析表明，通过自愿的私人市场提供部分残疾保险可以改善福利。然而，从分配角度来看，完全依赖公共残疾保险可能是合理的选择。

abstract.text: I consider an agent who posits a set of probabilistic models for the payoff‐relevant outcomes. The agent has a prior over this set but fears the actual model is omitted and hedges against this possibility. The concern for misspecification is endogenous: If a model explains the previous observations well, the concern attenuates. I show that different static preferences under uncertainty (subjective expected utility, maxmin, robust control) arise in the long run, depending on how quickly the agent becomes unsatisfied with unexplained evidence. The misspecification concern's endogeneity naturally induces behavior cycles, and I characterize the limit action frequency. I apply the model to monetary policy cycles and choices in the face of complex tax schedules.

10.3982/ecta22139.abstractZh: 我设想一个代理人，该代理人为与收益相关的结果构建了一组概率模型。该代理人对这些模型有一个先验知识，但担心实际模型可能有所遗漏，因此会采取对冲措施来应对这种可能性。对模型误设的担忧是内生的：如果某个模型能够很好地解释之前的观察结果，那么这种担忧就会减弱。我展示了在不确定性下，不同的静态偏好（主观期望效用、最大最小偏好、稳健控制）在长期内会出现差异，这取决于代理人对未解释证据的不满意程度有多快。对模型误设的担忧的内生性自然会导致行为周期性的出现，我描述了极限行动频率。我将这一模型应用于货币政策周期以及面对复杂税收安排时的决策过程。

abstract.text: Is more novel research always desirable? We develop a model in which knowledge shapes society's policies and guides the search for discoveries. Researchers select a question and how intensely to study it. The novelty of a question determines both the value and difficulty of discovering its answer. We show that the benefits of discoveries are nonmonotone in novelty. Knowledge expands endogenously step‐by‐step over time. Through a dynamic externality, moonshots—research on questions more novel than what is myopically optimal—can improve the evolution of knowledge. Moonshots induce research cycles in which subsequent researchers connect the moonshot to previous knowledge.

10.3982/ecta22144.abstractZh: 是否总是需要更多新颖的研究？我们建立了一个模型，其中知识塑造了社会的政策，并引导着探索的进程。研究人员选择一个问题以及研究该问题的深度。问题的新颖性决定了发现其答案的价值和难度。我们指出，发现带来的好处与问题的新颖性呈非单调关系。知识是逐步内生的，随着时间的推移不断扩展。通过动态的外生效应，那些比当前最优方案更为新颖的问题研究能够推动知识的演变。这些新颖的研究激发了研究循环，后续的研究者会将这些新颖的研究与先前的知识联系起来。

abstract.text: This paper studies assortative matching in a non‐stationary search‐and‐matching model with non‐transferable payoffs. Non‐stationarity entails that the number and characteristics of agents searching evolve endogenously over time. Assortative matching can fail in non‐stationary environments under conditions for which Morgan (1995) and Smith (2006) show that it occurs in the steady state. This is due to the risk of worsening match prospects inherent to non‐stationary environments. The main contribution of this paper is to derive the weakest sufficient conditions on payoffs for which matching is assortative. In addition to known steady state conditions, more desirable individuals must be less risk‐averse in the sense of Arrow–Pratt.

10.3982/ecta22257.abstractZh: 本文研究了一个非静态的搜索与匹配模型中的同质匹配现象，该模型中的收益是不可转移的。非静态性意味着搜索的代理人的数量和特征会随时间内生地演变。在非静态环境中，同质匹配可能会失败，而摩根（1995年）和史密斯（2006年）的研究表明，在稳态下这种匹配现象仍然会发生。这是由于非静态环境本身存在恶化匹配前景的风险。本文的主要贡献是推导出了匹配为同质匹配的最弱充分条件。除了已知的稳态条件外，更理想的个体在阿罗-普雷特意义上必须更不厌恶风险。

abstract.text: Structural measures of higher order risk attitudes have well‐developed foundations in Expected Utility Theory (EUT), but little is known about their empirical magnitudes. We introduce a novel experimental design and a companion econometric model that allows us to structurally estimate indices of risk aversion, prudence, and temperance under EUT without imposing restrictions on their interdependence. We find that indices of absolute risk aversion, prudence, and temperance exhibit distinct patterns of variation over income, and that predicted risk premia under EUT and Rank‐Dependent Utility Theory gradually converge as the order of risk increases. These findings are obscured by regular parametric utility functions, which inherently bias results toward prudence and temperance when subjects are risk averse. The results remain robust in subsamples of moderate size, which suggests that our approach can be adopted in broader studies that link higher order risk attitudes to other domains of latent individual preferences and economic behavior.

10.3982/ecta22260.abstractZh: 高阶风险态度的结构性度量在期望效用理论中有着完善的基础，但对其实际数值的了解却很少。我们引入了一种新的实验设计以及相应的计量经济模型，可以在不对其相互依赖性施加限制的情况下，利用期望效用理论来结构性地估计风险厌恶、谨慎和节制等指标。研究发现，绝对风险厌恶、谨慎和节制的指标在不同收入水平下表现出不同的变化模式，并且在期望效用理论和依赖秩的效用理论下，随着风险阶数的增加，预测的风险溢价逐渐趋于一致。这些发现受到常规参数效用函数的干扰，这些函数本身会使结果偏向于谨慎和节制，尤其是在受试者厌恶风险的情况下。然而，这些结果在中等规模的子样本中也依然成立，这表明我们的方法可以应用于将高阶风险态度与其他潜在个体偏好和经济行为领域联系起来的更广泛的研究中。

abstract.text: We offer a theory of changing dimensions of political polarization based on endogenous social identity. We formalize voter identity as in Bonomi, Gennaioli, and Tabellini (2021), but add parties that compete on policy and spread stereotypes to persuade voters. Parties are historically connected to different social groups, whose members are more receptive to the party messages. An endogenous switch from class to cultural identity accounts for three major changes: (i) growing cultural conflict between voters and parties; (ii) dampening of redistributive conflict, despite rising inequality; (iii) a realignment of lower class voters from the left to the right. The incentive of parties to spread stereotypes is a key driver of identity‐based polarization. Using survey data and congressional speeches, we show that—consistent with our model—there is evidence of (i) and (ii) in the voting realignment induced by the “China Shock” (Autor, Dorn, Hanson, and Majlesi (2020)).

10.3982/ecta22269.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种基于内生社会身份的政治两极分化维度变化理论。我们将选民身份形式化，参考了Bonomi、Gennaioli和Tabellini（2021）的研究，但增加了在政策上竞争并传播刻板印象以说服选民的政党。这些政党历史上与不同的社会群体相关联，而这些群体的成员更容易接受政党的信息。从阶级身份到文化身份的内生转变解释了三个主要变化：(i) 选民与政党之间的文化冲突加剧；(ii) 尽管不平等现象加剧，再分配冲突却有所减弱；(iii) 低阶层选民从左翼重新转向右翼。政党传播刻板印象的动机是引发基于身份的两极分化的关键驱动因素。通过调查数据和国会演讲，我们发现——与我们的模型一致——在“中国冲击”引发的选民重新分配中，确实存在上述(i)和(ii)现象。

abstract.text: How do collateral requirements impact consumer borrowing behavior? Using administrative loan application and performance data from the U.S. Federal Disaster Loan Program, we exploit a loan amount threshold above which households must post their residence as collateral. Our bunching estimates suggest that the median borrower is willing to give up 40% of their loan amount to avoid posting collateral. Exploiting time variation in the threshold, we estimate collateral causally reduces default rates by 36%. Finally, we structurally estimate households' attachment to their homes, net of any equity, and find a median value of $11,000. Attachment creates a wedge between lender and borrower valuation of collateral of 15%. Our results explain high perceived default costs in the mortgage market, and document the importance of collateral for reducing moral hazard in consumer credit markets.

10.3982/ecta22303.abstractZh: 抵押要求如何影响消费者借款行为？通过美国联邦灾难贷款计划的行政贷款申请和绩效数据，我们发现，当贷款金额超过一定阈值时，家庭必须将其住宅作为抵押品。我们的分组估计表明，平均借款者愿意放弃其贷款金额的40%以避免抵押。通过利用阈值随时间的变化，我们估计抵押品可以减少36%的违约率。最后，我们结构性地估计了家庭对其住宅的依附程度，扣除任何股权后，平均值为11,000美元。这种依附关系使得贷款人和借款者对抵押品的估值之间存在15%的差异。我们的研究结果解释了抵押贷款市场中高感知违约成本的原因，并证明了抵押品在降低消费者信贷市场道德风险方面的重要性。

abstract.text: We consider the problem of repeatedly choosing policies to maximize social welfare. Welfare is a weighted sum of private utility and public revenue. Earlier outcomes inform later policies. Utility is not observed, but indirectly inferred. Response functions are learned through experimentation. We derive a lower bound on regret, and a matching adversarial upper bound for a variant of the Exp3 algorithm. Cumulative regret grows at a rate of T 2/3 . This implies that (i) welfare maximization is harder than the multiarmed bandit problem (with a rate of T 1/2 for finite policy sets), and (ii) our algorithm achieves the optimal rate. For the stochastic setting, if social welfare is concave, we can achieve a rate of T 1/2 (for continuous policy sets), using a dyadic search algorithm. We analyze an extension to nonlinear income taxation, and sketch an extension to commodity taxation. We compare our setting to monopoly pricing (which is easier), and price setting for bilateral trade (which is harder).

10.3982/ecta22351.abstractZh: 我们考虑了反复选择政策以最大化社会福利的问题。社会福利是私人效用与公共收入的加权和。早期的结果为后续政策提供了参考。效用并非直接观测，而是通过间接推断得出。响应函数是通过实验学习得到的。我们推导出了后悔值的下界，以及Exp3算法变体的匹配对抗上界。累积后悔值以T的2/3速率增长。这意味着：(i) 社会福利的最大化比多臂老虎机问题更为困难（对于有限的策略集，其速率为T的1/2）；(ii) 我们的算法实现了最优速率。在随机环境下，如果社会福利是凹函数，我们可以使用二进制搜索算法实现T的1/2速率（对于连续的策略集）。我们分析了非线性所得税制的扩展情况，并概述了商品税制的扩展方案。我们将我们的模型与垄断定价（较为简单）以及双边贸易的价格设定（较为困难）进行了比较。

abstract.text: I propose a method for selecting seeds to maximize contagion. First, fit a random graph model using a coarse categorization of individuals. Next, compute a seed multiplier for each category—this is the average number of new infections a seed generates. Finally, seed the category with the highest multiplier. Relative to the most common methods, my approach requires far less granular data, and it consumes less computing power—the problem scales with the number of categories, not the number of individuals. I validate the methodology through simulations using real network data.

10.3982/ecta22448.abstractZh: 我提出了一种选择种子以最大化传播范围的方法。首先，使用对个体进行粗略分类的方式，拟合一个随机图模型。接着，为每个类别计算一个种子乘数——这是该种子产生的新感染平均数量。最后，用乘数最高的类别来作为种子。与大多数常用方法相比，我的方法所需的详细数据要少得多，且计算能力要求也较低——问题的规模与类别数量相关，而非个体数量。我通过使用真实网络数据进行模拟来验证该方法的有效性。

abstract.text: This paper offers a strategic rationale for zero‐sum thinking in elections. We show that asymmetric information and distributional considerations together make voters wary of policies supported by others. This force impels a majority of voters to support policies contrary to their preferences and information. Our analysis identifies and interprets a form of “adverse correlation” that is necessary and sufficient for zero‐sum thinking to prevail in equilibrium.

10.3982/ecta22474.abstractZh: 本文为选举中的零和思维提供了一种战略上的解释。我们指出，信息不对称和分配考量共同使得选民对其他人支持的政策持谨慎态度。这种力量促使大多数选民支持与他们偏好和信息相悖的政策。我们的分析识别并解释了一种“逆向关联”，这种关联是零和思维在均衡状态下占主导地位的必要充分条件。

abstract.text: Consumer surplus, the area between the demand curve and the price, plays a key role in many models of trade and growth. Quantifying it typically requires estimating and extrapolating demand curves. This paper provides an alternative approach to measuring consumer surplus by focusing on firms as consumers of inputs. We show that the elasticity of a downstream firm's marginal cost to supplier additions and separations measures the downstream firm's consumer surplus relative to its input costs. Using Belgian data and instrumenting for changes in supplier access, we find that for every 1% of suppliers gained or lost, the marginal cost of downstream firms falls or rises by roughly 0.3%. Our estimates are directly informative about the strength of love‐of‐variety effects and the gains from movements along quality ladders. We use our microeconomic estimates of consumer surplus to assess the macroeconomic importance of supplier additions and separations in a growth accounting framework. We find that supplier churn plausibly accounts for about half of aggregate productivity growth.

10.3982/ecta22672.abstractZh: 消费者剩余，即需求曲线与价格之间的区域，在许多贸易和增长模型中起着关键作用。量化消费者剩余通常需要估计并推断需求曲线。本文提出了一种替代方法，通过关注公司作为投入品的消费者来衡量消费者剩余。我们发现，下游企业边际成本对供应商增减的弹性，可以衡量下游企业的消费者剩余与其投入成本之间的关系。利用比利时数据，并考虑供应商获取情况的变化，我们发现每当供应商数量增加或减少1%时，下游企业的边际成本就会相应上升或下降约0.3%。我们的估计结果直接反映了多样化效应的强度以及沿着质量阶梯变动所带来的收益。我们利用微观经济层面的消费者剩余估计，在增长核算框架内评估供应商增减的宏观经济重要性。我们发现，供应商的流动合理地解释了大约一半的总生产率增长。

abstract.text: This paper investigates how children affect women in science, using biographies in the American Men of Science (MoS 1956), linked with publications. First, we show that mothers have a unique life cycle pattern of productivity: While other scientists peak in their mid‐30s, mothers become less productive at that age and reach peak productivity in their early‐40s. Next, we estimate event studies of marriage, comparing mothers and fathers with other married scientists. Event study estimates show that the productivity of mothers declines until children reach school age, while fathers experience no change. These differences have important implications for tenure and participation: Just 27% of mothers achieve tenure, compared with 48% of fathers and 46% of other women. When women carried the full burden of childcare, the time costs of raising the baby boom led to a great loss of female scientists.

10.3982/ecta22741.abstractZh: 本文研究了儿童如何影响女性在科学领域的发展，通过《美国科学名人录》（MoS 1956）中的传记资料，并结合相关出版物进行分析。首先，我们发现母亲的职业生涯模式具有独特性：其他科学家通常在30多岁达到职业生涯的巅峰，而母亲则在那个年龄后生产力下降，并在40岁出头达到巅峰。接下来，我们通过事件研究的方法，将母亲与父亲以及其他已婚科学家进行比较。研究结果显示，母亲的生产力在子女达到学龄之前持续下降，而父亲的生产力则没有变化。这些差异对终身职位和女性参与科学领域的影响非常重要：仅有27%的母亲获得了终身职位，而父亲则达到了48%，其他女性则达到了46%。当女性承担全部育儿责任时，抚养婴儿所带来的时间成本导致女性科学家的数量大幅减少。

abstract.text: Government debt can be rolled over forever without primary surpluses in some stochastic economies, including some economies that are dynamically efficient. In an overlapping‐generations model with constant growth rate, g , of labor‐augmenting productivity, and with shocks to the durability of capital, we show that along a balanced growth path, the maximum sustainable ratio of bonds to capital is attained when the risk‐free interest rate, r f , equals g . Furthermore, this maximal ratio maximizes utility per capita along a balanced growth path and ensures that the economy is dynamically efficient.

10.3982/ecta22749.abstractZh: 在某些随机经济体系中，政府债务可以无限期地延续，而不需要主要盈余，包括一些具有动态效率的经济体。在一个具有恒定增长率g的重叠世代模型中，当劳动力生产率得到提升，且资本耐久性受到冲击时，我们表明，在均衡增长路径上，债券与资本的最大可持续比例在无风险利率rf等于g时达到最大值。此外，这一最大比例在均衡增长路径上最大化了人均效用，并确保了经济的动态效率。

abstract.text: We study random assignment of indivisible objects among a set of agents, when each agent is to receive one object and has strict preferences over the objects. Random Serial Dictatorship (RSD) satisfies equal treatment of equals, ex post efficiency, and strategy‐proofness. Answering a longstanding open question, we show that RSD is not characterized by those properties—there are other mechanisms satisfying equal treatment of equals, ex post efficiency, and strategy‐proofness which are not welfare‐equivalent to RSD. On the other hand, we show that RSD is not Pareto dominated by any mechanism that is (i) strategy‐proof and (ii) boundedly invariant. Moreover, the same holds for all mechanisms that are ex post efficient, strategy‐proof, and boundedly invariant: no such mechanism is dominated by any other mechanism that is strategy‐proof and boundedly invariant.

10.3982/ecta22762.abstractZh: 我们研究了在一系列代理人中随机分配不可分割的对象的问题，每个代理人只能接收一个对象，并且对这些对象有严格的偏好。随机串行独裁机制（RSD）能够满足平等对待平等者、事后效率以及策略证明性这三个要求。针对一个长期存在的未解问题，我们证明了RSD并不具备这些特性——存在其他机制也能满足平等对待平等者、事后效率以及策略证明性，但这些机制在福利上并不等同于RSD。另一方面，我们表明RSD不会被任何满足以下条件的机制所帕累托支配：(i) 策略证明性；(ii) 有界不变性。同样，所有满足事后效率、策略证明性以及有界不变性的机制也不会被其他满足这些条件的机制所支配。

abstract.text: Using randomized control trials (RCTs) applied over time in different countries, we study whether the economic environment affects how agents learn from new information. We show that as inflation rose in advanced economies, both households and firms became more attentive and informed about publicly available news about inflation, leading them to respond less to exogenously provided information about inflation and monetary policy. We also study the effects of RCTs in countries where inflation has been consistently high (Uruguay) and low (New Zealand) as well as what happens when the same agents are repeatedly provided information in both low‐ and high‐inflation environments (Italy). Our results broadly support models in which inattention is an endogenous outcome that depends on the economic environment.

10.3982/ecta22764.abstractZh: 通过在不同国家进行随机对照试验（RCTs）的研究，我们探讨了经济环境如何影响个体从新信息中学习的能力。研究发现，在发达经济体中，随着通货膨胀率的上升，家庭和企业对公开报道的通胀信息变得更加关注且了解得更多，这导致它们对外部提供的通胀和货币政策信息反应减弱。我们还研究了在通货膨胀率持续较高的国家（如乌拉圭）和较低的国家（如新西兰）进行RCTs的效果，以及当同一群体在通货膨胀率较低和较高的环境中反复接受信息时的表现（如意大利）。我们的研究结果普遍支持这样一种模型：忽视新信息的行为是一种取决于经济环境的内生结果。

abstract.text: We develop a theory of monotone comparative statics for models with adjustment costs. We show that comparative‐statics conclusions may be drawn under the usual ordinal complementarity assumptions on the objective function, assuming very little about costs: only a mild monotonicity condition is required. We use this insight to prove a general Le Chatelier principle: under the ordinal complementarity assumptions, if short‐run adjustment is subject to a monotone cost, then the long‐run response to a shock is greater than the short‐run response. We extend these results to a fully dynamic model of adjustment over time: the Le Chatelier principle remains valid, and under slightly stronger assumptions, optimal adjustment follows a monotone path. We apply our results to models of saving, production, pricing, labor supply, and investment.

10.3982/ecta22841.abstractZh: 我们为具有调整成本的模型发展了一种单调比较静态理论。我们证明，在关于目标函数的常规序数互补性假设下，即使对成本的条件假设很少，也可以得出比较静态的结论：只需要一个温和的单调性条件。我们利用这一见解来证明一个通用的勒夏特列原理：在序数互补性假设下，如果短期调整受到单调成本的影响，那么对冲击的长期响应将大于短期响应。我们将这些结果扩展到随时间变化的完全动态调整模型：勒夏特列原理仍然成立，并且在稍微更强的假设下，最优调整将遵循单调路径。我们将我们的结果应用于储蓄、生产、定价、劳动力供应和投资模型。

abstract.text: We propose two general equilibrium models, quota equilibrium, and emission tax equilibrium. Government specifies quotas or taxes on emissions, and then refrains from further action. All results remain valid regardless of how government chooses its emissions target. Quota equilibrium exists; the allocation of emission property rights impacts the distribution of welfare. If the only externality arises from total net emissions, quota equilibrium is Pareto optimal among all feasible outcomes with the same total net emissions. For certain tax rates, emission tax equilibrium may not exist. Every quota equilibrium can be realized as an emission tax equilibrium and vice versa. However, different quota prices may arise in equilibrium from a single quota, and different emission levels may arise in equilibrium from a single tax rate. This leads to inequivalence between quota and emission tax equilibria.

10.3982/ecta22923.abstractZh: 我们提出了两种一般均衡模型：配额均衡和排放税均衡。政府设定排放配额或排放税，然后不再采取进一步行动。无论政府如何选择其排放目标，所有结果都仍然有效。配额均衡是存在的；排放财产权的分配会影响福利分配。如果唯一的外部性来自总净排放量，那么在所有具有相同总净排放量的可行结果中，配额均衡是帕累托最优的。对于某些税率，排放税均衡可能不存在。每个配额均衡都可以转化为排放税均衡，反之亦然。然而，从单个配额来看，均衡时可能会出现不同的配额价格；从单个税率来看，均衡时可能会出现不同的排放水平。这导致配额均衡和排放税均衡之间不存在等价性。

abstract.text: We study reputation formation where a long‐run player repeatedly observes private signals and takes actions. Short‐run players observe the long‐run player's past actions but not her past signals. The long‐run player can thus develop a reputation for playing a distribution over actions, but not necessarily for playing a particular mapping from signals to actions. Nonetheless, we show that the long‐run player can secure her Stackelberg payoff if distinct commitment types are statistically distinguishable and the Stackelberg strategy is confound‐defeating . This property holds if and only if the Stackelberg strategy is the unique solution to an optimal transport problem. If the long‐run player's payoff is supermodular in one‐dimensional signals and actions, she secures the Stackelberg payoff if and only if the Stackelberg strategy is monotone. Applications include deterrence, delegation, signaling, and persuasion. Our results extend to the case where distinct commitment types may be indistinguishable, but the Stackelberg type is salient under the prior.

10.3982/ecta23782.abstractZh: 我们研究了声誉形成机制，其中长期玩家会反复观察私人信号并采取行动。短期玩家只能观察到长期玩家的过去行为，而无法看到她的过去信号。因此，长期玩家可以建立起自己在不同行为上的声誉，但不一定能够建立起从信号到行为的特定映射的声誉。尽管如此，我们证明，如果不同的承诺类型在统计上是可区分的，并且Stackelberg策略能够克服混淆因素，那么长期玩家就能获得Stackelberg收益。这一性质成立的条件是Stackelberg策略是最优传输问题的唯一解。如果长期玩家的收益在一维信号和行为空间中具有超模块性，那么她获得Stackelberg收益的条件是Stackelberg策略是单调的。我们的研究结果还适用于承诺类型无法区分的情况，但在先验信息下，Stackelberg策略仍然具有显著性。

abstract.text: Medical imaging systems generate vast amounts of data, demanding advanced methods for efficient analysis and interpretation. Artificial intelligence (AI) has demonstrated remarkable potential in this domain, enabling more accurate diagnostics, earlier disease detection, and personalized treatment planning. As AI technologies continue to transform healthcare, their integration into clinical workflows and evaluation by health technology assessment (HTA) agencies require rigorous evidence of clinical validity, reliability, and cost-effectiveness. The introduction of AI-driven tools into healthcare presents new methodological and practical challenges for HTA bodies, particularly in assessing their broader economic and clinical impact. Traditional health economic modelling approaches may not fully capture the dynamic and adaptive nature of AI systems, necessitating innovative frameworks that can evaluate both their short- and long-term value. Oncology provides an ideal setting to explore these challenges, given its complex treatment pathways and rapid technological innovation. Within oncology, breast cancer remains a major focus due to its global prevalence and the potential for AI-enhanced imaging to improve outcomes through more tailored surveillance strategies. This thesis examines how AI can add value to medical imaging and how its health and economic impact can be systematically assessed. A review of recent health economic evaluations of AI applications revealed that most studies have focused narrowly on short-term cost savings rather than broader health outcomes, with limited transparency and insufficient assessment of uncertainty. These findings underscore the need for more comprehensive and methodologically robust evaluations to guide the responsible adoption of AI in healthcare. Using extensive real-world data from Dutch national cancer registries and hospital records, this research explored variations in breast cancer surveillance practices and their adherence to clinical guidelines. The analyses revealed substantial inconsistencies in follow-up intensity, with some low-risk patients receiving more imaging than necessary. These patterns highlight the potential of AI-based risk prediction tools to support more personalized, risk-adapted surveillance strategies, optimizing resource use while maintaining quality of care. To further investigate AI’s potential, a dynamic discrete event simulation (DES) model was developed to assess how AI-enhanced mammography sensitivity and alternative surveillance intervals could influence patient outcomes and healthcare costs. The model, calibrated with empirical data and expert input, demonstrated that AI could reduce missed recurrences and improve early detection. However, threshold analyses indicated that, under current assumptions, AI would be cost-effective only if its incremental health benefits were sufficiently large or its implementation costs relatively low. Overall, the findings highlight both the promise and the limitations of AI in breast cancer imaging. While AI has the potential to enhance diagnostic accuracy and support more efficient, individualized care, current economic evaluations often fail to capture its full value, particularly non-traditional benefits such as improved patient autonomy, decision-making, and well-being. Future research should expand health economic frameworks to include these dimensions, ensuring that AI technologies are assessed not only for their efficiency but also for their contribution to more equitable, patient-centered healthcare.

10.3990/1.9789036568982.abstractZh: 医学影像系统会产生大量数据，需要先进的方法来进行高效的分析和解读。人工智能在这一领域展现出了显著的潜力，能够提供更准确的诊断、更早地发现疾病，并制定个性化的治疗方案。随着人工智能技术不断改变医疗保健领域，将其整合到临床工作流程中，并经过健康技术评估机构的评估，需要严格证明其临床有效性、可靠性和成本效益。将人工智能驱动的工具引入医疗保健领域，给健康技术评估机构带来了新的方法和实践挑战，尤其是在评估其更广泛的经济和临床影响方面。传统的健康经济建模方法可能无法完全捕捉到人工智能系统的动态和适应性，因此需要创新的框架来评估其短期和长期的价值。肿瘤学为探索这些挑战提供了理想的环境，因为其治疗过程复杂，技术创新迅速。在肿瘤学中，乳腺癌由于其全球范围内的发病率，以及人工智能增强的影像技术能够通过更个性化的监测策略改善治疗效果，因此成为研究的重点。本论文探讨了人工智能如何为医学影像增添价值，以及如何系统地评估其健康和经济影响。对最近关于人工智能应用的健康经济评估的回顾显示，大多数研究仅关注短期成本节约，而忽视了更广泛的健康结果，且透明度有限，对不确定性的评估不足。这些发现强调了需要更全面、方法上更严谨的评估，以指导在医疗保健领域负责任地采用人工智能。本研究利用荷兰国家癌症登记系统和医院记录中的大量真实数据，探讨了乳腺癌监测实践中的差异及其对临床指南的遵循情况。分析结果显示，在随访强度上存在显著的不一致现象，一些低风险患者接受了过多的影像学检查。这些现象凸显了基于人工智能的风险预测工具在支持更加个性化、适应风险监测策略方面的潜力，有助于优化资源利用并维持护理质量。为了进一步探究人工智能的潜力，研究人员开发了一个动态离散事件模拟模型，以评估人工智能增强的乳腺X光检查敏感性和替代监测间隔对患者结果和医疗成本的影响。该模型通过实证数据和专家意见进行校准，表明人工智能能够减少漏诊复发并提高早期检测能力。然而，阈值分析表明，在当前假设条件下，人工智能只有在其增量健康效益足够大或实施成本相对较低时，才具有成本效益。总体而言，研究结果既揭示了人工智能在乳腺癌影像诊断中的潜力，也指出了其局限性。虽然人工智能有潜力提高诊断准确性并支持更高效的个性化护理，但当前的经济评估往往未能充分捕捉其全部价值，尤其是诸如提高患者自主性、决策能力和幸福感等非传统效益。未来的研究应扩展健康经济框架，纳入这些维度，确保人工智能技术不仅因其效率而被评估，还因其对更加公平、以患者为中心的医疗保健的贡献而被评估。

abstract.text: When estimating the effects of treatments defined by complex formulas, researchers often use simple functions of exogenous shocks as instruments.A leading example is "simulated instruments" for public policy eligibility, which capture variation in state-level policy generosity.We show how more powerful instruments can be constructed by incorporating heterogeneous shock exposure while using a recentering procedure to avoid bias.We characterize the asymptotically efficient instruments in this class and propose an algorithm for constructing feasible approximations to them.Compared to a simulated instrument approach, our approach yields a 44% smaller standard error on the private insurance crowd-out effect of Medicaid enrollment from the 2014 Affordable Care Act expansions.

10.47004/wp.cem.2025.0925.abstractZh: 在估计由复杂公式定义的处理效应的过程中，研究人员经常使用外生冲击的简单函数作为工具变量。一个典型的例子是“模拟工具变量”，用于衡量公共政策的可行性与否，这些工具变量能够捕捉到州级政策宽松程度的变化。我们展示了如何通过结合异质性的冲击暴露，并采用重新中心化程序来避免偏差，从而构建更强大的工具变量。我们描述了这类渐近有效工具变量，并提出了一种构建其可行近似值的算法。与模拟工具变量方法相比，我们的方法使得2014年《平价医疗法案》扩展对私人保险覆盖影响的标准误差减少了44%。

abstract.text: High-quality matches between patients and primary care providers improve downstream health outcomes, yet provider turnover breaks these matches and forces patients to be reassigned. Health systems facing this problem must decide not only which providers to recommend, but how much choice to offer. Direct assignment avoids competition for scarce provider capacity but relies on noisy estimates of patient preferences; broader choice allows patients to correct these estimates using private information but can create costly coordination failures. We study this tradeoff through the design of fixed, personalized menus from which patients choose providers. We show that constructing the optimal menu is NP-hard and establish an information-theoretic lower bound. We find that offering each patient a single provider matches this bound up to a constant factor, while unrestricted choice can perform arbitrarily poorly. However, we show that additional choice improves on single-provider assignment when the system cannot reliably distinguish among a patient's alternatives. We formalize this tradeoff through two forms of loss: menu loss, which arises when menus offer too few options, and coordination loss, which arises when scarce capacity is exposed to too much choice. Motivated by this decomposition, we develop the Scenario-Averaged Marginals (SAM) algorithm, which tailors menus based on provider shadow prices so choice is offered only when utility exceeds the capacity cost. We identify sufficient conditions which SAM's regret matches the lower bound, namely when patients have valuable alternatives and offered menus don't create competition for scarce capacity. In a semi-synthetic environment calibrated to a provider network using Medicare data, SAM improves total utility by up to 19% over single-provider assignment as preference uncertainty grows, while improving utility for the least-served ZIP codes.

10.48550/arxiv.2502.10353.abstractZh: 患者与初级保健提供者之间的高质量匹配能够改善后续的健康结果，然而提供者的流动会破坏这种匹配，迫使患者被重新分配。面临这一问题的卫生系统不仅要决定推荐哪些提供者，还要决定提供多少选择。直接分配可以避免对稀缺提供者的竞争，但依赖于对患者偏好的噪声估计；更广泛的选择允许患者利用私人信息来修正这些估计，但可能会导致昂贵的协调失败。我们通过设计固定且个性化的菜单来研究这种权衡，患者可以从这些菜单中选择提供者。我们发现构建最优菜单是NP难问题，并确定了信息论上的下界。我们发现，为每位患者提供单一提供者时，最优菜单的匹配程度可以高达一个常数因子，而无限制的选择则可能导致较差的效果。然而，我们表明，在系统无法可靠区分患者的不同选择时，额外的选择可以改善单一提供者分配的效果。我们通过两种形式的损失来形式化这种权衡：菜单损失，当菜单提供的选项太少时产生；协调损失，当稀缺资源受到过多选择时产生。基于这种分解，我们开发了场景平均边际算法（SAM），该算法根据提供者的影子价格来定制菜单，仅在效用超过容量成本时才提供选择。我们确定了SAM的遗憾值与下界相匹配的充分条件，即当患者拥有有价值的替代选项，且提供的菜单不会造成对稀缺资源的竞争时。在利用Medicare数据对提供者网络进行校准的半合成环境中，随着偏好不确定性的增加，SAM在单一提供者分配的基础上，总效用提升了高达19%，同时对于服务最少的邮政编码区，效用也得到了改善。

abstract.text: Startup accelerators are a leading gateway to venture capital, but top programs often require founders to relocate to a venture hub. From a hand-collected census of U.S. accelerator startups (2008-2011) followed for five years, we estimate a two-sided matching model that separates two channels behind the gender funding gap, geographic mobility and sorting across accelerator tiers. Women raise about 60% less than men over five years; the gap concentrates among non-relocating women, is largest at active-childrearing ages, and vanishes for relocators, while the mobility cost is near zero for men. Removing mobility frictions raises women's match quality but not their tier; reaching the high-funding top tier also requires removing the sorting disadvantage that women face. The 2012 JOBS Act eased the legal barrier and capacity grew tenfold, yet the U.S. VC dollar gap still tripled (2011-2020): closing it needs mobility, sorting, and capacity together.

10.48550/arxiv.2502.14984.abstractZh: 创业加速器是获取风险资本的重要途径，但顶尖的加速器项目通常要求创始人迁往风险资本中心。通过对美国加速器初创企业（2008-2011年）的五年跟踪调查，我们建立了一个双边匹配模型，揭示了性别资金差距背后的两个原因：地理流动性和不同加速器层级之间的排序差异。在五年时间里，女性创业者的融资额比男性低约60%；这种差距在非迁居女性中最为明显，在子女抚养期间尤为突出，而对于迁居者来说，这种差距则消失了。而男性的流动性成本几乎为零。消除流动性摩擦可以提高女性的匹配质量，但不会改变她们的层级；要进入高资金支持的顶级加速器，还需要消除女性面临的排序劣势。2012年的JOBS法案缓解了法律障碍，相关能力也增长了十倍，但美国的风险资本资金差距仍然增加了三倍（2011-2020年）：要消除这一差距，需要同时解决流动性、排序和能力问题。

abstract.text: We present a deep learning-based approach to studying dynamic clinical behavioral regimes in diverse non-randomized healthcare settings. Our proposed methodology - deep causal behavioral policy learning (DC-BPL) - uses deep learning algorithms to learn the distribution of high-dimensional clinical action paths, and identifies the causal link between these action paths and patient outcomes. Specifically, our approach: (1) identifies the causal effects of provider assignment on clinical outcomes; (2) learns the distribution of clinical actions a given provider would take given evolving patient information; (3) and combines these steps to identify the optimal provider for a given patient type and emulate that provider's care decisions. Underlying this strategy, we train a large clinical behavioral model (LCBM) on electronic health records data using a transformer architecture, and demonstrate its ability to estimate clinical behavioral policies. We propose a novel interpretation of a behavioral policy learned using the LCBM: that it is an efficient encoding of complex, often implicit, knowledge used to treat a patient. This allows us to learn a space of policies that are critical to a wide range of healthcare applications, in which the vast majority of clinical knowledge is acquired tacitly through years of practice and only a tiny fraction of information relevant to patient care is written down (e.g. in textbooks, studies or standardized guidelines).

10.48550/arxiv.2503.03724.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种基于深度学习的分析方法，用于研究不同非随机化医疗环境中的动态临床行为模式。我们提出的方法——深度因果行为政策学习（DC-BPL）——利用深度学习算法来学习高维临床行为路径的分布，并识别这些行为路径与患者结果之间的因果关系。具体来说，我们的方法包括：(1) 识别医疗服务提供者分配对患者结果的因果效应；(2) 学习在患者信息不断变化的情况下，特定医疗服务提供者会采取的临床行为分布；(3) 结合以上步骤，为特定患者类型确定最优医疗服务提供者，并模拟该提供者的护理决策。在这一策略的基础上，我们采用Transformer架构在电子健康记录数据上训练了一个大型临床行为模型（LCBM），并证明了其估计临床行为政策的能力。我们提出了一种对使用LCBM学习到的行为政策的新解释：它是一种高效编码复杂且通常隐含的知识的方式，用于治疗患者。这使我们能够学习到一系列对广泛医疗应用至关重要的政策，在这些应用中，绝大多数临床知识是通过多年的实践 tacitly获得的，只有极少一部分与患者护理相关的信息被记录下来（例如，在教科书、研究或标准化指南中）。

abstract.text: A large empirical literature regresses outcomes on empirical Bayes shrinkage estimates of value-added, yet little is known about whether this approach leads to unbiased estimates and valid inference for the downstream regression coefficients. We study a general class of empirical Bayes estimators and the properties of the resulting regression coefficients. We show that estimators can be asymptotically biased and inference can be invalid if the shrinkage estimator does not account for heteroskedasticity in the noise when estimating value added. By contrast, shrinkage estimators properly constructed to model this heteroskedasticity perform an automatic bias correction: the associated regression estimator is asymptotically unbiased, asymptotically normal, and efficient in the sense that it is asymptotically equivalent to regressing on the true (latent) value-added.
