Further, OLS standard errors from regressing on shrinkage estimates are consistent in this case. As such, efficient inference is easy for practitioners to implement: simply regress outcomes on shrinkage estimates of value-added that account for noise heteroskedasticity.

10.48550/arxiv.2503.19178.abstractZh: 大量实证文献将结果与基于实证贝叶斯收缩估计的附加值进行回归分析，但关于这种方法是否能得到无偏估计以及能否对下游回归系数进行有效推断，目前尚无明确结论。我们研究了一类实证贝叶斯估计量及其所得到的回归系数的性质。我们发现，如果收缩估计量在估计附加值时未能考虑噪声中的异方差性，那么估计量可能会存在渐近偏差，且推断结果可能无效。相比之下，那些能够适当建模这种异方差性的收缩估计量可以自动进行偏差校正：相应的回归估计量在渐近意义上是无偏的、正态的，并且具有高效性，即它与基于真实（潜在）附加值进行回归具有渐近等价性。此外，基于收缩估计量进行OLS回归得到的标准误差在这种情况下也是一致的。因此，对于实践者来说，实现高效推断是相对容易的：只需基于能够考虑噪声异方差性的附加值收缩估计量对结果进行回归即可。

abstract.text: With a multilateral vertical contracting model of media markets, we examine upstream competition and contractual arrangements in content provision. We analyze the trade of content by the Nash bargaining solution and the downstream competition by the Hotelling location model. We characterize the equilibrium outcomes and the contractual arrangements for various vertical structures. We show that the possibility of exclusive contracts rises when the value of the premium content increases, the degree of horizontal differentiation in the downstream market decreases, the importance of advertising revenue decreases, and the relative bargaining power of upstream firm decreases.

10.48550/arxiv.2506.15063.abstractZh: 在多边垂直契约的媒体市场模型中，我们研究了内容提供过程中的上游竞争和契约安排。我们通过纳什谈判解来分析内容交易，并通过霍特林位置模型来研究下游竞争。我们描述了各种垂直结构下的均衡结果和契约安排。我们发现，当高级内容的价值增加、下游市场的水平差异化程度降低、广告收入的重要性下降以及上游企业的相对谈判力量减弱时，独家合同的可能性就会上升。

abstract.text: Many automated decision systems (ADS) are designed to solve prediction problems -- where the goal is to learn patterns from a sample of the population and apply them to individuals from the same population. In reality, these prediction systems operationalize holistic policy interventions in deployment. Once deployed, ADS can shape impacted population outcomes through an effective policy change in how decision-makers operate, while also being defined by past and present interactions between stakeholders and the limitations of existing organizational, as well as societal, infrastructure and context. In this work, we consider the ways in which we must shift from a prediction-focused paradigm to an intervention-oriented paradigm when considering the impact of ADS within social systems. We argue this requires a new default problem setup for ADS beyond prediction, to instead consider predictions as decision support, final decisions, and outcomes. We highlight how this perspective unifies modern statistical frameworks and other tools to study the design, implementation, and evaluation of ADS systems, and point to the research directions necessary to operationalize this paradigm shift. Using these tools, we characterize the limitations of focusing on isolated prediction tasks, and lay the foundation for a more intervention-oriented approach to developing and deploying ADS.

10.48550/arxiv.2507.05216.abstractZh: 许多自动化决策系统旨在解决预测问题——其目标是从人群样本中学习模式，并将其应用于同一人群中的个体。实际上，这些预测系统在部署时会实施全面的政策干预。一旦部署，自动化决策系统可以通过决策者操作方式的政策变革来影响受影响人群的结果，同时也会受到过去和现在利益相关者之间的互动以及现有组织和社会基础设施及环境的限制。在这项研究中，我们考虑了在考虑自动化决策系统在社会系统中的影响时，必须从以预测为中心的范式转向以干预为中心的范式。我们认为，这需要对自动化决策系统的默认问题设置进行新的调整，将预测视为决策支持、最终决策和结果。我们强调了这种视角如何统一现代统计框架和其他工具，以研究自动化决策系统的设计、实施和评估，并指出了实现这种范式转变所需的研究方向。利用这些工具，我们指出了专注于孤立预测任务的局限性，并为开发和实施自动化决策系统提供了以干预为导向的方法的基础。

abstract.text: Women live longer than men yet report worse health. One common reading of this male-female health-survival paradox is that women also engage more with healthcare. We challenge that reading with causal evidence from the plausibly random timing of first-time non-fatal heart attacks and strokes in Danish administrative data. After such a shock, men increase their statin use and their general-practitioner visits substantially more than women. We find no evidence that the gap reflects a lower willingness among women to seek or take up care: men and women fill the same number of prescriptions, but women receive lower doses per fill, and the gap widens across drug classes where physicians have more discretion over what to prescribe. This points to provider behaviour rather than patient demand. Despite the additional treatment, men fare no better than women on mortality or morbidity, or on the labour-market outcomes we can measure. Given women's general survival advantage, this suggests women might have fared even better had they been treated as intensively as men. The gap arises even within a universal healthcare system and a country with comparatively low gender inequality, so removing barriers to access is not by itself sufficient to close it.

10.48550/arxiv.2509.01310.abstractZh: 女性的寿命比男性长，但健康状况却更差。对于这种男女健康与生存差异的常见解释是，女性更多地参与医疗保健。我们通过丹麦行政数据中首次非致命性心脏病发作和中风的随机时间数据，提出了对这一观点的质疑。在经历这种冲击后，男性比女性更大幅度地增加他汀类药物的使用频率，并更频繁地就诊于全科医生。我们没有发现证据表明这种差异反映了女性寻求或接受治疗的意愿较低：男性和女性所配的处方数量相同，但女性的用药剂量较低，而在医生有更大自主权来开药的药物类别中，这种差异更为明显。这表明问题主要出在医疗服务提供者的行为上，而非患者需求。尽管女性接受了额外的治疗，但在死亡率、发病率或我们可以衡量的劳动力市场结果方面，男性的表现并不优于女性。鉴于女性总体上具有更高的生存优势，这表明如果女性也能像男性那样接受密集的治疗，她们的表现可能会更好。即使在普遍医疗保健体系下，即使在一个性别不平等程度相对较低的国家，这种差异仍然存在，因此仅仅消除获取服务的障碍并不足以消除这种差异。

abstract.text: Enrollment in the Health Insurance Marketplaces created by the Affordable Care Act reached an all-time high of approximately 25 million Americans in 2025, roughly doubling since enhanced premium tax credit subsidies were made available in 2021. The scheduled expiration of enhanced subsidies in 2026 is estimated to leave over seven million Americans without health insurance coverage. Ten states have created supplemental Marketplace subsidies, yet little attention has been paid to how to best structure these subsidies to maximize coverage. Using administrative enrollment data from Maryland's Marketplace, we estimate demand for Marketplace coverage. Then, using estimated parameters and varying budget constraints, we simulate how to optimally allocate supplemental state premium subsidies to mitigate coverage losses from enhanced premium subsidy expiration. We find that premium sensitivity is greatest among enrollees with incomes below 200 percent of the federal poverty level, where the marginal effect of an additional ten dollars in monthly subsidies on the probability of coverage is approximately 6.5 percentage points, and decreases to roughly 2.5 percentage points above 200 percent FPL. Simulation results indicate that each 10 million dollars in annual state subsidies could retain roughly 5,000 enrollees, though the cost-effectiveness of these subsidies falls considerably once all enrollees below 200 percent of the federal poverty level are fully subsidized. We conclude that states are well positioned to mitigate, but not stop, coverage losses from expanded premium tax credit subsidy expiration.

10.48550/arxiv.2510.13791.abstractZh: 根据《平价医疗法案》设立的医疗保险市场，到2025年，参保人数达到了历史最高水平，约2500万美国人参加了该市场。这一数字自2021年推出增强型保费税收抵免补贴后几乎翻了一番。预计2026年增强型补贴将到期，届时将有超过700万美国人无法获得医疗保险。十个州已经推出了补充性市场补贴，但关于如何最好地设计这些补贴以最大化覆盖范围的问题却鲜有人关注。我们利用马里兰州市场的行政数据来估算对市场覆盖的需求。然后，利用估算出的参数和不同的预算限制，我们模拟如何最优地分配州级补充性保费补贴，以缓解增强型保费补贴到期带来的覆盖范围损失。我们发现，收入低于联邦贫困线200%的参保者对保费变化的敏感度最高，每月增加10美元的补贴对覆盖概率的影响约为6.5个百分点，而超过200%的联邦贫困线时，这一影响则降至约2.5个百分点。模拟结果显示，每增加1000万美元的年度州补贴，大约可以保留5000名参保者。不过，一旦所有收入低于联邦贫困线200%的参保者都获得全额补贴，这些补贴的成本效益就会显著下降。我们得出结论，各州有能力缓解但无法完全阻止因扩大保费税收抵免补贴到期而导致的覆盖范围损失。

abstract.text: The cost of inpatient hospital services is an important factor in the financial sustainability of health facilities. The ever-increasing cost of hospitalization poses a challenge to hospitals' financial sustainability, especially since the discrepancy between INA-CBG rates and actual costs often causes financial problems. This can reduce operational efficiency and service quality, particularly for vulnerable communities. This study to analyze the evaluation of the coverage of hospital care costs and financial sustainability. The methods A systematic review was conducted based on the PRISMA 2020 guidelines. Data were obtained from two main databases: Google Scholar and Garuda. A total of thirteen research articles met the inclusion criteria (articles from 2019–2024 that used the activity-based costing approach and were relevant to inpatient service rates). Quality assessment was conducted using the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale and internal validation questions. The results show that the ABC method provides a more accurate estimation of inpatient costs than the conventional method. There was a significant difference between the actual hospital rates and the ABC calculation results in the form of both under- and over-costing. Five studies showed lower rates than actual costs, while three studies showed higher rates. Conclusion: The application of ABC method is important for cost efficiency, fair tariff setting, and hospital financial stability and supports tariff negotiations with payers such as INA-CBGs.

10.55681/jige.v6i4.4784.abstractZh: 住院服务的成本是医疗机构财务可持续性的重要因素。不断上升的住院费用给医院的财务可持续性带来了挑战，尤其是由于住院费用与INA-CBG费率之间的差距常常导致财务问题。这可能会降低运营效率和服务质量，尤其是对脆弱社区而言。本研究旨在分析医院护理费用覆盖率和财务可持续性的评估。研究采用了基于PRISMA 2020指南的系统综述方法。数据来自两个主要数据库：Google Scholar和Garuda。共有十三篇研究文章符合纳入标准（这些文章来自2019年至2024年，采用基于活动的成本核算方法，且与住院服务费率相关）。质量评估使用了Newcastle-Ottawa量表和内部验证问题。研究结果表明，基于活动的成本核算方法比传统方法能更准确地估算住院成本。实际住院费用与基于活动的成本核算结果之间存在显著差异，表现为费用低估或高估。有五项研究显示的费用低于实际成本，而三项研究显示的费用高于实际成本。结论：应用基于活动的成本核算方法对于提高成本效率、合理制定收费标准以及维护医院的财务稳定非常重要，并且有助于与支付方如INA-CBGs进行费用谈判。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Patients with ST-elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) cared for by rural emergency medical services (EMS) agencies commonly do not have first medical contact-to-percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) time within the recommended goal of 90 minutes. In this study we identify factors associated with performance variation among rural EMS agencies in first medical contact-to-PCI time. METHODS: In this explanatory, sequential, mixed-methods study, we ranked eight rural county EMS agencies by continuous first medical contact-to-PCI time, accounting for loaded mileage, using data from a regional STEMI registry (2016-2019). A qualitative researcher conducted 28, one-hour, semi-structured interviews from January- March 2021 with the EMS director, training officer, medical director, and four paramedics at the top two high- and bottom two low-performing rural EMS agencies. Key informants were blinded to agency STEMI performance. Interviews were structured to identify positive deviance by exploring agencies' clinical approach to patients with chest pain, their organizational culture, structure, and quality improvement (QI) activities regarding STEMI care, and recommendations for improving STEMI performance. Interviews were digitally recorded and transcribed verbatim by a professional transcription service. We established a codebook and performed a thematic analysis using an inductive approach. We summarized and compared data across agencies to identify commonalities and differences between high- and low-performing agencies. Findings were reviewed and validated by an expert panel. RESULTS: The top two highest-performing EMS agencies had a median first medical contact-to-PCI time of 79 minutes (interquartile range [IQR] 65-91) minutes vs 98 minutes (IQR 82-120) among the bottom two lowest-performing agencies, P<.001. Both high- and low-performing agencies identified issues with electrocardiogram (ECG) transmitting technology and cumbersome hospital activation communications. However, top-performing agencies shared a culture that encourages early EMS activation of the cardiac catheterization lab after STEMI recognition. Top-performing agencies also placed a higher value on QI and training. These agencies prioritized mission and chain of command over staff relationships/interpersonal bonds; have stable, strong leadership; provide opportunities for career advancement; and collaborate with community leaders. CONCLUSION: Top-performing rural EMS agencies for STEMI care promote early activation, have a strong chain of command, are mission focused, and have a greater focus on quality improvement and training.

10.5811/westjem.43536.abstractZh:
背景：由农村紧急医疗服务机构负责治疗的ST段抬高型心肌梗死患者，从首次医疗接触到经皮冠状动脉介入治疗的时间通常未能达到推荐的90分钟目标。本研究旨在探讨影响农村紧急医疗服务机构在首次医疗接触至介入治疗时间方面的表现差异的因素。  

方法：在这项解释性、序贯性的混合方法研究中，我们根据连续记录的数据，对八个农村县的紧急医疗服务机构从首次医疗接触到介入治疗的時間进行了排名，同时考虑了实际行驶里程的影响。数据来源于一个区域性的ST段抬高型心肌梗死登记系统（2016-2019年）。2021年1月至3月期间，一位定性研究人员对表现优异和较差的农村紧急医疗服务机构的负责人、培训官员、医疗负责人以及两名高级护理人员和两名低级护理人员进行了28次为期一小时的半结构化访谈。关键信息提供者并不了解所在机构ST段抬高型心肌梗死治疗的表现情况。访谈旨在探讨各机构对胸痛患者的临床处理方式、组织文化、结构以及关于ST段抬高型心肌梗死治疗的品质改进活动，并提出改善ST段抬高型心肌梗死治疗表现的建议。访谈内容被数字化记录，并由专业转录服务进行了逐字转录。我们建立了编码手册，并采用归纳法进行了主题分析。我们汇总并比较了各机构的数据，以识别表现优异和较差的机构之间的共同点和差异。研究结果由专家小组进行了审核和验证。研究结果：表现最好的两家紧急医疗服务机构，首次医疗接触至冠状动脉介入手术的时间中位数为79分钟（四分位距为65-91分钟），而表现最差的两家机构则分别为98分钟（四分位距为82-120分钟），差异具有统计学意义（P<0.001）。无论是表现好的机构还是较差的机构，都存在心电图传输技术问题和繁琐的医院激活通信问题。然而，表现最好的机构具有一种文化，即鼓励在STEMI被识别后尽快启动紧急医疗服务，并派遣心脏导管实验室进行救治。这些机构还高度重视质量改进和培训。这些机构将任务与指挥链置于员工关系/人际关系之上；拥有稳定、强大的领导团队；为员工提供职业发展的机会；并与社区领袖合作。结论：在STEMI救治方面表现最好的农村紧急医疗服务机构能够推动早期行动，拥有强大的指挥链，以任务为重，并且更加重视质量改进和培训。

abstract.text: One of the most important compartments of the healthcare ecosystem is Ambulance services, which enables the effective transportation of the healthcare seeker to the healthcare provider. India, as a developing country has a lot of opportunities and challenges to improve, wherein, architecting a proper infrastructure uberizing Ambulance service. This paper draws a picture into the current state of ambulance service available in India, especially considering the tier 1 cities. A mathematical model has been designed to measure the impact of introducing a fully electric fleet of electric ambulances with modern facilities, integrating the environmental impact. This can be used to analyze and understand the feasibility of implementing a uberized system in a particular city. A basic user interface (UI) has been designed for a mobile-based application, which can essentially mediate the process of providing an ecosystem between the hospital, ambulances and the end user. Thus, an overall understanding of the challenges and opportunities of uberizing an electric ambulance fleet is discussed.

10.60142/ijhti.v4i01.10.abstractZh: 在医疗生态系统中，救护车服务是最重要的组成部分之一，它确保了医疗需求者能够高效地被送往医疗服务提供者处。作为发展中国家，印度在改进救护车服务方面面临着许多机遇和挑战。本文对印度现有救护车服务的现状进行了分析，特别关注一线城市的情况。为了评估引入全电动救护车系统的影响，本文设计了一个数学模型，同时考虑了环境因素的影响。该模型可用于分析和评估在特定城市实施电动救护车系统的可行性。此外，本文还为基于移动设备的应用程序设计了一个基本用户界面，该界面能够协调医院、救护车与最终用户之间的沟通流程。因此，本文全面探讨了电动救护车系统升级所面临的挑战和机遇。

abstract.text: Objective(s): The quality of hospital services should be constantly monitored and enhanced. Key performance indicators (KPIs) are as such essential to strengthen the supervision of the government, people, and other health system stakeholders and improve hospitals' performance. The present study thus seeks to identify the KPIs for ranking general hospitals in Iran. Methods: This study adopted a mixed-method design at four stages. The researchers used a scoping review to identify the related indicators and frameworks in the literature. They further qualitatively identified local indicators for hospital ranking. An expert panel refined the pooled indicators, and the KPIs were finally prioritized using the decision matrix technique. Results: Initially 233 and then 84 indicators were identified. The final 50 indicators were determined and prioritized. The number of medical staff per bed, mortality rate, patient satisfaction, staff satisfaction, and bed occupancy rate were among the highest-priority indicators. Conclusion: Structure, process, and outcome-related indicators were proposed to rank general hospitals in Iran that could be utilized to strengthen the current hospital evaluation system. Using these indicators to evaluate and rank hospitals could hopefully improve transparency, public disclosure, organizational efficiency, and ultimately the quality of services.

10.61186/payesh.24.3.315.abstractZh: 目标：医院服务的质量应持续监控并提升。关键绩效指标对于加强政府、民众及其他健康系统相关方的监督以及提高医院绩效至关重要。本研究旨在确定伊朗综合医院排名的指标。方法：本研究采用混合方法设计，分为四个阶段。研究人员通过范围审查来识别文献中的相关指标和框架，并进一步定性地确定用于医院排名的本地指标。专家小组对汇总指标进行了完善，最终通过决策矩阵技术对指标进行了优先级排序。结果：最初确定了233个指标，随后减少到84个。最终确定了50个指标并进行了优先级排序。每床位的医务人员数量、死亡率、患者满意度、员工满意度和床位占用率被列为最高优先级指标。结论：本研究提出了与结构、流程及结果相关的指标，用于对伊朗综合医院进行排名，这些指标有助于加强现有的医院评估体系。利用这些指标对医院进行评估和排名，有望提高透明度、公开性、组织效率，最终提升服务质量。

abstract.text: Background: This paper is meta-analysis study that analyses marketing as well as the literatures review that mention marketing phenomena and marketing strategies in general, especially in the field of healthcare services in improving marketing performance, which in this case is measured by looking at sales figures and the number of patient visits, and analyses how marketing strategies and marketing performance impact on consumer satisfaction. The marketing phenomena that is analysed in this study are: mix marketing strategy, relationship marketing, digital marketing, narrative/storytelling marketing, experimental marketing and emotional marketing. An analysis of communication and target markets as the main components in marketing is carried out. Target market is consisted of producer bargaining power, consumer bargaining power, supply, collaboration/cooperation, competitors, and environmental background analysis in marketing. Also important to analyse in marketing management is the assessment of the effectiveness of marketing strategies as well as the assessment and identification of target consumers. Aim: Literature tracking is carried out with the aim for analysing marketing phenomena that are important to improve marketing performance, to improve marketing effectiveness, to evaluate target consumer segmentation, to analyse various internal and external environmental factors of the organization that affect marketing management strategies and to prove their impact to consumer satisfaction. A meta-analyses study is carried out to find the meaningful relationship between marketing strategy, marketing performance and consumer satisfaction. Methods: A meta-analyses statistical methods is chosen to combines data from multiple studies to draw a single conclusion about marketing phenomena and marketing strategies in the field of healthcare services and their impact to the marketing performance and customer satisfaction. A literature review is also reported as a narrative literatures review in this study as background for the hypothesis, that is conducted on 72 literatures that analyses marketing as well as marketing phenomena and marketing strategies in general, especially in the field of healthcare services in improving marketing performance, as well as how marketing strategies and marketing performance impact on consumer satisfaction. Articles were taken from databases from Scopus, Science Direct, Discovery, SpringerLink and Google Scholar. Result: A model of the relationship between the variables developed in this study was found that formed a conceptual framework, which describes a meaningful relationship between marketing strategy and marketing performance, between marketing strategy and consumer satisfaction and between marketing performance and consumer satisfaction. Novelty: A meta-analysis research model was developed, with the result is a a complex form of conceptual framework, with the aim of providing input on how to conduct a complete analysis of marketing phenomena and marketing strategies in the field of healthcare services, how their impact and meaningful relationship on marketing performance and consumer satisfaction, analyse marketing effectiveness and consumer targets, which can provide recommendations as a basis for the development and implementation for further research in the field of service marketing Health.

10.61440/jbes.2025.v2.55.abstractZh: 背景：本文是一项元分析研究，旨在分析市场营销以及涉及市场营销现象和营销策略的文献综述，特别是在医疗服务领域如何提高市场营销绩效。在此研究中，市场营销绩效是通过观察销售数据和患者访问量来衡量的。研究分析了以下市场营销现象：组合营销策略、关系营销、数字营销、叙事/故事营销、实验性营销和情感营销。同时，对市场营销中的主要组成部分——沟通和目标市场进行了分析。目标市场包括生产者议价能力、消费者议价能力、供应情况、合作/协作关系、竞争对手以及市场营销中的环境背景分析。在市场营销管理中，评估营销策略的有效性以及识别和定位目标消费者也是非常重要的。目的：通过文献追踪，旨在分析对提高市场营销绩效、增强市场营销效果、评估目标消费者细分、分析影响市场营销管理策略的各种内部和外部环境因素，并证明这些因素对消费者满意度的影响。本研究采用元分析方法，以寻找营销策略、市场营销绩效和消费者满意度之间的有意义关系。方法：本研究采用了元分析统计方法，结合多项研究的数据，以得出关于医疗服务领域市场营销现象和营销策略的单一结论，以及这些现象和策略对市场营销绩效和顾客满意度的影响。研究还进行了文献综述，作为假设的背景依据，共分析了72篇文献，这些文献涉及市场营销以及市场营销现象和策略，特别是在医疗服务领域如何提高市场营销绩效，以及营销策略和市场营销绩效对顾客满意度的影响。文章来源于Scopus、Science Direct、Discovery、SpringerLink和Google Scholar等数据库。结果：本研究建立了变量之间关系的模型，形成了一个概念框架，描述了营销策略与市场营销绩效之间的关系、营销策略与顾客满意度之间的关系，以及市场营销绩效与顾客满意度之间的关系。创新点：本研究开发了一个元分析研究模型，其结果是一个复杂的概念框架，旨在为如何全面分析医疗服务领域的市场营销现象和营销策略提供指导，了解它们对市场营销绩效和顾客满意度的影响和有意义的关系，分析市场营销的有效性和消费者目标，并为服务市场营销领域的进一步研究提供建议。

abstract.text: Essais en la théorie des contrats et ses applications Cette dissertation comprend quatre essais indépendants et examine comment concevoir des cadres institutionnels—tels que des contrats, des lois ou des structures organisationnelles—afin de traiter de manière optimale les problèmes d’asymétrie d’information tout en poursuivant des objectifs socialement ou individuellement souhaitables. Chaque chapitre vise à (modestement) améliorer notre compréhension de certaines questions dans les domaines des marchés publics, des mécanismes d’incitation optimaux et de la conception organisationnelle. Le chapitre 1, coécrit avec Isact Antonio Olave Cruz, mesure les différentes formes de manipulation utilisées par les agents publics lors de l’attribution des contrats de marchés publics en Colombie, analyse leurs implications sur les résultats et discute des réformes légales susceptibles d’améliorer le bien-être collectif. Le chapitre 2 cherche à mieux caractériser le mécanisme d’incitation optimal qu’une organisation en concurrence propose à ses travailleurs et évalue les effets de la concurrence sur la structure des incitations. Le chapitre 3, coécrit avec Joaquín Coleff, analyse la conception organisationnelle (hiérarchies) comme un dispositif incitatif visant à motiver deux actions non contractuelles au sein d’une organisation. Enfin, le chapitre 4 examine comment les entreprises utilisent les contrats incomplets pour exploiter des avantages informationnels.

《契约理论及其应用研究》  
本论文包含四个独立的实验性研究，探讨如何设计诸如契约、法律或组织结构等制度框架，以在解决信息不对称问题的同时，实现社会或个人期望的目标。每一章都旨在（虽不夸张地）提升我们对公共市场、最优激励机制以及组织设计等领域问题的理解。  
第一章由笔者与Isact Antonio Olave Cruz共同撰写，旨在分析哥伦比亚公共合同授予过程中公共机构所使用的各种操纵手段，探讨这些手段对结果的影响，并讨论可能改善集体福祉的法律改革措施。  
第二章试图更精确地描述竞争性组织向其员工提供的优化激励机制，并评估竞争对激励结构的影响。  
第三章由笔者与Joaquín Coleff共同撰写，将组织结构视为一种激励手段，旨在激发组织内部两种非契约性行为的积极性。  
第四章则研究企业如何利用不完整的契约来获取信息优势。

abstract.text: Case management is a core function of social work practice, particularly in handling complex cases, such as those involving Children in Conflict with the Law (CICL). In the Philippine context, however, social workers often manage multiple roles with limited institutional support. This phenomenological study examined the lived experiences of six social workers who handled CICL cases in PPALMA+PB, Philippines. Data were gathered through in-depth individual interviews and analyzed using Colaizzi's thematic analysis. Findings revealed that participants assumed multiple roles, including broker, counselor, mediator, and resource provider. They encountered persistent challenges, including excessive caseloads, a limited workforce, low community awareness of social work functions, client indecisiveness, repeated offending, and inadequate financial and institutional resources. To navigate these constraints, they employed coping strategies such as structured time management, peer support, firm yet compassionate engagement with clients, and professional acceptance of systemic limitations. Implications highlight the urgent need for government and partner agencies to strengthen CICL case management systems. This includes increasing workforce allocations within the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD), providing continuous training on juvenile intervention frameworks, capacitating families as treatment partners, and intensifying community education on child rights and restorative justice. Overall, the study highlights that while social workers remain committed to rehabilitation and reintegration, their effectiveness is significantly influenced by the availability of structural support—or its absence. Strengthening support systems is crucial for sustaining ethical and effective CICL case management in the Philippine setting.

10.70838/pemj.490101.abstractZh: 案例管理是社会工作实践的核心职能，尤其是在处理涉及违法儿童等复杂案件时。然而，在菲律宾，社会工作者往往要在有限的机构支持下承担多种角色。这项现象学研究了六名在菲律宾PPALMA+PB地区处理违法儿童案件的社会工作者的实际经历。数据通过深入的个人访谈收集，并采用Colaizzi的主题分析法进行分析。研究发现，参与者承担了多种角色，包括调解人、顾问、 mediator和资源提供者。他们面临诸多挑战，包括过多的案件负担、有限的劳动力、社区对社会工作功能的认知不足、客户犹豫不决、反复犯罪行为，以及不足的财务和机构资源。为了应对这些限制，他们采取了应对策略，如结构化时间管理、同伴支持、以坚定而富有同情心的态度与客户互动，以及接受系统性的局限性。研究指出，政府及合作伙伴需要加强违法儿童案件管理系统，包括增加社会福利与发展部的人力资源、持续培训青少年干预框架、提升家庭作为治疗伙伴的能力，以及加强社区对儿童权利和恢复性司法的认识。总体而言，研究强调，尽管社会工作者致力于康复和重新融入社会，但他们的有效性在很大程度上取决于结构性支持的存在与否。在菲律宾的环境中，加强支持系统对于维持道德且有效的CICL案件管理至关重要。

abstract.text: We investigate the phenomenon of (private, out-of-pocket) "health expenditure rationing", or whether out-of-pocket health expenditures are shaped by income independently of actual health needs. Using microdata from an Italian Health Interview Survey, we assess the extent to which income explains variation in private health spending, after controlling for objective health conditions, self-assessed health, and a comprehensive set of socio-demographic factors. We find that individuals in the highest income brackets spend approximately 300 euros more annually than those in the lowest. Our findings point to a structural inequity in access and highlight the need for policy measures that address not only formal coverage but also the underlying role of income in shaping healthcare use.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.13102.abstractZh: 我们研究了“私人自付健康支出配给”现象，即自付健康支出是否受收入影响而独立于实际健康需求。通过意大利健康调查的微数据，我们在控制客观健康状况、自我评估的健康状况以及一系列社会人口学因素后，评估了收入在解释私人健康支出差异方面的程度。我们发现，收入最高的群体每年比收入最低的群体多支出约300欧元。我们的研究结果指出了在获取医疗服务方面的结构性不平等，并强调了需要采取政策措施，不仅解决正式保险覆盖问题，还要解决收入在塑造医疗使用中的潜在作用。

abstract.text: Enrollment in the Health Insurance Marketplaces created by the Affordable Care Act reached an all-time high of approximately 25 million Americans in 2025, roughly doubling since enhanced premium tax credit subsidies were made available in 2021. The scheduled expiration of enhanced subsidies in 2026 is estimated to leave over seven million Americans without health insurance coverage. Ten states have created supplemental Marketplace subsidies, yet little attention has been paid to how to best structure these subsidies to maximize coverage. Using administrative enrollment data from Maryland's Marketplace, we estimate demand for Marketplace coverage. Then, using estimated parameters and varying budget constraints, we simulate how to optimally allocate supplemental state premium subsidies to mitigate coverage losses from enhanced premium subsidy expiration. We find that premium sensitivity is greatest among enrollees with incomes below 200 percent of the federal poverty level, where the marginal effect of an additional ten dollars in monthly subsidies on the probability of coverage is approximately 6.5 percentage points, and decreases to roughly 2.5 percentage points above 200 percent FPL. Simulation results indicate that each 10 million dollars in annual state subsidies could retain roughly 5,000 enrollees, though the cost-effectiveness of these subsidies falls considerably once all enrollees below 200 percent of the federal poverty level are fully subsidized. We conclude that states are well positioned to mitigate, but not stop, coverage losses from expanded premium tax credit subsidy expiration.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.13791.abstractZh: 根据《平价医疗法案》设立的医疗保险市场，到2025年，参保人数达到了历史最高水平，约2500万美国人参加了该市场。这一数字自2021年推出增强型保费税收抵免补贴后几乎翻了一番。预计2026年增强型补贴将到期，届时将有超过700万美国人无法获得医疗保险。十个州已经推出了补充性市场补贴，但关于如何最好地设计这些补贴以最大化覆盖范围的问题却鲜有人关注。我们利用马里兰州市场的行政数据来估算对市场覆盖的需求。然后，利用估算出的参数和不同的预算限制，我们模拟如何最优地分配州级补充性保费补贴，以缓解增强型保费补贴到期带来的覆盖范围损失。我们发现，收入低于联邦贫困线200%的参保者对保费变化的敏感度最高，每月增加10美元的补贴对覆盖概率的影响约为6.5个百分点，而超过200%的联邦贫困线时，这一影响则降至约2.5个百分点。模拟结果显示，每增加1000万美元的年度州补贴，大约可以保留5000名参保者。不过，一旦所有收入低于联邦贫困线200%的参保者都获得全额补贴，这些补贴的成本效益就会显著下降。我们得出结论，各州有能力缓解但无法完全阻止因扩大保费税收抵免补贴到期而导致的覆盖范围损失。

abstract.text: This thesis consists of three essays in industrial organization, with a common focus on the production of open source software (OSS)---computer programs freely available for use and modification. The first chapter is an empirical study of how growing government involvement may affect the production of this critical public good. The second and third chapters are methodological, offering recommended practices for Berry, Levinsohn and Pakes (1995)-style estimation of differentiated product systems, along with my own contribution to OSS: a supporting software package PyBLP.

https://openalex.org/W7111653404.abstractZh: 本论文包含三篇关于产业组织的论文，共同聚焦于开源软件的生产——即可以自由使用和修改的计算机程序。第一章是对政府干预程度增加如何影响这一重要公共产品生产的实证研究。第二章和第三章则涉及方法论方面的内容，提出了类似于Berry、Levinsohn和Pakes（1995年）提出的差异化产品系统估计方法的建议，同时我还为开源软件开发了一个辅助软件包PyBLP。

abstract.text: This thesis comprises three essays on pharmacy networks, examining their roles in health outcomes, consumer welfare, and patient selection. The first chapter analyzes the effects of losing pharmacy access due to periodic network rearrangements by Medicare Part D prescription drug plans, whereas the last two chapters focus on preferred pharmacies---a selective tier of pharmacies that provide reduced cost-sharing for consumers. Overall, my results reveal that the design of both general and preferred pharmacy networks significantly affects various patient outcomes, including drug utilization and mortality. In the first chapter, I leverage a matched difference-in-differences research design to demonstrate that disrupting in-network access to pharmacies leads to an immediate 5% decline in medication adherence. Although adherence rates for affected patients partially recover over time, their mortality rates increase by 23% after one year. The second chapter investigates a different type of network shock---the initial adoption of a preferred pharmacy tier. I show that one year after a pharmacy gains preferred status, its patients experience a 15% reduction in out-of-pocket costs, a 1.3% increase in days' supply of prescriptions, and a 11.6% decline in mortality. I then estimate a model of plan and pharmacy demand to derive a measure of consumer willingness to pay for pharmacy networks based on revealed preferences. Counterfactual analyses indicate that consumers vastly undervalue the cost-sharing and mortality benefits of preferred pharmacies. Given their significant impact on healthcare provision, the third chapter studies whether preferred pharmacy networks are employed by insurance plans as a tool for consumer screening. Using an instrumental variable approach, I find that variation in local enrollees' exposure to Medicare's annual risk adjustment updates incentivizes plans to contract with pharmacies that serve more profitable patients. This underscores the need for regulatory reforms to ensure equitable access to the advantages offered by preferred pharmacy networks.

https://openalex.org/W7112994685.abstractZh: 本论文包含三篇关于药房网络的研究，探讨它们在健康结果、消费者福利和患者选择中的作用。第一章分析了由于Medicare Part D处方药计划定期调整药房网络而导致的药房访问中断对医疗效果的影响；后两章则聚焦于优先药房这一为消费者提供较低费用分担的精选药房层级。总体而言，我的研究结果表明，普通药房和优先药房网络的设计对多种患者结果有着显著影响，包括药物使用率和死亡率。在第一章中，我采用匹配差异研究设计，证明药房网络中断会导致药物依从性立即下降5%。尽管受影响患者的依从性在一段时间后有所恢复，但一年后的死亡率却上升了23%。第二章研究了另一种类型的网络冲击——优先药房层级的初始采用。我发现，当一家药房获得优先地位一年后，其患者的自付费用减少了15%，处方药品的日供应量增加了1.3%，死亡率则下降了11.6%。随后，我通过模型估算了计划和药房的需求，以基于揭示的偏好来衡量消费者对药房网络的支付意愿。反事实分析表明，消费者严重低估了优先药房在费用分担和死亡率方面的好处。鉴于优先药房网络对医疗服务的重要影响，第三章探讨了保险计划是否利用优先药房网络作为消费者筛选的工具。通过采用工具变量方法，我发现当地参保者接触医疗保险年度风险调整更新的程度，会促使保险公司与为更有利可图的患者提供服务的药店建立合作关系。这凸显了进行监管改革的重要性，以确保人们能够公平地享受到优先药房网络带来的优势。

abstract.text: This dissertation consists of three essays in financial economics with a common focus on the consequences of firm financing frictions for labor markets, entrepreneurship, and innovation. Chapter 1 provides novel evidence on the career returns to startup employment using quasi-exogenous variation in venture capital (VC) investment. The chapter shows how VC market conditions impact the labor market for startup talent, job outcomes, and worker career progression. It then documents how these effects vary with the technology-skill specificity of workers' human capital investments. Using novel administrative data on healthcare providers, Chapter 2 demonstrates the negative externalities of financial distress for employees and consumers: filing for corporate bankruptcy increases voluntary worker turnover, leading to worsened quality of care and patient health. By collecting a novel dataset on public-sector entrepreneurial finance programs, Chapter 3 provides a new look at government efforts to finance early-stage ventures, shedding light on their global scope, scale, and consequences.

https://openalex.org/W7113154982.abstractZh: 本论文包含三篇关于金融经济学的文章，共同关注企业融资摩擦对劳动力市场、创业和创新的影响。第一章利用准外生变化的风险投资投资数据，提供了关于初创企业就业的职业回报的新证据。该章节展示了风险投资市场状况如何影响初创企业人才的市场就业状况、工作结果以及员工的职业晋升。随后，该章节进一步探讨了这些效应如何随着劳动者人力资本投资的技术-技能特性而变化。第二章利用关于医疗服务提供者的新型行政数据，揭示了财务困境对雇员和消费者的负面影响：企业申请破产会增加员工的自愿离职率，从而导致医疗服务质量下降和患者健康状况恶化。第三章通过收集关于公共部门创业融资计划的新数据集，从新的角度审视了政府为早期创业项目提供融资的努力，揭示了这些计划的全球范围、规模及其影响。

abstract.text: Public sector organizations around the world are held to account on the basis of objective measures of performance. This paper investigates, for the first time, the impact of subjective school inspection ratings on labor market and career outcomes for school principals, senior managers and teachers. Employing unique school inspection data and the population of teachers in secondary schools in England, we compare personnel in schools experiencing a rating change with those in schools with no change in inspection rating, in a difference-in-differences framework. A change in the overall school inspection rating has substantial impact on principals' wages and their rate of exit from public sector schooling, but the impact on teachers is much more muted. Our findings suggest that competition is a key mechanism through which changes in school inspection ratings affect school personnel labor market outcomes. Importantly, exploiting novel inspection sub-grade data on school leadership and management quality enables us to assess the impact on principals arising from this direct channel, over and above the response to overall school ratings. It reveals that the rating for this specific dimension of quality is an important channel driving principals' outcomes. These results shed new light on the impact of subjective quality assessments on the careers of public sector managers and employees.

https://openalex.org/W7113455647.abstractZh: 全球范围内的公共部门组织都需依据客观绩效指标来接受问责。本文首次研究了主观的学校检查评级对校长、高级管理人员和教师劳动力市场及职业发展的影响。我们利用独特的学校检查数据以及英格兰中学教师的人口数据，通过差异-差异框架，比较了检查评级发生变化的学校与评级没有变化的学校中的人员情况。整体学校检查评级的变化对校长的工资以及他们离开公共部门教育机构的频率有显著影响，但对教师的影响则较为微弱。我们的研究结果表明，竞争是改变学校检查评级对学校人员劳动力市场结果产生影响的关键机制。重要的是，通过利用关于学校领导和管理质量的新颖子评级数据，我们能够评估这一直接渠道对校长的影响，而不仅仅是整体学校评级的反应。研究还发现，这一特定质量维度的评级是推动校长职业发展的一个重要渠道。这些结果为我们理解主观质量评估对公共部门管理者和员工职业生涯的影响提供了新的视角。

abstract.text: We study the allocative effects of enhancing consumer choice and non-price competition in markets with heterogeneous producers. We use comprehensive administrative data and a difference-in-differences design based on the introduction of a regional patient choice reform for planned surgeries in Finland. We find that large teaching hospitals attracted more patients and concentration increased in their markets. Waiting times decreased in hospitals exposed to the reform and more patients were treated, with little effect on clinical quality or average surgical expenditure after the reform. Our results suggest that increased choice can reallocate patients towards large producers and improve public hospital performance.

https://openalex.org/W7137432420.abstractZh: 我们研究了在具有异质生产者的市场中，增强消费者选择和非价格竞争对资源配置的影响。我们利用了全面的行政数据，并基于芬兰计划中的区域患者选择改革，采用了差异-差异设计的方法进行研究。研究发现，大型教学医院吸引了更多的患者，市场的集中度也提高了。在受到改革影响的医院中，等待时间减少，治疗的患者数量增加，但临床质量或平均手术费用在改革后几乎没有变化。我们的结果表明，增加选择可以重新分配患者到大型生产者手中，从而提高公立医院的绩效。

abstract.text: This thesis investigates the mechanisms addressing information asymmetry in the digital economy, focusing on the interactions between policy, technology, and market behavior in the online used car market. It comprises three essays that integrate theoretical synthesis with empirical identification to explore how trust is constructed in digital marketplaces. The first essay reviews the literature on signaling, disclosure, and certification, establishing a theoretical framework for understanding how digital platforms reshape traditional solutions to adverse selection. It highlights the pivotal role of platform governance in facilitating credible information exchange. The second essay employs a difference-in-differences strategy to analyze the market response to Volkswagen’s court-mandated Zero Emission Vehicle (ZEV) investment plan. The results indicate a significant 13.5% increase in the final auction prices of Volkswagen used cars following the announcement, with no corresponding change in transaction volume. This finding suggests that non-voluntary CSR initiatives can effectively enhance consumer perceived quality and willingness to pay. The third essay investigates the impact of buyer information acquisition through eBay’s WeGoLook inspection service. The analysis reveals that the introduction of the service increased final prices by approximately 12% and reduced the marginal value of seller-provided photos. Furthermore, the policy induced a strategic supply-side response, where sellers increased voluntary disclosure to mitigate the threat of third-party verification. This body of research contributes to information economics and platform design by demonstrating that credible signals, ranging from institutional mandates to technological enablers, are indispensable for mitigating moral hazard and enhancing market efficiency in the digital age.

https://openalex.org/W7160677511.abstractZh: 本论文探讨了数字经济中解决信息不对称问题的机制，重点关注政策、技术和市场行为在在线二手车市场中的相互作用。论文包含三篇论文，将理论分析与实证识别相结合，以探索数字市场中信任是如何构建的。第一篇论文回顾了关于信号传递、信息披露和认证的相关文献，为理解数字平台如何重塑传统解决逆向选择的方案提供了理论框架。文章强调了平台治理在促进可信信息交换中的关键作用。第二篇论文采用差异-差异策略分析市场对大众汽车法院强制执行的零排放车辆投资计划的反应。研究结果显示，在公告发布后，大众汽车二手车的最终拍卖价格显著上涨了13.5%，而交易量并未相应变化。这一发现表明，非自愿的CSR举措可以有效提升消费者感知的质量和支付意愿。第三篇论文研究了通过eBay的WeGoLook检查服务获取买家信息的影响。分析显示，该服务的引入使最终价格上升了约12%，并降低了卖家提供的照片的边际价值。此外，该政策引发了卖方方面的战略性供应反应，卖方增加了自愿信息披露，以缓解第三方验证的威胁。这项研究通过证明，从制度规定到技术支持的各类可信信号，对于减轻道德风险和提高数字时代的市场效率至关重要，从而为信息经济学和平台设计提供了贡献。

abstract.text: Multispeciality hospitals have been reported to struggle with performance management due to challenges in identifying appropriate performance measures that are visionary to the organizational objectives. Rapid results initiative (RRI) has been identified as a performance management tool to help achieve results within organizations over a short period of time. This study investigated the effect of rapid results initiative on performance of multispecialty hospitals in the rural settings of Kenya. The study variables included; RRI monitoring, RRI capacity building, Transformative leadership, success factors and challenges in implementation of RRI. The research was grounded on the goal-setting and resource-based view theories, with a mixed study design utilized in the survey alongside census approach to sampling which delivered a sample size of 39 respondents. The data obtained was analyzed using a special software and the results presented in tables, graphs and figures. The study findings revealed that RRI has a strong effect on the performance of multispeciality hospitals in Kenya. The study however established that the independent variables, RRI monitoring, Capacity building, transformative leadership, success factors and challenges all are contributing factors of RRI that translates into performance of multispeciality hospitals in Kenya. The study found that limited resources, high staff turnover, resistance to change, and partial staff involvement hindered effective RRI implementation. It also noted a lack of insight into long-term impacts. Recommendations include developing a clear RRI framework, using tailored training methods, adopting modern leadership styles, improving the work environment, and conducting further research on RRI’s role in hospital performance.

https://openalex.org/W7214822073.abstractZh: 据报道，多专科医院在绩效管理中面临挑战，难以确定能够体现组织目标的适当绩效指标。快速成果计划被认定为一种绩效管理工具，有助于在较短时间内实现组织目标。本研究调查了快速成果计划在肯尼亚农村地区的多专科医院绩效中的影响。研究变量包括：快速成果计划的监测、能力建设、变革型领导、成功因素以及实施中的挑战。研究基于目标设定和资源基础理论，采用混合研究设计，通过普查法抽取了39名受访者作为样本。数据通过专用软件进行分析，结果以表格、图表形式呈现。研究发现，快速成果计划对肯尼亚多专科医院的绩效有显著影响。然而，研究也发现，快速成果计划的监测、能力建设、变革型领导、成功因素及实施中的挑战都是影响其绩效的重要因素。研究还指出，资源有限、员工流动率高、对变革的抵触情绪以及员工参与度不足等因素都阻碍了快速成果计划的有效实施。此外，研究还发现缺乏对长期影响的了解。建议包括制定明确的快速成果计划框架、采用定制化的培训方法、采用现代领导风格、改善工作环境，以及进一步研究快速成果计划在医院绩效中的作用。
